All of Wainwatch's strength rides behind you. +5 party size.
战车哨站的全部兵力策马追随你。部队人数上限+5。
All that is gold does not glitter, not all those who wander are lost.
金子不一定闪闪发光，流浪的人也不一定迷失了方向。
All that knowledge - does it weigh heavily?
那么多知识，会不会很沉重？
All the hill-clans answer your war-call. +4 party size.
所有丘陵氏族都会回应你的战争号召。+4 部队规模。
All three heroes may fight at once.
三名英雄可以同时参战。

All wanderers (default): every wanderer, by culture. Named companions only: just the lore characters from named_companions.xml (Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli and the rest); generic tavern wanderers hire as in vanilla.
所有流浪者（默认）：按文化判断所有流浪者。仅知名同伴：只限制 named_companions.xml 中的原著人物，如阿拉贡、莱戈拉斯、吉姆利等；普通酒馆流浪者仍按原版规则雇佣。
允许远程安排建设队列
允许选择索隆和那兹古尔
Almost no influence required to march
行军几乎不需要影响力
Almost no influence to muster armies
集结军队几乎不需要影响力
Along the southern shore you find a sheltered cove where the black ships of the Corsairs of Umbar lie at anchor.
在南方海岸边，你发现一处受遮蔽的海湾，乌姆巴尔的海盗的黑船正停泊在那里。
Alpha Howl boosts mount resilience while active.
头狼嚎叫生效期间，会增强坐骑韧性。
Alpha Howl charge greatly reduced, ride without ceasing.
头狼嚎叫充能消耗大幅降低，可以不停冲锋。
Alpha Howl charge reduced, swifter activation.
头狼嚎叫充能消耗降低，发动更加迅捷。
Alpha Howl duration extended, maintaining momentum.
头狼嚎叫持续时间延长，让冲锋势头保持更久。
Alpha Howl grants +5% melee damage and the pack hunts.
头狼嚎叫提供 +5% 近战伤害，狼群随之展开猎杀。
Alpha Howl radius expanded, sweeping wider formations.
头狼嚎叫作用范围扩大，可以扫过更宽的阵型。
Alpha Howl radius greatly expanded, unstoppable impact.
头狼嚎叫作用范围大幅扩大，冲击势不可挡。
Already a stronghold - the highest tier.
已经是最高等级的堡垒。

Also lists the wanderers of your culture. A wanderer has no clan, so instead of taking over a house they are adopted into the clan you named, with the banner you designed, and you lead it. Only 20 of 39 cultures have any wanderers.
同时列出所选文化的流浪者。流浪者没有家族，因此不会接管现有家族，而是加入你命名的家族，使用你设计的旗帜，并由你领导。39种文化中，只有20种有流浪者。
Also write every intercepted charge order and the state it produced to the TAOM log file. State transitions are logged regardless. Nothing is drawn on the HUD.
同时将每次截获的冲锋命令及其产生的状态写入 TAOM 日志。状态切换无论如何都会记录。不会在 HUD 上显示信息。
Altani of House Zorian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
佐里安家族的阿勒塔妮是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Altu is heir to the tribal holdings east of the inland sea.
阿勒涂是鲁恩内海以东部族领地的继承人。
阿琳妮丝是一名瓦里亚格贵族女子。
阿马尔贡是埃肯布兰德的继承人。

Amandir, Lord of Hirilionath, is the eldest of the Tier lords of Gondor, and his memory reaches back unto the boyhood of the Steward himself. His seat is at Ethring above the fords of the Ringlo, in upland Lamedon, where the hill-spearmen have served his house for nine generations. He bears the silver-on-sable banner of his fathers, and the long sword Tirnaith, named for a kinsman lost at the Dagorlad of old. In the matter of the king out of the North, Amandir has cast his weight with the claimant, holding that the Steward's oath was sworn until the king should come again, and that this hour, ere he himself passes, is that hour.

阿曼迪尔是希瑞利昂纳斯家族之主，也是刚铎梯级领主中最年长者，他的记忆能追溯到宰相本人年少的时候。他的驻地在凛格罗河浅滩上方的埃斯林，位于拉梅顿高地；那里山地矛兵已为他的家族效力九代。他举着祖先留下的黑底银纹旗帜，佩长剑提尔奈斯；此剑以一位在古老达戈拉德失踪的亲族命名。对于北方来的国王，阿曼迪尔已经把自己的分量押给这位宣称者，因为他认为宰相的誓言本就是直到国王归来为止，而在他本人离世之前，这一刻已经到来。
Amarië, spouse to Galenor, represents the enduring love themes in elven tales, her songs revitalizing the clan's spirits amid the growing gloom.
阿玛瑞依是加勒诺尔的配偶，代表精灵故事中历久不灭的爱。她的歌声在日益深重的阴郁中振奋族人的精神。
Ambition in Orthanc's shadow can be dangerous...
欧尔桑克阴影下的野心，可能很危险……
Ambition is no crime. A captain needs a company to prove himself.
有雄心不是罪。想证明能带兵，也得先有一队兵。
野心披着腐朽贵族的外衣。
Ambitious and treacherous, qualities that cut both ways.
既有野心，又会背叛，这两样都能反噬自己。
Ambush also increases troop ranged damage while active.
伏击生效期间，还会提高部队的远程伤害。
Ambush and lookout camps stay hidden - no supply convoys.
伏击营地和瞭望哨需要保持隐蔽，无法接收补给车队。
Ambush charge greatly reduced, becoming nearly always available.
伏击所需充能大幅减少，几乎随时都能发动。
Ambush charge requirement reduced, activating more frequently.
伏击所需充能减少，可以更频繁地发动。
Ambush duration extended, granting additional evasion.
伏击持续时间延长，并提供额外闪避能力。
Ambush grants +5% ranged damage and scales duration with Bow skill.
伏击提供+5%远程伤害，持续时间随弓技能提高而延长。
Ambush radius greatly increased, devastating arrow volleys.
伏击的作用范围大幅扩大，箭矢齐射更具毁伤力。
Ambush radius increased, arrows deal bonus damage from stealth.
伏击的作用范围扩大，从潜行中射出的箭矢造成额外伤害。
Amdûr Amdûrid leads a powerful clan of the eastern steppes.
阿姆杜里德家族的阿姆杜尔领导着东方草原上的一个强大氏族。
Amelia is a young noble of the eastern marches.
维日杜娜是东部边境的年轻贵族。
Among my kin, I learned that true craftsmanship transcends the physical. I shape worlds from nothing, sculpting beauty that rivals nature itself.
在族人中间，我学到真正的工艺并不局限于实体。我从无到有塑造世界，雕琢出足以媲美自然本身的美。
Among the bleak hills of the east you come upon a dwarf-camp of the Blacklocks, a clan long ago fallen into shadow and ruin.
在东方荒凉的丘陵间，你发现了一处黑发族矮人的营地。这个氏族早已堕入黑暗，走向衰败。
Among the spoils of the field lies {ITEM}, the harness of {LORD}'s household. It is yours by right of arms, though his kin would take its return as a courtesy.
战利品中有一件{ITEM}，是{LORD}家族的铠甲。按战场上的规矩，它归你所有；不过如果送还，领主的亲属会领你这份情。
Among the wooded hills of Dunland you spy a rough camp of hide tents and a crude palisade, half-hidden in a clearing.
在黑蛮地林木覆盖的丘陵间，你发现了一处粗陋营地，里面有兽皮帐篷和简陋木栅，半藏在一片林间空地里。
Amorcon serves alongside his kinsman in the guard.
阿莫尔孔与他的族亲一同在卫队中效力。
Amrothos, youngest son of Imrahil, is still young but already shows his family's martial spirit and noble character.
阿姆洛梭斯是伊姆拉希尔最小的儿子，年纪尚轻，却已展现出家族的尚武精神和高贵品格。
Amrúnbar lies on the eastern shore of the isle of Tolfalas, below Caras Tolfalas. Its herders graze cattle on the grassy downs above the sea and ship salted beef to Dol Amroth.
阿姆伦巴尔位于托尔法拉斯岛的东岸，卡拉斯托尔法拉斯下方。牧民在海边上方的草坡放牛，再把腌牛肉用船运往多阿姆洛斯。
An Elven realm in the northern reaches of Mirkwood, where the Wood-elves maintain their ancient forests against the creeping darkness from the south.
尼尔多瑞斯是黑森林北部的精灵国度，森林精灵在这里守护古老的森林，抵御从南方蔓延而来的黑暗。
An Ironwood hewer of Angáladh who swings a great axe in both hands, splitting shields and the orcs behind them.
安加拉兹的铁木伐木手，双手挥舞巨斧，劈开盾牌，连同盾后的奥克一并斩倒。
An Uruk moderator? The world truly has changed.
一个乌鲁克管理员？这个世界真的变了。
An Uruk teaching instead of taking? Saruman would be appalled.
一个教导别人而不是掠夺别人的乌鲁克？萨茹曼会气坏的。
An Uruk-Hai who creates? That defies everything I know of your kind.
一个会创造的乌鲁克？这和我对你们种族的认知完全相反。
An Uruk-hai who helps rather than harms? That's unprecedented.
一个帮人而不是害人的乌鲁克？这可前所未有。
An abandoned refuge stands here, beyond repair. It can only be dismantled.
这里有一座废弃的避难所，已无法修复，只能拆除。
An alliance has been forged between {PLAYER_KINGDOM} and {TARGET_KINGDOM}.
An armor-piercing specialist of the Lôkhas Drûs corps who trains to drive arrows through the heaviest plate at range.
洛卡斯德鲁斯军团的破甲专家，专门训练在远距离以箭矢贯穿重型板甲。

An armored champion of the North-kingdom, whose thundering charge has broken countless enemy formations. The Knight of Arthedain combines Arthedain discipline with Fornost's proud cavalry tradition, becoming an immovable wall of steel.
北方王国的披甲勇士，雷霆般的冲锋已击溃无数敌阵。阿塞丹骑士将严明的军纪与佛诺斯特引以为傲的骑兵传统融为一体，成为坚不可摧的钢铁壁垒。

An armored champion of the coastal fiefdom of Belfalas, whose thundering charge has broken countless enemy formations. The Knight of Belfalas combines Gondorian discipline with Dol Amroth's proud cavalry tradition, becoming an immovable wall of steel.
贝尔法拉斯沿海封地的重甲勇士，雷霆般的冲锋曾击溃无数敌阵。贝尔法拉斯骑士兼具刚铎的纪律和多阿姆洛斯骄傲的骑兵传统，如同一堵移动的钢铁之墙。

An armored champion of the hill kingdom, whose thundering charge has broken countless enemy formations. The Rider of the Fells combines Rhudaur discipline with Cameth Brin's proud cavalry tradition, becoming an immovable wall of steel.

Another party's troop count on the campaign map blurs with its distance from you: '1??', '12?', then exact as you close in, and '...' at the very edge of sight. Standing closer, a higher Scouting skill and hosts of your own realm all sharpen it. Wounded and prisoner counts show only when the count is exact. A count you read stays remembered with a '~' and fades by the hour, and reading an enemy host's count from afar trains your scout's Scouting; Off stops both. AI lords still see true numbers. A host's orders in its hover tooltip stay hidden until its count is exact. Off = vanilla counts and orders. Applies immediately. Default: on.

战役地图上，其他部队的人数会随与你的距离变得模糊，先显示“1??”“12?”，靠近后才显示精确人数，视野最边缘则显示“...”。距离更近、侦察技能更高，以及对方属于本国，都会提高辨识精度。只有人数精确时，才显示伤兵和俘虏数量。你读出的数字会暂时保留，并加上“~”，随后逐小时失效；远距离探查敌军人数还会锻炼侦察兵的侦察技能。关闭后，这两项效果都会停止。AI领主仍能看见真实人数。鼠标悬停提示中的部队命令，也会隐藏到人数能够精确显示为止。关闭后使用原版人数和命令显示。立即生效。默认：开启。

A master strategist and a shrewd manipulator, Ar-Gimilkhâd wields both the sword and the mind with deadly precision. Under his rule, Umbar thrives as a haven for raiders and seafarers, its dark ships spreading fear across the coasts of Middle-earth. Ar-Gimilkhâd's vision of dominance extends beyond the seas, as he forges alliances with the forces of shadow and prepares to unleash the might of Umbar against the Free Peoples. His charisma and iron-fisted rule ensure loyalty among his captains, while his name strikes terror into the hearts of his enemies.

Arnach serves as the traditional seat and stronghold of Lord Forlong, though the corpulent lord maintains closer personal ties to Imloth Melui through his marriage to Lady Vanyalos. The town represents the administrative and military center of Lossarnach, where taxes are collected, justice dispensed, and the fiefdom's military forces mustered.The settlement takes its name from the ancient pre-Númenórean kingdom of Arnach that once controlled these valleys, preserving a connection to peoples who lived here millennia before Gondor's founding. This antiquity shows in the town's layout - irregular streets following ancient pathways rather than the ordered planning typical of Númenórean cities, and foundations incorporating stonework whose origins are lost to time.

阿尔那赫是佛朗领主传统上的治所和堡垒，不过这位身材肥胖的领主因娶了瓦妮亚洛斯夫人，与伊姆洛丝美路伊保持着更紧密的私人联系。城镇是洛斯阿尔那赫的行政和军事中心，税赋在这里征收，司法在这里施行，封地军队也在这里集结。聚落得名于古老的前努门诺尔王国阿尔那赫；那个王国曾控制这些山谷，使此地保留着与刚铎建立前数千年古老民族的联系。这份古老感也体现在城镇布局上：街道不规则地沿着旧路延伸，而不是努门诺尔城市常见的规整规划；许多地基还混入了来源早已不可考的古老石工。
Arthamund serves as a captain of the Hornburg garrison.
阿萨蒙德担任号角堡守军队长。
Arthedain still holds Fornost, and our cousins hold Cardolan and Rhudaur, but the wild lands between them answer to no king. That is where my people keep their watch, and where I have spent my years.
阿塞丹仍守着佛诺斯特，我们的亲族也保有卡多蓝和鲁道尔，但三国之间的荒野不听命于任何国王。我的族人就在那里守望，而我大半辈子也都在那里度过。
Arthedain's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #A0B4D8.
阿塞丹在地图上的颜色，格式为#RRGGBB。留空使用默认值#A0B4D8。
Arwa is a princess of the desert tribes.
阿尔瓦是沙漠部族的公主。

As a Tribal Skirmisher, you learned to ambush Rohirrim outriders in the passes, hurling javelins and vanishing into the ridgeline before they could counter. The old grudge against the horse-lords lived in every throw.
作为部族散兵，你学会了在山口伏击洛希尔人的斥骑，投出标枪，再赶在他们反击前躲到山脊后面。你投出的每一支标枪，都带着对驭马者的旧恨。
As a member of the Uruk-thar, you learned to fight with thrown weapons and sword in the Easterling skirmishing tradition.
作为乌鲁克萨尔的一员，你学习东夷散兵传统，以投掷武器和刀剑作战。
As a member of the garrison, you defended the rebuilt gates of Dale, learning the art of siege defense from veterans who had seen the city fall and rise again.
作为守军一员，你保卫重建后的河谷邦城门，向见过城市陷落又重生的老兵学习围城防御。
As a spearman of the Eastfold, you learned to hold the shieldwall against the enemy's charge.
作为东伏尔德矛兵，你学会在敌人冲锋面前守住盾墙。
As a spearman of the Northmark you learned to hold the line with spear and shield against a charge.
作为北境矛兵，你学会用矛和盾守住阵线，抵挡冲锋。
As a whelp, I crushed skulls better than any in my pit. 'You're a beast among goblins,' they'd growl. I boast not, these are facts. When I grew fangs, I left to claim glory.
我还是幼崽时，砸碎头骨就比坑里谁都强。他们会低吼着说：“你是半兽人里的野兽。”我不是吹牛，这都是事实。等我长出獠牙，我就离开那里，去夺取荣耀。
As at the Fields of the Pelennor, your charge is unstoppable. +15% horse charge damage.
如同佩兰诺平野之战，你的冲锋不可阻挡。+15% 坐骑冲锋伤害。
As in the great battles of the plain, your charge is unstoppable. +15% horse charge damage.
如同平原上的历次大战，你的冲锋势不可挡。+15%坐骑冲锋伤害。
As part of Erebor's garrison, you manned the crossbows and held the gates against all comers, learning the art of dwarven siege defense.
作为孤山守军的一员，你操作弩机，守住大门，抵御所有来犯者，并学习矮人围城防御之道。
As part of the garrison of Belegost, you manned the crossbows on the gate-towers and held the passes against all comers, learning the craft of dwarven siege defence.
你曾在贝烈戈斯特的驻军中服役，操作城门塔楼上的弩，挡住所有进犯隘口的敌人，并学会了矮人的守城本领。

Asela is a shieldmaiden who guards the Deeping Coomb.
阿塞拉是守卫深谷宽谷的盾女。
Ashisa is wife to the raider captain.
阿希莎是这位劫掠队长的妻子。

刺客，被利用又被抛弃后逃离魔多的权力斗争。杀人精准老练。

突击首领，因在仪式决斗中杀死上级军官而被流放。看重力量胜过权谋。

以雷鸣般的群狼嚎叫宣示支配：+25% 冲锋伤害，+20% 坐骑速度，+10% 近战伤害，持续 8 秒。
Astrid Bearclaw is known for her ferocious fighting style and bear-skin cloak.
“熊爪”阿斯特丽德以凶猛的战斗风格和熊皮披风闻名。

At Blue Craig the quays were my business, and the council asked me to plan every raid that left them. I took elf-wine from the Lindon coast and traded it for dwarf-iron from the old Blue Mountain roads, and took a share from each end. The council knew and did not care. I paid them well to know less.
我在蓝岩管码头，议会要我安排每次出海劫掠。我从林顿海岸抢精灵葡萄酒，换蓝色山脉古道上运来的矮人铁料，两头都抽成。议会知道，也不在乎。我给足他们钱，让他们少知道点。

At Mount Gram I mended the chieftain's wounded and kept the tally-bones. Every skull from the last great defeat went on my strings, ours and theirs, and I knew who lived and who was owed. Nobody counts the counter.
我在格拉姆山给酋长的伤兵治伤，也管记账的骨头。上次大败后，每颗头骨，不管谁的，都串到我的绳上。我知道谁还活着，该给谁记账，却没人想到查查记账的我。

At a faction's key settlements (capitals), speak with the faction emissary to buy that faction's elite troops for its special resource (Castar, War Spoils, Gems...). Conquering a settlement flips its offerings to the new owner.
在阵营的重要聚落（首都）中，与阵营使者交谈，可以用该阵营的特殊资源，如卡斯塔尔、战争战利品或宝石，招募精锐兵种。聚落被攻占后，可招募的兵种会改为新统治者的兵种。

At court, I witnessed the great lords squabbling over precedence while ignoring the realm's decay. They debate bloodlines and ancient claims while orcs mass at our borders. When I spoke against this folly, they mocked me as an idealistic fool.
在宫廷里，我目睹了那些大领主们为排位次序争执不休，却对王国的衰败视而不见。他们争论着血统和古老的权利主张，而奥克正在我们的边境集结。当我反对这种愚蠢行径时，他们嘲笑我是个理想主义的傻瓜。
At fourteen I was taken in by a healer who kept the infirmary at Egladil. She taught me to sew a wound and set a bone, and to bear what cannot be cured. I worked her ward through three winters.
十四岁时，埃格拉迪尔医馆的一位医者收留了我。她教我缝伤口、接骨，也教我承受那些治不好的病痛。我在她的病房里干了三个冬天。
At fourteen I was taken in by a healer who kept the infirmary at Minas Eithel. She taught me to sew a wound and set a bone, and to bear what cannot be cured. I worked her ward through three winters.
十四岁时，米那斯艾塞尔医馆的一位医者收留了我。她教我缝伤口、接骨，也教我承受那些治不好的病痛。我在她的病房里干了三个冬天。
At fourteen I was taken in by a healer who kept the old infirmary of Annúminas. She taught me to sew a wound and set a bone, and to bear what cannot be cured. I worked her ward through three winters.
十四岁时，安努米那斯老医馆的一位医者收留了我。她教我缝伤口、接骨，也教我承受那些治不好的病痛。我在她的病房里干了三个冬天。

Aurzan of House Vazevian rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
瓦泽维安家族的奥尔赞率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。

贝奥恩大厅持斧守望者

Aye, born among endless plains and rolling hills. That vastness taught me to see the world as it could be, not just as it is. Now I recreate that majesty wherever I go.
是啊，我出生在无边的平原与起伏的丘陵之间。那份辽阔教会我看见世界可能成为的样子，而不只是它现在的模样。如今，我把那种壮美带到所到之处。
Aye, every system, every feature, every breath of life in this world flows from the forge of my imagination. I brought together the finest craftsmen and gave them purpose.
没错，每个系统、每个功能、这个世界里的每一口生命气息，都来自我想象力的熔炉。我把最出色的工匠聚到一起，并赋予他们目标。

行，咱们可以谈。就算是海盗，也更喜欢鼓鼓的钱袋，不喜欢满甲板的血。你出多少？[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]

Azgar, the Warlord of Gundabad, is a fearsome orc chieftain who rules the northern orc stronghold with an iron fist, echoing the dark legacy of Azog and Bolg from Tolkien's tales. Towering and scarred from countless battles, he unites the clans through sheer brutality and cunning, harboring a deep-seated grudge against the Dwarves who once claimed Gundabad as their own. As the primary leader, Azgar plots to reclaim the Misty Mountains' peaks, serving the growing shadow in the East while crushing any dissent among his kin.
阿兹加尔，贡达巴德军阀，是一名可怖的奥克酋长。他以铁腕统治北方奥克要塞，延续着托尔金故事中阿佐格与波尔格的黑暗遗产。他高大魁梧，满身战痕，靠纯粹的残暴与狡诈把各氏族捏合在一起，并对曾经宣称贡达巴德属于自己的矮人怀有深仇。作为主要领袖，阿兹加尔谋划夺回迷雾山脉的诸峰；他一边服务东方日益壮大的阴影，一边碾碎族人中的任何异议。
Azina is daughter of a raiding captain.
阿齐娜是劫掠队长的女儿。
Azrak commands the serpent riders of the far south.
阿兹拉克统领极南之地的巨蛇骑手。
Azruphel is fourteen and already rides with the Morannon patrols. Her name means Sea-Daughter, for a sea no living Black Numenorean has laid eyes on.
阿兹鲁斐尔才十四岁，就已经随魔栏农的巡逻队骑马巡行。她的名字意为“海之女”，但那片海，如今活着的黑努门诺尔人谁也没亲眼见过。

Back off, maggot. The whole warren waits in the rocks above you, hungry, waiting for a signal.
退后，蛆虫。整窝人都在你头顶的乱石间等着，肚子饿得很，只等一个信号。
Back to the line, then. What I carry goes with the commission; the ranks do not hand it back. You are certain of this?
那我就回去当兵了。我身上的装备是受任命时领的，回去以后不会再还给我。你确定吗？
Bagai serves as a captain of the royal guard.
巴盖担任王家卫队队长。
Baidar of House Zorian is counted among the keen horse-archers of Rhûn, loosing his shafts from the saddle at a full gallop.
佐里安家族的拜答儿是鲁恩出色的骑射手之一，能在战马全速奔驰时从马背上射出箭矢。

Balatar, cousin-german to Lord Amandir, has kept the lower hall of Ethring these forty years and is reckoned among the last men living who remembers the funeral of Steward Turgon. He is broad-shouldered yet, though his beard is wholly white, and the household captains seek him out for tales of campaigns long ended. He stands with his kinsman Amandir for the King, saying it is meet that an old man should see the old oath fulfilled ere he is laid in stone.
巴拉塔尔是阿曼迪尔领主的堂亲，四十年来一直照看埃斯林下厅，也是最后几个还记得宰相图尔巩葬礼的人之一。他仍然肩膀宽阔，只是胡须已全白；家族队长们常来找他，听他讲述早已结束的战役。他与亲族阿曼迪尔一起支持国王，说老人能在入土前看见古老誓言兑现，才算合宜。

Bar Elir enjoys a reputation throughout Lamedon for possessing the most fertile soil in the entire fiefdom - a gift of the converging rivers that annually deposit rich sediment across the surrounding fields. The farmstead sprawls across the river junction with numerous homesteads, grain storage barns, and water-powered mills taking advantage of the strong currents where the two waterways meet. Unlike the sheep-focused settlements of northern Lamedon, Bar Elir specializes in intensive agriculture: wheat, barley, vegetables, and orchards that supply Calembel and contribute to the food stores of Dol Amroth. The rivers also provide abundant freshwater fish, particularly prized in coastal cities where Bar Elir's fishermen trade their catches. During planting and harvest seasons, the population swells with temporary laborers from less fertile areas, creating a lively atmosphere uncommon in the usually sedate countryside. The confluence itself is marked by an ancient stone bridge - possibly of Númenórean construction - that carries the eastern road toward Pelargir. The prosperity brought by fertile land has made Bar Elir's buildings more substantial than typical farmsteads, with several manorial estates belonging to wealthy landholder families who pledge allegiance to Lord Angbor in Calembel.

巴尔埃利尔在拉梅顿享有盛名，因为它拥有整个封地最肥沃的土地；这份恩赐来自汇流河水每年带来的丰厚泥沙。农庄铺展在河流交汇处，许多宅院、粮仓和水力磨坊借助两条水道相遇时的强劲水流运转。与拉梅顿北部以养羊为主的聚落不同，巴尔埃利尔专精于集约农业，种植小麦、大麦、蔬菜和果树，供应卡伦贝尔，也为多阿姆洛斯的粮仓作出贡献。河流还带来充足淡水鱼，在沿海城市尤其受欢迎，巴尔埃利尔的渔民会把渔获送去交易。播种和收获季节，来自贫瘠地区的临时劳工会使村中人口大增，给通常安静的乡间带来少见的热闹气氛。交汇处有一座古老石桥，很可能出自努门诺尔工匠之手，承载着通往佩拉基尔的东路。肥沃土地带来的繁荣让巴尔埃利尔的建筑比普通农庄更为坚固，还出现了几处属于富有地主家族的庄园；这些家族都向卡伦贝尔的安格博领主效忠。
Barandil, brother of Golasgil, serves as a captain of the coastal watch of Anfalas.
巴兰迪尔是戈拉斯吉尔的兄弟，担任安法拉斯海岸守望队长。
Barandor, son of Hirluin, trains to one day lead the warriors of Pinnath Gelin. He rides with his father's green-clad company.
巴兰多尔是希尔路因的儿子，正在训练自己，有朝一日将领导品那斯盖林战士。他随父亲那支绿衣队伍骑行。
Baranor serves as a captain in the Lossarnach contingent, a trusted officer of Lord Forlong.
巴拉诺尔是洛斯阿尔那赫队伍中的队长，是佛朗领主信赖的军官。
Baranthir keeps the northern eaves of the Golden Wood, where his patrols have turned back orc-bands out of Moria beyond counting.
巴兰希尔守卫着金色森林的北部林缘。他的巡逻队已经击退了无数支从墨瑞亚出来的奥克队伍。

Bard's rebuilt city beneath Erebor. The rich grain of the Long Lake and a hardy tradition of mustering at low cost pair with the Vale Traders' speed on open ground, though Dale's council can be as stubborn as it is proud. A thriving trade alliance with the Dwarves keeps the city rich and ready.
巴德重建的城市，坐落在孤山脚下。长湖丰饶的谷物、低成本集结军队的坚韧传统，与河谷商人在开阔地上的速度相得益彰，不过河谷邦议会既骄傲又固执。与矮人之间繁荣的贸易联盟，让城市始终富足，随时做好准备。
Bargha of the Throgmaw orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
巴尔加是斯罗格莫氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Barred from sire's pit. Embraced warrior path dreamed. But tales of honored she-orcs lie for kinless. Fight for scraps now.
我被挡在父亲的坑外，于是走上了自己梦里的战士之路。但那些关于受尊敬女奥克的传说，对没有亲族的人来说都是谎话。如今我只能为残羹剩饭而战。
Bartered along the trade roads of the East.

战斗：{B}  平民：{C}  坐骑：{M}
战场医师能救很多人的命。
Battlefield scavenger turned black marketeer. Fled Mordor after selling military equipment to enemies.
战场拾荒者，后来成了黑市商。把军用装备卖给敌人后逃离魔多。
Battles are won in the mind before a single blade is drawn...
真正的战斗，在第一把刀出鞘前就已经于头脑中分出胜负……
Bayalun of House Zorian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
佐里安家族的巴雅伦是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Be warned, traveller. The whole warband rests in the next wadi, spears ready, waiting for a single signal from us.
提醒你，过路的。整个战团就在旁边的干河谷里歇着，长矛都备好了，只等我们一个信号。
Beacon-keepers see smoke and call it fire. A sensible lord waits for proof.
守烽火台的人看见烟就说着火。明智的领主会等证据。
Beasag is a Variag warrior of the northern clans.
贝萨格是北部氏族的瓦里亚格战士。
贝萨格是卡尔菲德的妻子。

Before an assault, or before defending a siege, open the 'Manage Troops' screen the lord's hall fight uses and choose who fights. By default, trolls start unticked; tick them to bring them. Troops you leave out take no part in the battle and suffer no losses in it. Takes effect from the next assault. As defender, pressing Escape in the battle surrenders the siege and everyone with it, reserves included. When off, every troop fights as in vanilla. Default: on.
攻城或守城前，打开领主大厅战斗使用的“管理部队”界面，选择谁参战。食人妖默认不勾选，需要时自行勾选。没有选中的士兵不参加战斗，也不会在其中损失。下次攻城起生效。守城方在战斗中按 Escape 会投降，所有人（包括预备队）都会一同投降。关闭时，所有士兵按原版规则参战。默认：开启。

Before the gate of Minas Tirith the Steward of Gondor offers up the white rod of his office, and the King gives it back to him. Then the ancient crown of the kings is set upon the head of {HERO}.{newline}After long years an heir of Isildur sits upon the throne of Gondor, and the {CLAN} rules the realm from {SEAT}.
在米那斯提力斯城门前，刚铎宰相献上他职位的白色权杖，国王又把它交还给他。随后，古代诸王的王冠被戴在{HERO}头上。{newline}多年之后，伊熙尔杜的继承人终于坐上刚铎王座，{CLAN}以{SEAT}为都统治这个王国。
战斗开始时进入观望之椅
Beleg, a strong bowman of Nos Oropher, draws from the lore of Beleg Strongbow, friend to Túrin, excelling in forest ambushes against orc incursions.
贝烈格是欧洛斐尔一族中强健的弓手，原型来自图林的挚友、强弓贝烈格。他擅长在森林中设伏，对付奥克入侵。
Believers flock to your banner. +4 party size.
信徒纷纷聚到你的旗帜下。+4 部队规模。
Belwen, wife of Angbor, stands steadfastly by her husband in the defense of Lamedon.
贝尔玟是安格博的妻子，在拉梅顿防务中坚定地支持丈夫。
Beneath the crags of the Misty Mountains you find a foul warren of Gundabad orcs burrowed into the bare rock.
在迷雾山脉峭壁下方，你发现贡达巴德奥克在裸岩中挖出的一处污秽巢穴。

Beornings came down on the forge-gate in a night of snow. Bears the size of ponies. They broke the slave chains and let the dwarves loose, and the dwarves had my own hammers. I killed nine of them with their own steel. The fire took the rest of the forge, and my brothers with it.
一个雪夜，贝奥恩一族袭击了锻坊大门，是小马那么大的熊。他们扯断锁链，放出矮人奴隶，矮人拿起的却是我的锤子。我用他们自己打出的兵器杀了九个，大火烧掉了剩下的锻坊，也烧死了我的兄弟们。
Beregund Wolfborn is a trusted captain of Dunland, known for his skill in raiding Rohirric settlements.
“狼裔”贝瑞贡德是黑蛮地深受信任的队长，以擅长劫掠洛希尔人的聚落而闻名。
Berethiel, wife of Forlong, is the Lady of Lossarnach. She oversees the fertile valleys while her husband rides to war.
贝瑞希尔是佛朗的妻子，也是洛斯阿尔那赫夫人。丈夫骑马出征时，她负责照管肥沃山谷。
Berke of House Kalkian rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
卡尔基安家族的别儿哥率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
挣脱锁链的狂战士之力，想想都可怕。
Berserker too violent even for Isengard. Escaped rather than die in a suicide assault.
狂战士，凶暴到连艾森加德都难以驾驭。为了不死在自杀突击里逃走了。
Berserker who killed his officers during a mission. Uncontrolled but devastatingly effective.
狂战士，在任务中杀死了自己的军官。不受控制，但破坏力惊人。
Berserker who turned on his own commanders, unpredictable.
反过来杀自己指挥官的狂战士，难以预测。
贝特莉安娜是卢坎德的妻子。
最佳纪录：击退{WAVES}波，击杀{KILLS}人
Best turn around, stranger. Half the clan waits in the heather behind those ridges, and they are not patient.
最好回头，外乡人。族里有一半的人就埋伏在那些山脊后的石楠丛里，他们可没多少耐心。
野兽般的多古尔都恶棍
野兽般的贡达巴德恶棍
野兽般的乌姆巴尔暴徒
Betrayer of Saruman himself, audacious or suicidal.
背叛萨茹曼本人，究竟是胆大，还是找死。
Better to choose your battles than have them chosen.
自己选择战斗，总比被战斗选中要好。
Big creatures shrug off hits below a per-creature damage threshold — no flinch-locking a troll with arrows. Thresholds live in combat_mechanics_config.json.
大型生物受到低于各自伤害阈值的攻击时，不会产生硬直，因此不能再用箭矢把食人妖打得一直无法行动。阈值位于 combat_mechanics_config.json。
Bite damage as a percentage of the spider's base bite (100 = the ridden spider's damage).
撕咬伤害占蜘蛛基础撕咬伤害的百分比。100等同被骑乘蜘蛛的伤害。
Bjornric Strongarm is a mighty warrior who wields a great war axe in battle.
“强臂”比约恩里克是一名强大的战士，在战场上挥舞着巨大的战斧。
Black Arrow charge greatly reduced, relentless fire.
黑箭充能消耗大幅降低，火力毫不间断。
Black Arrow charge reduced, maintaining constant pressure.
黑箭充能消耗降低，可以持续向敌人施压。

黑箭提供 +5% 远程伤害，以此纪念神箭手巴德。
Black Arrow radius greatly expanded, inescapable volleys.
黑箭作用范围大幅扩大，齐射让敌人无处可逃。
Black Arrow radius increased, covering wider kill zones.
黑箭作用范围扩大，可以覆盖更宽的杀伤区域。
Black Arrows: your archers deal 4 times the damage to towers.
黑箭：你的弓兵对防御塔造成4倍伤害。
Black Númenórean officer fled after political maneuvering went wrong. Seeks power through any means.
黑努门诺尔军官，政治算计失败后逃离魔多。为获得权力不择手段。
Black market operator with quality goods.
Black sails are far off, traveller, but black blades are close. The corsairs of Umbar claim every road they walk. Pay the landing fee, or we take it from your pack.
黑帆还在远处，过路的，黑刀可已经到眼前了。乌姆巴尔海盗走过的路，都归我们管。交上岸费，不然我们自己翻你的行囊。
Black-forged tips pierce deeper. +8% armour penetration.
黑铁打造的箭镞能刺得更深。+8% 破甲。
Blade for hire, duels my trade. Banned for bloodlust, now here.
受雇的刀，靠决斗吃饭。因嗜血被禁，如今来到这里。
Blade for hire, to fat purses. Recall sire's craft, do what's needed. World showed no pity, nor I.
我给钱袋够鼓的人卖刀。我还记得我爹的手艺，也会做该做的事。这个世界没有怜悯过我，我也不会怜悯它。
Blend into the forest shadows — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
融入森林的阴影之中：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。
Bless you, traveller. You have saved us.
祝福你，旅人。你救了我们。
Blood Rage charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.
血之狂怒充能消耗大幅降低，几乎随时可用。

血仇能毁掉整支军队，我为什么要替你打？
Blows that would fell lesser orcs only anger you. +5% blunt resistance.
足以击倒弱小奥克的重击，只会让你更加愤怒。+5% 钝击抗性。

蓝岩狂暴提供+5生命值，并让你麾下的食人妖陷入狂暴。

蓝岩狂暴生效期间，会提供额外防御加成。

蓝岩狂暴作用范围大幅扩大，释放出毁灭性的力量。

蓝岩狂暴作用范围扩大，可以强化更多战士。
Blue stone under my nails. Does it show? It always shows.
指甲缝里都是蓝石，看得见吗？总也藏不住。
Blunt (wound-only) damage chance in player battles. Vanilla = 0.30.
玩家参与的战斗中，结算为钝击伤害（只会受伤，不会死亡）的概率。原版为0.30。
Blunt damage chance in AI vs AI battles. Vanilla = 0.10.
AI之间的战斗中，结算为钝击伤害的概率。原版为0.10。
Boarding Action charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.
登船突袭充能消耗大幅降低，几乎随时可用。

登船突袭充能消耗降低，可以更频繁发动。

登船突袭作用范围扩大，可以强化更多战士。
Boasting? Ha! My axe has felled more foes than you've had hot meals! But I seek companions worthy of a dwarf's loyalty. Perhaps you'll do.
大话？哈！我斧下倒过的敌人，比你吃过的热饭还多！不过，我要找的是配得上矮人忠诚的同伴。也许你还算合适。
Bodkin archer of the river meadows.
使用锥头箭的河畔草甸弓手。
Bolat serves in the royal household.
博拉特在王室家中效力。
大胆的罗瓦尼安帮派头目
大胆的里德马克帮派头目
勇猛的乌姆巴尔海盗领主
勇猛的伊姆拉缀斯精灵领主
勇猛的洛丝罗瑞恩精灵领主
勇猛的黑森林精灵领主
勇猛的米斯泷德精灵领主
大胆的长湖镇帮派头目
Bolg is a powerful Orc chieftain, descended from Azog the Defiler.
波尔格是一名强大的奥克酋长，是玷污者阿佐格的后裔。
Bolg of the Grobûrz warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
波尔格是格罗布尔兹战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Bolg's brood did not like one with Azog's name beating them. They called a feud. They held me down and carved the ring-scar across my jaw, and left me in the snow to die for the shame of it.
波尔格那窝崽子，见不得顶着阿佐格名号的家伙赢他们，就挑起血仇。他们按住我，在下巴上刻了一圈伤痕，把我丢在雪里，让我带着耻辱等死。
波尔格麾下的精锐重装战列。
Bolga is the Skull Crushers' champion, having bested every challenger in the fighting pits. Her strength is legendary among the Uruk-hai.
博尔加是碎颅者的斗士冠军，曾在格斗坑中击败每一个挑战者。她的力量在乌鲁克中堪称传奇。
Bolgath leads his clan with the vengeful spirit of Bolg from The Hobbit, seeking to avenge ancient defeats. His aggressive expansion pushes Gundabad's borders southward.
波尔加斯以《霍比特人》中波尔格的复仇精神领导氏族，试图为古老败绩报仇。他激进扩张，把贡达巴德的边界向南推进。
Bolgrat holds a watchpost on the road to Cirith Ungol, and feuds quietly with the tower garrison over the counting of the dead.
博尔格拉特驻守通往奇立斯乌苟道路上的哨所。他因清点死者的事，与塔内驻军暗中结下了仇。
Bolzga of the Morzûk orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
博尔兹加是莫尔祖克氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Bones lie as often as I do. Let me fight under your banner.
骨头跟我一样爱撒谎，让我到你的旗下来打仗吧。
边境目标判定修正半径
Borhador, Lord of Barahirionath, is one of the eldest lords of Gondor. His long years have given him wisdom, though his body weakens with age. His counsel is respected by all.
博尔哈多尔，巴拉希瑞昂纳斯家族之主，是刚铎最年长的领主之一。漫长岁月给予他智慧，尽管身体已随年老衰弱。他的建议受到所有人尊重。
Borlach of House Hûz rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
胡兹家族的玻拉赫率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。

Born after the dragon's death, I grew up hearing tales of Thorin's Company, the Battle of Five Armies. My elders have their glory, I have only prosperity and peace. Trained with the Iron Hills regiment, learned crossbow and tactics, but never tested them.
我出生在巨龙死后，从小听着梭林远征队和五军之战的故事长大。长辈们有他们的荣耀，而我只有繁荣与和平。我在铁丘陵军团受训，学会了弩和战术，却从没真正检验过它们。

Born in the fighting pits, bred for pure aggression. They fed us man-flesh and set us against each other to select the strongest. I survived. More than survived, I excelled. The berserker rage flows through me like fire. In battle, I am unstoppable, a force of destruction.
我生在斗坑里，被培育成纯粹的攻击性。他们喂我们人肉，让我们互相厮杀，从中选出最强者。我活下来了。不只是活下来了，我还胜过其他人。狂战士的怒火像火一样在我体内流动。战斗中，我势不可挡，是一股毁灭之力。

Born in the shadow of the Black Gate, I've known nothing but Mordor's rule. Trained as an assassin, I served the Mouth of Sauron directly, eliminating traitors, silencing dissent, removing obstacles. I was good at it. Very good. Fear is an excellent teacher, and I've perfected its lessons.
我出生在黑门的阴影下，从小只知道魔多的统治。我被训练成刺客，曾直接听命于索隆之口，清除叛徒、压下异议、移除障碍。我很擅长，非常擅长。恐惧是绝佳的老师，而我已经把它的课程练到了极致。

Born into the noble line of the House of Caladionath, Eldorion can trace his mighty ancestry back to the ancient island kingdom of Númenor and has ever been a most noble and honorable vassal of Lord Denethor. Now, as the shadow in the east grows longer and his days grow old, he once again must take up arms, defend his liege and be the northernmost bulwark against the incoming tidal wave of darkness. And yet, through these dark days, hope remains and the banners of Lord Eldorion may fly high once more.
埃尔多瑞昂出身卡拉迪昂纳斯家族的高贵血脉，他能把自己的显赫祖先追溯到古老的岛屿王国努门诺尔，也一直是德内梭尔领主最高贵、最光荣的封臣。如今东方阴影越发漫长，他也日渐年老，却必须再次拿起武器，保卫自己的君主，成为抵挡黑暗浪潮的最北屏障。即便身处这些黑暗岁月，希望仍未熄灭，埃尔多瑞昂领主的旗帜也终将再次高高飘扬。
Born warrior exiled for refusing a pointless duel. I seek real battles, not tavern brawls.
天生的战士，因拒绝无意义的决斗被流放。我寻找真正的战斗，而不是酒馆斗殴。
Boroghul of House Kalkian rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
卡尔基安家族的博罗古勒率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Boromir, eldest son of Denethor, is Captain-General of Gondor. A great warrior of renown, he seeks any weapon to defend his people against the darkness.
波洛米尔是德内梭尔的长子，也是刚铎统帅。他是声名卓著的伟大战士，为保护人民免受黑暗侵害而寻求任何武器。
Boronchar is a seasoned warrior who advises the northern chieftain.
孛容察儿是一名经验丰富的战士，为北方酋长出谋划策。
Borthand of House Hûz rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
胡兹家族的玻桑德率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Bortu is a noble of the royal house.

Borzak acts as a beast-tamer in Gundabad, handling wargs and trolls akin to those allied with orcs in Tolkien's battles. His command over these creatures enhances the clan's military might in assaults.
博尔扎克是贡达巴德的驯兽者，负责驾驭座狼和食人妖，就像托尔金笔下那些与奥克并肩作战的怪物。他对这些野兽的控制，大大增强了氏族进攻时的战力。
Borzak is a defender orc, fortifying positions echoing the barricades at Helm's Deep. In Gundabad, his walls repel invasions from the deep.
博尔扎克是一名防御型奥克，擅长加固阵地，让人想起海尔姆深谷的层层壁垒。在贡达巴德，他筑起的防线挡住了来自地底深处的入侵。
Both require discipline, friend. My code is tested in battle as surely as any bronze spear. I offer systematic solutions and warrior's determination. Will you have me in your company?
两者都需要纪律，朋友。我的代码和青铜长矛一样经得起战场检验。我能提供系统化的解法，也有战士的决心。你愿意让我加入你的队伍吗？
Both speed and weight in melee
近战中兼具速度与重量
Bounty hunters took some of my lads and mean to sell them. Break the curs holding them and there's coin in it -- quiet coin.
赏金猎人抓走了我的几个手下，还打算把他们卖掉。打垮看押他们的那群混蛋，我会私下给你报酬，绝不声张。
Bow-orc of the deep halls and high tunnels.
来自深厅和高处隧道的弓奥克。
Bow. Cliff. Ship. In that order.
弓，悬崖，船，就这么个顺序。
Brakash of the Gashrim warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
布拉卡什是嘎什林战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Brakghash, chieftain of the Lugbúrz orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
布拉克嘎什是路格布尔兹奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Branoc Feathershaft is the finest archer among the Dunlendings, able to shoot the eye out of a raven at a hundred paces.
“羽杆”布兰诺克是黑蛮地人中最出色的弓手，能在百步外射中渡鸦的眼睛。
Branoc leads scouts into enemy territory.
布兰诺克率领斥候潜入敌境。
Brave, or foolish, and we have buried both. Show them what the hills do to trespassers.
有胆量，还是犯了傻？这两种人我们都埋过。让他们瞧瞧，擅闯我们的山会有什么下场。
Break the raiders that haunt our roads and we will reward you. The land will breathe easier for it.
除掉那些在道路上作恶的劫掠者，我们会给你报酬。这里的日子也能安稳些。
Breaking camp to raise the refuge cancels any supply orders placed from this camp; their goods and gold are forfeit.
拔营修建避难所会取消从这个营地下达的所有补给订单，货物和金币都将损失。

Bred for war, trained for slaughter, perfected in battle, that's my existence. Elite guard for a Nazgûl's fortress, I fought anything that threatened my master's domain. Trolls, men, elves, rival orc clans. Never defeated. My reputation spread; enemies feared encountering Skarnûl the Unbroken.
为战争而生，为杀戮而训，在战斗中磨炼到完美，这就是我的存在。我曾是那兹古尔堡垒的精锐守卫，对抗一切威胁主人领地的敌人：食人妖、人类、精灵，还有敌对奥克部族。我从未败过。我的威名传遍四方，敌人都害怕遇见“不破者”斯卡努尔。

Bred in the deeper pits where Saruman's most aggressive experiments occur. They wanted berserkers who could channel rage but remain controllable. I learned to fake obedience while feeding on that rage. They thought I was tamed, I was just patient, waiting for opportunity.
我在更深的坑里被培育出来，那里是萨茹曼进行最激进实验的地方。他们想要能引导怒火、却仍可控制的狂战士。我学会了假装服从，同时喂养那股怒火。他们以为我被驯服了，其实我只是在耐心等机会。

Bred in the pits of Isengard before its fall, I came to Mordor seeking greater purpose. Joined the Black Guard, earned my place through combat prowess. Younger than most but faster, stronger. I've killed veteran warriors in the fighting pits, proven myself worthy of command.
我在艾森加德的坑穴中被培育出来，后来艾森加德败落，我来到魔多寻找更大的目标。我加入黑卫队，凭战斗本事挣到了位置。我比大多数人年轻，却更快、更强。我在斗坑里杀过老练的战士，证明了自己有资格指挥别人。

Brenin Wulf rules the wild clans of Dunland with an iron fist. Known as the Ironhand, he united the scattered hill tribes through conquest and cunning. He dreams of reclaiming the lands taken by the Horse-lords of Rohan.
布雷宁·伍尔夫以铁腕统治黑蛮地的野性氏族。他被称为铁手，凭借征服和狡诈统一了分散的山地部族。他梦想夺回被洛汗驭马者夺走的土地。
Brianna Wingdart learned archery from her mother and now surpasses her in skill.
“翼镖”布莉安娜从母亲那里学会了弓术，如今技艺已经超过母亲。
布里甘是阿拉德维尔的妻子。
Brigid the Howling leads war bands through the mountain passes.
“嚎叫者”布里吉德率领战帮穿越山口。
Bring in {COUNT} measures of grain as the tithe demands and I will pay you a fair share for the collecting.
按照什一税应收的数额，收来{COUNT}份粮食。我会给你一份公道的报酬。
Bring me along and your wounded will walk again, those who can.
带我同行吧。你的伤员里，只要还有希望的，我就让他们重新站起来。
Bring me along, and I will find you provisions, goodwill and honest allies.
带我同行吧。我能替你找到补给，赢来好感，也结交可靠的盟友。
Bring me {COUNT} bars of good iron for the forge and there's coin in it -- the blades are my business.
给我弄来{COUNT}块上好的铁锭用于锻造，你就有钱拿。至于刀剑，那是我的事。
Bring me {COUNT} bolts of velvet to clothe my heir as a lord should be clothed, and you will be paid well for it.
给我带来{COUNT}匹天鹅绒，让我的继承人穿得像个领主该有的样子。我会给你丰厚的报酬。
Bring me {COUNT} captives and I will pay you well.
给我带来{COUNT}名俘虏，我会给你丰厚的报酬。
Bring me {COUNT} captives and I'll see them put to work. There's coin in it for you, no questions asked.
给我带来{COUNT}名俘虏，我会安排他们干活。你拿钱，我也不问他们的来路。
Bring me {COUNT} captives for the labor gangs and I'll pay you for the trouble of taking them.
给我带来{COUNT}名俘虏补充劳工队，我会付你抓人的辛苦钱。
Bring me {COUNT} loads of leather and my workshop will sing again. I will pay you fairly for the trouble.
给我带来{COUNT}批皮革，我的作坊就能重新开工。我会给你公道的报酬。
Bring me {COUNT} loads of oil to set the venture rolling and you will share in the profit when it is sold.
给我带来{COUNT}批油，让生意做起来。货物卖掉后，你也能分到利润。
Bring me {COUNT} loads of pottery to send to better markets and I will pay you a share of the trade.
给我带来{COUNT}批陶器，好送到销路更好的市场去。我会分给你一部分卖货的收入。
Bring me {COUNT} loads of {ITEM} and the harness is yours when it is done. Steel for steel: a fair trade.
给我送来{COUNT}份{ITEM}，甲做好就是你的。拿钢料换铠甲，这买卖很公平。
Bring me {COUNT} loads of {ITEM} for the shaft, and you shall have the first of what they dig out. It is worth more to you than to me.
给我送来{COUNT}份{ITEM}加固矿井，第一批开采出来的矿石就归你。它们对你来说比对我更有用。
Bring me {COUNT} measures of grain and my men will march on full stomachs. Do this and the realm will remember it.
给我带来{COUNT}份粮食，我的部下就能吃饱了出征。办成这件事，整个王国都会记住你的功劳。
Bring me {COUNT} sound horses and my riders will ride again. You will be paid well for them.
给我带来{COUNT}匹健壮的马，我的骑手就能重新出征。你会得到丰厚的报酬。
Bring us {COUNT} bars of iron and the forge will ring again. We have not the coin to buy so much ourselves.
给我们带来{COUNT}块铁锭，锻炉旁就能重新响起锤声。我们自己实在买不起这么多铁料。
Bring us {COUNT} {ITEM} and we will be saved.
把我们需要的{ITEM}带来，数量是{COUNT}，我们就有救了。
Bring your war-hammer crashing down with titanic force — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 10s.
以食人妖般的巨力砸下战锤：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 10 秒。
Broken men with swords come for our grain and our coin, and they have spilled blood. We cannot fight them alone.
一群拿着剑的溃兵来抢我们的粮食和钱财，已经闹出了人命。光靠我们自己对付不了他们。
Brughza of the Uzgnâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
布鲁格扎是乌兹格纳什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Brunhild Ironclaw is the formidable wife of Gorwulf, equally skilled in battle as her husband.
“铁爪”布伦希尔德是戈尔伍尔夫强悍的妻子，战斗技艺不逊于丈夫。
Brutal raider who killed his sergeant over discipline. Seeks freedom to fight without rules.
残暴的劫掠者，因纪律问题杀死了自己的军士。正在寻找不受规矩束缚的战斗自由。
Brutality beyond even Saruman's appetite, impressive and horrifying.
残暴到连萨茹曼都吃不下，惊人，也可怕。
Bryncelyn sits among holly-covered hills near Barnavon. The Dunlendings have grazed cattle here since long before the Men of Gondor came to the Isen.
布林凯林坐落在冬青覆盖的丘陵之间，靠近巴纳文。早在刚铎人来到艾森河很久以前，黑蛮地人就已在这里放牧牛群。
Bryncoch sits on a red-earthed hill near Methedras, in the foothills of the Misty Mountains. Its herders keep their cattle close, for orcs and wolves come down from the heights in hard winters.
布林科赫坐落在美塞德拉斯附近、迷雾山脉山麓的一座红土山丘上。牧民们让牛群待在近处，因为严冬时奥克和狼会从山上下来。
Brûga oversees the weapon-pits behind the Black Gate, and flogs any smith-snaga who lets a blade go dull.
布鲁加监管黑门后方的兵器坑场。哪个铁匠斯那嘎让刀刃变钝，她就鞭打哪个。
Bulgan of House Mithruntai is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
米斯伦泰家族的布尔干是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Burzash, chieftain of the Vrakmaw orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
布尔扎什是弗拉克莫奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Burzga of the Skarnâk orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
布尔兹加是斯卡尔纳克氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Burzlug of the Skarnâk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
布尔兹卢格是斯卡尔纳克战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Burzza of the Krimpâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
布尔兹扎是克林帕什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
布希拉训练年轻的猛犸骑手。

But I discovered discrepancies in our records - battles that never happened, heroes who never lived. When I brought this to the archivists, they silenced me, saying some truths serve the realm better than facts. They offered me gold to forget what I'd found.
但我发现我们的记录存在矛盾——有些战役从未发生，有些英雄从未存在。当我向档案管理员提出质疑时，他们让我噤声，说有些真相比事实更能服务于王国。他们还给我金钱让我忘记我发现的一切。

But I know horse tracks from wolf tracks, boot prints from orc spoor. Someone wanted those villages gone, and it wasn't the Wainriders. I left my company to seek the truth. The plains are threatened from within and without.
可马蹄印和狼爪印，靴印和奥克足迹，我还是分得清。有人想让那些村庄消失，而那人不是战车民。我离开队伍寻找真相。平原受到的威胁，既来自外面，也来自里面。

But I know horse tracks from wolf tracks, boot prints from orc spoor. Someone wanted those villages gone, and it wasn't wild men. I left my éored to seek the truth. The Mark is threatened from within and without.
可我分得清马蹄印和狼的足迹，也认得出靴印和奥克留下的痕迹。有人想毁掉那些村庄，但不是野人。我离开伊奥雷德骑兵队，去查清真相。洛汗正面临来自内外的威胁。
But I know horses. They weren't spooked - they were terrified. Something unnatural grows in Isengard. I left the royal stables to investigate on my own. If the horses fear it, we should too.
可我懂马。它们不是受惊，而是恐惧。艾森加德里有某种反常的东西正在滋长。我离开王家马厩，独自去调查。既然马害怕它，我们也该害怕。

But I know horses. They weren't spooked, they were terrified. Something unnatural grows beneath the forest's southern shadow. I left the royal stables to investigate on my own. If the horses fear it, we should too.
可我懂马。它们不是一时受惊，是怕到了骨子里。森林南部的阴影下，有什么不正常的东西正在滋长。我离开王家马厩，自己去查。连马都怕的东西，我们也该怕。
But I refused to craft weapons for a corrupt lord who planned to use them against innocent people. He burned my forge and had me beaten. I survived, but my workshop was destroyed.
可有个腐败领主想用武器伤害无辜者，我拒绝为他打造。他烧了我的锻炉，又让人殴打我。我活了下来，但工坊毁了。
But I witnessed my captain murder a prisoner in cold blood and reported it. The captain was connected to powerful families, and suddenly I was the one accused of crimes I didn't commit.
可我亲眼看见队长冷血杀死一名俘虏，并把此事上报。那名队长与强大的家族相连，于是突然之间，被指控犯下罪行的人变成了我。

But a blood-feud is older than any lawspeaker, and when it took my own house I could not judge it cold. I ruled against my kin to keep the peace, and my kin never forgave it. An elder without the trust of his clan is only an old man, so I gave up my seat and my hearth.
可血仇比任何律法代言人都更古老。当它卷走我自己的家族时，我没法冷静裁断。我为了维持和平，判自己的亲族有错，而我的亲族从未原谅我。一个失去氏族信任的长老，就只是个老人，所以我放弃了席位和炉火。

But a jealous merchant house conspired to frame me for smuggling contraband. They seized my warehouses, scattered my contacts, and left me with nothing but the clothes on my back and the knowledge in my head.
可一个嫉妒的商人家族合谋陷害我走私禁货。他们夺走我的仓库，打散我的联系人，最后只给我留下身上的衣服和脑子里的知识。
But a jealous superior took credit for my victories and blamed me for a retreat that saved our army from annihilation. The council sided with him - he had connections I lacked.
可一个嫉妒我的上级夺走了我的战功，又把一次挽救全军免于覆灭的撤退怪到我头上。议会站在他那边，因为他有我没有的人脉。
But brood-thoughts stir. Need more iron for spawn. Warlords pay for scouts. Know depths well.
可繁衍后代的念头开始搅动起来。要养崽子，就需要更多铁。军阀会花钱雇斥候，而我熟悉深处的路。
But honor demanded I challenge a corrupt commander who sent soldiers to die for personal glory. I won the duel but lost my position - the commander had powerful allies who saw me banished.
可荣誉要求我挑战一名腐败的指挥官，他为了个人荣耀把士兵送去送死。我赢了决斗，却失去了职位；那名指挥官有强大的盟友，他们把我放逐了。

But the marshals quarrel among themselves while the real enemy gathers. I left the muster to find a leader worth following — someone who sees beyond petty border disputes to the true darkness rising in the East.
可元帅们彼此争吵，真正的敌人却在集结。我离开军队，去寻找值得追随的领袖：一个能看透边境小争端，看见东方真正黑暗正在升起的人。

But the marshals quarrel among themselves while the real enemy gathers. I left the muster to find a leader worth following, someone who sees beyond petty border disputes to the true darkness rising beneath Mirkwood.
可真正的敌人在集结，元帅们却只顾彼此争吵。我离开军队，去找值得追随的领袖，一个不只盯着琐碎边境争端，也看得见黑森林下真正黑暗正在崛起的人。

But the raids grew crueler as the Taskral bent the tribes to the Dark Lord's purpose. I was made to walk the fields after and finish the enemy wounded rather than tend them. The third time, I could not, and a healer who will not kill is no use to a war-clan.
可随着塔斯克拉尔把各部族拧向黑暗魔君的目的，突袭变得越来越残酷。我被命令在战后走过战场，处死敌方伤员，而不是救治他们。到了第三次，我做不到了。一个不愿杀人的医者，对战争氏族来说就没有用处。
But when I uncovered a conspiracy reaching into the highest circles of power, I became a liability. Those I served decided I knew too much and sent assassins. I killed two of them and fled.
可当我揭开一个牵连到最高权力圈的阴谋时，我成了麻烦。那些我曾效力的人认为我知道得太多，派来了刺客。我杀了其中两个，然后逃走。
But when a noble's son died despite my best efforts - the wound was beyond any healer's skill - his father blamed me and demanded my execution. I fled rather than face a rigged tribunal.
可一名贵族之子在我尽力医治后仍然死去，那伤势已经超出任何医者的能力。他父亲却把责任怪到我头上，要求处死我。我不愿面对一场早已被操纵的审判，于是逃走了。
But when a rival accused me of weakening our fortifications for the enemy, I was cast out despite my innocence. The walls I built still stand, though my name has been struck from the builders' rolls.
可一个对手指控我替敌人削弱我们的防御工事。尽管我清白无辜，仍被逐了出去。我筑起的墙至今仍在，可我的名字已经从建造者名册上划掉。
Buy a claim on the {TITLE} for {COST}?
Buy food for the host whenever we reach a market.
每到集市，就为部队购买食物。
Buy the Elven Volley between waves first.
请先在两波之间购买精灵齐射。
Buzgar of the Hrakdûr warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
布兹加尔是赫拉克杜尔战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Böri of House Adekig rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
阿德基格家族的博里率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Börte of House Mithruntai is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
米斯伦泰家族的孛儿帖是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Bûrznak commands a regiment of Mordor orcs, a mounted captain who rides down stragglers and deserters alike.
布尔兹纳克指挥一支魔多奥克军队，是个骑马的队长。不管是掉队者还是逃兵，他都会纵马追杀。
Bûrzum, Warlord of the Misty Mountains, who holds the deep places of Moria and the cold peaks above.
布尔祖姆，迷雾山脉军阀，掌握墨瑞亚深处以及上方寒冷的山峰。
Caladwen, wife of Erchirion, joined the house of Imrazôrionath through their union. She is a woman of quiet courage.
卡拉德玟是埃尔奇瑞安的妻子，通过婚姻加入伊姆拉佐瑞昂纳斯家族。她是一位有沉静勇气的女子。

Calaniel was wedded into the House of Malandilionath out of the green wolds of Pinnath Gelin, and she brought with her the fair hair of Hirluin's country and a small banner of pale green that her mother stitched for her bridal-journey. She is eight and twenty, gentle of voice but not of purpose, and she has borne a son who shall one day raise the house's standard upon the western hills. With her husband's kindred she stands by the Steward of the City, for the green hills lie far from any northern claimant and near indeed to the beacons of Anórien.

Calembel stands as the principal town of Lamedon, commanding a small but prominent hill overlooking the fords of the River Ciril in northern Gondor. The town's position makes it a critical waypoint on the ancient road connecting Erech in the Morthond Vale to the great port city of Pelargir, serving as both guardian of the river crossing and gateway between the mountainous interior and the fertile lowlands of southern Gondor. The Ciril's fords below the town represent one of the few reliable crossing points in the region, and control of Calembel has historically meant control of movement through western Lamedon.The town rises in terraced levels up the hillside, with the imposing castle of Angbor - Lord of Lamedon - crowning the summit. From this vantage, watchmen can observe traffic on the road for miles in either direction and monitor the river valleys where tributaries descend from the White Mountains to the north. The elevation also provides natural defensive advantages, though Calembel has long been more administrative center than fortress, its strength lying in the loyalty of Lamedon's people rather than impregnable walls.

卡伦贝尔是拉梅顿的主要城镇，坐落在一座不大却醒目的山丘上，俯瞰刚铎北部奇利尔河的渡口。它位于一条古道的关键位置；这条路连接墨松德山谷中的埃瑞赫和伟大港城佩拉基尔，因此卡伦贝尔既守护河流渡口，也是山区腹地通往刚铎南部肥沃低地的门户。城下的奇利尔河渡口是当地少数可靠过河点之一，历史上控制卡伦贝尔就意味着控制西拉梅顿的交通。城镇沿山坡分层而上，拉梅顿领主安格博的雄伟城堡立在山顶。守望者从那里可以观察数英里内道路两端的行人车马，也能监视北方白色山脉支流汇入的河谷。高地本身也带来天然防御优势，不过卡伦贝尔长期以来更像行政中心而非不可攻破的堡垒，它真正的力量在于拉梅顿人民的忠诚。

Calion of the House of Eärnurionath keeps the sea-wall of Pelargir as his fathers did before him, since the days when the Faithful first laid stone upon that haven in the Second Age. He bears a long blade named Sîrlam, the River-Tongue, which his great-grandsire wielded at the breaking of the corsair fleet off Tolfalas. In these darkening years he has lent his voice and his ships to the cause of the King returned, holding that the oath of the Stewards was sworn until such a one should come, and come he has.

Celeborn, the wise and noble Lord of Lothlórien, stands as a stalwart defender of his realm and people. Renowned for his calm demeanor and keen insight, he is a master of strategy and diplomacy, a complement to the ethereal power of Galadriel. Celeborn's presence in Lothlórien is a beacon of stability and strength, providing wise counsel to those who seek guidance. While his sword remains ever ready to protect his homeland, his true strength lies in his enduring patience and deep understanding of the struggles facing Middle-earth. Celeborn's leadership ensures that Lothlórien remains a bastion of hope amidst a world in turmoil.
凯勒博恩是洛丝罗瑞恩睿智而高贵的领主，也是王国与人民坚定的守护者。他以沉稳的气度和敏锐的洞察闻名，精通战略与外交，正好补足加拉德瑞尔近乎缥缈的力量。凯勒博恩的存在为洛丝罗瑞恩带来稳定与力量，也为寻求指引的人提供明智建议。他的剑随时准备保护故土，但真正的力量在于持久的耐心，以及对中洲所面临苦难的深刻理解。凯勒博恩的领导让洛丝罗瑞恩在乱世中仍是希望的堡垒。

Charger-to-victim weight ratio at which a charge ALWAYS knocks the victim down, from any angle, regardless of resistance (mumakil vs man is ~125, warg + orc vs man 8, horse + man vs man exactly 6). Default 6 since 2026-09-17, so a full-speed horse contact floors a man; raise it to 7 or 8 to give that back to wargs and chariots only. Configured heroes (shipped: Sauron and the Nine) get direction-mapped effects on any melee hit. Sauron: an overhead is a Slam (the struck foe always goes down, enemies in a ring around the impact are knocked down and take part of the damage, a burst of fear drains their morale; also fires on an overhead into the ground), a side swing is a Sweep (the struck foe and enemies in front are staggered back). The Nine: an overhead or a side swing is a Scream (enemies around the wraith take part of the damage, are staggered back and lose morale; the struck foe is staggered and frightened too). Never on a throw, a shot, a kick or bare hands. The same rules apply in a Custom Battle. Cooldowns and radii live in signature_strikes_config.json.

Dol Amroth stands as a fortress-city upon a high promontory jutting westward into the Bay of Belfalas, commanding Gondor's southern coast with majestic authority. The city occupies the southern end of the small bay called Cobas Haven, where the River Ringló flows into the sea. This peninsula position grants Dol Amroth natural defensive advantages - towering cliffs protect seaward approaches, while massive walls guard the landward sides. The city's elevated position allows watchers on the Sea-ward Tower to scan vast stretches of ocean for approaching ships, whether friendly traders or hostile Corsair raiders.The name commemorates a tragic love story from the distant past. In T.A. 1981, Amroth, the last King of Lórien, came to Edhellond (the Elven haven fifty miles north) seeking passage to Aman with his beloved Nimrodel. She had fled Lórien's darkness after the Balrog awakened in Moria, and Amroth had promised to follow her into the West. But Nimrodel became lost in the White Mountains, never reaching the coast. Amroth waited aboard the last ship from Edhellond, but when a great autumn storm drove the vessel out to sea, he leaped overboard in a desperate attempt to swim ashore and search for her. He drowned in the bay's cold waters, and Nimrodel was never found. The hill where the Princes' stronghold stood was thereafter called Dol Amroth in memory of the lost Elf-king's final moments - a poignant reminder that even immortal beings can fall to grief and the sea's merciless power.The principality itself is known by multiple names. Officially, the fief is called Belfalas, or alternatively Dor-en-Ernil, reflecting its unique status as a hereditary princedom within the kingdom of Gondor. In the Common Speech, the region is sometimes called the Langstrand, though this name more properly belongs to Anfalas to the west.

多阿姆洛斯是一座高踞海岬的要塞城市，向西伸入贝尔法拉斯湾，以威严姿态俯瞰刚铎南方海岸。城市位于科巴斯港这处小海湾南端，凛格罗河在此入海。半岛地形让多阿姆洛斯拥有天然防御优势：高耸悬崖守住临海方向，厚重城墙则护卫陆路一侧。城市地势高拔，海望塔上的守望者可以远眺大片海面，及时发现友方商船或敌对的海盗袭击者。这个名字纪念着远古的一段悲剧爱情。第三纪元一九八一年，罗瑞恩末代国王阿姆洛斯来到北边五十英里外的精灵港口埃蒂尔泷德，想与心爱的宁洛德尔一同乘船前往阿门洲。炎魔在墨瑞亚苏醒后，宁洛德尔逃离罗瑞恩的黑暗，阿姆洛斯也许诺随她西去。但宁洛德尔在白色山脉中迷失，再也没有抵达海岸。阿姆洛斯在埃蒂尔泷德最后一艘船上等待她；一场秋季风暴把船吹离海岸时，他绝望地跃入海中，想游回岸上寻找她。他最终溺死在冰冷海湾中，宁洛德尔也再无人找到。亲王堡垒所在的山丘后来便被称为多阿姆洛斯，以纪念这位失落精灵王最后的时刻，也提醒世人，即便是不朽者也可能败给悲伤和无情的海。这个亲王领本身有多个名字。正式来说，这片封地称为贝尔法拉斯，也可称为多尔-恩-埃尔尼尔，体现出它在刚铎王国内作为世袭亲王领的特殊地位。在通用语中，这片地区有时也被叫作长滩，不过这个名字更准确地属于西面的安法拉斯。

别怨一个杀手喜欢宴食和厮杀。

Don't need Mordor's structure, their rules, their weakness. Out here, strength is law. I'll fight for anyone who points me at good targets and doesn't waste my time with discipline and cooperation. Pay me, feed me, get out of my way. Simple.
我不需要魔多的条条框框，不需要他们的规矩，也不需要他们的软弱。在外面，力量就是法则。谁给我指一个好目标，别拿纪律和配合来浪费我时间，我就为谁而战。付钱，管饭，别挡路。就这么简单。

Don't need Saruman's approval to do what I'm bred for. War is coming to all Middle-earth, and warriors like me will be in demand. I break things and kill people, that's valuable everywhere. No rules, no officers, just pure violence for whoever pays or points me right.
我不需要萨茹曼批准我去做自己被培育出来该做的事。战争会烧遍整个中洲，像我这样的战士会很抢手。我砸东西，也杀人，这在哪儿都有价值。没有规矩，没有军官，谁付钱，或者谁给我指对目标，我就给谁献上纯粹的暴力。
Done. The Wood forgets you now. Walk on, and walk quietly, because other things here do not bargain.
成交。林子现在不会再惦记你了。接着走，脚步轻些，这里别的东西可不跟人讲价。
Doom is only a word the weak whisper.
厄运不过是胆小鬼悄悄念叨的话。
Doomed, they say. How restful. Nothing left to worry about.
他们说我命里有灾。真轻松，连操心都省了。
Doquz of House Mithruntai is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
米斯伦泰家族的脱古思是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Dorathila serves in the dark armies.
多拉希拉效力于黑暗大军。

Dorwen came to the House of Olindurionath out of a lesser fief upon the windward coast of Anfalas, where the huntsmen reckon their kindred by the seasons of the seal-hunt rather than by the rolls of Minas Tirith. Three and thirty winters she has counted, and she has not unlearned the sea-wisdom of her father's strand, nor the silence that the long coast teaches. She walks with the King's faction as her wedded house does, holding that the Langstrand has waited too long upon a City that forgets its further shores.
多玟来自安法拉斯迎风海岸上一处较小的封地，那里猎人按猎海豹的季节来算亲族关系，而不是按米那斯提力斯的名册。她已经度过三十三个寒冬，却没有忘记父亲海岸上的海上智慧，也没有忘记漫长海岸教给人的沉默。她随出嫁后的家族一起支持国王派，认为长滩已经在一个忘记远岸的白城面前等待太久。

Dorwen of the house of Maeglion in Morthond Vale came to Hirilionath bearing the troth of Blackroot bowmen and the stern watchfulness of her shadowed valley. She is grave of countenance and slow of word, and has borne her husband Pelamir one son and many years of patient stewardship while the old lord lingered. She follows the house in its turning toward the claimant, though she remembers the old oaths to the White Tower with sorrow.
墨松德山谷迈格利昂家族的多玟来到希瑞利昂纳斯，带来黑源河山谷弓手的婚约和她那阴影山谷里的严肃警觉。她神情庄重，说话迟缓，为丈夫佩拉米尔生下一子，也在老领主久居不退的年月中耐心持家。她跟随家族转向那位宣称者，但仍怀着悲伤记得对白塔的旧誓。
多温尼安资深商队护卫
Dorwinion's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #722721.
多温尼安在地图上的颜色，格式为#RRGGBB。留空使用默认值#722721。
Dorwinion's spearmen hold the Eastmarch road against all comers, and the work there is not gentle. We learn it, and we do not forget it.
多温尼安的矛手守着东境大道，谁来都挡。那里的差事可不温和，我们学会了，也就忘不了。
Double your realm's special resource from every source.
从所有来源获得的本国专属资源翻倍。
Draw on the shadows of Dol Guldur — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
汲取多古尔都的阴影之力：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。
Draw the arrow trail from the source to your party while a convoy is on the road. Presentation only.
运输队在路上时，绘制从补给来源到你的部队的箭头路线。只影响显示。

Draws each kingdom's border on the campaign map, following rivers, coasts and mountain ranges, and redraws it when a fief changes hands. While this is on, the Show Realm Borders key (M by default) hides and shows them, and the map mode key (G) switches what they show.
在战役地图上沿河流、海岸和山脉绘制各王国边界，领地转手时重绘。开启时，显示国境键（默认 M）可隐藏或显示，地图模式键（G）可切换显示内容。
Draws your own kingdom's frontier as a gold cord, so you can find it at a glance.
用金线绘制自己王国的边境，便于一眼找到。
Drazgor, a wraith-like commander, haunts the borders of Mirkwood, his ethereal form striking terror like the Nazgûl in the films, enforcing Sauron's will through fear and illusion.
德拉兹戈尔是一名幽魂般的指挥官，徘徊在黑森林边境。他虚幻的身形像电影中的那兹古尔一样制造恐惧，并以恐吓和幻象执行索隆的意志。
Dread Charge boosts mount resilience while active.
恐惧冲锋生效期间，会增强坐骑韧性。
Dread Charge charge greatly reduced, ride without ceasing.
恐惧冲锋充能消耗大幅降低，可以不停冲锋。
Dread Charge charge reduced, swifter activation.
恐惧冲锋充能消耗降低，发动更加迅捷。
Dread Charge duration extended, maintaining momentum.
恐惧冲锋持续时间延长，让冲锋势头保持更久。
Dread Charge grants +5% melee damage, shadow wreathing your mount.
恐惧冲锋提供 +5% 近战伤害，阴影缠绕着你的坐骑。
Dread Charge radius expanded, sweeping wider formations.
恐惧冲锋作用范围扩大，可以扫过更宽的阵型。
Dread Charge radius greatly expanded, unstoppable impact.
恐惧冲锋作用范围大幅扩大，冲击势不可挡。
Drengulf Irontusk is a young warrior eager to prove his worth in battle.
“铁獠”德伦古尔夫是一名年轻的战士，渴望在战斗中证明自己的价值。
Drifted across the Wold with no fixed allegiance.
无固定效忠地漂泊北高原。
Drifted across the plains with no fixed allegiance.
在平原漂泊，不固定效忠任何势力。
Drifted between the clans as an outcast.
作为弃民在氏族之间漂泊。
Drilled in the shadow-yards of Dol Guldur.
在多古尔都阴影院中操练。
Drilled with the Black Serpent's footmen.
Drilled with the desert spearmen of Harad.
随哈拉德沙漠矛兵操练。
Drilled with the household guard of Thranduil's court.
随瑟兰杜伊王庭亲卫操练。
Drilled with the sons of noble houses.
Drilled with the sons of the Angle.
与河角地的子弟一起操练。
Drilled with the sons of the old houses.
与古老贵族家的子弟一起操练。
Drive scythe-bladed chariots through the enemy line — boosts +25% charge damage, +20% mount speed, and +10% melee damage for 8s.
驾驭装有镰刃的战车撕开敌阵：+25% 冲锋伤害，+20% 坐骑速度，+10% 近战伤害，持续 8 秒。
Drive the rivals off our commons by force and the pasture is ours again. We will pay what we can.
用武力把他们赶出公用牧地，牧场就又是我们的了。我们会尽力凑出报酬。
Drive your war-ram forward — boosts +25% charge damage, +20% mount speed, and +10% melee damage for 8s.
驱策战羊向前猛冲：+25% 冲锋伤害，+20% 坐骑速度，+10% 近战伤害，持续 8 秒。
Drive {COUNT} head of sheep to us and our flocks may grow again. We will pay what the village can spare.
给我们赶来{COUNT}只羊，畜群才有机会重新繁衍。我们会尽村子所能凑出报酬。
Drozga of the Vrakmaw orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
德罗兹加是弗拉克莫氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。

Drozmak is a savage orc captain in Gundabad, known for his relentless raids on Dwarven outposts, much like the orc hordes that assailed Erebor in the books. His tactical ferocity and loyalty to Azgar make him a key enforcer, ensuring clan unity through intimidation and bloodshed, ever eager to spill the blood of Elves and Men encroaching on orc territories.
德罗兹马克是贡达巴德的野蛮奥克队长，以不断袭击矮人哨站而闻名，很像书中围攻孤山的奥克大军。他凶狠的战术和对阿兹加尔的忠诚让他成为关键执法者，靠威吓与流血维持氏族团结，也总是渴望让闯入奥克领地的精灵和人类流血。
Druzhak of the Lugbúrz warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
德鲁扎克是路格布尔兹战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Druzhak, a spirit caller, summons ghosts, evoking the haunted aura of the fortress in lore.
德鲁扎克是唤灵者，能召来幽魂，让人想起传说中那座堡垒阴森闹鬼的气息。

Druznar is a veteran orc fighter, scarred from clashes reminiscent of the Battle of Azanulbizar. In Gundabad, he trains new recruits, instilling the hatred and skills needed to confront the Dwarves once more.
德鲁兹纳尔是老练的奥克战士，身上的伤痕让人想起阿扎努比扎之战。在贡达巴德，他训练新兵，把再次对抗矮人所需的仇恨与技巧灌进他们脑中。
Druznia, a spectral consort, haunts dreams, her influence spreading fear like the Nazgûl's Black Breath.
德鲁兹妮娅是幽魂配偶，萦绕在人们梦中；她扩散恐惧的方式像那兹古尔的黑息一样可怕。

Drûgash, a cunning and iron-willed leader of the Black Maw, commands his Uruk-hai with a blend of calculated strategy and raw aggression. His devotion to Saruman fuels his relentless drive, his forces sweeping across Middle-earth with disciplined savagery. Drûgash's sharp intellect and scorn for weakness make him a formidable commander, his troops a relentless engine of destruction. Under his leadership, the Black Maw carves a path of ruin, advancing Isengard's dark ambitions with every bloody triumph.
德鲁加什是黑颚部族狡诈而意志如铁的领袖，以精心谋划的策略和原始攻势相结合来指挥乌鲁克。他对萨茹曼的忠诚推动着无休止的进军，他的部队以纪律严明的野蛮席卷中洲。德鲁加什头脑锐利，鄙视软弱，是一名强悍的指挥官；他的士兵则像一台不知停歇的毁灭机器。在他的领导下，黑颚一路留下废墟，用每一次血腥胜利推进艾森加德的黑暗野心。
Dug and hauled in the pits of Isengard.
在艾森加德深坑中挖掘搬运。
Dug in the mines beneath the mountain.
Duilin, elder son of Duinhir, leads his own company of archers and fights alongside his father in defense of Gondor.
杜伊林是杜因希尔的长子，率领自己的弓手队伍，与父亲并肩保卫刚铎。
Duinhir, Lord of Morthond, leads his archers from the Black Root Vale to the defense of Gondor. He is a stern and capable commander.
杜因希尔是墨松德领主，率领黑源河山谷的弓手前来保卫刚铎。他严厉而能干，是一位可靠的统帅。
Dulruk, a terror rider, patrols from above, spotting and striking with precision.
杜尔鲁克是恐怖骑手，从高空巡逻，精准发现目标并发起打击。
