Dunland remembers your service. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
黑蛮地会记住你的贡献。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
Dunland's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #7A4A28.
黑蛮地在地图上的颜色，格式为 #RRGGBB。留空使用默认值 #7A4A28。

Dunland, a rugged and untamed land of rolling hills and dense forests, is home to the fierce and independent Dunlendings. Often marginalized and at odds with their neighbors, the people of Dunland are hardened by centuries of struggle and survival. Their chieftains lead through strength and cunning, uniting clans under a shared banner of vengeance and freedom. Known for their ferocious warriors and skilled hunters, the Dunlendings favor axes, spears, and bows, fighting with a tenacity born from their deep connection to their ancestral lands. Though their ways may seem primitive to others, the Dunlendings are proud and resourceful, ready to reclaim their rightful place in Middle-earth.

黑蛮地是一片崎岖而未被驯服的土地，起伏丘陵与浓密森林交错，也是凶悍独立的黑蛮地人的家园。他们常被边缘化，也常与邻人冲突，数百年的挣扎与求生让这里的人变得坚硬。酋长们凭借力量和狡诈统领族人，把各氏族团结在复仇与自由的共同旗帜下。黑蛮地人以凶猛战士和熟练猎手闻名，偏爱斧、矛和弓，并以源自祖地深厚联系的韧性作战。虽然他们的方式在别人看来或许粗陋，但黑蛮地人骄傲而善于应变，随时准备夺回自己在中洲应有的位置。
Dunlending fletching traditions fill your quiver. +10% ammo.
黑蛮地人的制箭传统让你的箭袋始终充足。+10% 弹药。
Dunlending mountain ponies are tough as iron. +10% horse health.
黑蛮地的山地矮马像钢铁一样坚韧。+10% 坐骑生命值。
Dunlending mounts are faster on broken ground. +5% movement speed.
黑蛮地坐骑在崎岖地面上跑得更快。+5% 移动速度。

Dunlending raiders burned a farm at Girdley that belonged to my wife's kin and left nothing standing. I pulled my company off the road to hunt them and found them camped. We killed them all, wounded and captive alike, and I did not stop my hand.
黑蛮地劫掠者烧了格德利的一处农庄，那是我妻子亲戚的家，什么也没留下。我把队伍从大道拉走，追到了他们的营地。我们把他们杀了个干净，伤兵、俘虏都没放过，我也始终没停手。
Durbash of the Gashrim warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
杜尔巴什是嘎什林战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Durbghash, chieftain of the Throgmaw orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
杜尔布嘎什是斯罗格莫奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Durbgûl is a whip-captain of the Nurn pens, who measures a thrall's worth by how long it lasts under the lash.
杜尔布古尔是努尔恩奴隶营的一名监工队长。他判断奴隶有没有用，只看对方能在鞭子下撑多久。
Durbza of the Vargrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
杜尔布扎是瓦格林氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Durga, a resilient orc warrior-female, embodies the tough endurance of orc kind in harsh environments. She guards the inner sanctums, ensuring the clan's core remains unbreached.
杜尔加是坚韧的奥克女战士，体现奥克种族在严酷环境中的顽强耐力。她守卫内部圣所，确保氏族核心不被攻破。

During a celebration, deep in drink, I said what many think, that Erebor grows soft, that we need war to stay sharp. Wrong words to the wrong lord, whose son died in the last orc raid. He demanded satisfaction. I refused to duel a grieving father. They called it cowardice.
一次庆典上，我喝得很深，说出了许多人心里想的话：孤山正在变软，我们需要战争保持锋利。话说给了不该说的人听；那位领主的儿子刚死在上一次奥克袭击里。他要求决斗讨个说法。我拒绝和一位悲痛的父亲决斗。他们说这是懦弱。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the Horse-lords of Rohan. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻中，我发现我们自己人里有人谋划勾结洛汗驭马者走私。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者已经买通了某个有权势的人。我被告知，要忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the Shadow in the East. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻中，我发现我们自己人里有人谋划勾结东方的阴影走私。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者已经买通了某个有权势的人。我被告知，要忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the elves and men of the West. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻中，我发现我们自己人里有人谋划勾结西方的精灵和人类走私。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者已经买通了某个有权势的人。我被告知，要忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the forces of darkness. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻中，我发现我们自己人里有人谋划勾结黑暗势力走私。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者已经买通了某个有权势的人。我被告知，要忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the men of Gondor. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻时，我发现自己人中有人密谋，走私者正在和刚铎人勾结。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者早已买通了某个有权势的人。有人叫我忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the navy of Gondor. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻时，我发现自己人中有人密谋，走私者正在和刚铎海军勾结。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者早已买通了某个有权势的人。有人叫我忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the spiders and orcs of Dol Guldur. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻中，我发现我们自己人里有人谋划勾结多古尔都的蜘蛛和奥克走私。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者已经买通了某个有权势的人。我被告知，要忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the western kingdoms. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen.
一次巡逻时，我发现自己人中有人密谋，走私者正在和西方诸国勾结。我上报之后才知道，那些走私者早已买通了某个有权势的人。有人叫我忘掉自己看见的一切。

During a patrol, we encountered a merchant vessel under corsair colors. But when we boarded, we found Gondorian soldiers disguised as pirates, smuggling weapons to unknown buyers. My commander ordered us to sink the ship and never speak of it.
在一次巡逻中，我们遇到了一艘挂着海盗旗的商船。我们登船后却发现是刚铎士兵伪装成海盗，向不知名的买家走私武器。指挥官命令我们击沉那艘船，并永远不要说出这件事。

During a raid near Osgiliath, we captured Southron scouts. They weren't spies but refugees - families fleeing the Shadow's growing influence. My unit was ordered to execute them. I helped them escape instead.
在欧斯吉利亚斯附近的一次突袭中，我们抓获了南方人的侦察兵。他们并非间谍，而是难民——为躲避日益蔓延的暗影势力而逃亡的家庭。我的部队接到命令要将他们处决，但我却协助他们逃走了。

During a raid on a Gondorian outpost, our captain ordered retreat when victory was within grasp. Coward wanted to preserve his warband for another day. I ignored the order, rallied those with courage, and we took the fort. The captain accused me of insubordination, sentenced me to the slave pits.
一次袭击刚铎前哨时，胜利已经近在眼前，我们的队长却下令撤退。那个懦夫只想把自己的战团留到下一天。我无视命令，召集还有胆量的人，拿下了那座堡垒。队长指控我违抗军令，把我判进奴隶坑。
During a raid, my commander ordered us to trample fleeing civilians - they might be enemy sympathizers, he said. I refused and was court-martialed for disobedience.
一次突袭中，指挥官命令我们践踏逃跑的平民，说他们可能是敌人的同情者。我拒绝了，并因抗命被送上军事审判。

During a siege window, how much more the attackers' armies want to besiege the target and the defender's armies want to defend it once it is attacked. 1 turns the focus off. Needs AI Strategic Intelligence on. Default 1.4.
限时围城事件期间，进攻方军团围攻目标的意愿，以及目标遭到进攻后守方军团前往防守的意愿，会提高到此倍率。1为不增加偏重。需要开启AI战略判断。默认：1.4。

During a skirmish, we pursued a raiding band too far and discovered they wore mail stamped by the envoy from Rhun, who feasted at our King's table as a friend. When I reported this to my captain, he ordered me to forget what I had seen. He said the King's steward had forbidden such talk.
一次遭遇战中，我们追一伙劫掠者追得太远，发现他们穿的锁子甲，竟打着鲁恩使者的印记。那使者可是以朋友身份，坐在我们国王席上赴宴的人。我向队长禀报，他却命我忘掉看到的事，说国王的总管不准谈这个。

During a skirmish, we pursued orcs too far and discovered they wore gear from Isengard - supposedly our ally. When I reported this to my captain, he ordered me to forget what I'd seen. He said the King's counselor had forbidden such talk.
一次冲突中，我们追击奥克追得太远，发现他们穿着艾森加德的装备，而艾森加德本该是我们的盟友。我向队长报告时，他命令我忘掉所见。他说国王的顾问禁止谈论这种事。

During a training exercise, the rage took me fully. I killed three overseers before they subdued me with nets and chains. Saruman's lieutenant wanted me destroyed as defective. But I heard them say I was 'too valuable to waste', scheduled for the suicide assault on Helm's Deep instead. I broke my chains that night.
一次训练里，怒火彻底吞没了我。我杀了三个监工，他们才用网和铁链制服我。萨茹曼的副官想把我当成残次品销毁。但我听见他们说我“太有价值，不能浪费”，于是把我安排进攻打海尔姆深谷的自杀突击。那天夜里，我挣断了锁链。

During an attack on the fortress, I defended my post perfectly while my master fled to safety. When he returned and saw the carnage, dozens of attackers dead by my hand, he grew suspicious. Too strong, too independent, too dangerous. He planned to have me eliminated quietly. I eliminated his assassins loudly and left.
堡垒遭到攻击时，我完美守住岗位，而我的主人逃去了安全处。他回来后看见满地尸体，看见数十名进攻者死在我手下，于是起了疑心。太强，太独立，太危险。他打算悄悄除掉我。我则大张旗鼓地除掉了他的刺客，然后离开了。
Durkar, a spectral lieutenant, aids in raising wraiths, her presence chilling like the fear induced by the Necromancer in Mirkwood's lore.
杜尔卡尔尔是幽魂副官，协助唤起怨灵。她的存在像黑森林传说中死灵法师带来的恐惧一样令人发寒。
Durla, a shadow binder, manipulates darkness, concealing guards as in Dol Guldur's veiled assaults.
杜尔拉是缚影者，操纵黑暗，在多古尔都隐蔽的突袭中遮掩守卫。

Durmash is a stalwart orc guardian of Gundabad's halls, evoking the vigilant orcs that guarded the passes in Middle-earth's lore. His defensive prowess protects the stronghold from intruders, while his alliance with clan members strengthens the internal bonds against external threats.
杜尔马什是贡达巴德大厅中坚定的奥克守卫，让人想起中洲传说里那些守卫山口的警觉奥克。他的防守本领保护要塞免受入侵者侵扰，他与氏族成员的盟约也加强了内部纽带，共同抵御外来威胁。
Durmorg, a brood keeper, raises spiderlings, bolstering Khamûl's creepy allies.
杜尔莫格是一名蛛群看护者，饲养幼蛛，为可哈穆尔增添令人毛骨悚然的盟友。
Durza of the Lugbúrz orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
杜尔扎是路格布尔兹氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Durzak is a vanguard orc, leading charges with the fury of Uglúk's band. In Gundabad, his boldness breaks enemy lines in pivotal battles.
杜尔扎克是奥克先锋，带着乌格鲁克队伍般的怒火发起冲锋。在贡达巴德，他的大胆能在关键战斗中撕开敌阵。
Durzha, a resurrectionist, revives the slain, bolstering Khamûl's endless armies.
杜尔扎是一名复生术士，能让战死者重新站起，不断壮大可哈穆尔的军队。
Dust in my teeth, blue stone in my knuckles. You want to try me?
牙缝里是灰，指节里是蓝石。想跟我试试？
Duty pulled you away. That is not the same as abandoning them.
职责把你召走，跟抛弃他们不是一回事。
穿着矮人盔甲的河谷邦战列兵。
矮人完美主义拖慢城墙建设
Dwarves and Elves hate the Pale Orcs
矮人和精灵憎恨苍白奥克

Dwarves, Isengard and Dale, defending outnumbered against an army of mostly horse, stand where horse cannot ride them down: a choke point, a forest, a slope, or where they are. Where the riders sit on ordinary horses, the cavalry dismount and join the shield wall with polearms ready. The AI sides only; your own army is never touched. Needs Enable Culture Doctrine. Applies from the next battle; tuning in culture_doctrines.json.
矮人、艾森加德和河谷邦的AI在寡不敌众、又遭到以骑兵为主的军队进攻时，会选择骑兵不易冲垮的地形据守，例如狭道、树林、斜坡，也可能就地防守。其中骑普通马的骑兵会下马，持长杆武器加入盾墙。只影响AI一方，绝不会改动你自己的军队。需要开启文化战法。从下一场战斗开始生效；参数设在culture_doctrines.json中。

Dáin Ironfoot, the stalwart and unyielding King under the Mountain, stands as a paragon of dwarven resilience and valor. Renowned for his unwavering determination and tactical prowess, Dáin is a battle-hardened leader who inspires loyalty and courage in his kin. A veteran of countless conflicts, he led the dwarves of the Iron Hills with unmatched strength, bringing stability and prosperity to his people. His resolve in the face of adversity and his dedication to the defense of Erebor and its allies ensure that the legacy of Durin's folk endures through the darkest days of the Third Age.
铁足戴因，坚毅不屈的山下之王，是矮人韧性与勇气的典范。他以坚定的意志和出色的战术才能闻名，是一位身经百战、能让族人忠诚追随并鼓起勇气的领袖。他经历过无数战事，曾以无可匹敌的力量统率铁丘陵的矮人，为自己的人民带来稳定与繁荣。他面对逆境时绝不退缩，又始终守护孤山和盟友，这让都林一族的传承能在第三纪元最黑暗的岁月里延续下去。
Déorwyn is heir to Grimbold's command.
德奥温将接掌格里姆博德的部队。

Dínadab epitomizes the quiet, enduring character of Lamedon's hill-folk. This small hamlet nestles among rolling slopes where shepherds have tended their flocks for generations, living lives largely unchanged since before Númenor's founding. The settlement is so peaceful that even during the tumult of war, it remained a place of relative safety - though not without cost. The hamlet lost Fuirion, one of its sons, during the Dawnless Day when Sauron's shadow fell across Gondor, and his absence haunts the close-knit community like a wound that won't fully heal. Dínadab's buildings cluster around a central sheepfold and washing pools where the famous Lamedon wool is cleaned in the cold, clear waters flowing down from the mountains. The people here speak with linguistic peculiarities inherited from the ancient Daen folk who inhabited these valleys in ages past, preserving fragments of a culture that existed before Gondor's kings ever looked westward. The hamlet serves as a watch-point for the northern approaches, with riders ready to carry warning to Calembel should danger threaten from the mountain passes.

迪纳达布体现着拉梅顿山民安静而坚忍的性格。这座小村藏在起伏山坡之间，牧羊人世代在此照看羊群，生活方式从努门诺尔建立以前到如今几乎没有改变。这里如此宁静，即便在战争动荡中也算相对安全之地，但并非没有代价。索隆阴影笼罩刚铎的无晓之日，村中之子福伊里昂丧生；他的缺席像一道迟迟无法愈合的伤口，萦绕着这个紧密相连的社群。迪纳达布的房屋围绕中央羊圈和洗毛池聚集，著名的拉梅顿羊毛会在山中流下的冰冷清水里洗净。当地人说话保留着古代戴恩人传下的语言特点；那些古老民族曾居住在这些山谷中，早在刚铎诸王西望之前就已存在。小村也充当北方通道的守望点，一旦山口出现威胁，骑手便会立刻把警讯带往卡伦贝尔。
Dûrkan of House Bozorganith rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
博佐加尼思家族的杜尔坎率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。

Dûrzan commands a Tower-guard company in the shadow of Barad-dur itself, chosen for cunning over bulk by an officer of the Mouth's household. Payback is the engine of him, for a Morgul-captain reported his company light at a muster three years past and his banner was nearly broken for it. That captain is dead now in a stair-quarrel none can quite explain, and Dûrzan has been seen at the Mouth's gate more than once since. He keeps a particular eye on the Cirith Ungol garrison, and on Maugrukh's accounting of the dead.
杜尔赞在巴拉督尔的阴影下指挥一支塔卫部队。索隆之口家中的一名军官提拔了他，看中的不是他的块头，而是他的狡诈。他一心想着报复：三年前集结时，一名魔古尔队长举报他的部队人数不足，险些让他的队伍被撤销。如今，那名队长已死在一场没人说得清的楼梯争斗中，此后人们不止一次在索隆之口的门前看见杜尔赞。他特别留意奇立斯乌苟驻军，以及莫格鲁赫上报的死亡人数。
Dûshrat proved his worth in single combat against dozens of challengers. He now leads the elite guard of the White Hand.
杜什拉特在与数十名挑战者的单挑中证明了自己的价值。如今他统领白手的精锐卫队。
伊比尔是卢伊钱的妻子。

Each culture's AI fights field battles with its own doctrine: Dwarves hold a shield wall on the high ground, Elves ring their archers with infantry, Rohan leads with cavalry, Mordor and Gundabad mass their infantry. Replaces the tactic list the engine's team AI chooses from; the AI still picks by weight every 5 seconds. Applies from the NEXT battle (the list cannot change once a battle has started). Your own orders are never touched; when you delegate command (F6) your army fights with its culture's doctrine. Off by default until the in-game A/B passes; tuning lives in ModuleData/culture_doctrine/culture_doctrines.json, which reloads on game restart only.

各文化的 AI 在野战中使用自己的战法：矮人在高地坚守盾墙，精灵用步兵围护弓手，洛汗以骑兵带头，魔多和贡达巴德集中步兵。替换引擎供队伍 AI 选择的战术列表，AI 仍每5秒按权重选择。下次战斗起生效，战斗开始后不能更改列表。不会修改你的直接命令；委托指挥（F6）后，部队会按自身文化作战。完成游戏内 A/B 测试前默认关闭。参数位于 ModuleData/culture_doctrine/culture_doctrines.json，只在重启游戏时重新读取。

Each culture's soldiers fight the melee their own way: orcs attack on sight and rarely cover with a shield, Dwarves and Gondor raise shields and hold, Elves shoot straighter, Rohan commits to a charge from further out. Multiplies the engine's per-soldier AI decision values after skill has set them. Needs Enable Culture Doctrine. Applies to soldiers spawned from the next battle; tuning in culture_doctrines.json.
各文化的士兵有不同战斗习惯：奥克见敌就打，很少举盾；矮人和刚铎士兵举盾坚守；精灵射击更准；洛汗骑兵从更远处开始冲锋。技能确定单个士兵的 AI 决策值后，再乘以文化系数。需要开启“文化战法”。下次战斗中生成的士兵起生效，参数位于 culture_doctrines.json。

Each culture's soldiers hold under fear their own way: Dwarves, Elves, Isengard, Gundabad and Dol Guldur never rout (pride, or a hatred too great), the free peoples of Rohan, Gondor and Dale and the men of the East and South break as vanilla does, and every culture carries a bravery offset on its starting morale. Needs Enable Culture Doctrine. Applies from the next battle; tuning in culture_doctrines.json.
各文化应对恐惧的方式不同：矮人、精灵、艾森加德、贡达巴德和多古尔都因骄傲或强烈仇恨而不会溃逃；洛汗、刚铎、河谷邦的自由人民，以及东方和南方的人类，按原版规则溃逃。每种文化的初始士气还有各自的勇气修正。需要开启“文化战法”。下次战斗起生效，参数位于 culture_doctrines.json。

Each lord who fought against you in a battle thinks less of you, once per lord per battle (once per clan when Personal Relations is off, because a clan then shares one relation). Bandits are never counted. Default: off.
与你交战的每位领主都会降低对你的好感，每位领主每战结算一次。关闭个人关系时，则每个家族只结算一次，因为家族共享关系。匪徒不计入。默认：关闭。
Each lord's daily chance to escape: {CHANCE}%
每名领主每天的逃脱概率：{CHANCE}%

Each orc and goblin warrior walks with one of several gait sets, picked at random and fixed for that soldier. A gait set that is not installed is skipped, so with none installed this does nothing. Applied when a soldier spawns, so it takes effect in the next battle.
每名奥克和半兽人士兵会随机采用一套步态，并在该士兵身上保持不变。未安装的步态会跳过；如果一套都没安装，此项不会产生效果。生成士兵时应用，因此从下一场战斗开始生效。

Each soldier's step size is vanilla's step size times a random factor between this value and 1.00. Vanilla's own step size is 0.80 at Athletics 0 and rises to 1.00 at Athletics 300, so the factor is not the final step size: at 0.92 an Athletics 0 soldier ends at 0.74 to 0.80 and an Athletics 300 soldier at 0.92 to 1.00, and at 0.80 the lowest step size is 0.64. 1.00 turns the spread off. A value outside 0.80 to 1.00 falls back to 0.92.
每名士兵的步幅为原版步幅乘以此值至1.00之间的随机系数。原版步幅在跑动技能0时为0.80，跑动技能300时增至1.00，因此这里的系数不是最终步幅。设为0.92时，跑动0的士兵最终步幅为0.74至0.80，跑动300的士兵为0.92至1.00；设为0.80时，最低步幅为0.64。1.00为取消差异。设置超出0.80至1.00范围时，回退为0.92。
埃德弗里斯·艾尔夫威金
Eadric the Swift is chieftain of a mountain clan, hardened young by border warfare.
“迅捷者”埃德里克是一支山地氏族的酋长，年轻时就被边境战争磨炼得十分坚韧。
埃德瓦尔德·艾尔夫威金
Echoes of Mûmakan boosts beast resilience during the charge.
穆玛坎的回响会在冲锋期间强化巨兽韧性。
Echoes of Mûmakan charge greatly reduced, unending dread.
穆玛坎的回响充能消耗大幅降低，恐惧永不止息。
Echoes of Mûmakan charge reduced, terror always imminent.
穆玛坎的回响充能消耗降低，让恐怖随时逼近。
Echoes of Mûmakan duration extended, fear lingers.
穆玛坎的回响持续时间延长，恐惧久久不散。
Echoes of Mûmakan grants +10% horse charge damage and spreads fear.
穆玛坎的回响提供 +10% 坐骑冲锋伤害，并散播恐惧。
Echoes of Mûmakan radius expanded, fear spreads further.
穆玛坎的回响作用范围扩大，恐惧传播得更远。
Echoes of Mûmakan radius greatly expanded, the very earth shakes.
穆玛坎的回响作用范围大幅扩大，连大地都随之震颤。
Eilidh manages the clan's horse herds.
艾莉德负责管理氏族马群。
Eira Shadowclaw moves silently through enemy camps, striking without warning.
“影爪”艾拉悄无声息地穿行于敌营，毫无预兆地出手。
Elanor Swiftness boosts mount resilience while active.
埃拉诺的敏捷生效期间，会增强坐骑韧性。
Elanor Swiftness charge greatly reduced, ride without ceasing.
埃拉诺的敏捷充能消耗大幅降低，可以不停骑行。
Elanor Swiftness charge reduced, swifter activation.
埃拉诺的敏捷充能消耗降低，发动更加迅捷。
Elanor Swiftness duration extended, maintaining momentum.
埃拉诺的敏捷持续时间延长，让攻势保持更久。
Elanor Swiftness grants +5% melee damage and elven grace.
埃拉诺的敏捷提供 +5% 近战伤害，并赋予你精灵般的优雅。
Elanor Swiftness radius expanded, sweeping wider formations.
埃拉诺的敏捷作用范围扩大，可以扫过更宽的阵型。
Elanor Swiftness radius greatly expanded, unstoppable impact.
埃拉诺的敏捷作用范围大幅扩大，冲击势不可挡。
Elarwen, wife of Hirgon, is a woman of the borders known for her resilience and practical wisdom.
埃拉玟是希尔巩的妻子，是一位边境女子，以坚韧和实用智慧闻名。
Elbereth, invoking Varda's name, leads with celestial hymns, her clan drawing strength from ancient Avari roots in the deep woods.
埃尔贝瑞丝借用了瓦尔妲的名号，以星辰圣歌领导族人。她的氏族扎根于深林中的古老阿瓦瑞传统，并从中汲取力量。
Elbet serves in the household of Erkenbrand.
埃尔贝特在埃肯布兰德家中效力。
Eldith Grey-Claw is a fierce warrior woman of Dunland, renowned for her ferocity in battle.
埃尔迪丝·灰爪是黑蛮地凶悍的女战士，以战斗中的狂烈闻名。
Eldra Boarsong carries on the fierce traditions of her parents.
“野猪歌”艾尔德拉继承了父母凶悍的传统。
Eleduran the younger serves as a horse warden.
小埃莱杜兰担任马匹看守。
Eleduran trains warhorses for the king's army.
埃莱杜兰为国王军队训练战马。
Elendara is heir to the western vale holdings.
埃兰达拉是西部谷地领地的继承人。

Eleneth, second of the wedded ladies of the House of Olindurionath, was given in alliance out of an old huntsmen-line of the Anfalas coast, and she is thirty winters told. She keeps a small reliquary of weathered driftwood said to bear the mark of a Númenórean keel cast up in the year of the Dimming, and she names it her dower above any gold. She holds, with her house, for the King returned, for the wind-bitten shore has long memory and longer hope, and the watchers of the Langstrand would see the old line restored.
埃兰妮丝是奥林杜瑞昂纳斯家族第二位出嫁的夫人，出身安法拉斯海岸一支古老的猎人血脉，已经三十岁。她保存着一个由风化浮木制成的小圣物匣，据说上面带有昏暗之年被冲上海岸的努门诺尔船龙骨印记；在她看来，这件东西胜过任何黄金嫁妆。她与自己的家族一样支持归来的国王，因为被风吹咬的海岸有漫长的记忆，也有更漫长的希望；长滩的守望者想看见古老王脉复归。

Eleniel of the House of Barahirionath is but fourteen summers old, yet already she is named among the fairest maidens of Lossarnach, the Vale of Flowers. She is taught the old songs of plenty and the older songs of mourning, and her father's foresters have begun to school her in the axe-craft for which her vale is famed. Her house keeps faith with Lord Denethor, as the husbandmen of Lossarnach have ever kept faith with the City whose granaries they fill; the young lady knows no other loyalty, and asks none.
巴拉希瑞昂纳斯家族的埃兰妮尔只有十四个夏天，却已经被称为洛斯阿尔那赫花谷中最美丽的少女之一。她学习丰收的古歌，也学习更古老的哀歌；她父亲的林地守卫也开始教她掌握这个山谷闻名的斧技。她的家族忠于德内梭尔领主，就像洛斯阿尔那赫农夫一直忠于他们粮仓所供养的白城一样；这位年轻小姐不懂其他忠诚，也不想要其他忠诚。
Eleven years I led the pass raids for the Goblin-town host. Merchants' wagons, dwarf caravans, a Beorning farm if the snow was kind. My plans held. My boys came home fat.
十一年，我替半兽人镇的大军带队劫掠隘口。商人的大车、矮人的商队，雪不太厚时，再抢个贝奥恩农场。我的计划管用，手下都吃得肥肥的回来。
Elf-wine, dwarf-iron, salt, rope. All for sale. Even rope.
精灵葡萄酒、矮人的铁、盐、绳子，全卖。没错，连绳子都卖。
埃尔芙格里姆·格里明加斯
Elfgrim serves as a rider of the royal household.
艾尔夫格林是王室家中的骑手。
埃尔芙希尔德·奥德拉金
Elfhild was queen of Rohan, mother of Théodred. She died in childbirth, a grief that shadowed Théoden's reign.
埃尔芙希尔德曾是洛汗王后，也是希奥杰德的母亲。她死于分娩，这份悲痛一直笼罩着希奥顿的统治。
Elidilea serves in the dark hierarchy.
埃利迪蕾娅效力于黑暗阶层。
Eligible careers for your culture and standing.
适合你文化和身份的职业。
Elite armored infantry of Minas Tirith.
米那斯提力斯的精锐披甲步兵。
Elite guard who became too powerful for his master's comfort. Seeks worthy employment.
精锐守卫，强大到让主人感到不安。正在寻找值得效力的雇主。
Elite heavy cavalry of the King.
国王麾下的精锐重骑兵。
来自巴拉督尔的精锐冲击步兵。

Elite shock trooper, unleashed when Saruman needed maximum violence. Gates smashed, defenders slaughtered, villages reduced to ash, that's my specialty. The berserker blood makes me fearless, unstoppable. Give me a target, watch it burn. Simple. Effective.
我是精锐突击兵，萨茹曼需要最大程度的暴力时才会把我放出去。砸开大门，屠杀守军，把村庄烧成灰，这就是我的专长。狂战士的血让我无所畏惧，势不可挡。给我一个目标，看它烧起来。简单，有效。
Elite troops desert each day while you have no {RESOURCE}
没有{RESOURCE}时，每天都会有精锐士兵逃离队伍
Elite units bound to specific regions
精锐单位绑定特定地区
精锐部队维护消耗（{TYPES}种兵种）
Elphir, eldest son of Imrahil, is heir to Dol Amroth. He commands the Swan Knights with martial precision and carries his father's noble bearing.
埃尔菲尔是伊姆拉希尔的长子，也是多阿姆洛斯继承人。他以严整武艺指挥天鹅骑士，并继承父亲高贵的气度。
Elrond has sent {HUNTER} with a host of the Eldar to bring you down.
埃尔隆德派遣{HUNTER}率领埃尔达大军前来击败你。
Elrond honors your service. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
埃尔隆德嘉奖你的贡献。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。

Elrond's hidden valley, sanctuary of the Wise. Elven Wisdom unifies armies at little influence cost; the Last Homely House grows hearths in every village. Elven Pride still drives every council — every Noldor blade is irreplaceable.
幽谷是埃尔隆德的隐秘山谷，也是智者的庇护所。精灵智慧让军队能以较少影响力团结起来；最后家园让每座村庄户数增长。精灵骄傲仍会影响每一次议会，因为每一柄诺多之刃都无可替代。

Elrond, the Lord of Rivendell, is a figure of unmatched wisdom, healing, and foresight. As a descendant of both Elves and Men, he bridges the two worlds with grace and understanding. Rivendell, under his guidance, stands as a sanctuary of knowledge and refuge for all who seek aid in their struggle against the shadow. Elrond's insight shapes the great councils of the Free Peoples, and his stewardship over the Last Homely House ensures that the light of the Eldar continues to shine. In both counsel and action, he exemplifies the timeless strength and resilience of the Elves.
埃尔隆德，幽谷之主，是智慧、医术与远见都无人可及的人物。他兼有精灵与人类的血脉，以从容和理解联结着两个世界。在他的引领下，幽谷成为知识与庇护之地，所有为对抗阴影而寻求援助的人都能在这里得到庇护。埃尔隆德的洞见影响着自由人民的重要会议，他守护最后家园，也让埃尔达的光辉继续闪耀。无论在议事还是行动中，他都体现出精灵历久不衰的力量与韧性。
Elthild is a noble lady of the Eoforing.
艾尔希尔德是埃奥尔家族的贵族女士。
精灵骄傲提高影响力花费
Elven Sight charge greatly reduced, relentless fire.
精灵锐眼充能消耗大幅降低，火力毫不间断。
Elven Sight charge reduced, maintaining constant pressure.
精灵锐眼充能消耗降低，可以持续向敌人施压。
Elven Sight duration extended, sustained barrage.
精灵锐眼持续时间延长，压制射击不断持续。
Elven Sight gains additional penetration while active.
精灵锐眼生效期间，会获得额外穿透力。
Elven Sight grants +5% ranged damage with centuries of practice.
精灵锐眼凭借数百年练习提供 +5% 远程伤害。
Elven Sight radius greatly expanded, inescapable volleys.
精灵锐眼作用范围大幅扩大，齐射让敌人无处可逃。
Elven Sight radius increased, covering wider kill zones.
精灵锐眼作用范围扩大，可以覆盖更宽的杀伤区域。
敌军进攻时可用精灵齐射
Elys is a noble lady of the Rohirrim court.
伊莉丝是洛希尔宫廷中的贵族女士。

允许为7至10阶兵种设置用于自动战斗结算的战力值。
Enables configurable wound/kill ratios for battle simulation.
允许设置自动战斗结算中的受伤与死亡比例。
Enemies flee before your warhost. +5% troop damage.
敌人在你的大军面前四散奔逃。+5% 部队伤害。

Enemy archers that have nothing to shoot at, are steady, and are within bow range of you may fix on you and shoot, for a few seconds at a time. A cap keeps the volley small. Archers of a team that is making a stand against horse are left to that stand. Field battles, sieges and sally-outs. Default: on.
敌方弓兵没有射击目标、状态稳定，且你在其射程内时，可能转而瞄准你，每次持续数秒。同时瞄准的人数有上限，不会形成过大的齐射。正在择地抵御骑兵的阵营，其弓兵会继续承担抗骑任务，不受此项干扰。适用于野战、攻城和突围出击。默认：开启。
Enemy commanders wait 50 percent longer between war cries and summonings.
敌方指挥官战吼与召唤之间的间隔延长50%。
Engineer exiled for creating weapons too reminiscent of dragon-fire. Innovation knows no taboos.
工程师，因制造太像龙焰的武器被流放。创新不该有禁忌。
Engineers: your units deal 50% more damage to towers.
工程师：你的单位对防御塔造成的伤害增加50%。
Enkhtuya of House Vazevian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
瓦泽维安家族的恩赫图雅是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Enough rounds have been poured for one day.
今天已经请过足够多轮了。
Enough. Go. Run before we change our minds. Gundabad is still hungry.[ib:closed]
够了。走。在我们改主意前快跑，贡达巴德可还饿着呢。[ib:closed]
Enter a blood-fuelled rage, inspiring nearby Black Uruks — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
让嗜血的狂怒席卷全身，并鼓舞附近的黑乌鲁克：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。
Enter a graceful Noldor combat trance — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
进入优雅的诺多战斗步法：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。

输入新名称，需花费{COST}影响力。

爆发恶毒蛮力投入战斗：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。

陷入乌鲁克的狂暴战意：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。
Eorwyn Featherbolt prefers the bow to the blade, striking from the shadows.
比起刀剑，“羽矢”埃奥尔温更喜欢弓箭，常从阴影中出手。
Eotheod ride in close formation. +2% troop damage.
伊奥希奥德骑手以紧密队形驰骋。+2% 部队伤害。
换上已保存的预设装备。
Equipment Presets are disabled in MCM.
装备预设已在 MCM 中禁用。
Erchirion, second son of Imrahil, serves as a knight of Dol Amroth. Bold in battle and loyal to his house, he rides with his father's Swan Knights.
埃尔奇瑞安是伊姆拉希尔的次子，作为多阿姆洛斯骑士服役。他作战勇敢，忠于家族，随父亲的天鹅骑士一同出征。
Erdurand is a rider of Théoden's household.
埃尔杜兰德是希奥顿家中的骑手。
孤山单手斧配重球 A
孤山双手斧配重球 A
孤山双手斧配重球 A2
孤山双手斧配重球 B
孤山双手斧配重球 B2

Erebor fears weapons that remind them of past horrors, but our enemies won't hesitate to use fire against us. My designs could save the mountain when war comes. Until they realize this, I'll build for those with clearer vision and fewer haunting memories.
孤山害怕那些会让他们想起旧日恐惧的武器，但我们的敌人不会犹豫用火来对付我们。我的设计能在战争到来时拯救这座山。在他们明白这一点之前，我会为眼光更清楚、噩梦更少的人制造武器。

Erebor grows wealthy, but I see storm clouds gathering. Orcs mass in the Grey Mountains, strange messengers ride south. My healing skills and knowledge of the enemy will serve those preparing for what comes. The mountain may not need me, but the wider world does.
孤山越来越富，但我看见风暴正在聚拢。奥克在灰色山脉集结，奇怪的信使向南骑去。我的医术，以及我对敌人的了解，会帮助那些为将来做准备的人。山中也许不需要我，但更广阔的世界需要。

Erebor may embrace merchant ways, but the world still needs iron warriors. Orcs gather, darkness spreads, and someone must stand ready. My hammer and shield seek those who value strength over comfort, preparation over profit.
孤山也许拥抱了商人那套，可世界仍需要铁一般的战士。奥克正在集结，黑暗正在蔓延，总得有人准备好。我的战锤和盾牌，要寻找那些重视力量胜过舒适、重视备战胜过利润的人。
Erebor's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #2A4DA8.
孤山在地图上的颜色，格式为 #RRGGBB。留空使用默认值 #2A4DA8。
埃瑞德路因资深商队护卫
Ered Luin's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #7B68EE.
埃瑞德路因在地图上的颜色，格式为#RRGGBB。留空使用默认值#7B68EE。
Erestor, chief of the counsellors of the house of Elrond, sets aside the ledger for the sword when the passes of the Misty Mountains grow restless.
埃瑞斯托是埃尔隆德家族的首席顾问。每当迷雾山脉的隘口不再安宁，他就会放下账册，拿起长剑。
额儿格捏是阿姆杜尔的妻子。
Ergeon is a chieftain who leads the eastern Variag clans, known for their swift cavalry tactics.
埃尔吉昂是一名酋长，率领东部瓦里亚格氏族，以迅捷骑兵战术闻名。
Erkenbrand, Lord of Westfold, commands the fortress of the Hornburg. He arrived with Gandalf at Helm's Deep to turn the tide of battle.
埃肯布兰德是西伏尔德领主，统领号角堡。他与甘道夫一同赶到海尔姆深谷，扭转了战局。
埃萨切伊是莫卢克的妻子。
埃瑟伦是沙哈尔的妻子。
Establish a camp here first, then raise a refuge from it.
请先在这里扎营，再将营地扩建为避难所。
Esur is a warrior of Gûrtilm's host.
额速儿是古尔提姆军中的一名战士。

Ethacali Cilzeron, a diplomatic envoy of Rhûn, negotiates treaties and alliances in the Third Age to expand Sauron's influence. His eloquence and cunning secure vital pacts. Ethacali's words weave a net of loyalty around the Easterling clans.
埃萨卡利·西尔泽隆是鲁恩的外交使者，在第三纪元为扩张索隆影响力而谈判条约和盟约。他的口才与狡诈能争取关键协定。埃萨卡利的话语在东夷氏族周围织成一张忠诚之网。
Even a thief can learn what hunger costs.
就算是贼，也能明白挨饿是什么滋味。
Even among orcs, some hunger for glory beyond their station...
即便在奥克之中，也有人渴望超出自身地位的荣耀……
Even death cannot stop the faithful. +9 health.
即使死亡也无法阻止虔诚的信徒。+9 生命值。
Even gravely wounded you keep fighting. +9 health.
即使身受重伤，你也会继续战斗。+9 生命值。
Even grievous injury cannot stop the Olog. +9 health.
就算身受重伤，也无法阻止奥洛格。+9 生命值。
Even in the Dark Tower's shadow, some see opportunity in chaos...
即使在邪黑塔的阴影下，也有人能从混乱中看到机会……
Even mortal wounds do not slow you. +9 health.
致命伤也无法让你慢下来。+9 生命值。
Even siege bolts bounce off your hide. +10% resistance to ranged.
连攻城弩矢都会从你的厚皮上弹开。+10% 远程抗性。
Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
再不起眼的人，也能改变未来的走向。
Even when outnumbered, you do not fall easily. +6 health.
即使寡不敌众，你也不会轻易倒下。+6 生命值。
Every Dunlending fights as a berserker in your name. +12% melee damage.
每个黑蛮地人都会以你的名义像狂战士一样战斗。+12% 近战伤害。
Every House of Âbanissa is built on its ledgers as much as its spears. I kept one such ledger. Listen.
阿巴尼萨的每个家族，都是靠账册和长矛一同撑起来的。我曾掌管过这样一本账册。听着。
Every caravan on the Dwarf-road needs a guide, and every guide has his price...
矮人路上每支商队都要向导，而每个向导都有自己的价钱……
Every cask on the quay at Tharbad has a number, and I knew them all...
沙巴德码头的每只桶都有编号，我以前全记得……
Every clan from Dunland sends warriors to your banner. +6 party size.
黑蛮地每个氏族都会派出战士投到你的旗下。+6 部队规模。
Every cleared wave pays 35 percent more gold.
每击退一波敌军，金钱奖励增加35%。
Every corpse has a number. Ask me what yours is worth.
每具尸体都得记个数。问问我，你的值多少。
Every day, and I fear it as often. If my claim comes, it will not come by taking. I am glad you ask as a friend.
每天都想，也同样害怕。如果真有那一天，我也绝不会靠强夺来得到王位。你能以朋友的身份问起这件事，我很高兴。
Every defender, the lord too, regains {SHARE}% of the health he is missing. Once between waves.
每名守军，包括领主，恢复已损失生命值的{SHARE}%。每两波之间可使用一次。
Every foe you cut down pays 30 percent more gold.
每击杀一个敌人，金钱奖励增加30%。
Every fortress wall, every village square, every mountain pass - I capture their essence and rebuild them in perfect detail. Some call it art, I call it preservation.
每一段城墙、每一座村庄广场、每一处山口，我都捕捉它们的神韵，再以完美的细节重建。有些人称之为艺术，我称之为保存。
Every hunter in Dunland answers your call. +4 party size.
黑蛮地每一名猎手都会回应你的召唤。+4 部队规模。
Every rider in Dunland rides under your banner. Warpack Charge radius +5.
黑蛮地每一名骑手都在你的旗帜下驰骋。战群冲锋作用范围 +5。
Every road has a price. I know the price of most.
每条路都有价钱。大多数的价钱，我都知道。
Every scar tells of a victory survived. +7 health.
每一道伤疤都见证了你活着赢下的一场战斗。+7 生命值。
Every shaft is lethal. +14% ranged damage.
每一支箭都足以致命。+14% 远程伤害。
Every title of the realms, from the village lordships to the high crowns: who holds each by right and who claims it.
列出各国从村庄领主到至高王位的所有头衔，以及各头衔的合法持有者和宣称者。
Every trophy adds to your fearsome legend. +14% battle renown gain.
每一件战利品都会让你的可怖传说更响亮。+14% 战斗声望获取。

Every valley, every mountain peak, every forest glade - I craft them with the care of one who knows that landscapes shape the stories told within them. My scenes don't just exist, they breathe with life and purpose.
每一道山谷、每一座山峰、每一片林间空地，我都以明白地貌如何塑造故事的人那样去雕琢。我的场景不只是存在，它们会呼吸，也有自己的生命与目的。
Every wave carries one affix fewer.
每波敌军减少一条词缀。
Every wave carries two affixes fewer.
每波敌军减少两条词缀。
Every weapon is honed by the Stangard smiths. +8% melee damage.
每件武器都经过斯坦加德铁匠仔细打磨。+8% 近战伤害。
Every weapon is honed by the Wainwatch smiths. +8% melee damage.
战车哨站的铁匠将每一件武器都磨得锋利。+8%近战伤害。
Every wolfskin hunter in Dunland rides with you. +6 party size.
黑蛮地每一名月獠猎手都会与你同往战场。+6 部队规模。
Everyone has a price. Name yours: {PRICE} gold.
人人都有个价。开价吧：{PRICE}金。
Everything in the shop costs 10 percent more.
商店所有物品价格增加10%。
Everything in the shop costs 15 percent more.
商店所有物品价格增加15%。
Everything in the shop costs 20 percent less.
商店所有物品价格降低20%。
Everything in the shop costs 25 percent more.
商店所有物品价格增加25%。
黑暗阵营进攻倾向倍率
Execute a precise twin-blade sequence — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
施展精准的双刃连击：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。
Experimental: hostile parties can attack your refuges (auto-resolved when you are away). Off by default.
实验性功能：敌方部队可以袭击你的避难所。你不在场时会自动结算战斗。默认关闭。

Extra daily and battle training XP for the troops of AI lord parties, as a fraction: 0.25 is 25 percent more. Applies to a lord party that is not yours, not in your clan and not in an army you lead; caravans and garrisons are left out. In a co-op session only the host's value applies; while a co-op mod TAOM cannot probe (such as BannerlordTogether) is enabled, it is off for every player. 0 is vanilla. Between 0 and 1. Default: 0.25.
AI领主部队士兵每天和战斗中额外获得的训练经验比例，0.25表示增加25%。不影响你自己的部队、你家族的部队，以及你率领军团中的部队；商队和驻军也不受影响。合作联机只采用主机端的设置；启用了TAOM无法识别的合作联机MOD，例如BannerlordTogether时，对所有玩家停用。0为原版。范围：0至1。默认：0.25。

Extra hit points per day for wounded heroes: a base amount that the usual healing percentages raise too. Works only while the camp panel is open (Camp Options, then Manage camp); the work menus do not count (set both to 0 to turn rest healing off, lodging perks included). Default 19.
受伤英雄每天额外恢复的生命值。这是基础值，也会受常规治疗百分比加成影响。只有打开营地面板时生效，路径为“营地选项”再选“管理营地”；劳作菜单不计入休养。两项都设为0，可关闭休养治疗，包括住宿技能加成。默认：19。

Extra wounded troops healed per day: a base amount that the usual healing percentages raise too. Works only while the camp panel is open (Camp Options, then Manage camp); the work menus do not count (set both to 0 to turn rest healing off, lodging perks included). Default 15.
每天额外治愈的伤兵数。这是基础值，也会受常规治疗百分比加成影响。只有打开营地面板时生效，路径为“营地选项”再选“管理营地”；劳作菜单不计入休养。两项都设为0，可关闭休养治疗，包括住宿技能加成。默认：15。
Eyes inside the enemy's walls win wars cheaply.
敌人城墙里的眼睛，能用很低的代价赢下战争。

Fade fallen soldiers after a set time and cap how many bodies a battle keeps, whatever your Number of Corpses option says. The engine walks its whole corpse list every frame, and players reported mid-battle freezes at high corpse settings. Field battles, sieges and sally-outs only; towns, arenas and hideouts keep their bodies. Never raises your own Number of Corpses option.
让阵亡士兵的尸体在一定时间后消失，并限制战斗保留的尸体数量，不受“尸体数量”选项的较高值影响。引擎每帧都会遍历完整尸体列表，有玩家反馈高尸体数量会导致战斗中卡死。只用于野战、攻城和出城作战；城镇、竞技场与藏身处保留尸体。不会提高你自己的“尸体数量”设置。
Fade settlement nameplates with camera distance. When off, all nameplates display at full visibility regardless of distance (vanilla).
根据镜头距离，让聚落名牌逐渐淡出。关闭后，无论距离多远，名牌都完全显示，即原版表现。
逐渐消逝的民族，补员稀少
Fair dealing, for a stranger. Keep to the road, and the hills will let you pass this once.
一个外乡人能这么痛快，还算公道。沿着路走，这次山里的人就放你过去。
Fair division of spoils keeps the clan loyal. -5% troop wages.
公平分配战利品能让氏族保持忠诚。-5% 部队工资。
Fair winds to you. A share is a share, and Umbar remembers a fair deal.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
祝你一路顺风。该分的那份就是该分的，乌姆巴尔不会忘记公道的买卖。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
Fair. The plains forget no debt, and neither do we. Ride on, and ride quickly.
公道。草原不忘欠账，我们也一样。走吧，骑快点。

Falathwen was born of a knightly house of Anfalas, the wind-bitten Langstrand, and was betrothed to Orondir when both were yet children, the alliance sworn between their fathers ere the eastern war took Baranor. She is gentle of bearing but resolute, and has borne her young lord twin children before her own four and twentieth year. She follows him in his fealty to the Steward.
法拉斯玟出生于安法拉斯长滩的一支骑士家族；在东方战争夺走巴拉诺尔之前，她与奥隆迪尔还都是孩子时，两人的父亲便立下了这桩婚约。她举止温柔但意志坚定，在自己二十四岁之前已经为年轻领主生下一对双胞胎。她追随丈夫，效忠宰相。
False accusation is a bitter draught to swallow.
遭人诬陷，这杯苦酒实在难以下咽。
狂热的多古尔都战歌咏唱者
狂热的半兽人战歌咏唱者
狂热的贡达巴德战歌咏唱者
狂热的奥克战歌咏唱者
Fancy smithing won't help in battle, artisan.
花哨的锻造手艺可帮不上战场，工匠。
Far Sight: elven towers fire 50% further than any others.
远视：精灵防御塔的射程比其他防御塔远50%。

Far beyond the Sea of Rhûn, past the withered steppes and the red dust of forgotten empires, lies the vast and veiled East. Here dwell the Easterlings, a proud and ancient people whose history predates even the rise of Gondor. Their lands stretch endlessly beneath wide skies, from the shores of the inland sea to the shadowed mountains that mark the edge of the known world. The Easterlings are no single nation, but a tapestry of tribes and kingdoms, united only in their reverence for strength and their long memory of grievance against the West. Some have served the Dark Lord willingly, drawn by promises of power and vengeance; others resist, clinging to old ways and older gods. Their warriors are feared for their discipline and their mastery of chariot and bow, and their golden armor gleams like fire beneath the eastern sun.

远在鲁恩内海之外，越过枯萎草原和被遗忘帝国的红色尘土，就是辽阔而笼罩面纱的东方。东夷居于此地；他们骄傲而古老，历史甚至早于刚铎崛起。他们的土地在宽广天空下无尽延伸，从内海岸边直到标记已知世界边缘的阴影山脉。东夷并非单一国家，而是部族和王国交织成的图景，只因崇敬力量和长久记得对西方的怨恨而联系在一起。有些人自愿侍奉黑暗魔君，受力量与复仇的许诺吸引；另一些人仍在抵抗，守着旧道路和更古老的神祇。他们的战士以纪律、战车和弓术闻名，金色铠甲在东方太阳下如火般闪耀。
Faramir, younger son of Denethor, is Captain of the Rangers of Ithilien. Though overlooked by his father, he is beloved by his men for his wisdom, mercy, and quiet strength.
法拉米尔是德内梭尔的幼子，也是伊希利恩游侠队长。尽管被父亲忽视，他仍因智慧、仁慈和安静的力量而深受部下爱戴。
Farina is wife to the golden banner chief.
法丽娜是金旗酋长的妻子。
Farzana is daughter of the merchant prince.
法尔扎娜是商人王子的女儿。
Fast hit-and-run cavalry of the White Hand.
白手麾下迅捷的打了就跑骑兵。
在雪地和峭壁上行动迅速
在雪地和山地上行动迅速
法斯特赫姆·莫尔卡加斯
Fasthelm Morcargas commands the southern watch posts.
法斯特赫姆·莫尔卡加斯统领南部哨所。
Fear can make men see monsters.
人一害怕，也会看见怪物。
Fear has killed more good men than any warband.
被恐惧害死的好人，比任何战团杀的都多。
Fear has taken more men than orcs ever did.
被恐惧击垮的人，比死在奥克手里的还多。
Fear is not a crime, and you are speaking of it now.
害怕不是罪，何况你现在肯说了。
Fear of your wrath drives the host onward. -5% troop wages.
对你怒火的恐惧会驱使军势继续向前。-5% 部队工资。
Fear touches every man. You have paid for it.
人人都会害怕。你也已经付出代价了。
Feed me, give me a hammer and an anvil, and I will turn your steel into something that kills.
给我饭吃，给我锤子和铁砧，我就把你的钢打成杀人的家伙。
Feeding the hungry is no crime to me.
在我看来，让饿肚子的人吃上饭不算犯罪。
Feeding the survivors is as good a fight as any.
养活幸存者，也是一场值得打的仗。
Fenagan is a Variag champion known for his dueling prowess.
费纳甘是一名瓦里亚格勇士，以决斗本领闻名。
Fenrik the Red Wolf leads raiding parties deep into enemy territory.
“红狼”芬里克率领劫掠队深入敌境。

Feren, a loyal captain in Thranduil's guard, reflects the steadfast warriors seen in the films, patrolling the borders with unmatched archery skill. His devotion to the Elvenking ensures the safety of the halls, warding off spiders and orcs with precision and valor.
费伦是瑟兰杜伊卫队中忠诚的队长，有着电影中那些坚定战士的影子。他以高超的箭术巡守边境，对精灵王的忠诚确保了王宫大厅的安全，也让蜘蛛和奥克在他的精准射击前止步。
Few lords, with goblins at the door
领主少，半兽人就在家门口
人数稀少，每名战士都很重要

Few who entered the pits were named worthy. You did not merely survive — you broke three challengers in succession before the overseers called it done. The legionary brand was pressed into your arm before the crowd dispersed.
很少有人进了斗坑还能被称作合格。你不只是活下来，还在监工叫停前连续打垮三个挑战者。人群散去前，军团烙印被按进了你的手臂。
Few would have held that door. Good work.
换别人未必守得住那扇门，干得好。
Fiarad guards the southern trade routes.
菲阿拉德守卫南部商路。
Fief management is turned off in the mod options.
MOD选项中已关闭封地管理。
Field camps are disabled in the mod options.
野战营地已在模组选项中禁用。
Field care is already used between these waves.
这两波之间已经使用过战地治疗。
凶悍的瓦里亚格战祭司
Fight goblins long enough and you learn to smell the next raid coming...
跟半兽人打得够久，下回劫掠还没到，你就能闻到味儿……
Fighting fire with fire, practical, if disturbing.
以火攻火，实用，虽然令人不安。
Find the band that took my men and break it. Do that and you'll be paid, no questions asked.
找到抓走我手下的那伙人，把他们打垮。办成了就有钱拿，我不会多问。
Find the gang that took my girl and break it. Bring her safe home and I will give you all I have to spare.
找到抓走我女儿的那伙人，把他们打垮。只要把她平安带回家，我愿意拿出所有能拿得出的东西来报答你。
Find the raiders waiting in ambush and destroy them. Clear the road and my goods -- and your reward -- will get through.
找到那些埋伏的劫掠者，把他们消灭。道路畅通了，我的货物和你的报酬才能送过来。
Find the swindlers and break them. Teach them a lesson they will not forget and I will reward you as I am able.
找到那些骗子，给他们一个忘不了的教训。我会尽我所能报答你。
Findariel, wife of Ciryandur, manages the affairs of their household with care and intelligence.
芬达瑞尔是奇瑞安杜尔的妻子，以谨慎和智慧管理家中事务。
Finduilas, consort to Taurion, channels the tragic beauty of her namesake from the Silmarillion, her healing arts sustaining river guardians against Dol Guldur's poisons.
芬杜伊拉丝是陶瑞昂的配偶，承袭《精灵宝钻》中同名人物的悲剧美感。她的疗愈技艺支撑着河畔守卫，使他们能抵御多古尔都的毒害。
出色的杜内丹弓手与卫士
Fine rangers and a hard two-handed guard
出色的游民与顽强的双手武器卫士
Fire from a stable corsair stance — boosts +20% ranged damage, +20% draw speed, and +15% movement speed for 8s.
以海盗熟悉的稳固姿态开火：+20% 远程伤害，+20% 拉弓速度，+15% 移动速度，持续 8 秒。
Fire from an elevated woodland vantage — boosts +20% ranged damage, +20% draw speed, and +15% movement speed for 8s.
从林间高处占据优势开火：+20% 远程伤害，+20% 拉弓速度，+15% 移动速度，持续 8 秒。
Firebeard Volley charge greatly reduced, relentless fire.
火须齐射所需充能大幅减少，箭矢连绵不绝。
Firebeard Volley charge reduced, maintaining constant pressure.
火须齐射所需充能减少，能够持续压制敌人。
Firebeard Volley duration extended, sustained barrage.
火须齐射持续时间延长，箭幕持续不息。
Firebeard Volley gains additional penetration while active.
火须齐射生效期间，提供额外破甲。
Firebeard Volley grants +5% ranged damage with masterwork bolts.
火须齐射以大师打造的弩矢提供+5%远程伤害。
Firebeard Volley radius greatly expanded, inescapable volleys.
火须齐射的作用范围大幅扩大，敌人难逃齐射。
Firebeard Volley radius increased, covering wider kill zones.
火须齐射的作用范围扩大，覆盖更广的杀伤区域。
Fished the Long Lake and worked the surrounding fields.
在长湖捕鱼并耕作周边田地。
Fishermen of the Great River take up the boat-hook and the spear when the watch calls. Not all of us stand when the shouting starts.
守卫队一招呼，大河的渔民就拿起船钩和长矛。可喊杀声响起来时，我们不是人人都站得住。
Fishermen of the Long Lake take up the boat-hook and the spear when the watch calls. Not all of us stand when the shouting starts.
镇卫队一招呼，长湖的渔民就拿起船钩和长矛。可喊杀声响起来时，我们不是人人都站得住。
Fishermen of the Sea of Rhûn take up the boat-hook and the spear when the watch calls. Not all of us stand when the shouting starts.
守卫队一招呼，鲁恩内海的渔民就拿起船钩和长矛。可喊杀声响起来时，我们不是人人都站得住。
Fiskdal lies above the rapids of a swift river near Taigbarn. Its fishermen climb down the cliffs each morning to set their nets.
菲斯克达尔位于泰格巴恩附近一条湍急河流的急流上方。渔民每天早晨爬下峭壁撒网。
Five minutes remain. The side with the most towers standing will then win.
还剩五分钟，结束时防御塔剩余最多的一方获胜。
Floraidh is daughter of the mountain guardian.
弗洛蕾德是山口守卫者的女儿。
Focus ancient elven perception — boosts +20% ranged damage, +20% draw speed, and +15% movement speed for 8s.
凝聚古老精灵的敏锐感知：+20% 远程伤害，+20% 拉弓速度，+15% 移动速度，持续 8 秒。
Folk of the Forochel shore live on seal, fur and whatever the hunt gives. We learn early to count every arrow and every coin.
佛洛赫尔海岸的人靠海豹、毛皮和猎物过活。我们很小就学会了，每支箭、每枚钱都得算着用。
Followed the herds with the wagon-folk.
For centuries, my people have kept to our forests, but darkness stirs in many places now. I believe we must stand with others against the growing shadows.
数百年来，我的族人一直守在森林中，但如今黑暗在许多地方蠢动。我相信我们必须与他人并肩，抵御日益逼近的阴影。
For iron, guard the weak, rend the marked.
给我铁，我就守住弱者，撕碎被标记的人。

For months contraband had moved through Osgiliath's ruins into Minas Tirith without anyone knowing how. You mapped the routes, identified the ringleader, and handed the whole operation to the city watch. The reward paid for your first real sword.
几个月来，违禁品一直从欧斯吉利亚斯废墟流入米那斯提力斯，却没人知道路线。你绘出线路，找出首领，并把整个团伙交给城防队。赏金买下了你的第一把真正的剑。

For months gold from the old troll-hoards had been turning up in the back rooms of the Last Bridge. You traced the trade, found the men behind it and handed them to the King's wardens, keeping a little of the gold for your trouble.
接连几个月，食人妖旧宝藏里的金币不断出现在最后大桥的后屋交易中。你追查这门买卖，找到幕后的人，把他们交给国王手下的守卫，也留下了一点金币，算是自己的辛苦钱。

For months grave-goods from Tyrn Gorthad had been turning up in the back rooms of Tharbad. You traced the trade, found the men behind it and handed them to the King's wardens, keeping a little of the gold for your trouble.
接连几个月，提殒戈沙德的随葬品不断出现在沙巴德的后屋交易中。你追查这门买卖，找到幕后的人，把他们交给国王手下的守卫，也留下了一点金币，算是自己的辛苦钱。

For months grave-goods from the Barrow-downs had been turning up in the back rooms of Bree. You traced the trade, found the men behind it and handed them to the King's wardens, keeping a little of the gold for your trouble.
接连几个月，古冢岗的随葬品不断出现在布理的后屋交易中。你追查这门买卖，找到幕后的人，把他们交给国王手下的守卫，也留下了一点金币，算是自己的辛苦钱。

For months looted goods had been turning up in the back rooms of Woodmen-town. You traced the trade, found the men behind it and handed them to the king's wardens, keeping a little of the silver for your trouble.
接连几个月，被抢走的货物不断出现在林中居民镇的后屋交易中。你追查这门买卖，找到幕后的人，把他们交给国王手下的守卫，也留下了一点银子，算是自己的辛苦钱。

For months stolen goods from the Misty Mountains had turned up in the back rooms along the river. You traced the trade, found the men behind it and handed them to the wardens, keeping a little of the silver for your trouble.
接连几个月，迷雾山脉来的赃物不断出现在沿河的后屋交易中。你追查这门买卖，找到幕后的人，把他们交给守卫，也留下了一点银子，算是自己的辛苦钱。

For months wine had been leaving the king's warehouses without paying a toll. You traced the cargo, found the harbour official behind it and handed him to the wardens, keeping a little of the silver for your trouble.
接连几个月，葡萄酒没有缴税就被运出国王的仓库。你追查货物，找到幕后操纵的港口官员，把他交给守卫，也留下了一点银子，算是自己的辛苦钱。

For thirty years I was lawspeaker to clan Banûgand, the one who remembered the oaths, judged the feuds, and spoke the old words at the gatherings. The young came to me to settle their quarrels before steel did, and mostly they listened.
三十年来，我曾是巴努甘德氏族的律法代言人，负责记住誓言、裁断仇怨，并在集会上说出古老的词句。年轻人会来找我，在钢铁开口之前解决争端，而他们多数时候也愿意听。

For three ages I have gathered knowledge, but my greatest wisdom came through battle alongside Thyrell, my brother-in-arms. Together we stood at countless fights - he with golden blade, I with ancient words. Blood makes brothers, but shared purpose makes them eternal.
三个纪元以来，我一直收集知识，但我最宝贵的智慧来自与泰瑞尔并肩作战的岁月，他是我的战友兄弟。我们共同经历过无数战斗，他持金色之刃，我握古老之言。血缘能造就兄弟，但共同的目标能让兄弟永存。

For three months you observed, recorded, and cross-referenced Rohirrim movements along the Isen. When you presented the pattern map to Saruman's strategists they rearranged the entire eastern scouting rotation on its basis. Saruman acknowledged you by name in the briefing.
三个月里，你观察、记录并交叉比对艾森河沿线洛希尔人的动向。你把规律图交给萨茹曼的战略人员后，他们据此重排了整个东方侦察轮换。萨茹曼在简报中点名认可了你。
搜集到 +{N} 份谷物（营地共有 {TOTAL} 份）。

Forlong the Fat, Lord of Lossarnach, leads the largest contingent from the fiefs to the defense of Minas Tirith. Despite his girth, he is a fierce and experienced warrior.

Former interrogator from Barad-dûr. I fled after a prisoner's death brought unwanted attention.
曾在巴拉督尔担任审讯者。一名囚犯死亡后引来不该有的注意，于是我逃走了。
Former merchant, exiled for theft. My dishonor is your opportunity.

Fornost's stewards keep the counts of grain and refugees. A few of us have spoken up for the North Downs folk and been sent away for it.

Fraction of an AI lord party's food consumption waived. A large party cannot buy 30 days of food from any town, so it starves permanently, and starvation is -30 morale which opens vanilla's morale-desertion path. 0 = vanilla, which is the default. Only worth raising if you have raised the AI Lord multiplier: at vanilla party sizes nothing starves. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
免除AI领主部队粮食消耗的比例。大部队无法从任何一座城镇买足30天的粮食，因此会长期挨饿；饥饿会扣除30点士气，进而触发原版的低士气逃兵机制。0为原版数值，也是默认值。只有提高过AI领主部队倍率时，才值得提高此项；原版规模的部队不会出现这种饥荒。2026年11月以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。

Fraction of an AI lord party's wage bill waived. AI clan wage budgets are set from clan gold and a large party blows past them, pinning unpaid wages at -20 morale and opening the same desertion path. 0 = vanilla, which is the default. Only worth raising if you have raised the AI Lord multiplier. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
免除AI领主部队军饷的比例。AI家族根据现有资金制定军饷预算，大部队会远超预算，导致欠饷惩罚一直维持在降低20点士气，并触发低士气逃兵机制。0为原版数值，也是默认值。只有提高过AI领主部队倍率时，才建议提高此项。2026年11月以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。
Fraction of each opposed-alignment troop type that deserts per day (minimum 1 per type). Default 0.50 = half per day. Higher clears mixed parties/garrisons faster.
每种立场对立的兵种每天逃走的比例，每种兵种至少1人。默认0.50，即每天一半。数值越高，混合立场的部队和驻军清理得越快。

Fresh from the breeding pits, I'm among Saruman's latest creations, faster, stronger, more resilient than earlier generations. Proven myself in every trial, every combat test. I've killed older Uruks in the fighting rings, shown the White Hand means nothing if you're weak.
我刚从培育坑里出来，是萨茹曼最新的造物之一，比早先几代更快、更强，也更耐打。我在每一次试炼、每一次战斗测试中证明了自己。我在斗环里杀过年长的乌鲁克，证明了如果你软弱，白手印记也毫无意义。
Freya Clawrend leads a warband of fierce shield-maidens into battle. She trained as a warrior from childhood and has never known defeat.
“裂爪”芙蕾雅率领一支凶悍的盾女战帮投入战斗。她自幼接受战士训练，从未尝过败绩。
Freya Wolfheart is the fierce wife of Brenin Wulf. She commands respect among the warriors for her skill with axe and shield.
“狼之心”芙蕾雅是布雷宁·伍尔夫凶悍的妻子。她精通斧与盾，在战士中备受尊敬。
Freydis Oxmane is wife to Othric and a skilled healer as well as warrior.
“牛鬃”弗蕾迪丝是奥瑟里克的妻子，既是医术娴熟的医者，也是一名战士。
From merchant to outlaw, gold corrupts all.

From strong brood, much territory. Craved blade since spawning. Fought whelps and elders. Some packs honor she-slayers; mine snarled shame.
我出身强大的族群，领地很大。我从出生起就渴望拿刀，和幼崽打，也和长辈打。有些兽群尊敬女杀手；我的兽群只会咆哮着说这是羞耻。

Galadriel had need of a cloak worthy of a diplomatic gift to a visiting lord. You were given the commission and the materials and one week. The cloak that left Caras Galadhon made three Elven weavers ask who had made it. Galadriel smiled and did not say.
加拉德瑞尔需要一件足以赠给来访领主的外交礼物。你得到委托、材料和一周时间。那件离开卡拉斯加拉松的斗篷，让三位精灵织工都询问是谁做的。加拉德瑞尔只是微笑，没有回答。

Galadriel, the Lady of Lothlórien, is a being of extraordinary grace, wisdom, and power. As one of the eldest and most revered Elves in Middle-earth, she wields unmatched foresight and a profound connection to the unseen world. Galadriel's strength lies not in martial might but in her unwavering resolve to preserve beauty and hope against the encroaching shadow. Her leadership transforms Lothlórien into a haven of serenity and light, and her guidance inspires unity and courage among the Free Peoples of Middle-earth. Through her wisdom and the radiance of Nenya, she embodies the enduring spirit of resistance against darkness.
加拉德瑞尔，洛丝罗瑞恩夫人，拥有非凡的优雅、智慧与力量。她是中洲最古老、最受尊崇的精灵之一，具备无可匹敌的远见，也与不可见的世界有着深刻联系。加拉德瑞尔的力量不在武勇，而在她守护美与希望、抵挡逼近阴影的坚定意志。她的统治使洛丝罗瑞恩成为宁静与光明的庇护所，她的指引也激励中洲的自由人民团结起来、鼓起勇气。凭借她的智慧与能雅的光辉，她体现了反抗黑暗的长存精神。

Galdirion, son of Rondamir and Rondiel, is but fourteen summers old, yet already the household masters at arms set him to the practice-blade each dawn upon the courtyard stones. He is grey-eyed as his father, and quiet in the manner of the old Númenórean stock, given to long readings of the Annals of the Stewards. The hall names him heir of Erech-march, though he has not yet ridden to war. Ere the Shadow is broken, men say, his hour shall be required of him.
加尔迪瑞昂是隆达米尔和隆迪尔之子，只有十四个夏天；但家族武艺师已经每天黎明都让他在庭院石板上练习木剑。他像父亲一样灰眼睛，也有古老努门诺尔血脉那种安静气质，常长时间阅读《宰相纪年》。厅堂称他为埃瑞赫边境的继承人，尽管他尚未真正上过战场。人们说，在阴影被打破之前，他的时刻终会到来。
Galenor, chieftain of Nos Galengrim, focuses on Mirkwood's green heart, combating the forest's decay with wards akin to those against Sauron's influence in the books.
加勒诺尔是加伦格林一族的首领，专注守护黑森林苍翠的腹地。他用类似书中抵御索隆影响的防护手段，对抗森林的衰败。

Galinwen came out of Pelargir, daughter of a shipwright-house of old Faithful blood that has watched the sea-roads against the Corsairs of Umbar since the days of Castamir's flight. By her hand the House of Hýarthulionath has gained tidings of every keel betwixt Ethir Anduin and the Bay of Belfalas. She wedded Silmador in the autumn of a year of fair harvest, binding hill to haven. In the present strife she follows her husband's house and the Steward's banner.
加林玟来自佩拉基尔，是一支古老忠实者血统造船家族的女儿；自卡斯塔米尔逃亡以来，她的家族一直守望海路，防备乌姆巴尔的海盗。凭借她的手，希阿尔苏利昂纳斯家族得以获知埃希尔安都因到贝尔法拉斯湾之间每一艘船的消息。丰收之年的秋天，她嫁给希尔玛多尔，把山地与港口连在一起。在如今的纷争中，她跟随丈夫家族和宰相旗帜。

Galion, the royal butler and advisor, evokes the merry yet dutiful elves in The Hobbit, managing the feasts and stores of the Woodland Realm. His resourcefulness supports the clan's endurance, blending mirth with the serious defense against encroaching evils.
加理安是王室管家兼顾问，让人想起《霍比特人》中那些快乐却尽职的精灵。他管理林地王国的宴席与储藏，凭借机敏维系族人的持久力量，在欢快性情与抵御逼近邪恶的严肃职责之间取得平衡。
Galuvir of the Egladil drills the young of the Golden Wood in blade and bow against the gathering dark in Dol Guldur.
来自埃格拉迪尔的加卢维尔训练金色森林的年轻人用剑和射箭，以应对多古尔都日渐聚集的黑暗势力。
Ganbaatar of House Cilzeron rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
西尔泽隆家族的钢巴特尔率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。

西尔泽隆家族的钢图勒嘎率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Gashash of the Morzûk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.

Gashka of the Lugbúrz orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
嘎什卡是路格布尔兹氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Gashnak is a fierce Uruk-hai warrior who earned her place through brutal combat. She commands the breeding pits of Isengard with ruthless efficiency.
加什纳克是一名凶悍的乌鲁克战士，靠残酷战斗赢得地位。她以无情效率管理艾森加德的育种坑。
Gashzur of the Lugbúrz warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
嘎什祖尔是路格布尔兹战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。

Gildor Inglorion of the House of Finrod has long wandered the westlands; in these darkening days his company keeps to Imladris and the banner of Glorfindel.
芬罗德家族的吉尔多·英格罗瑞安常年漫游西方各地。如今黑暗渐盛，他和同伴留在伊姆拉缀斯，追随格罗芬德尔的旗帜。
Give me a column to keep alive and I will do it, and you will not ask how.

Give me a company to feed and a tower to hold, and I will make the numbers work.

Give me a company to lead and I will show you what Nogrod passed over.
给我一队人，我会让你看看，诺格罗德错过了怎样的人才。
Give me a concept, no matter how complex, and I'll breathe life into it. Every system, every mechanic, every feature - I craft them from the void, line by line, until they live and breathe.
给我一个概念，无论多复杂，我都能让它活起来。每个系统、每个机制、每个功能，我都从虚无中一行一行地打造，直到它们真正运转起来。
Give me a horse beneath me and an enemy ahead, and you will not find a harder lance for hire.
给我一匹马，再给我一个前方的敌人，你找不到比我更硬的雇佣骑枪手。
Give me a horse under me and a lance, and I will carry your banner ahead of every charge.

Give me a mount and a cause worth riding for.
给我一匹坐骑，再给我一个值得骑行的理由。
Give me a mount and a fair share, and I will outride your enemies.

Give me a pike and a road north, and I will give you the best killer you have ever marched beside.

Give me a post and a lord worth guarding, and I will hold it to the last.

Give me a saddle and a share of the plunder, and I will ride ahead of your column.

Give me a shield-wall to stand in and I will hold it, whatever comes over it.
给我一段盾墙的位置，不管冲来什么，我都守得住。
Give me a warband that pays on time. I will lead it under any mountain you name, and mend the wounded on the way.
给我一支按时付钱的战团。你说哪座山，我就带他们钻到山下，路上还能治伤。
Give me elves to kill and I will give you my whole arm.
给我精灵杀，我就把这身力气都交给你。
Give me forty good swords and a road to hold, and I will hold it past the last man.
给我四十个好剑手，再给我一条要守的路。就算战到最后一人，我也会守下去。
Give me forty sound men and a road, and I will hold it past the last of us.
给我四十个好汉，再给我一条路。就算战到最后一人，我也会守下去。
Give me forty spears and a road, and I will hold it to the last.
给我四十个矛手，再给我一条路，我会守到最后。
Give me riders and a plan, and I will teach you what a Variag feint does to a line.
给我骑兵和一份作战计划，我让你看看瓦里亚格人的佯攻怎么撕开阵线。
Give me timber and a few hands, and I will build you something that opens any gate.
给我木材和几个帮手，我造出的东西，什么城门都能撞开。
Give me your maps and your enemies, and I will tell you where the fight is already decided.
给我地图，告诉我敌人是谁，我就能指出战局在哪里已经定了。
Give me your raw men and a season, and I will give you back soldiers.
给我你的新兵和一个季节，我会还给你真正的士兵。
Give me your sieges to plan, and walls will cease to be your problem.
把你的围城交给我规划，城墙就不再是你的麻烦。
Give the {TITLE} and its fief to {HERO}?
将{TITLE}头衔及其封地一并授予{HERO}？
Give {TROOP_NAME} a name, or keep the one they carried into battle.
为{TROOP_NAME}取一个名字，也可以保留原来上阵时使用的名字。

Gives AI kingdoms that have lost a large share of their towns and castles a small, temporary boost: a higher daily volunteer roll in their towns, castles and villages (empty recruit slots fill faster and waiting recruits are promoted sooner) and faster escapes for their captured lords. Never applies to a kingdom you rule, or to your own clan's settlements and lords; its lords in your prisons escape faster too. Takes effect at the next daily tick; turning it off removes every rally effect. Default on.
为失去大量城镇和城堡的AI国家提供小幅临时加成：提高其城镇、城堡和村庄每日征募兵员的判定值，让空缺兵位更快补足、待招募兵员更快升级；被俘领主也更容易逃脱。不会作用于你统治的国家，也不作用于你自己家族的定居点和领主；但受益国家的领主被关在你的监狱时，也会更快逃脱。下次每日结算时生效；关闭后移除全部重整加成。默认：开启。
Gladly. Come, and I will name you to them.
当然，跟我来，我会把你介绍给他们。
Global multiplier applied to all per-faction strength inflation values from army_targeting.json. 1.0 = use JSON defaults. Raise to make evil factions siege even when outnumbered.
对 army_targeting.json 中各阵营高估自身兵力的系数统一乘以此倍率。1.0表示使用JSON默认值。提高后，黑暗阵营即使兵力不足，也更愿意发动围城。
Gnasha of the Maughâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
格纳莎是毛嘎什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Goblin-town Frenzy charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.
半兽人镇狂暴充能消耗大幅降低，几乎随时可以发动。
Goblin-town Frenzy charge reduced, activating more frequently.
半兽人镇狂暴充能消耗降低，可以更频繁地发动。
Goblin-town Frenzy duration extended, fortifying the defense.
半兽人镇狂暴持续时间延长，让防线更加稳固。
Goblin-town Frenzy grants +5 health and drives your trolls berserk.
半兽人镇狂暴提供+5生命值，并让你麾下的食人妖陷入狂暴。
Goblin-town Frenzy grants additional defensive buffs while active.
半兽人镇狂暴生效期间，会提供额外防御加成。
Goblin-town Frenzy radius greatly expanded, devastating power.
半兽人镇狂暴作用范围大幅扩大，释放出毁灭性的力量。
Goblin-town Frenzy radius increased, empowering more warriors.
半兽人镇狂暴作用范围扩大，可以强化更多战士。
半兽人镇食人妖驱使者
Goblins never stay dead in the Blue Mountains. There are always more of them in the north...
蓝色山脉的半兽人总也杀不完。北方永远还有更多……
Goblins of Blue Craig's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #6A8AA8.
蓝岩半兽人在地图上的颜色，格式为 #RRGGBB。留空使用默认值 #6A8AA8。
Goblins's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #AFC93A.
半兽人在地图上的颜色，格式为 #RRGGBB。留空使用默认值 #AFC93A。
Goksun of House Adekig is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
阿德基格家族的格克松是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Golasgil, Lord of Anfalas, commands the long coastline against Corsair raids. He is a weathered sea-lord who has defended Gondor's shores for decades.
戈拉斯吉尔是安法拉斯领主，负责守卫漫长海岸，抵御海盗袭击。他是久经风浪的海上领主，数十年来一直保卫刚铎海岸。
Gold flows from the mountain, but so does warrior's blood when needed...
黄金从山中流出，需要时，战士的血也会流出……
Gold opens doors that swords cannot...
金币能打开刀剑打不开的门……
Gold paid to each soldier (not you) by the large pay option. Never read below the small pay's gold. Between 10 and 500. Default: 100.
使用大额赏钱选项时，付给每名士兵的金币，不包括你自己。实际采用的数值不会低于小额赏钱金额。范围：10至500。默认：100。
Gold paid to each soldier (not you) by the small pay option, in a settlement or a ready field camp. Between 10 and 500. Default: 50.
在定居点或已经搭好的野外营地中，使用小额赏钱选项时，付给每名士兵的金币，不包括你自己。范围：10至500。默认：50。
Gold to establish a refuge. Default 2000.
建立一处避难所所需的金币。默认：2000。
Gold to fortify a raised field camp. Default 500.
将已建成的野战营地加固为设防营地所需的金币。默认：500。
Gold to upgrade a refuge into a stronghold. Default 5000.
将避难所升级为堡垒所需的金币。默认：5000。
Golfimbul, chieftain of the Skarnâk orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
高尔夫酋是斯卡尔纳克奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Gondor Lossarnach 1H Black Ash Axe Handle A
刚铎洛斯阿尔那赫单手黑灰木斧柄 A
刚铎佩拉基尔骑士旗帜 A
Gondor remembers your valor! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
刚铎会记住你的勇气！影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。

Gondor stands as a proud bastion of strength and resilience in Middle-earth, known for its towering white stone cities, ancient lineage, and skilled armies. Founded by Elendil and his sons after the fall of Numenor, Gondor has long guarded the realms of men against the growing darkness in the east. With Minas Tirith as its capital, the kingdom is renowned for its valor, discipline, and loyalty to the Free Peoples. While beset by years of conflict with Mordor, Gondor's warriors and Stewards have kept hope alive, awaiting the return of the king to restore its former glory.
刚铎是中洲中力量与韧性的骄傲堡垒，以高耸的白石城市、古老血脉和精锐军队闻名。努门诺尔沉没后，埃兰迪尔和他的儿子们建立了刚铎；长久以来，刚铎一直守卫人类诸国，抵御东方日益增长的黑暗。王国以米那斯提力斯为都城，以勇气、纪律和对自由人民的忠诚而著称。虽然多年与魔多交战，刚铎战士和历代宰相仍让希望延续，等待国王归来，恢复昔日荣耀。
Gondor's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #3F76B8.
刚铎在地图上的颜色，格式为 #RRGGBB。留空使用默认值 #3F76B8。
Gondorian turncoat and embezzler. Fled Mordor with stolen wealth after serving as a diplomatic fixer.
刚铎叛徒兼贪污者，曾为魔多充当外交掮客，后来带着偷来的财富逃走。
自由人民军团留守新占城池
Good men are always welcome. Let me look them over.
好士兵总是受欢迎的，让我看看他们。
Good! The pack has not eaten since the last snowfall. Tear them apart![ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
好！这群家伙从上次下雪起就没吃东西了。撕碎他们！[ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
Good. Bargaining is the breath of the south. Show me what you carry, and we will find the number together.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
好。南方人过日子，少不了讨价还价。给我看看你带了什么，咱们总能谈出个价。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
Good. Even a landlubber can read the tide. Name an offer, and quickly, before the captain loses patience.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
很好，连旱鸭子也懂得看形势。快开个价，别等船长没了耐心。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
Goods a finished camp work brings in for every ten healthy men, on the best ground for it; poorer ground brings in less. Default 10.
在最适宜的地点完成一次营地劳作后，每十名健康士兵带回的货物数量；条件较差的地点产量更低。默认：10。
Gorash of the Uzgnâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
戈拉什是乌兹格纳什战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Gorbag, Captain of Minas Morgul, leads the garrison of the dead city. He is cunning even by Orc standards.
“米那斯魔古尔队长”戈巴格统领这座死城的驻军。即便按奥克的标准来看，他也十分狡猾。
Gorbûz came up through the whip-gangs beside Uznash, and resents that the pens answer to his old comrade and not to him.
戈尔布兹与乌兹纳什一起从监工队爬了上来。他一直不服气，凭什么奴隶营听命于这位老同伴，而不是自己。
Gordiana dwells in the shadow of the Dark Tower.
戈尔迪安娜居于邪黑塔的阴影之下。

Gorlag, a towering and merciless warlord of the Black Maw, rules his Uruk-hai with an unyielding grip, his loyalty to Saruman matched only by his thirst for slaughter. His commanding presence and brutal tactics ensure that his forces strike with overwhelming force, leaving no survivors in their wake. Gorlag's disdain for mercy and his strategic prowess make him a terror to Middle-earth's defenders, his victories a testament to Isengard's might. With the Black Maw at his back, he drives Saruman's war machine forward, crushing all opposition.
戈尔拉格是黑颚的一名军阀，身形高大，冷酷无情。他牢牢控制着手下的乌鲁克，对萨茹曼的忠诚和对杀戮的渴望一样强烈。他凭着威严和残暴的战术，驱使军队以压倒性的力量出击，所到之处不留活口。他鄙弃仁慈，又精于谋划，是中洲守卫者的噩梦。他的胜利一次次展示着艾森加德的力量。在黑颚的支持下，他推动萨茹曼的战争机器不断前进，碾碎一切反抗。
Gorlak of the Maughâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
戈尔拉克是毛嘎什战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Gormund Oxflank serves as a trusted lieutenant to the clan chief.
“牛肋”戈尔蒙德是氏族酋长信赖的副官。
Gorthak is an orc captain holding the high pass into Mordor, watchful and merciless to any who would slip past the Eye.
戈萨斯是一名奥克队长，守卫通往魔多的高山隘口。他十分警觉，对任何想避开魔眼溜过去的人都毫不留情。
Gorvash, a beast mistress, tames draconic horrors, her command echoing the dread steeds' shrieks.
戈尔瓦什是驯兽女主人，驯服龙形恐怖；她的号令呼应那些可怖坐骑的尖啸。
Gorvin the Fell is a grim chieftain whose cruelty is legendary even among Dunlendings.
“凶残者”戈尔文是个阴沉的酋长，即使在黑蛮地人中，他的残酷也出了名。
Gorwulf the Boar is a savage chieftain known for his brutal raids on border settlements.
“野猪”戈尔伍尔夫是一名残暴的酋长，以凶狠劫掠边境聚落而闻名。
Gorza of the Morzûk orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
戈尔扎是莫尔祖克氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Gorzag, an orc warlord, rallies hordes for Khamûl, his ferocity mirroring the orc captains in The Hobbit, pushing incursions into elven territories.
戈尔扎格是一名奥克军阀，为可哈穆尔集结大军，向精灵领地发动进攻。他的凶悍与《霍比特人》中的奥克队长如出一辙。
Gothmog, Lieutenant of Morgul, commands the armies of Mordor at the Pelennor Fields. A brutal and cunning Orc, he leads from the front.
勾斯魔格是魔古尔副将，在佩兰诺平野统领魔多大军。他是一名残暴狡诈的奥克，总是亲临前线指挥。
Grafton lies in the stony hills near Gramburg. Its iron mines supply the smiths who make the spears and helms of the Riders of Rohan.
格拉夫顿位于格兰堡附近多石的丘陵中。这里的铁矿供给当地铁匠，用来打造洛汗骑兵的长矛和头盔。
Gragnor trains the warg packs of Isengard. His beasts are said to understand commands as well as any soldier.
格拉格诺尔训练艾森加德的座狼群。据说他的野兽理解命令的程度不逊于任何士兵。

Gragor acts as a ruthless orc overseer in Gundabad, enforcing discipline akin to the taskmasters in Mordor's armies from the books. His role in managing the clan's forges and slaves ensures a steady supply of weapons, bolstering the horde's readiness for the impending wars.
格拉戈尔尔是贡达巴德残酷的奥克监工，执行纪律的方式近似书中魔多军队里的工头。他负责管理氏族熔炉和奴隶，确保武器供应稳定，让大军随时准备投入即将到来的战争。
Grakmaw of the Skarnâk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
格拉克莫是斯卡尔纳克战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Gralka of the Skarnâk orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
格拉尔卡是斯卡尔纳克氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Gralnia, a necromantic healer, sustains the wounded, twisting life to unlife for Khamûl's service.
格拉尔尼亚是一名精通死灵术的治疗者，维持伤员的性命，将活人变成不死生物，让他们继续为可哈穆尔效力。
Gralthak, an orc duelist, thrives in single combats like the orc champions in lore. His prowess in challenges asserts clan dominance in internal disputes and external battles.
格拉尔萨克是奥克决斗者，热衷于像传说中的奥克冠军那样单挑。他在挑战中的本领能确立氏族内斗和对外战斗中的优势。

Gralza, a fierce orc matron of Gundabad, draws from the implied shadowy breeders in Tolkien's world, overseeing the rearing of new warriors with iron resolve. Her strategic mind aids in clan politics, ensuring the survival and proliferation of orc kind amidst the northern perils.
格拉尔扎是贡达巴德凶悍的奥克女族长，取材于托尔金世界中那些隐约提到的阴影繁育者。她以铁一般的决心照管新战士的养育；她的战略头脑也参与氏族政治，确保奥克种族能在北方险境中存续并扩张。
Gralzia, a shadow infiltrator, spies in darkness, like the unseen agents of Sauron.
格拉尔齐娅是暗影渗透者，在黑暗中刺探情报，如同索隆那些看不见的爪牙。
Gralzuk, a silk harvester, crafts traps from webs, aiding in capturing elven scouts as in film scenes.
格拉尔祖克是采丝者，用蛛网制作陷阱，帮助抓捕精灵斥候，类似电影中的场景。
Grasha, a death whisperer, demoralizes enemies, her voice like the chilling winds from Dol Guldur in the films.
格拉莎是死亡低语者，用声音摧垮敌人士气；她的嗓音如电影中多古尔都吹出的寒风。
Grazar serves as a beast-master, taming giant spiders akin to those in Mirkwood. In Gundabad, his pets guard tunnels and ensnare intruders.
格拉扎尔是一名驯兽师，驯养着与黑森林巨蛛相似的巨型蜘蛛。在贡达巴德，他的蜘蛛负责守卫地道，用蛛网困住闯入者。
Great Goblin of the High Pass
手持巨斧、砍伐铁木的伐木手。

Greaves fit for a lord are earned in the press of battle, not bought. Strike down enemies with your own hand and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with them.
领主级护胫是靠战场上的功劳赢来的，不能直接买到。亲手击倒敌人、赢得战斗，或者向铸甲师交付你所属文化的领主级材料，大师便会为你打造护胫。
Grief has bent better captains than you.
比你更好的队长，也曾被悲痛压垮。
Grief has bent harder men than you.
比你更坚强的人，也曾被悲痛压垮。
Grief has bent many a good captain.
许多好队长，也曾被悲痛压垮。
Grief like that makes a hard judge of any of us.
经历过那种悲痛，谁都会变得严厉。
Grimbeorn, son of Beorn, Chieftain of the Beornings, who keeps the High Pass and the Old Ford and lets no orc cross the Vales of Anduin.
格里姆贝奥恩是贝奥恩的儿子，也是贝奥恩一族的首领。他守卫高隘口和老渡口，绝不让奥克穿过安都因河谷。
格里姆博德·格里明加斯
Grimbold of Grimslade commands the riders of Westfold. A fierce warrior, he held the Fords of Isen and later died heroically at the Pelennor.
格里姆博德统领格里姆斯雷德的西伏尔德骑手。他是一名勇猛战士，曾坚守艾森河渡口，后来在佩兰诺英勇战死。
Grimwulf Ironfang carries on his father's legacy of raiding and warfare against Rohan.
“铁牙”格里姆伍尔夫继承父亲的事业，继续劫掠洛汗，并与洛汗作战。
Grisha engineers the siege weapons of the Stone Breakers. Her constructions have brought down many a fortress wall.
格里莎负责破石者的攻城器械。她建造的机器已经摧毁多处以为自己坚不可摧的防御。
Grisha oversees the poison-fields of southern Nurn, where the air itself does most of the killing.
格里莎监管努尔恩南部的毒田。那里大多数人的死因，就是他们呼吸的空气。
Grishash of the Vrakmaw warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
格里沙什是弗拉克莫战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Grishnak, chieftain of the Grobûrz orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
格里什纳赫是格罗布尔兹奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Grishza of the Dushnakh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
格里什扎是杜什纳克氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Grisnak earned his command through brutality and cunning during countless raids. His knowledge of Rohan's borderlands makes him invaluable for lightning strikes against enemy supply lines.
格里斯纳克凭借无数次劫掠中的残忍与狡诈赢得指挥权。他熟悉洛汗边境，在突袭敌军补给线时是个不可多得的人才。
Gromash of the Morzûk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.

Gurzod, a towering figure of the White Hand, leads his Uruk-hai with unyielding authority and a thirst for conquest. His devotion to Saruman fuels his relentless pursuit of victory, commanding his forces with a disciplined ferocity that leaves no room for failure. Vrothgar's strategic acumen and commanding presence make him a cornerstone of Isengard's war machine, his troops marching with grim resolve under his banner. Known for his scorn of weakness, he forges his warriors into an unstoppable force, striking dread into the hearts of Middle-earth's defenders.
古尔佐德是白手麾下高大威严的人物，以不容动摇的权威和征服欲统率乌鲁克。他对萨茹曼的忠诚驱使他不停追求胜利，并以纪律严明的凶猛指挥部队，不给失败留下余地。他的战略眼光和统帅气势让他成为艾森加德战争机器的支柱；他的士兵在旗帜下带着阴沉的决心前进。他鄙视软弱，也把战士锻造成难以阻挡的力量，使中洲的守卫者心中生畏。
Gwenna is wife to Tormund, managing the clan's holdings while he campaigns.
格温娜是托蒙德的妻子，在他出征时管理氏族产业。
Gûl-nûrn lies on the plains of Nurn near Barad Wath. Its grain is stored in walled granaries and sent north to Gorgoroth.
古尔-努尔恩位于瓦斯塔附近的努尔恩平原。这里的粮食先存进有围墙的粮仓，再运往北方的戈埚洛斯。
Gûl-salth lies on the salt flats near Barad Nûrn. Slaves rake salt from the shallow pans while overseers watch from wooden towers.
古尔-萨尔斯位于努尔恩塔附近的盐滩。奴隶们在浅盐池里用耙子收盐，监工则在木塔上盯着他们。

Gûlnak stands at Mauhoshat's right hand in the Udun camps, and the clerks of Lugburz mark him as the sharper blade of the two. He has been passed over twice for a banner of his own, and the resentment of it sits behind his teeth like a second tongue. He waits for Mauhoshat to be summoned to the Black Gate or thinned in the Pelennor, and reckons the Arki muster will fall to him before the next great war-march. Until that day he flatters his captain and counts his rivals.
古尔纳克是乌顿营地中莫霍沙特的得力助手。路格布尔兹的书记员认为，两人之中他才是更锋利的那把刀。他已经两次与独自领兵的机会失之交臂，满腔怨恨，却藏在嘴里不说。他等着莫霍沙特被召去黑门，或在佩兰诺损兵折将，认定下一次大军出征前，阿尔基氏族的兵权就会落到自己手里。在那之前，他一边奉承队长，一边盘算着有哪些对手。
Gûrtilm Salurian commands the western armies of Rhun. After her husband's death, she took command with iron resolve.

Ha! Fresh meat and a fight, the best kind of day. Kill them all.

Harad, a vast and diverse region south of Gondor, encompasses arid deserts, lush jungles, and fertile oases. Its geography is as varied as its people, with sprawling dunes giving way to dense forests and rivers teeming with life. Harad's history is steeped in ancient lore, with grand cities and fortresses dotting the landscape, built by rulers whose legacies echo through the ages. The Great Desert of Haradwaith separates its northern frontier from the heartland, while its southern coasts are bustling with trade and piracy. United under the banners of Sauron, Harad's many tribes and kingdoms channel their deep-rooted traditions into their war efforts, transforming this vibrant land into a powerhouse of culture and conflict.

哈拉德位于刚铎以南，是一片辽阔而多样的地区，包含干旱沙漠、茂密丛林和肥沃绿洲。它的地貌和人民一样多变，连绵沙丘会让位于浓密森林，河流中也充满生机。哈拉德历史沉浸在古老传说中，宏伟城市和堡垒点缀大地，由遗产至今回响的统治者们建成。哈拉德地区大沙漠把北部边境与腹地分隔开来，而南方海岸则充满贸易与海盗活动。在索隆旗帜下联合起来后，哈拉德众多部族和王国把根深蒂固的传统投入战争，使这片充满活力的土地变成文化与冲突交织的强大力量。

He plays all sides. I would be only the next one he sells.

He robbed his own clan. He would rob me the moment it paid.

He was within his right, and I do not quarrel with it. But I gave my word to those Men and I kept it. I will serve a lord who wants a captain like that, if there is one.

安努米那斯的医者在老医馆和湖岸救人，伤员总比草药多。我们学会了取舍，可不是人人都肯原谅。
Healers of Egladil work the old infirmary at the meeting of the rivers, where the wounded outnumber the herbs. We learn to choose, and not everyone forgives that.

战车哨站草甸上牧人的儿子，先学认地形，才学使骑枪。我们骑术好，哪里需要，就往哪里去。

Herumarth, a Black Númenórean of Sauron's own blood, commands a fortress on the marches of Mordor. Cold and proud, he keeps the old Númenórean cruelty sharpened by the Shadow that sired him.
赫茹马尔斯是索隆亲生的黑努门诺尔人，指挥着魔多边境的一座要塞。他冷酷而高傲，保留着古老努门诺尔人的残忍，而生下他的黑暗力量又让这份残忍更加深重。
Hestby lies among rye and barley fields near Garthness, at the edge of the wild woods. Its landholders raise horses on pastures cleared from the forest.
赫斯特比位于加思尼斯附近、荒野森林边缘的黑麦与大麦田之间。当地地主在从森林开辟出来的牧场上养马。

幽谷藏在迷雾山脉深处的裂谷中，是大海以东最后家园。它由半精灵埃尔隆德建立，是抵御不断聚集的黑暗的避难所，也是一处疗愈、学识与安静力量并存的地方。

Hideouts each bandit faction starts with on a NEW campaign; read once at world-gen, so changing it does nothing to a campaign already in progress. TAOM has 8 bandit factions, so this is a per-faction target, x8 on the map, bounded by each faction's physical hideout count (three have only 10). Vanilla = 7. Default: 7. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
新战役开始时，每个匪徒派系拥有的藏身处数量。只在生成世界时读取一次，修改不会影响已经开始的战役。TAOM有8个匪徒派系，因此这是各派系的目标数，全地图合计目标为此数值的8倍，但仍受各派系实际藏身处数量限制，其中三个派系只有10处。原版为7，默认：7。2026年11月以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。

Hirilwen of the House of Olindurionath, eight and forty years of age, never wedded, and is named among her kindred the watch-lady of the western tower. Through the salt-rimed nights of her middle years she has trimmed the lamp that warns the fisherfolk of the long reef, and she keeps in a chest of black oak the hunting-knife of her brother who fell upon the dunes in the corsair raid of her youth. She holds, as her house holds, for the King returned, for the Langstrand has too often watched alone.
希瑞尔玟来自奥林杜瑞昂纳斯家族，四十八岁，从未成婚，亲族称她为西塔守望夫人。在中年那些带着盐霜的夜晚，她一直修剪警灯，提醒渔民避开漫长暗礁；她还在黑橡木箱中保存着哥哥的猎刀，哥哥在她年轻时一次乌姆巴尔海盗袭击中死于沙丘。她和家族一样支持归来的国王，因为长滩已经太多次独自守望。
Hirluin the Fair, Lord of Pinnath Gelin, leads his green-clad warriors from the hills of Gondor. He is known for his valor and loyalty to the Steward.
“白肤”希尔路因是品那斯盖林领主。他率领来自刚铎丘陵、身披绿衣的战士，以英勇和对宰相的忠诚而闻名。
His pack hunted me for the overseer. I'd have yielded, paid in flesh. But one clawed me, rage boiled, I slew two more. No desire for their blood.
他那伙人为监工追捕我。我本来可以认栽，用自己的肉赔罪。可其中一个抓伤了我，怒火一下烧起来，我又杀了两个。我并不想要他们的血。

Hold, meat on legs. The Mountain claims all that crosses it, and we are the Mountain's teeth. Coin and trinkets, whatever shines, or teeth.

兹拉特卡是加尔登的女儿。

建立野战营地所需的小时数。伏击点和瞭望点耗时为四分之一，设防营地则为两倍。默认：4小时。
Hours to raise a refuge after founding; the stronghold rebuild takes the same. Default 6.
开始建设后，建成避难所所需的小时数；改建为堡垒的耗时相同。默认：6小时。
哈尔博隆尼昂纳斯家族
希阿尔苏利昂纳斯家族
伊姆拉佐瑞昂纳斯家族
House of the Old Forest Road
How can anyone trust a self-admitted spy?
一个自认是间谍的人，谁能信？

How close riders must be to their slots before the line charges, and before a reform counts as done: the average rider may be 10 m off at 0, 4.4 m at the 0.7 default, 2 m at 1. Max Line-Up Seconds launches the charge regardless when it runs out.
骑手靠近指定位置到什么程度，阵线才开始冲锋、重整才算完成。设为0时，平均偏差可达10米；默认0.7为4.4米；设为1则为2米。达到最长列阵时间后，无论是否列齐都会冲锋。
How close your party must be to manage a refuge's garrison and stores. Default 4.
你的部队距离避难所多近时，才可以管理驻军和库存。默认：4。

How far below vanilla the weight term may push a light charger's penetration against a heavy victim. Default 1.0 = never below vanilla (uruks and trolls fall like men; the troll, dwarf and Sauron race rows do the resisting). 0.25 restores the pre-2026-09-17 feel where a horse could not floor anything heavier than a man. The ceiling is the JSON's maxPenetrationFactor (shipped 2.5); a slider value above it is treated as that maximum.
轻型冲撞者面对较重目标时，重量因素最多能把穿透能力降到原版的多少。默认1.0，表示不低于原版；乌鲁克和食人妖也能像人类一样被撞倒，其抗性由食人妖、矮人、索隆的种族配置承担。0.25恢复2026-09-17前的效果：马无法撞倒比人重的目标。上限是 JSON 的 maxPenetrationFactor，随包值为2.5；超过它的滑块数值按此上限处理。
How far from the battle, in map units, a settlement still thanks you. A settlement is usually about 17 units from its nearest neighbour. Default: 25.
战场周围多大范围内的定居点会感谢你，以地图单位计算。相邻定居点通常相距约17个单位。默认：25。

How far, in average town gaps, a priority-list target may be and still have its unreachable verdict overturned by the Border Proximity Floor above. Not a general distance penalty: the game already applies one of its own. 3.2 clears the widest real front on the map.
优先目标最远可以位于多少个平均城镇间距以内，仍由上方的边境接近度评分下限推翻“无法抵达”的判定。这不是通用距离惩罚，游戏本身已有距离惩罚。3.2可以覆盖地图上最宽的实际战线。

How hard each fief a clan already holds counts against its next claim, as 1/(1 + fiefs x penalty). Vanilla only divides by the VALUE it holds, so a clan sitting on many cheap castles is barely damped. 0.00 = off. Default: 0.35.
家族每拥有一处封地，对下一次分配评分的削减程度，公式为 1/(1 + 封地数 x 惩罚系数)。原版只按已有封地的价值做除算，因此拥有许多廉价城堡的家族受到的限制很小。0.00表示关闭。默认：0.35。
How many battles/sieges you must take part in before either side can win. Default 5.
任一方获胜前，你必须亲自参加的战斗或围城次数。默认：5次。

How many entries each [TickProfile] and [TickSummary] line lists (mission behaviours) and each [MapProfile] and [MapProfileSummary] line lists (map tick listeners and TAOM map views), slowest first. Default 8. Read at each mission start and each campaign session start.
每条 [TickProfile]、[TickSummary] 中列出的任务行为数，以及每条 [MapProfile]、[MapProfileSummary] 中列出的地图更新监听器和 TAOM 地图视图数，最慢项排在前面。默认8，每次任务和战役会话开始时读取。
How many horses do you need?

How many of the nearest towns that will buy from you the Provender-master offers. A town at war with you, of the opposing alignment, besieged, barring you or short of gold is never offered. Between 1 and 5. Default: 3.
军需官提供多少个最近且愿意收购货物的城镇。与你交战、属于对立阵营、正在被围、禁止你进入或资金不足的城镇不会列出。范围：1至5。默认：3。
How many promoted companions you may take beyond your clan tier's companion limit. 0 = the limit is strict and an offer waits until you have room. Default: 0.
通过晋升获得的同伴，最多可以超出家族等级对应的同伴上限多少人。0表示严格遵守上限，晋升建议会等到有空位时再提出。默认：0。
How many recruiters each castle is populated with (vanilla towns = 5, villages = 3). Higher = more recruitment volume per castle. Default: 3.
每座城堡生成多少名提供兵员的要人，原版城镇为5名、村庄为3名。数值越高，每座城堡可提供的兵员越多。默认：3。
How many soldiers a left or right swipe can strike at once.
向左或向右横扫一次最多命中多少士兵。
How many soldiers the running pounce can strike at once.
奔跑扑击一次最多命中多少士兵。
How many soldiers the standing front bite can strike at once (the nearest ones in its arc).
站立时向前撕咬一次最多命中多少士兵，会选择攻击弧线内最近的目标。
How many stand in the way?
How much further caravans range past the vanilla distance ceiling. 1.0 = vanilla reach; higher = they visit more distant, more profitable markets. Default: 1.6.
商队行程范围相对于原版距离上限的倍率。1.0为原版范围；数值越高，商队越会前往更远、利润更高的市场。默认：1.6。
How much grain do you need?
How much relation each enemy lord loses when the option above is on. 0 = none. Default: 5.
开启上一项后，与每位敌方领主降低的关系值。0为不降低。默认：5。

How outnumbered you must be for a battle to count. Your party's healthy troops divided by the whole enemy side must come in UNDER this. 1.00 = only fights where you are outnumbered; higher = easier fights still earn merit. Default: 1.30.
决定什么样的兵力对比才能计入功绩。你的部队中健康士兵数除以敌方总人数，必须低于此值。1.00表示只有以少打多的战斗才算；数值越高，越容易获胜的战斗也能获得功绩。默认：1.30。
How strongly an army commits to its current target. 4.0 = the alternative must score 4x better before the army will divert. Vanilla implicit = 1.3.
军团坚持当前目标的程度。4.0表示新目标的评分必须达到当前目标的4倍，军团才会改道。原版隐含值为1.3。
How strongly the land is tinted: 0.05 is a faint wash, 0.8 nearly paints over the map. Default: 0.5.
土地着色的强度：0.05是淡淡的一层，0.8几乎会盖住地图。默认：0.5。
How strongly the relation colour is applied to the bar, the name and the diamond frame. 100 is the full palette, 0 is plain parchment for everyone. Applies immediately. Default 100.
关系颜色在名称栏、名字和菱形边框上的强度。100为完整配色，0为全部使用普通羊皮纸颜色。立即生效。默认：100。
Howl a Dunlending war-cry into the fray — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
在混战中吼出黑蛮地人的战吼：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。
