我当过枪骑兵，随灰港派出的卫队北上，护送阿尔诺诸王。从埃兰迪尔的时代起，奇尔丹的族人就一直这么做。我学着与杜内丹人并肩作战，也开始敬佩他们短暂生命里那份顽强的勇气。
I rode in the war-host of clan Taiymâkä and swore the blood-oath young, as we all do. I held it more dearly than most. To me an oath was the only thing on the steppe a man truly owns.
我曾骑在泰伊玛卡氏族的战团里，年轻时就像所有人一样立下血誓。我比大多数人更看重它。对我来说，誓言是草原上一个人真正拥有的唯一东西。
I rode shaggy ponies in the raids on the farms along the Gulf of Lune. A rider is always wanted by the Craig, and I ride for coin now.
我骑毛茸茸的小马，劫掠过路恩湾沿岸的农场。蓝岩总缺骑手，现在我骑马挣钱。

I rode the post between Beorn's Hall and the Old Ford, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every ford and farm along the Great River.
我曾骑马跑贝奥恩大厅到老渡口的邮路，送信、送钱，偶尔也把生病的孩子送去看医者。走那条路的骑手都认得我，大河沿岸每个渡口、每处农庄，我也全熟。

I rode the post between Dale and Esgaroth, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every ford and farm along the River Running.
我曾骑马跑河谷城到埃斯加洛斯的邮路，送信、送钱，偶尔也把生病的孩子送去看医者。走那条路的骑手都认得我，奔流河沿岸每个渡口、每处农庄，我也全熟。

I rode the post between Vineholm and Redwater, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every ford and farm along the River Running.
我曾骑马跑葡萄洲到红水的邮路，送信、送钱，偶尔也把生病的孩子送去看医者。走那条路的骑手都认得我，奔流河沿岸每个渡口、每处农庄，我也全熟。

I rode the post between Woodmen-town and the Forest Gate, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every glade and farm along the eaves of Mirkwood.
我曾骑马跑林中居民镇到森林之门的邮路，送信、送钱，偶尔也把生病的孩子送去看医者。走那条路的骑手都认得我，黑森林边缘每处林间空地、每个农庄，我也全熟。
I rode wargs out of the Great Goblin's kennels, raiding the Vales of Anduin. A rider with no beast is worth little, so I hire out and save.
我骑着半兽人王兽栏里的座狼，去安都因河谷劫掠过。没有坐骑的骑手不值钱，所以我出来卖力气，攒钱。
I rode with the cavalry of Aldburg, defending the Eastemnet from orc raids. My spear drank deep of enemy blood, and my horse Thunderfoot was known across the Riddermark for his speed.
我曾随奥德堡的骑兵作战，保卫东埃姆内特不受奥克劫掠。我的长矛饱饮敌血，我的马“雷蹄”也以速度闻名整个里德马克。
I rode with the cavalry of Wainwatch, defending the eastern plains from Wainrider raids. My spear drank deep of enemy blood, and my horse Dustmane was known across Rhovanion for his speed.
我曾随战车哨站的骑兵出战，保卫东部平原，抵挡战车民的劫掠。我的长矛沾满敌人的血，我的坐骑尘鬃，也因跑得快而闻名罗瓦尼安。

I rode with the most aggressive company of Wainwatch. We gave no quarter to the Wainriders, pursuing them to extinction. My commander said mercy to enemies was cruelty to our own people. I believed him.
我曾在战车哨站最凶悍的一支骑兵队效力。我们不留战车民活口，一路追杀到底。长官说，对敌人仁慈，就是对自己人残忍。我信了。
I rode with the most aggressive éored in the Eastfold. We gave no quarter to orcs, pursuing them to extinction. My commander said mercy to enemies was cruelty to our own people. I believed him.
我曾隶属于东伏尔德最好战的伊奥雷德骑兵队。我们对奥克毫不留情，追杀到一个不剩。指挥官说，对敌人仁慈就是对自己人残忍。我信了他。

I saw a chance to advance, a rival officer whose failure could become my opportunity. I ensured that failure, then ensured he couldn't explain it. Unfortunately, his allies were more numerous than I calculated. They couldn't prove my involvement, but suspicion was enough. I left before suspicion became certainty.
我看见了晋升的机会：一名敌对军官的失败，可以变成我的机会。我确保他失败，又确保他没法解释。不幸的是，他的盟友比我估算的更多。他们无法证明我参与其中，但怀疑已经够了。我在怀疑变成定罪前离开了。
I scout ahead of the Misty Mountain warbands, along the forest roads and the river fords. It is quiet work, for those who prefer it.
我替迷雾山脉的战团走在前面探路，走林间道路和河流渡口。喜欢安静的人，适合干这个。
I scouted for the merchant caravans that run from Dale to the Iron Hills and the gates of Erebor. Water, ambush ground, safe fords, I priced them all. A good scout is paid by the mile.
我曾替河谷城往铁丘陵和埃瑞博山大门去的商队侦察。水源、埋伏的地形、安全渡口，每样我都算价钱。好斥候的报酬，是按路程算的。

I scouted for the trading parties that run from Woodmen-town to Ironwood Hall and the borders of the Woodland Realm. Water, ambush ground, safe glades, I priced them all. A good scout is paid by the mile.
我曾替林中居民镇往铁木厅和林地王国边境去的商队侦察。水源、埋伏的地形、安全的林间空地，每样我都算价钱。好斥候的报酬，是按路程算的。
I scouted for the trading parties that run from the Old Ford to Gladden Hold and the High Pass. Water, ambush ground, safe fords, I priced them all. A good scout is paid by the mile.
我曾替老渡口往金鸢尾堡和高隘口去的商队侦察。水源、埋伏的地形、安全渡口，每样我都算价钱。好斥候的报酬，是按路程算的。
I scouted for the wine caravans that run from Vineholm to the Sea of Rhûn landings and the Northgate road. Water, ambush ground, safe fords, I priced them all. A good scout is paid by the mile.
我曾替葡萄洲往鲁恩内海码头和北门大道去的运酒商队侦察。水源、埋伏的地形、安全渡口，每样我都算价钱。好斥候的报酬，是按路程算的。

I scouted from the Tower Hills, keeping watch beside the keepers of Emyn Beraid when the white towers still looked west for something other than rain. I walked the old north road to Arthedain more often than their own messengers did.
我从塔丘出发侦察，与埃敏贝莱德的守塔人一同值守。那时白塔向西望，望的还不只是雨。我走通往阿塞丹的古老北路，比他们自己的信使还勤。
I scouted the Old Forest Road for the northern holds, ahead of the warbands, sleeping in the roots of oaks. I knew every Woodman path and every ford, and I threw a knife better than I talked.
我替北方堡垒侦察老密林路，走在战团前头，睡在橡树根底下。林中居民的小路、河上的渡口，我都熟。扔刀比说话更拿手。
I scouted the old dwarf ruins of Belegost and Nogrod for the Craig. A scout knows where the old roads go, and sells that knowledge.
我替蓝岩侦察过贝烈戈斯特和诺格罗德的矮人废墟。斥候知道古道通往哪里，也靠这份本事挣钱。

I scouted the ruins of Belegost and Nogrod for Blue Craig. The old dwarf halls have more graves than walls, and each grave has a little hoard. The chief wanted maps and I gave him maps. I gave myself the hoards.
我替蓝岩侦察贝烈戈斯特和诺格罗德的废墟。古老的矮人大厅里，坟比墙还多，每座坟里都有点积蓄。酋长要地图，我给他地图，财宝给自己。
I see what moves in the hills before it reaches you, and I shoot straight. Keep your parleys to yourself.
山里有什么动静，没到你跟前，我就看见了，弩也射得准。谈判的事，别来找我。
I seek honest work for honest pay. Will you have me?
我寻求一份诚实的差事，换取应得的报酬。您愿意雇用我吗？

I served Prince Imrahil as a marine, defending Belfalas from corsair raids. We fought from ship decks and harbor walls, repelling those who would plunder our coasts. The sea salt and combat forged me into a warrior.
我以海军的身份为伊姆拉希尔亲王效力，保护贝尔法拉斯不受海盗袭击。我们在战舰的甲板上作战，在港口的城墙上作战，打退那些胆敢侵扰我们的人。海盐和战斗将我打造成了真正的战士。

I served as a battlefield scavenger, officially recovering equipment from fallen soldiers for reuse. Unofficially, I took the best items for personal profit, weapons, armor, jewelry from the dead. Both sides' dead, mind you. War is wasteful; I merely reclaimed what would otherwise rot.
我曾是战场拾荒者，名义上负责回收阵亡士兵的装备以便再利用。私下里，我把最好的东西拿去为自己牟利：武器、护甲，还有死人身上的珠宝。注意，是双方死者的东西。战争本来就浪费，我只是回收那些本会烂掉的财物。

I served as a healer in Erebor's infirmary, tending those still sick from the dragon-sickness that lingers in old gold. My father taught me the ancient arts, herbs from the Iron Hills, stones that draw poison. The kingdom prospers, but shadows grow. More wounded come from eastern patrols each month.
我曾在孤山的医所担任医者，照料那些仍受龙病折磨的人。旧日黄金上的病气还没有散尽。我父亲教我古老的医术：来自铁丘陵的草药，能吸出毒素的石头。王国正在繁荣，但阴影也在增长。每个月都有更多东部巡逻队的伤员被送回来。
I served as a scout in Dol Guldur, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the dark pits and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在多古尔都担任斥候，远远越过边界巡视威胁。我熟悉黑暗坑穴中的每一条路，也能在流水中追踪狐狸留下的痕迹。
I served as a scout in Imladris, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the Valley of Rivendell and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在幽谷担任斥候，远远越过边界巡视威胁。我熟悉穿过幽谷的每一条路，也能在流水中追踪狐狸留下的痕迹。
I served as a scout in the Golden Wood, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the borders of Lórien and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在金色森林担任斥候，远远越过边界巡视威胁。我熟悉罗瑞恩边界上的每一条路，也能在流水中追踪狐狸留下的痕迹。
I served as a scout in the Haven of Umbar, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the sea fortress and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在乌姆巴尔港担任斥候，远出边境之外监视威胁。我熟悉这座海上要塞的每一条路，也能在流动的水边追踪狐狸。
I served as a scout in the Woodland Realm, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the forest paths and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在林地王国担任斥候，远远越过边界巡视威胁。我熟悉林中道路的每一条小径，也能在流水中追踪狐狸留下的痕迹。
I served as a scout in the eastern steppes, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the Sea of Rhûn and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在东方草原担任斥候，远出边境之外监视威胁。我熟悉鲁恩内海一带的每一条路，也能在流动的水边追踪狐狸。
I served as a scout in the hills of Dunland, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the Gap of Rohan and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在黑蛮地丘陵中担任斥候，远远越过边界巡视威胁。我熟悉洛汗隘口的每一条路，也能在流水中追踪狐狸留下的痕迹。
I served as a scout in the lands of Harad, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the oases and can track a fox through running water.
我曾在哈拉德诸地担任斥候，远出边境之外监视威胁。我熟悉绿洲之间的每一条路，也能在流动的水边追踪狐狸。

I served as a scribe in the Citadel, recording the annals of Gondor's glory. My father was a captain of the Tower Guard, my mother a healer in the Houses of Healing. I studied both sword and scroll, believing knowledge and steel together preserve our realm.
我曾作为抄写员在王城中任职，记录刚铎荣耀的编年史。我的父亲是塔卫队的队长，母亲则是诊疗院中的医者。我既研习剑术也钻研典籍，深信知识与钢剑共同守护着我们的王国。

I served as a sergeant on the Eastmarch road, where Dorwinion's spearmen stand against whatever comes out of Rhûn. The old wardens taught me to keep the spear steady and the line closed, and to waste nothing, pity included.
我曾在东境大道当军士，多温尼安的矛手在那里抵挡鲁恩来的敌人。老守望者教我端稳长矛、守紧阵线，什么都别浪费，怜悯也一样。

I served as a sergeant on the Iron Hills road, where Dale's spearmen stand beside the dwarves against whatever comes down from the north. The dwarves taught me to keep the spear steady and the line closed, and to waste nothing, pity included.
我曾在铁丘陵大道当军士，河谷城的矛手在那里跟矮人并肩作战，抵挡北方来的敌人。矮人教我端稳长矛、守紧阵线，什么都别浪费，怜悯也一样。

I served as an envoy for Gondor, negotiating with the Rohirrim, treating with merchant princes, even parlaying with Dunlendings. My father taught me diplomacy, my mother swordplay - both served me well.
我曾作为刚铎的使节，与洛希尔人谈判，与商贾王公交涉，甚至与黑蛮地人周旋。父亲教我外交手腕，母亲授我剑术——两者都让我受益匪浅。

I served as an interrogator in the dungeons of Barad-dûr, extracting secrets from prisoners and rebels. The work required precision, patience, and a strong stomach. I learned to read fear, to understand what breaks each creature. The Dark Lord values information, and I provided it reliably.
我曾在巴拉督尔的地牢里担任审讯者，从囚犯和叛乱者口中挖出秘密。这活儿需要精准、耐心，也需要够硬的心肠。我学会了辨认恐惧，明白每一种生灵会被什么击垮。黑暗魔君看重情报，而我一直能稳定地交出结果。

I served at Cair Andros, the island fortress that guards the northern road. We were rangers and scouts, watching for threats from the Dead Marshes and the Black Gate. My bow and stealth kept many orcs from ever reaching Gondor.
我曾在凯尔安德洛斯服役，那是一座守卫北方道路的岛上要塞。我们是游侠和斥候，时刻警惕来自死亡沼泽和黑门的威胁。靠着弓箭和潜行本领，我拦下了许多奥克，让他们没能踏进刚铎。

I served in Minas Tirith's guard since boyhood, rising through discipline and skill to guard the Citadel itself. I've seen three captains come and go, watched the Steward age, witnessed the realm's slow decline.
我自幼便在米那斯提力斯的护手服役，凭借纪律与技艺一路晋升，最终得以守卫白城王庭。我亲历三任队长的更迭，目睹摄政日渐苍老，也见证了王国缓慢的衰败。

I served in the mounted forces of Dol Guldur, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the elves and men of the West's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the uruks of the fortress.
我曾在多古尔都的骑乘部队服役，巡逻边境，快速打击西方精灵和人类的劫掠队。我的骑术在要塞乌鲁克中无人能比。
I served in the mounted forces of Imladris, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the forces of darkness's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Eldar.
我曾在幽谷的骑乘部队服役，巡逻边境，快速打击黑暗势力的劫掠队。我的骑术在埃尔达中无人能比。
I served in the mounted forces of the Golden Wood, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the Shadow in the East's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Galadhrim.
我曾在金色森林的骑乘部队服役，巡逻边境，快速打击东方阴影派来的劫掠队。我的骑术在加拉兹民中无人能比。
I served in the mounted forces of the Haven of Umbar, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the navy of Gondor's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Corsairs of Umbar.
我曾在乌姆巴尔港的骑兵部队服役，巡守边境，并快速打击刚铎海军的劫掠队。我的骑术在乌姆巴尔的海盗中无人能比。

I served in the mounted forces of the Woodland Realm, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the spiders and orcs of Dol Guldur's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Silvan Elves.
我曾在林地王国的骑乘部队服役，巡逻边境，快速打击多古尔都蜘蛛和奥克的劫掠队。我的骑术在西尔凡精灵中无人能比。
I served in the mounted forces of the eastern steppes, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the western kingdoms's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Easterlings.
我曾在东方草原的骑兵部队服役，巡守边境，并快速打击西方诸国的劫掠队。我的骑术在东夷中无人能比。

I served in the mounted forces of the hills of Dunland, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the Horse-lords of Rohan's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Dunlendings.
我曾在黑蛮地丘陵的骑乘部队服役，巡逻边境，快速打击洛汗驭马者的劫掠队。我的骑术在黑蛮地人中无人能比。
I served in the mounted forces of the lands of Harad, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the men of Gondor's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Haradrim.
我曾在哈拉德诸地的骑兵部队服役，巡守边境，并快速打击刚铎人的劫掠队。我的骑术在哈拉德人中无人能比。
I served the Great Goblin's guard in the tunnels and hunted dwarves in the old shafts. A spear-arm is always wanted, so I carry mine.
我在地道里当过半兽人王的亲卫，也去老竖井追杀过矮人。总有人缺使矛的，所以我带着家伙来了。
I served with the Rangers of Ithilien under Captain Faramir. We were the eyes of Gondor in the wild, harrying orcs and watching the Black Gate. My bow sang death to many servants of the Enemy.
我曾效力于法拉米尔队长麾下的伊希利恩游侠部队。我们是刚铎在荒野中的眼睛，袭扰奥克，监视黑门。我的弓箭曾为许多魔多爪牙奏响死亡之歌。

I shaved the count. Not much, a head in twenty, sold on the side to a trader of Rhovanion. A new overseer counted again. One head short, then two, then eleven. I will say only that I am grateful for a long throwing arm and a short corridor.
我在人数上做了点手脚，不多，每二十个里偷卖一个，买家是罗瓦尼安的商人。新监工重新点数，先少一个，再少两个，最后少了十一个。我只能说，多亏我扔得够远，那条走廊又够短。
I shoot better than I stab.
比起持矛近战，我更擅长射箭。
I shoot from cover along the rivers and the edge of the Vales of Anduin. The holds have plenty of bowmen, and most of us prefer not to be seen.
我藏在河边和安都因河谷边缘放箭。堡里弓手很多，我们大多不爱让别人看见。
I shot from the sea-cliffs of Luinkrag at the white ships of Lindon. A long bow in the mist is wanted wherever elves sail.
我站在路因克拉格的海崖上，射过林顿的白船。有精灵扬帆的地方，就缺一张藏在雾里的长弓。
I smelted blue-stone steel in the forges under Krathol. A smith with that skill is wanted by every warband on the coast.
我在克拉索尔地下的锻坊炼过蓝石钢。懂这手艺的铁匠，海岸上的每个战团都想要。
I sold charts of the northern coves to a Man who paid in silver and asked no questions. Those charts reached the goblins of Blue Craig, who found the coves useful. People died in them.
我把北边小海湾的海图卖给一个人类。他付白银，不多问。那些图后来到了蓝岩半兽人手里，他们拿来派上了用场，有人死在那些海湾里。
I sold my pike at Last Bridge for bread and slept in sheepfolds for a season. Deserters are called traitors, and perhaps I am one. Still, I am alive, and I would take pay for another chance.
我在最后大桥卖了长枪换面包，在羊圈里睡了整整一季。人家说逃兵就是叛徒，也许我就是吧。可我还活着，要是有人肯付钱，我愿再试一次。
I sold my pike in Tharbad for bread and slept in barges for a season. Deserters are called traitors, and perhaps I am one. Still, I am alive, and I would take pay for another chance.
我在沙巴德卖了长枪换面包，在驳船上睡了整整一季。人家说逃兵就是叛徒，也许我就是吧。可我还活着，要是有人肯付钱，我愿再试一次。
I sold my spear in Bree for bread and slept in barns for a season. Deserters are called traitors, and perhaps I am one. Still, I am alive, and I would take pay for another chance.
我在布理卖了长矛换面包，在谷仓里睡了整整一季。人家说逃兵就是叛徒，也许我就是吧。可我还活着，要是有人肯付钱，我愿再试一次。

I sold strong slaves to traders heading east, split the profit with a corrupt overseer. Would've continued indefinitely, but I got greedy, took too many, too quickly. An audit revealed the discrepancy. Rather than face the Dark Lord's justice, I killed the overseer and fled with what wealth I'd accumulated.
我把强壮的奴隶卖给东去的商人，再和一个腐败监工分账。本来可以一直做下去，可我贪了，拿得太多，也太快。一次审计查出了差额。与其面对黑暗魔君的审判，我杀了那个监工，带着攒下的财富逃了。

I speak multiple languages, understand various cultures, know which officials in several kingdoms can be bought. I can negotiate, spy, establish networks, or simply advise on human psychology. Neither side trusts me completely, which means both will use me when necessary. That's profitable positioning.
我会说多种语言，了解不同文化，也知道几个王国里哪些官员可以买通。我能谈判、刺探、建立网络，或者只是为你分析人类的心思。双方都不会完全信任我，这意味着双方在必要时都会用我。这是很有利可图的位置。

I spent forty years in the Iron Hills before returning to reclaimed Erebor. Fought goblins in the Grey Mountains, orcs from Gundabad. I know what threatens us. Now I serve as captain of the watch, but my warnings fall on deaf ears. The young think the mountain invincible.
我在铁丘陵待了四十年，后来才回到重获的孤山。我在灰色山脉打过半兽人，也打过贡达巴德来的奥克。我知道是什么在威胁我们。如今我担任卫队队长，可我的警告没人听。年轻人以为这座山不可战胜。

I spent forty years on the northern marches, first on the walls of Stonewatch and then raising them. I know how the Blue Craig tribes think, when they move and where they strike. Every spring I told the council that the old north gate would not hold.
我在北方边境待了四十年，先是守石望堡的城墙，后来又修城墙。蓝岩部落怎么想，何时出动、往哪儿打，我都知道。每年春天，我都告诉议事会，老北门撑不住了。
I stay with them when I can and send what I earn, which is never enough. A guard with no hall is a guard for hire, and I will take any honest wage that feeds them.
有空我就回去陪他们，挣到钱就寄回去，可怎么都不够。没了厅堂的护卫，只能出去受雇。只要是正当工钱，能喂饱他们，我都肯挣。
I still carry a kit of needles, a bottle of spirits, and a conscience nobody warned me about. I keep patching people and still wonder why it never pays.
现在我还带着一套缝针、一瓶烈酒，还有一份从来没人提醒过我的良心。我还在给人治伤，也还是不明白，这事怎么老挣不到钱。
I still know the secret of that metal. Give me an anvil and a week, and I will make you a blade the elves will not like to see.
那种金属的秘密，我还记着。给我一座铁砧、一星期，我能打一把精灵见了就不痛快的刀。
I stood at the Great Goblin's forges and made blades for half the Misty Mountains. Dwarf slaves worked the bellows; I worked the slaves. Every one who lagged got the hot end of the tongs.
我在半兽人王的锻炉前，替半个迷雾山脉打造刀剑。矮人奴隶拉风箱，我管奴隶，谁动作慢，就挨烧红的铁钳。

I stood in the household guard of the House of Vashan, sworn to the dynasty's hall and the safety of its lord. It was an honest post for an honest man: to stand watch, to guard the gates, to be the last line between my lord and a blade in the dark.
我曾在瓦珊家族的家卫中站岗，向王朝厅堂和领主的安全宣誓。对一个诚实人来说，那是一份诚实的职务：站岗，守门，成为领主和黑暗中刀刃之间的最后一道防线。

I stood in the shield-wall when we reclaimed Erebor from the dragon. Fought at the Battle of Five Armies too, when I was barely bearded. Now I train the young ones, teaching them axe-work and courage. But the mountain feels too quiet, too safe.
当年我们从巨龙手中夺回孤山时，我就在盾墙里。五军之战那会儿，我胡子都还没长硬。如今我训练年轻人，教他们斧技和胆量。但这座山太安静，太安全了。

I stood the sea-wall above Luinkrag with a long bow and a quiver of gull-feather shafts. When the white ships came near the rocks, I shot their steersmen. A good shot at that range takes patience and wind-sense.
我拿一张长弓，背一筒海鸥羽毛做的箭，站在路因克拉格上方的海墙。白船靠近礁石，我就射舵手。隔那么远想射准，得有耐心，还得懂风。

I studied the alchemical arts in service to Mordor's apothecaries, poisons, antidotes, potions to enhance warriors or weaken enemies. My specialty became subtle toxins, the kind that kill slowly, invisibly, leaving no trace. The Dark Lord's servants appreciate such tools for removing obstacles without drawing attention.
我曾为魔多的药剂师研习炼金术，调制毒药、解毒剂，以及能强化战士或削弱敌人的药剂。我的专长后来变成了隐秘毒素：那种杀人缓慢、看不见、也不留下痕迹的东西。黑暗魔君的仆从很欣赏这种工具，能在不引人注意的情况下移除障碍。

I studied the ancient arts of Dol Guldur, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the Necromancer's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过多古尔都的古老技艺，从死灵法师自己的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。

I studied the ancient arts of Imladris, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from Lord Elrond's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过幽谷的古老技艺，从埃尔隆德大人的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。

I studied the ancient arts of the Golden Wood, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from Lord Celeborn and Lady Galadriel's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过金色森林的古老技艺，从凯勒博恩大人和加拉德瑞尔夫人的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。

I studied the ancient arts of the Haven of Umbar, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the Corsair Lords's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过乌姆巴尔港的古老技艺，从海盗领主自己的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。

I studied the ancient arts of the Woodland Realm, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from King Thranduil's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过林地王国的古老技艺，从瑟兰杜伊国王自己的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。

I studied the ancient arts of the eastern steppes, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the Kagan's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过东方草原的古老技艺，从可汗自己的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。

I studied the ancient arts of the hills of Dunland, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the clan chiefs's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过黑蛮地丘陵中的古老技艺，从氏族酋长自己的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。

I studied the ancient arts of the lands of Harad, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the Serpent Lords's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses.
我研习过哈拉德诸地的古老技艺，从巨蛇领主自己的工程师那里学到建造和攻城术的秘密。我的家族世代都是建造者，修筑城墙，打造防御工事。
I swore my blade once. I would swear it again, if the man were worth it.
我曾以刀剑起誓效忠。要是那人值得，我愿再发一次誓。
I take no pride in this, but a captive's pride feeds no one. Listen, then.
这事我也不光彩，可俘虏的骨气填不饱肚子。听好了。
I take nothing from those who serve the Shadow.
我不会收黑暗势力爪牙的任何东西。

I took command of a war-band of the plains when its captain died at a ford, and I won my first fight with a feint that drew a Haradrim column into a gully. By the next summer the riders called me by a title I had not earned yet.
平原上一支战团的队长死在渡口，我接过指挥，用一招佯攻把一支哈拉德纵队引进山沟，打赢了头一仗。到了第二年夏天，骑兵们已经用一个我还配不上的头衔称呼我了。
I took my bow and left the Shaws. The rangers say I broke faith. His escort carried pitch and torches meant for the hill villages, and nobody thanks me for that.
我拿着弓离开了森林。游民们说我背信弃义，可那使者的护卫带着沥青和火把，就是要烧山里的村庄。为这事，倒没人谢我。
I took my bow and went north. The rangers say I broke faith. His escort carried pitch and torches meant for the villages below, and nobody thanks me for that.
我拿着弓往北走了。游民们说我背信弃义，可那使者的护卫带着沥青和火把，就是要烧下面的村庄。为这事，倒没人谢我。
I took my bow and went south. The rangers say I broke faith. His escort carried pitch and torches meant for the villages below, and nobody thanks me for that.
我拿着弓往南走了。游民们说我背信弃义，可那使者的护卫带着沥青和火把，就是要烧下面的村庄。为这事，倒没人谢我。

I took my bow down the valley the next spring and have kept every coin since. I fight well and I am not afraid, but I give nothing away, because I learned what giving costs. Pay me fairly and I will never leave my post.
第二年春天，我带着弓下了山谷，从此挣来的每一枚钱都攒着。我能打，也不怕死，可我什么都不会白送，因为我知道送出去要付什么代价。只要工钱公道，我绝不擅离岗位。
I took my gear and my savings and nothing else. A dwarf can win a hall of his own out in the world, if he has the wit and the axe for it. I mean to come home with a name the council cannot pass over.
我只带走装备和积蓄。矮人只要有脑子、有斧头，就能在外面打下一座自己的厅堂。我要带着议事会再也不能忽视的名声回家。

I took the blade from him and dropped it into the Gulf, and the captain called that theft. Now I have no forge of my own, and I make my living mending other people's swords, which is humbler work than I deserve.
我夺下那把剑，扔进海湾，队长却说那是偷窃。现在我没了自己的锻炉，只能替别人修剑谋生。照我的本事，本不该只干这些。

I took the bow south the next spring and have kept every coin since. I fight well and I am not afraid, but I give nothing away, because I learned what giving costs. Pay me fairly and I will never leave my post.
第二年春天，我带着弓去了南方，从此挣来的每一枚钱都攒着。我能打，也不怕死，可我什么都不会白送，因为我知道送出去要付什么代价。只要工钱公道，我绝不擅离岗位。

I took the bow upriver the next spring and have kept every coin since. I fight well and I am not afraid, but I give nothing away, because I learned what giving costs. Pay me fairly and I will never leave my post.
第二年春天，我带着弓去了上游，从此挣来的每一枚钱都攒着。我能打，也不怕死，可我什么都不会白送，因为我知道送出去要付什么代价。只要工钱公道，我绝不擅离岗位。
I track enemies and uncover secrets, both skills valuable to honest folk.
我能追踪敌人，也能揭开秘密，这两样本事对正直人都很有价值。

I trained as a healer in Dol Guldur, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the uruks of the fortress. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the elves and men of the West, saving countless lives.
我在多古尔都接受医者训练，学习要塞乌鲁克所知的每一种草药和疗法。每次与西方的精灵和人类交战后，我都会照料伤者，救下了许多性命。
I trained as a healer in Imladris, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Eldar. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the forces of darkness, saving countless lives.
我在幽谷接受医者训练，学习埃尔达所知的每一种草药和疗法。每次与黑暗势力交战后，我都会照料伤者，救下了许多性命。

I trained as a healer in the Golden Wood, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Galadhrim. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the Shadow in the East, saving countless lives.
我在金色森林接受医者训练，学习加拉兹民所知的每一种草药和疗法。每次与东方的阴影交战后，我都会照料伤者，救下了许多性命。

I trained as a healer in the Haven of Umbar, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Corsairs of Umbar. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the navy of Gondor, saving countless lives.
我在乌姆巴尔港学成医者，熟知乌姆巴尔的海盗掌握的各种草药和疗法。每次与刚铎海军交战之后，我都照料伤员，救回过无数性命。

I trained as a healer in the Woodland Realm, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Silvan Elves. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the spiders and orcs of Dol Guldur, saving countless lives.
我在林地王国接受医者训练，学习西尔凡精灵所知的每一种草药和疗法。每次与多古尔都的蜘蛛和奥克交战后，我都会照料伤者，救下了许多性命。

I trained as a healer in the eastern steppes, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Easterlings. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the western kingdoms, saving countless lives.
我在东方草原学成医者，熟知东夷掌握的各种草药和疗法。每次与西方诸国交战之后，我都照料伤员，救回过无数性命。

I trained as a healer in the hills of Dunland, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Dunlendings. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the Horse-lords of Rohan, saving countless lives.
我在黑蛮地丘陵中接受医者训练，学习黑蛮地人所知的每一种草药和疗法。每次与洛汗驭马者冲突后，我都会照料伤者，救下了许多性命。

I trained as a healer in the lands of Harad, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Haradrim. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the men of Gondor, saving countless lives.
我在哈拉德诸地学成医者，熟知哈拉德人掌握的各种草药和疗法。每次与刚铎人交战之后，我都照料伤员，救回过无数性命。

I trained as an archer in a Variag battle line, loosing from the rear while the axemen held the front. I could put an arrow through a mailed throat at two hundred paces, and I took pride in the number I kept in my quiver.
我在瓦里亚格军阵里练成弓手，斧兵守前面，我从后面放箭。两百步外，穿甲人的喉咙我也射得穿。我得意的是，箭袋里总能省下不少箭。

I trained in the Houses of Healing while learning swordplay from my father, a guard captain. I believed a healer who could defend herself could serve in the field, saving lives where they're lost - in battle itself.
我在诊疗院接受训练，同时跟我的父亲学习剑术，他是一名警卫队长。我相信只有懂得如何自卫的医师才能在战争中活下去，进而拯救那些可能会因战斗丢掉性命的人。

I trained with Ithilien's rangers but specialized in infiltration and intelligence. While others fought openly, I slipped behind enemy lines, gathering information and eliminating key targets. The Enemy never knew I existed.
我曾与伊希利恩的游侠一同受训，但专攻渗透与情报工作。当其他人正面作战时，我已潜入敌后，搜集情报并清除关键目标。敌人至死都不知我的存在。

I tried to recreate the Steel of Stars, a lost alloy mentioned in burnt fragments. The explosion destroyed half the forge hall. No one died, thank Mahal, but the damage... The guild expelled me, banned me from any forge in Erebor or the Iron Hills.
我试图重现星辰钢，一种在烧焦残片里提到的失落合金。爆炸毁掉了半座锻造大厅。感谢玛哈尔，没人死，但损失……公会把我除名，禁止我在孤山或铁丘陵的任何锻炉工作。

I uncovered evidence that someone in Minas Tirith was selling patrol routes to Southron spies. When I reported this, my own commanders accused me of fabrication, saying I'd grown paranoid from too much time alone in the shadows.
我发现了证据，米那斯提力斯有人将巡逻路线卖给南方间谍。当我上报此事时，我的指挥官反而指责我捏造事实，说我独自在暗处待得太久，变得疑神疑鬼。

I understand the real war, the one fought with coin and supply, not just blades. Every army needs equipment, and I know how to acquire it, how to move it, how to profit from it. My connections in Mordor still exist, and I know which officials can be bought. That knowledge is worth more than any sword-arm.
我懂真正的战争，那种用钱和补给打的战争，而不只是刀剑。每支军队都需要装备，我知道怎么弄到、怎么转运、怎么从中获利。我在魔多的人脉还在，也知道哪些官员可以买通。这些知识比任何一条挥剑的胳膊都值钱。
I visit when I can and send what I earn, which is never enough. A guard without a hall is a sword for hire, and any honest wage that feeds them will do.
有空我就回去探望，挣到钱就寄回去，可怎么都不够。没了厅堂的护卫，只能卖剑受雇。只要是正当工钱，能喂饱他们，多少都行。
I wage absolute war, no survivors, no prisoners, no mercy. Only victory.
我打的是绝对战争：没有幸存者，没有俘虏，没有怜悯。只有胜利。
I walk now, and walking is for slaves. I mean to earn another beast, and a bigger hoard, and this time hide it where no thief sniffs. Then I will find the eyrie.
现在我得走路，走路是奴隶干的事。我要再赚头坐骑，再攒一大堆财宝，这回藏到小偷闻不着的地方。然后，我要去找那个鹰巢。
I walk the coast roads now, with the sea on my left. I sell tide tables and ship-tallies to any warband that wants to know when the water will let it through. Not to elves again. Never again.
现在我走海岸道路，大海在左边。哪个战团想知道水路什么时候能过，我就卖潮汐表和船只记录。再也不卖给精灵，绝不。
I walk the old road now, looking for new graves. The dwarves are long gone from the best of them. The dead do not count their possessions, and I never stop.
现在我走古老的路，找新的坟。最有油水的那些，矮人早就不在了。死人不会清点财物，我也不会停下。
I walk with a hammer, a scarred hand, and a stubborn pride that cost me everything. I never regretted it, and I suspect I never will.
如今我带着一把锤、一只满是伤疤的手，还有那份害我失去一切的倔强。我从没后悔过，往后大概也不会。
I walked out of the smoke with one hammer and a burnt ear. Now I wander and smash whatever I find, and if there is an anvil on the way I will make you a good blade.
我带着一把锤子，从烟里走了出来，烧坏了一只耳朵。现在我四处走，碰上什么就砸什么。路上有铁砧的话，我也能替你打一把好刀。
I walked out through a drain before they came to count properly. Now I sell my numbers to whoever bleeds silver, and I keep one string for every warband that has crossed me.
他们还没来仔细点数，我就从排水道钻出去了。现在谁肯出白银，我就把数字卖给谁。每个招惹过我的战团，我都替它留着一串骨头。

I walked the boardwalks of Esgaroth with the town watch, a boat-spear in my hands, keeping thieves out of the fish stalls. Hold a long spear on a rocking deck for ten years and you can use it anywhere.
我曾跟着埃斯加洛斯镇卫队走过木板街道，手里拿着船上用的长矛，赶走鱼摊边的小偷。在晃荡的甲板上使十年长矛，到了哪儿都使得来。

I walked the landings of the Old Ford with the watch, a long spear in my hands, keeping thieves out of the ferry sheds. Hold a spear steady on a rocking ferry deck for ten years and you can use it anywhere.
我曾跟着守卫在老渡口的码头巡逻，手里拿着长矛，赶走渡船棚边的小偷。在晃荡的渡船甲板上端十年长矛，到了哪儿都使得来。

I walked the plank-ways of Woodmen-town with the watch, a long spear in my hands, keeping thieves out of the market stalls. Hold a spear steady on a swaying walkway between the great oaks for ten years and you can use it anywhere.
我曾跟着守卫在林中居民镇的木板道巡逻，手里拿着长矛，赶走集市摊位边的小偷。在大橡树之间晃荡的栈道上端十年长矛，到了哪儿都使得来。

I walked the quays of Redwater Landing with the town watch, a boat-spear in my hands, keeping thieves out of the cask yards. Hold a long spear on a rocking deck for ten years and you can use it anywhere.
我曾跟着镇卫队在红水码头巡逻，手里拿着船上用的长矛，赶走酒桶堆场的小偷。在晃荡的甲板上使十年长矛，到了哪儿都使得来。
I wandered from my homeland seeking something I could not name. In the art of shaping three-dimensional visions, I found what I never knew I was searching for.
我离开故乡四处漂泊，追寻一个连自己也说不清的东西。后来，在塑造三维景象的技艺中，我找到了那个自己一直在寻找却从未明白的答案。
I want blades made -- proper ones, not the rubbish my lads carry -- and that takes good iron. Bring me the metal and I'll see the smiths put to work.
我要打一批刀剑，得是真正的好刀剑，不是我手下拿的那些破烂。这就得用好铁。把铁料弄来，我会让铁匠开工。

I was a Marshal of Westmark, commanding a riding company of thirty. We patrolled from Westmark to the Southwood, watching the edge of Mirkwood for threats from Dol Guldur and beyond. But dark rumors came out of the forest.
我曾是西境的元帅，统领一支三十人的骑兵队。我们从西境巡逻到南林，盯着黑森林边缘，提防多古尔都和更远处来的威胁。可森林里渐渐传出了不祥的消息。
I was a Marshal of the Westfold, commanding a éored of riders. We patrolled from Helm's Deep to the Gap of Rohan, watching for threats from Dunland and beyond. But dark rumors came from Isengard.
我曾是西伏尔德的一名元帅，率领一支伊奥雷德骑兵队。我们从海尔姆深谷巡逻到洛汗隘口，提防黑蛮地和更远处的威胁。后来，艾森加德开始传出不祥的消息。

I was a beast-master of the House of Ardâcheran, keeper of the war-mûmakil, the towering grey beasts of the southern jungles that no enemy line will stand against. I raised them from calves, knew each by name and temper, and walked beneath their feet without fear.
我曾是阿尔达切兰家族的驯兽大师，照管战用猛犸。那是南方丛林里高耸的灰色巨兽，没有哪条敌阵能挡住它们。我从幼崽开始养大它们，知道每一头的名字和脾气，也敢毫无惧色地走在它们脚下。
I was a bone-setter in the mines of Belegost until I let a lord's son die to save his hewers. Now I mend whoever pays.
我曾在贝烈戈斯特的矿井当接骨师，为了救领主手下的开凿工，放弃了他儿子的性命。如今谁付钱，我就治谁。

I was a captain of spears for the House of Gorazehan, drilling the dynasty's foot into the disciplined ranks that make our hosts feared. My companies held the line where lesser men broke, and I was proud of every one of them.
我曾是戈拉泽汗家族的长矛队长，训练王朝步兵，让他们排成令敌人畏惧的严整阵列。我的连队在软弱者崩溃的地方坚守阵线，而我为他们每一个人感到骄傲。

I was a captain on the Luinkrag road, a post for whoever could hold the way to the coast. My band, thirty strong, guarded the ore-carts from the mines to the shore. We raided the Lindon outposts when the week was dull.
我在路因克拉格的道路上当过队长，能守住通往海岸的路，才有资格干。手下三十个，从矿场到岸边，我们护送矿车。一星期太闷，就去抢林顿的前哨。

I was a champion of Dol Guldur, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the uruks of the fortress, and I served the Necromancer with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是多古尔都的勇士，自年少起受战争技艺训练。我的刀盾本领让我在要塞乌鲁克中赢得名声，我也以毫不动摇的忠诚侍奉死灵法师。
I was a champion of Imladris, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Eldar, and I served Lord Elrond with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是幽谷的勇士，自年少起受战争技艺训练。我的剑盾本领让我在埃尔达中赢得名声，我也以毫不动摇的忠诚侍奉埃尔隆德大人。

I was a champion of the Golden Wood, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Galadhrim, and I served Lord Celeborn and Lady Galadriel with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是金色森林的勇士，自年少起受战争技艺训练。我的剑盾本领让我在加拉兹民中赢得名声，我也以毫不动摇的忠诚侍奉凯勒博恩大人和加拉德瑞尔夫人。

I was a champion of the Haven of Umbar, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Corsairs of Umbar, and I served the Corsair Lords with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是乌姆巴尔港的勇士，自幼接受战争技艺的训练。我凭刀盾本领在乌姆巴尔的海盗中赢得名声，也曾坚定地效忠海盗领主。

I was a champion of the Woodland Realm, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Silvan Elves, and I served King Thranduil with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是林地王国的勇士，自年少起受战争技艺训练。我的剑盾本领让我在西尔凡精灵中赢得名声，我也以毫不动摇的忠诚侍奉瑟兰杜伊国王。
I was a champion of the eastern steppes, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Easterlings, and I served the Kagan with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是东方草原的勇士，自幼接受战争技艺的训练。我凭刀盾本领在东夷中赢得名声，也曾坚定地效忠可汗。

I was a champion of the hills of Dunland, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Dunlendings, and I served the clan chiefs with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是黑蛮地丘陵中的勇士，自年少起受战争技艺训练。我的刀盾本领让我在黑蛮地人中赢得名声，我也以毫不动摇的忠诚侍奉氏族酋长。

I was a champion of the lands of Harad, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Haradrim, and I served the Serpent Lords with unwavering loyalty.
我曾是哈拉德诸地的勇士，自幼接受战争技艺的训练。我凭刀盾本领在哈拉德人中赢得名声，也曾坚定地效忠巨蛇领主。

I was a factor for the slave caravans that ran from the markets of Khand south to the Harad coast. I kept the ledgers, bribed the toll-keepers, and bought and sold more men and horses than I could count.
我曾给贩奴商队当管事，从可汗德的市场一路跑到南方哈拉德海岸。我管账、贿赂收路费的人，经手买卖的人和马，多得自己都数不清。
I was a healer in Erebor until politics forced me out. Now I wander, offering my skills.
我曾是孤山的医者，直到政治把我逼走。如今我四处流浪，靠本事谋生。

I was a herder's son of clan Acammes, happy enough with my goats and the open sky, until the Taskral's muster came through and took every man who could hold a spear. They put me in the war-host and called me a soldier.
我曾是阿卡梅斯氏族一个牧人的儿子，和山羊、开阔天空待在一起也算过得开心，直到塔斯克拉尔的征召队到来，带走了每一个能握住长矛的男人。他们把我塞进战团，说我是士兵。

I was a horse-archer and scout for the caravans that cross the plains of Khand toward the southern roads. I knew every well, every ambush hollow, and which Haradrim raiders took coin to look the other way.
我曾是商队的骑射手兼斥候，护送他们穿过可汗德平原，前往南方道路。每口水井、每处适合埋伏的洼地，还有哪些哈拉德劫掠者拿了钱就肯睁只眼闭只眼，我全知道。

I was a horse-breaker and lancer in a clan whose wealth stood in its herds. I broke wild colts from the plains, rode the ridge-line at dawn, and charged at the head of the lances when the clan went to war.
我原是一个氏族的驯马师兼枪骑兵，我们的家当全在马群里。我驯服平原上的野马驹，天亮就骑上山脊；氏族出征时，我便带头挺枪冲锋。

I was a house guard in the hall of a minor lord near Barrowfield. He paid little and I gave most of it away, to the widows of the garrison and the families of horsemen who did not come back. A guard's work is quiet, and I liked that mine was useful.
我曾在陵地附近一个小领主的厅堂里当护卫。他给的工钱少，我又把大半送给了驻军的遗孀，还有没能回来的骑兵的家属。护卫的日子平静，能帮上忙，我很知足。

I was a house guard in the hall of a minor lord near Emyn Beraid. He paid little and I gave most of it away, to the widows of the garrison and the families of rangers who did not come back. A guard's work is quiet, and I liked that mine was useful.
我曾在埃敏贝莱德附近一个小领主的厅堂里当护卫。他给的工钱少，我又把大半送给了驻军的遗孀，还有没能回来的游民的家属。护卫的日子平静，能帮上忙，我很知足。

I was a house guard in the hall of a minor lord on the edge of the Coldfells. He paid little and I gave most of it away, to the widows of the garrison and the families of shepherds who did not come back. A guard's work is quiet, and I liked that mine was useful.
我曾在冷原边缘一个小领主的厅堂里当护卫。他给的工钱少，我又把大半送给了驻军的遗孀，还有没能回来的牧羊人的家属。护卫的日子平静，能帮上忙，我很知足。

I was a junior clerk to the king's stewards at Fornost Erain, tallying grain and writing letters for lords who could not write their own. I was good with people, and the old clerks sent me to talk to the angry ones. I came to like it.
我曾在佛诺斯特·埃莱因给国王的总管们当小文书，清点粮食，替不会写字的领主写信。我擅长跟人打交道，老文书就派我去劝那些气头上的人。渐渐地，我还挺喜欢这差事。

I was a junior clerk to the king's treasurers at Cameth Brin, tallying grain and writing letters for hill chiefs who could not write their own. I was good with people, and the old clerks sent me to talk to the angry ones. I came to like it.
我曾在卡梅斯布林给国王的财务官们当小文书，清点粮食，替不会写字的山民首领写信。我擅长跟人打交道，老文书就派我去劝那些气头上的人。渐渐地，我还挺喜欢这差事。

I was a junior clerk to the king's treasurers at Caras Gorthad, tallying grain and writing letters for lords who could not write their own. I was good with people, and the old clerks sent me to talk to the angry ones. I came to like it.
我曾在卡拉斯戈沙德给国王的财务官们当小文书，清点粮食，替不会写字的领主写信。我擅长跟人打交道，老文书就派我去劝那些气头上的人。渐渐地，我还挺喜欢这差事。

I was a master of the forges of Nogrod, where Telchar once worked. I made blades for the Firebeard lords and mended heirlooms older than the halls they hung in. Mending was not enough. I read every scrap of Telchar's craft that survived, and I tried his quenching in the old dark forges under the city.
我曾是诺格罗德锻炉里的大师，铁尔哈就在那儿干过活。我给火须族领主造剑，修过的传家兵器，比挂着它们的厅堂还老。可我不甘心只会修。我读遍了铁尔哈技艺留下的每片记载，在城下昏暗的老炉子里，试他的淬火法。
I was a master smith in Dol Guldur, crafting weapons and armor that the uruks of the fortress prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是多古尔都的铁匠大师，打造要塞乌鲁克极为珍视的武器和护甲。我的锻炉产出的利刃，能像切羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的护甲。
I was a master smith in Imladris, crafting weapons and armor that the Eldar prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是幽谷的铁匠大师，打造埃尔达极为珍视的武器和护甲。我的锻炉产出的利刃，能像切羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的护甲。
I was a master smith in the Golden Wood, crafting weapons and armor that the Galadhrim prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是金色森林的铁匠大师，打造加拉兹民极为珍视的武器和护甲。我的锻炉产出的利刃，能像切羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的护甲。

I was a master smith in the Haven of Umbar, crafting weapons and armor that the Corsairs of Umbar prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是乌姆巴尔港的锻造大师，打造出乌姆巴尔的海盗极为珍视的武器和盔甲。我的锻炉出产的刀刃，能像撕羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的甲胄。
I was a master smith in the Woodland Realm, crafting weapons and armor that the Silvan Elves prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是林地王国的铁匠大师，打造西尔凡精灵极为珍视的武器和护甲。我的锻炉产出的利刃，能像切羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的护甲。
I was a master smith in the eastern steppes, crafting weapons and armor that the Easterlings prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是东方草原的锻造大师，打造出东夷极为珍视的武器和盔甲。我的锻炉出产的刀刃，能像撕羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的甲胄。
I was a master smith in the hills of Dunland, crafting weapons and armor that the Dunlendings prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是黑蛮地丘陵中的铁匠大师，打造黑蛮地人极为珍视的武器和护甲。我的锻炉产出的利刃，能像切羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的护甲。
I was a master smith in the lands of Harad, crafting weapons and armor that the Haradrim prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment.
我曾是哈拉德诸地的锻造大师，打造出哈拉德人极为珍视的武器和盔甲。我的锻炉出产的刀刃，能像撕羊皮纸一样劈开敌人的甲胄。

I was a pathfinder for the lesser House of Phaxim, scouting the trackless southern jungles where a wrong turn means a slow death. I could read the wet ground, find the dry path through a swamp, and lead a column where the maps showed only green. The Houses paid well for a man who never lost his way.
我曾是小家族法克西姆的探路者，在无路的南方丛林中侦察，那里一个错误的转向就意味着缓慢死亡。我能读懂潮湿地面，能在沼泽里找到干路，也能带领纵队穿过地图上只画着绿色的地方。各家族愿意花大价钱雇一个永远不会迷路的人。

I was a ranger of Tyrn Gorthad, trained by an old captain who taught me to move unseen and leave no track. For six years I watched the road below the barrows and counted every Dunlending band that passed. I was the best scout on the downs, and I knew it.
我曾是提殒戈沙德的游民，一个老队长教会我隐蔽行踪、不留痕迹。我在古冢下守了六年，路过的黑蛮地队伍，一支也没漏看。我是岗地上最好的斥候，我自己也清楚。

I was a ranger of the Trollshaws, trained by an old captain who taught me to move unseen and leave no track. For six years I watched the road below the fells and counted every orc that passed. I was the best scout in the hills, and I knew it.
我曾是食人妖森林的游民，一个老队长教会我隐蔽行踪、不留痕迹。我在山地下方守了六年，路过的奥克，一个也没漏看。我是山里最好的斥候，我自己也清楚。

I was a ranger of the Weather Hills, trained by an old captain who taught me to move unseen and leave no track. For six years I watched the road below Amon Sûl and counted every orc that passed. I was the best scout in the Hills, and I knew it.
我曾是风云丘陵的游民，一个老队长教会我隐蔽行踪、不留痕迹。我在阿蒙苏尔下守了六年，路过的奥克，一个也没漏看。我是丘陵里最好的斥候，我自己也清楚。

I was a ranger who served as warden of Combe in Bree-land, guarding it against wolves and Dunlending raiders. The villagers fed me, mended my cloak and made me one of their own. I swore on the Greenway stone that I would not let their roofs burn.
我原是守护布理乡库姆村的游民，替他们抵挡狼群和黑蛮地劫掠者。村民给我吃的，替我补斗篷，把我当自己人。我在绿大道的石头上起誓，绝不让他们的屋顶烧起来。

I was a ranger who served as warden of Downsend, guarding it against wolves and Dunlending raiders. The villagers fed me, mended my cloak and made me one of their own. I swore on the boundary stone that I would not let their roofs burn.
我原是守护岗尾的游民，替他们抵挡狼群和黑蛮地劫掠者。村民给我吃的，替我补斗篷，把我当自己人。我在界石上起誓，绝不让他们的屋顶烧起来。

I was a ranger who served as warden of a hamlet in Ettendale, guarding it against wolves and hill trolls. The villagers fed me, mended my cloak and made me one of their own. I swore on the gatepost that I would not let their roofs burn.
我原是守护埃滕谷一个小村的游民，替他们抵挡狼群和山地食人妖。村民给我吃的，替我补斗篷，把我当自己人。我在门柱边起誓，绝不让他们的屋顶烧起来。

I was a scribe and lore-keeper in the temple-archives of the House of Azadafrozan, copying the dynasty's histories, its treaties, its rolls of the dead. I know the lineages of every great House of Âbanissa and the old tongues the priests no longer speak.
我曾是阿扎达弗罗赞家族神庙档案室里的书记和传承守护者，抄录王朝的历史、条约和死者名册。我知道阿巴尼萨每个大家族的血脉，也懂祭司们早已不再使用的古老语言。
I was a shaman in Gundabad's depths. Raiders destroyed my kin, forcing me to wander. Many orcs share such fates in these shadowed lands.
我曾是贡达巴德深处的萨满。掠袭者毁了我的族人，逼我四处流浪。在这些阴影笼罩的土地上，很多奥克都有类似命运。
I was a smith in Forlindon, working in the cold forges where iron from the Blue Mountains comes down in carts. I made good plain blades, and I had a name for them among the captains of the Havens.
我曾在佛林顿当铁匠，在寒冷的锻坊里打铁。蓝色山脉的铁料，一车车运来。我造结实朴素的刀剑，灰港的队长们都知道我的手艺。

I was a spearman of the Egladil watch in the Angle, first over the ditch in every drill and first to volunteer for every sortie. My captain called me the best arm in the company and the worst ear. I took both as praise.
我曾是河角地埃格拉迪尔守卫队的矛手。每次操练，第一个跳过壕沟，每次出击，第一个报名。队长说我是队里最好的战士，也是最不听话的，我全当夸奖。

I was a spearman of the Emyn Beraid watch, first over the ditch in every drill and first to volunteer for every sortie. My captain called me the best blade in the company and the worst listener. I took both as praise.
我曾是埃敏贝莱德守卫队的矛手。每次操练，第一个跳过壕沟，每次出击，第一个报名。队长说，我是队里最好的战士，也是最不听话的，我全当夸奖。

I was a spearman of the Sarn Ford garrison, first into the water in every drill and first to volunteer for every sortie. My sergeant called me the best arm in the company and the worst ear. I took both as praise.
我曾是萨恩渡口驻军的矛手。每次操练第一个下水，每次出击第一个报名。军士说我是队里最好的战士，也是最不听话的，我全当夸奖。

I was a tide-reader on the cliffs by Blue Craig. I counted the white ships that crept in and out of the Gulf of Lune, how often, how laden, which watch-fires burned at Mithlond. The chiefs fed me because I could say when the elves slept.
我在蓝岩的海崖上看潮汐，也数进出路恩湾的白船：来得多勤、装得多满、米斯泷德哪些烽火点着。酋长们给我饭吃，因为我知道精灵什么时候睡。

I was a tunnel-reader for the Great Goblin. I stitched the wounded of the guard with gut and ash, and I knew every passage under the mountain, every crack, every drop of the shaft where we threw the dead, I walked and counted. Nobody else knew how the deep ways joined, so nobody dared to touch me.
我替半兽人王探过地道。守卫受了伤，我用肠线和灰给他们缝。我摸过山下每条通道、每道裂缝，连扔死人的竖井有多深，也亲自走过、数过。只有我知道深处的路怎么连，谁也不敢动我。
I was a young pikeman levied from a farm near Andrath, one of three hundred sent to hold the line below the old barrows. I drilled hard and bragged of it. In truth I had never seen blood.
我原是安德拉思附近农庄征来的年轻长枪兵。我们三百人被派去守古冢下的阵地。我操练得卖力，还总拿这事吹嘘。其实我连血都没见过。
I was a young pikeman levied from a farm near the North Downs, one of three hundred sent to hold the line below the old barrows. I drilled hard and bragged of it. In truth I had never seen blood.
我原是北岗附近农庄征来的年轻长枪兵。我们三百人被派去守古冢下的阵地。我操练得卖力，还总拿这事吹嘘。其实我连血都没见过。
I was a young pikeman levied from a hill farm in Ettendale, one of three hundred sent to hold the line below the hold. I drilled hard and bragged of it. In truth I had never seen blood.
我原是埃滕谷山中农庄征来的年轻长枪兵。我们三百人被派去守堡垒下的阵地。我操练得卖力，还总拿这事吹嘘。其实我连血都没见过。

I was among the elite who guard the Citadel itself. We stood watch as the Steward pondered, as captains planned, as the realm slowly forgot its king. I witnessed the nobility's petty squabbles while orcs gathered in Mordor.
我曾是守卫要塞本身的精锐之一。当摄政沉思时，当将领们谋划时，当王国逐渐遗忘它的国王时，我们始终驻守。我目睹了贵族们无谓的纷争，而奥克已在魔多集结。

I was among the first generation bred in Orthanc's caverns, designed for intelligence as well as strength. Saruman needed commanders who could think, not just kill. I oversaw the training of new breeds, refining techniques, identifying weaknesses. My methods were efficient, brutal when necessary, calculating always.
我是欧尔桑克洞穴里培育出的第一代之一，不只追求力量，也被设计得更聪明。萨茹曼需要会思考的指挥官，而不只是会杀人的兵器。我负责监督新品种的训练，改进技巧，找出弱点。我的方法很有效，必要时也很残酷，而且始终精于计算。

I was an agent of the House of Artaxshâsan, the kind a dynasty does not admit to keeping. Forged writs, false seals, a letter in any lord's hand you cared to name, I made the documents that won lawsuits, ruined rivals, and shifted the Châjaphân's favor without a blade ever being drawn.
我曾是阿塔克沙桑家族的密探，那种王朝绝不会承认自己养着的人。伪造文书、假印章、任何领主笔迹的信，只要你说得出名字，我都能做。那些文件赢下诉讼、毁掉对手，也能在没有一把刀出鞘的情况下改变查贾凡的宠信。

I was an archer of the sea-watch on the Ered Luin foothills, one of the best the Falathrim ever trained. I could put an arrow through a gull's eye at two hundred paces, and I thought that made me a soldier.
我在埃瑞德路因山麓当过海防弓手，是法拉斯民训练出来的佼佼者。隔两百步，我能射穿海鸥的眼睛，还以为这就算个战士。

I was bone-setter to the iron mines under Belegost. When a gallery came down I went in after it with splints, poppy and a lamp, and I learned to judge in a breath who would mend and who would not. Between falls I drew the shoring plans myself, since the hewers kept building them wrong.
我曾在贝烈戈斯特地下铁矿当接骨师。矿道一塌，我就带着夹板、罂粟药和灯往里钻，练到一眼就能看出谁还有救、谁没有。没塌方时，支护图也得我自己画，因为开凿工老是搭错。

I was bonesetter and herb-healer to clan Zayaknûri, riding behind the war-host to mend what battle broke. The old women taught me which steppe roots draw fever and which seal a wound, and for many years my hands saved more riders than any lance took.
我曾是扎亚克努里氏族的接骨师和草药医者，跟在战团后面，修补战斗打碎的一切。老妇人们教会我哪些草原根茎能退烧，哪些能封住伤口。许多年里，我这双手救下的骑手，比任何一支骑枪夺走的都多。
I was born in the saddle, or near enough. My family supplied horses to the King's own stables at Vidugard. I could ride before I could properly walk, and understood horses better than people.
我差不多算生在马背上。我家给维杜加德国王自己的马厩供马。我还没走稳就会骑马，懂马比懂人多。
I was born in the saddle, or near enough. My family supplied horses to the King's own stables. I could ride before I could properly walk, and understood horses better than people.
我几乎是在马背上出生的。我的家族为国王自己的马厩供马。我会好好走路前就已经会骑马，也比懂人更懂马。

I was born to a lesser house of Minas Tirith, raised in marble halls with servants and tutors. My family held lands in Lossarnach, rich with orchards and vineyards. I was groomed for court life and military command.
我出生于米那斯提力斯的一个小贵族家庭，在大理石厅堂中由仆人和导师抚养长大。我的家族在洛斯阿尔那赫拥有土地，那里果园和葡萄园丰富，我被培养成适合宫廷生活和军事指挥的人。

I was chosen for the King's own guard, the elite who ride beside royalty. It was the highest honor a rider could achieve. I served with pride, until I saw how far our King had fallen under Wormtongue's influence.
我曾被选入国王亲卫，那是能骑在王族身边的精锐。对骑手来说，这是最高的荣誉。我骄傲地服役，直到看见我们的国王在佞舌影响下衰弱到何等地步。

I was chosen for the King's own guard, the elite who ride beside the Horse-lord. It was the highest honor a rider could achieve. I served with pride, until I saw how far the King's court had fallen under his steward's influence.
我曾被选进国王的亲卫队，成为随驭马领主并骑的精锐。这是骑手能得到的最高荣誉。我一直为效忠他而自豪，直到看见王廷在总管摆布下，已经败坏成了什么样。
I was dismissed with no pay owed and no word to carry. I would do it again. The farms along that road stayed safe the rest of the year.
他们结清饷钱，就把我赶了出来，连句话都没有。再来一次，我还是会这么做。那条路上的农庄，那年剩下的日子都平平安安。

I was eyes and ears for the lords of clan Uzharês, master of the scouts and the whisperers who watch the steppe forts. I knew which captains took bribes, which oaths were rotten, and which fortress would open its gates before a single arrow flew.
我曾是乌扎雷斯氏族领主们的眼睛和耳朵，统管斥候和低语者，监视草原上的堡垒。我知道哪些队长收了贿赂，哪些誓言已经腐烂，哪座堡垒会在第一支箭射出前打开大门。

I was master of trade for the House of Tîrdahanâ, a merchant-soldier who kept the dynasty's spears fed, armed, and paid through every campaign. Caravans across the jungle roads, contracts with the coast Houses, the gold that turns a rabble into an army, that was my work, and I was generous in it.
我曾是提尔达哈纳家族的贸易主管，一个商人士兵，在每一场战役中为王朝的长矛兵筹粮、配武器、发军饷。穿过丛林道路的商队、与海岸家族的契约、把乌合之众变成军队的黄金，这些都是我的工作，而我也花得很大方。

I was master-builder to the House of Vasnârad, raising the stone fortresses that crown the jungles of Âbanissa: walls to break an army, gates no ram could split, cisterns to outlast any siege. The Châjaphân's own strongholds bear my hand.
我曾是瓦斯纳拉德家族的营造大师，在阿巴尼萨的丛林高处修筑石堡：能挡住军队的城墙，攻城槌也撞不开的大门，足以撑过任何围城的蓄水池。查贾凡自己的要塞里也有我的手艺。

I was physician to the House of Hoshêdharma, trained in the jungle dynasties' old art of medicine: the fevers of the wetlands, the wounds of beast and blade, the slow poisons the Houses favor against one another. For twenty years I kept the dynasty's blood alive.
我曾是霍谢达尔玛家族的医师，受训于丛林王朝的古老医术：湿地热病、野兽与刀刃造成的创伤，还有各家族彼此暗害时偏爱的慢性毒药。二十年来，我维系着那个王朝的血脉。

I was raised in the old way of Belegost: hammer and shield, the slow advance, no step back. I served twenty years in the Broadbeam guard and kept the outer gates against goblins and worse. My fathers' fathers faced Glaurung in the masks of Belegost, and I meant to be worthy of them.
我按贝烈戈斯特的老规矩长大：锤与盾，稳步前进，绝不后退。我在宽梁族卫队待了二十年，守着外门，抵挡半兽人和更可怕的东西。我的祖辈戴着贝烈戈斯特的面具，迎战过格劳龙，我也想配得上他们。
I was relieved of the watch and sent to walk the Harlindon shore, which is a polite exile. I would make the same count again, and that is what keeps me from the quays.
我被撤了守港的职务，派去走哈林顿海岸，客气点说，就是流放。再来一次，我还会那么算，这也正是我再也上不了码头的原因。

I was sent to negotiate a treaty with certain Southron chiefs who claimed neutrality. I discovered they were already allied with Mordor, and our delegation was meant to be killed as a provocation for war. We fought our way free, barely.
我被派去与一些自称中立的南方酋长谈判条约，却发现他们早已与魔多结盟，我们的使团本将成为引发战争的牺牲品。我们拼死杀出重围，勉强脱身。

I was steward and tax-master to the House of Phaxsharân, one of the great stone dynasties of the southern jungles. The tribute of a dozen villages, the upkeep of the war-beasts, the pay of the House spears, all of it passed through my reckoning, and the House prospered for it.
我曾是法克沙兰家族的管事兼税务官。那是南方丛林中伟大的石筑王朝之一。十几个村庄的贡赋、战兽的养护、家族长矛兵的军饷，全都要经过我的核算，而家族也因此兴盛。

I was stripped of my fletching and barred from the butts. I still shoot better than any man in the hall, and they know it, and it changes nothing. I am not sorry I wanted to win, only that I was caught.
他们收走了我的羽箭，还不准我再进箭场。我还是比厅里任何人都射得好，他们也知道，可这改变不了什么。我不后悔想赢，只后悔被抓到。
I was stripped of the farm before I had seen it. Since then I have lived by wit, which is thin fare in hill country. I did kill the four goblins, though. Nobody ever mentions that.
那处农庄我还没见着，就给收回去了。此后我靠耍小聪明过日子，可在这山里，这本事不太顶饱。不过那四个半兽人确实是我杀的，这倒从来没人提。
I was stripped of the land before I had seen it. Since then I have lived by wit, which is thin fare in a country at war. I did kill the four orcs, though. Nobody ever mentions that.
那块地我还没见着，就给收回去了。此后我靠耍小聪明过日子，可打仗的地方，这本事不太顶饱。不过那四个奥克确实是我杀的，这倒从来没人提。
I was sworn blade-brother to the heir of a horse clan, and we rode together from boyhood. I won my place in the war-band with the sword, against older men, and never lost a duel I was given.
我曾与一个养马氏族的继承人结为刀剑兄弟，从小一同骑马长大。我靠剑术打败年长的战士，在战团里挣到了一席之地，安排给我的决斗，我从没输过。
I was thane of a small hall near the Westfold, sworn to Erkenbrand. My people looked to me for protection and justice. I had good riders, strong walls, and fertile lands. It should have been enough.
我曾是西伏尔德附近一座小厅的领主，向埃肯布兰德宣誓效忠。我的人指望我带来保护和公正。我有优秀的骑手、坚固的墙，还有肥沃的土地。这本该足够。
I was the best archer in Dale at twenty, with a black-fletched arrow on my quiver in honor of Bard. The great shoot at the midsummer fair was mine to lose, and I wanted it badly.
我二十岁时就是河谷城最好的弓手，为了向巴德致敬，箭袋上插着一支黑羽箭。仲夏集市的射箭大赛，我本来胜券在握，而我也非赢不可。
I was the best archer in Dorwinion at twenty, with a white-fletched arrow on my quiver in honor of the Vineholm butts. The great shoot at the vintage fair was mine to lose, and I wanted it badly.
我二十岁时就是多温尼安最好的弓手，为了向葡萄洲箭场致敬，箭袋上插着一支白羽箭。葡萄丰收集市的射箭大赛，我本来胜券在握，而我也非赢不可。

I was the best horse-thief clan Selarkes ever raised, which is no small boast among a people who measure a man by the mounts he can take. I could walk into a rival fortress's pens and walk out with their finest stallion, and they would not wake until I was a league gone.
我是塞拉克斯氏族养出的最好盗马贼。对一个用能抢到多少坐骑来衡量男人的民族来说，这可不是小小的夸口。我能走进敌对堡垒的马栏，牵走他们最好的种马，等他们醒来时，我已经走出一里格了。

I was the champion of the riding-games of clan Alâranin: the spear-casts, the mounted duels, the contests of nerve the nine tribes hold when they gather. For six summers no rider unseated me, and the Taskral's own captains wagered fortunes on my lance.
我曾是阿拉拉宁氏族骑术竞技的冠军：投枪、马上决斗，还有九大部族集会时举行的胆量比试。整整六个夏天，没有任何骑手能把我挑下马，塔斯克拉尔自己的队长们也会在我的骑枪上押下重注。

I was the finest marksman in Dol Guldur, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as the Necromancer's personal guard archer, watching over the uruks of the fortress from the highest vantage points.
我曾是多古尔都最优秀的射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任死灵法师的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望要塞乌鲁克。
I was the finest marksman in Imladris, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as Lord Elrond's personal guard archer, watching over the Eldar from the highest vantage points.
我曾是幽谷最优秀的射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任埃尔隆德大人的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望埃尔达。

I was the finest marksman in the Golden Wood, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as Lord Celeborn and Lady Galadriel's personal guard archer, watching over the Galadhrim from the highest vantage points.
我曾是金色森林最优秀的射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任凯勒博恩大人和加拉德瑞尔夫人的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望加拉兹民。

I was the finest marksman in the Haven of Umbar, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as the Corsair Lords's personal guard archer, watching over the Corsairs of Umbar from the highest vantage points.
我曾是乌姆巴尔港最优秀的神射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任海盗领主的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望乌姆巴尔的海盗。

I was the finest marksman in the Woodland Realm, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as King Thranduil's personal guard archer, watching over the Silvan Elves from the highest vantage points.
我曾是林地王国最优秀的射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任瑟兰杜伊国王的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望西尔凡精灵。

I was the finest marksman in the eastern steppes, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as the Kagan's personal guard archer, watching over the Easterlings from the highest vantage points.
我曾是东方草原最优秀的神射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任可汗的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望东夷。

I was the finest marksman in the hills of Dunland, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as the clan chiefs's personal guard archer, watching over the Dunlendings from the highest vantage points.
我曾是黑蛮地丘陵中最优秀的射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任氏族酋长的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望黑蛮地人。

I was the finest marksman in the lands of Harad, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as the Serpent Lords's personal guard archer, watching over the Haradrim from the highest vantage points.
我曾是哈拉德诸地最优秀的神射手，能在两百步外劈开一支箭。我担任巨蛇领主的亲卫弓手，从最高的制高点守望哈拉德人。
I was the first through every door in my warband. My axe was three paces of reach and I never counted heads, only skulls. The hold sang of me, and I believed the song.
战团每次破门，我都第一个冲进去。我的斧头够得着三步外，从来不点人头，只数头骨。堡里的人编歌夸我，我还真信了。

I was the youngest of seven brothers and the only one who could not swing a hammer worth the name, so I learned the crossbow and the art of keeping still. For years I led the scouts of Ironcrag, tracking the Blue Craig bands through the northern fells and bringing word back before they struck.
我们兄弟七个，我最小，也只有我连锤子都使不利索，于是我学了弩，也学会一动不动地等。我多年带领铁崖的斥候，在北方山地追踪蓝岩队伍，赶在它们动手前报信。

I was too free with what I knew. A petitioner came begging the lineage that would prove his claim against a powerful House, and I gave it freely, as I would to anyone, it was only the truth. The House he challenged did not see it so, and the temple could not protect a scribe who had made such an enemy.
我太随意地给出了自己知道的东西。有个请愿者来求一份族谱，好证明他对某个强大家族的主张。我像对任何人一样，把它免费给了他，因为那只是事实。被他挑战的家族可不这么看，而神庙也保护不了一个结下这种仇敌的书记。

I was whelped at Mount Gram in a hard winter, and the old shaman looked at the afterbirth, then at me, and said I was marked. The name stuck. So did the stares. I hid in the siege shops and learned rams, ladders and sapping, because stone does not care about omens.
一个严冬，我在格拉姆山出生。老萨满看看胎衣，又看看我，说我身上有灾星的记号。这个名号跟了我，那些目光也跟了我。我躲进攻城作坊，学撞锤、梯子和挖地道，石头可不管什么凶兆。

I was young among the shipwrights of Mithlond, set to learning the grain of pale wood and the way a hull listens to the sea. I helped lay the keel of the last great ship of my year, and I loved her more than was sensible. Between launchings I tended the yard's injured, for my hands knew herbs and bandages almost as well as timber.
在米斯泷德的造船匠里，我还年轻，得从浅色木料的纹理学起，也学船身如何顺着海浪。我帮着铺下那一年最后一艘大船的龙骨，爱它爱得有些过头。两次下水之间，我也照料船场的伤员，双手辨草药、包伤口，几乎与辨木料一样熟。
I watch the high rocks. Birds watch me. Don't speak loud.
我盯着高处的岩石，鸟盯着我。小声点。
I watched the passes and the high rocks for Goblin-town. A scout sells what he sees, and I sell it to whoever pays.
我替半兽人镇盯过隘口和高处岩石。斥候卖眼睛看见的东西，谁付钱我就卖给谁。
I will be honest with you. I am not brave, but I am very hard to hit.
说实话，我不勇敢，可真要打中我，也很难。
I will bring grain for your host.
我会给你的军队送来粮食。
I will bring what you need.
我会带来你们需要的东西。
I will bring you a captive lord.
我会给你带来一名被俘的领主。
I will bring you a herd.
I will bring you the steel.
I will bring you the timber.
I will carry the war to them.
我会把战火带到他们那里。
我会清除商路上的匪患。
我会让他们再也没法劫掠。
I will find that grain for you.
I will help. Where are they?
我会追上他们，把他们除掉。
I will keep your company fed, armed and paid for less than you think. Do not ask how.
我能让你的队伍吃得饱、拿得到武器、领得到饷，花的钱比你想的少。别问怎么做的。
I will keep your steel sharp and swing a hammer in a fight, if you swear to use it well.
只要你发誓会善用它，我就替你磨利兵器，打起来也能抡锤子。
I will make soldiers of them.
我会把他们训练成士兵。
I will mend your wounded and shore up your siege works, and I will not waste either on a lost cause.
我会救治你的伤员，加固你的攻城工事。没救的人、没用的工事，我都不会白费工夫。
I will not take gifts from you.
I will plan your battles and build your walls, and I will win them in my own way.
我会替你谋划战事、修筑城墙，再用自己的办法赢下来。
I will provide for your heir.
我会为你的继承人备齐所需物品。
I will put down this revolt.
I will ride for you gladly, and I will give my last coin to anyone you want to help.
我很乐意替你骑马出力。你想帮谁，我也肯为他掏出最后一枚钱。
I will scout for you, and I promise to report exactly what I find, however unwelcome.
我可以替你侦察，也保证如实报告，不管你爱不爱听。
I will see your wares move.
我会帮你的货物打开销路。
I will sew up your wounded and your enemies too, if you can stand the sight of it.
我会缝好你的伤兵，也会给你的敌人缝，只要你看得下去。
I will stand, if the pay is good and the line behind me is thick.
只要工钱好，背后的阵线够厚，我就站得住。
我会给你的生意备好货。
I wish to discuss my career path.
我想谈谈我的职业道路。
I wish to enlist under your command.
我想加入你的部队，在你麾下服役。
I wish to purchase elite units.
I work best when no one sees me coming. Will you have me?
没人看见我来时，我做得最好。你愿意用我吗？

I worked as an enforcer for a slave-master in the mines of Gorgoroth, keeping the workers in line. The pay was steady, the work easy, break a few bones, make examples of troublemakers. But I saw opportunities the master missed. Slaves died regularly; no one counted too carefully if a few more vanished.
我曾在戈埚洛斯矿井里给奴隶主当打手，负责管住劳工。报酬稳定，活儿也简单：打断几根骨头，拿闹事者立个规矩。但我看到了主人没看见的机会。奴隶经常死，若是多消失几个，也没人会数得太仔细。

I worked in the intelligence networks, gathering information from spies, prisoners, informants throughout Middle-earth. My specialty was collating data, finding patterns, identifying threats before they materialized. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated both.
我曾在情报网中办事，从遍布中洲的间谍、囚犯和线人口中收集消息。我的专长是汇总资料、寻找规律，在威胁成形前识别它。知识就是力量，而我两者都积累了不少。

I worked the forges and armories, ensuring weapons reached the right units. Simple work, but it taught me value, what weapons sell for, which commanders pay for advantages, how to redirect supplies for profit. Saruman has gold; he doesn't miss a few coins here and there.
我在锻炉和军械库里干活，确保武器送到正确的部队手上。活儿简单，却教会了我价值：武器能卖多少钱，哪些指挥官愿意为优势付钱，又该怎样把补给转走来牟利。萨茹曼有金子，不会在意少几个钱。
I worked the forges below the Dimrill gate of Moria, cleavers and hooks for the war bands. I ate what I cut. I liked the work.
我在墨瑞亚黯溪门下的锻炉干活，替战团打造砍刀和钩子。砍下什么，我就吃什么。我喜欢这份活。
I worked the forges of the Great Goblin with dwarf slaves at the bellows. A smith always finds an anvil, and I carry my own hammer.
我在半兽人王的锻坊干过，矮人奴隶给我拉风箱。铁匠总能找到铁砧，锤子我自己带着。
I worked the slave pits and the tallies of Goblin-town. Anything can be bought or sold there, and a battle is just another count.
我管过半兽人镇的奴隶坑和账目。那里什么都能买卖，打一场仗，也不过是另一笔账。

I worked the smelters under Krathol, melting down the blue ore into hard, pale metal that holds an edge like a winter morning. I was the best hand at the bellows. The overseers beat the lazy; I beat harder.
我在克拉索尔地下的熔炉干活，把蓝矿石熔成坚硬、发白的金属，刃口像冬日的清晨一样锋利。拉风箱我最拿手，监工揍懒鬼，我揍得更狠。

I would do it again, and the warden knows it, which is why he will not have me back. So I carry my axe where a fighting dwarf is still wanted. There is no shortage of goblins between here and the Misty Mountains.
再来一次，我还是会去，守将也知道，所以他不肯让我回去。我只好带着斧头，去还用得上战斗矮人的地方。从这里到迷雾山脉，半兽人可不缺。
I would draw my service kit from the quartermaster.
我想找军需官领取服役装备。
I would have a champion bear my favour in the tourney and win glory in my name. Triumph in the lists and you will earn my lasting gratitude.
我希望有位勇士佩戴我的信物参加竞技大赛，以我的名义赢得荣耀。只要你在比武场上获胜，我就会一直记得这份恩情。
I would rather you did not ask which company I came from...
我不太想让你问起，我原来是哪个队的……
I would take a different place in the line.
我想调换在阵线中的位置。
I would turn back, stranger. A hundred bows are already trained on you from the branches, waiting for our signal.
我劝你回头，外乡人。树上已经有一百张弓对准你了，只等我们的信号。
I'd choose peace, tend forges, spawn whelps. But shadows decree blood. In depths, chieftains pay for slaughter.
要我选，我会过太平日子，照看锻炉，养出一窝崽子。但阴影偏要鲜血。在深处，酋长们愿意花钱买屠杀。
I'll be expecting your messenger then.
I'll hire my blade, amass iron and bones. Then, I'll claim distant lairs, drag back elf-slaves and treasures. Thus, my kin thrive under my shadow.
我会把自己的刀租出去，攒下铁和骨头。然后我会夺取远处的巢穴，拖回精灵奴隶和财宝。这样，我的族人就能在我的阴影下兴旺起来。
我会夺下他们藏的武器。
I'm Saruman's finest work, stronger and faster than lesser breeds.
我是萨茹曼最杰出的作品，比那些次等品种更强、更快。

I'm a simple creature, I fight, I kill, I take what I want. Served in the raiding parties that strike fast into Gondor, Rohan, wherever the captains point us. I don't ask questions, don't play politics. Point me at the enemy, I break them. My record speaks for itself, twenty successful raids, never failed an objective.
我就是个简单的家伙：打仗、杀人、夺走想要的东西。我曾在劫掠队服役，快速袭击刚铎和洛汗，队长指哪儿我们就打哪儿。我不问问题，也不玩权术。把我指向敌人，我就击溃他们。我的战绩说明一切：二十次成功劫掠，从未失手。
I'm forged in blood. Fought with Azog's kin, Misty goblins, any worth their fangs. Others lie, but I'm the slaughter incarnate.
我是在鲜血里锻出来的。和阿佐格的族人、迷雾山脉的半兽人，还有任何獠牙够硬的家伙都打过。别人会撒谎，但我就是屠杀本身。

I'm not fleeing, I'm relocating. My skills are universal, killing transcends borders and loyalties. Someone will pay well for an assassin trained in Barad-dûr's shadow. And someday, I'll return to Mordor with enough power or allies to settle accounts with the one who made me a liability.
我不是逃跑，只是换个地方。我的本事到哪里都通用，杀人不受边境和忠诚限制。总有人愿意为一个在巴拉督尔阴影下训练出来的刺客付高价。总有一天，我会带着足够的力量或盟友回到魔多，和那个把我变成麻烦的人清算。
I've a pile of goods that mustn't be seen by the wrong eyes. Carry them for me and there's clean coin waiting -- no questions, no names.
我有一批货，可不能让不该看见的人看见。替我运走它们，就有一笔干净的钱等着你。不问来路，也不留姓名。
I've laid down a heavy purse on the next tourney, and I don't like to lose. Win it for me and there's a fat share of the winnings in it for you.
我在下一场竞技大赛上押了一大笔钱，而我不喜欢输。替我赢下来，赢来的钱有你一大份。
Iaulad lies on gentle slopes near Ost Arndir, in the Green Hills of Pinnath Gelin. Its golden wheat fields feed the towns of the western coast.
伊奥拉德坐落在奥斯特阿恩迪尔附近、品那斯盖林（绿丘陵）的平缓山坡上。这里金黄的麦田为西海岸的城镇提供粮食。

If a battle frame stops for 10s (the agent AI tick or the main mission frame never finishes: the game freezes with no crash), briefly suspends the stuck thread at +10/+20/+40s to photograph its call stack into the TAOM debug log as [MissionStall]. It never runs while the game is responsive, and never while a mission is ending or exiting (the exit sampler above covers that). Independent of the master Battle Load Diagnostics toggle: this is crash forensics, not load logging. Same tiny residual risk as the exit sampler. Default ON.
战斗一帧停滞10秒时（单位 AI 更新或主任务帧一直不结束，游戏卡死但没有崩溃），在第10、20、40秒短暂暂停卡住的线程，把调用栈写入 TAOM 调试日志的 [MissionStall]。游戏正常响应时不运行，任务结束或退出时也不运行，后者由上方退出采样器处理。独立于“战斗加载诊断”总开关，属于崩溃排查，不是加载日志。与退出采样器一样有极小残余风险。默认：开启。
If a chieftain needs steadfast claw, snarl at me.
如果有酋长需要一只稳当的爪子，就朝我吼一声。

If a mission exit stalls past 15s, briefly suspends the game's main thread (at +15/+30/+60s) to photograph its call stack into the TAOM debug log — this is what root-caused the tournament-exit freeze (#331). Tiny residual risk: a suspension landing mid-GC can freeze the game harder than the stall itself. Turn OFF to keep the other diagnostics without any thread suspension. Default ON.
退出场景耗时超过15秒时，会在第15、30和60秒短暂挂起游戏主线程，将当时的调用栈记录到TAOM调试日志。比武大会退出卡死问题（#331）就是这样找到根因的。仍有极小风险：若恰好在垃圾回收过程中挂起线程，可能使游戏陷入比原本卡住更严重的冻结。关闭此项后，可以保留其他诊断而不挂起线程。默认开启。
If a warlord seeks a fierce blade, none hungrier than I.
如果有军阀想要一把凶狠的刀，没有谁比我更饥渴。
If enabled, battle_balance_config.json TierPower values replace the vanilla formula for T1-T6.
开启后，使用 battle_balance_config.json 中的 TierPower 数值，替代原版1至6阶兵种的战力公式。
If the torches were real, you saved those villages.
要是那些火把真是做那用途，你救了那些村子。
If you brought us {COUNT} sets of tools, the village could set itself right and prosper once more.
如果你能带来{COUNT}套工具，村子就能恢复正常，再次兴旺起来。
If you came to hear that I was wrong below the Weather Hills, save your breath. I have heard it...
要是来劝我承认风云丘陵那一仗错了，就省省吧。我都听过……
If you came to tell me I was wrong at Sarn Ford, save your breath. I have heard it all...
要是来劝我承认萨恩渡口那一仗错了，就省省吧。我都听过……
If you came to tell me I was wrong at the Hoarwell, save your breath. I have heard it...
要是来劝我承认苍泉河那一仗错了，就省省吧。我都听过……
If you can pay a fair wage and spare a ration for my people, I will serve you faithfully.
只要工钱公道，再给我那些人匀口饭吃，我就忠心为你效力。
If you can use a man who knows his own failing, I will carry a spear for you and try to stand firmer than I did.
你若用得上一个知道自己错在哪里的人，我愿替你持矛，努力比上回站得更稳。
If you could bring us {COUNT} measures of grain, we could sow the fields before the season turns. We have no coin to buy so much ourselves.
如果你能带来{COUNT}份粮食，我们就能赶在换季前播种。我们自己实在买不起这么多。
If you could drive {COUNT} head of cattle to us, we could break the ground again before the season turns.
如果你能给我们赶来{COUNT}头牛，我们就能在换季前重新翻耕土地。
If you have a road that needs walking, I would walk it with you rather than alone, and I will tend your wounded on the way.
如果你有路要走，我愿意陪你走，不想再独自一人。路上，我也能照料伤兵。
If you know a warhost seeking one who mends flesh and brews doom, I'd join, for a price.
如果你知道哪个战团需要会缝肉、会酿灾祸的人，我可以加入，只要给钱。
If you need eyes ahead of your column and a shaft that finds its mark, I will ride scout for you.
要是需要有人在纵队前头探路，箭又射得准，我可以替你当骑马斥候。
If you need one who can build as well as fight, I am at your service.
如果你需要一个既会建造也会战斗的人，我愿为你效力。
If you need someone to hold a line and keep faith with the men in it, I will lead a company for you.
你若需要一个能守住阵线、也对手下守信的人，我可以替你带一队兵。
If you ride for the north, my lance is already pledged to you.
如果你北上作战，我的长枪就已许给你了。
If you seek one who values both wisdom and valor, I would join your company.
若你寻的是智勇双全之人，我愿加入你的队伍。
If you value the lives of your people, let me tend to them.
如果你看重自己人的性命，就让我照料他们。
Iminyar, elder of Nos Iminyé, traces lineage to the first-awakened elves, preserving primal Silvan traditions against Mirkwood's taint.
伊明雅是伊明耶一族的长者，血统可以追溯到最早苏醒的精灵。他守护着古老的西尔凡传统，抵抗黑森林的腐化。
Imloth is daughter of Baranor, learning the ways of Gondor's nobility in the valleys of Lossarnach.
伊姆洛丝是巴拉诺尔的女儿，正在洛斯阿尔那赫诸谷学习刚铎贵族的规矩。

Imrahil II, Prince of Dol Amroth, is the greatest knight of Gondor. His line carries Elvish blood, and he is said to be the fairest lord in all the realm. His Swan Knights are legendary throughout Middle-earth.
伊姆拉希尔二世，多阿姆洛斯亲王，是刚铎最伟大的骑士。他的血脉带有精灵血统，据说是整个王国最俊美的领主。他的天鹅骑士在中洲广为传颂。
In Isengard's forges and pits, opportunity exists for the clever...
在艾森加德的锻炉和坑穴里，聪明人总能找到机会……
In Mordor, those who control supplies control power...
在魔多，掌握补给的人就掌握权力……
In Nogrod a younger son inherits a name and nothing else...
在诺格罗德，小儿子继承的只有家名，别的什么也没有……

In Rivendell's halls, I preserve not just history but its meaning. Every mod feature, every faction's rise, every hero's journey - I weave them into the grand tapestry. When creators doubt their path, I show them where they fit in the greater pattern. This realm's lore is my life's work.
在幽谷的殿堂里，我保存的不只是历史，还有历史的意义。每个模组功能、每个阵营的兴起、每位英雄的旅程，我都把它们织进宏大的织锦。当创作者怀疑自己的道路时，我会让他们看见自己在更大图景中的位置。这个国度的传说，就是我毕生的事业。
In a battle, cancels fast time and pauses the mission; press it again to go on. The Seat's view still flies while the battle is paused. Defaults to Home.
战斗中取消加速并暂停，再按一次即可继续。暂停时仍可自由移动指挥视角。默认按键为 Home。
In a battle, steps mission time down one level, to a quarter of normal speed at the lowest. Defaults to Page Down.
战斗中将时间速度降低一档，最低为正常速度的四分之一。默认按键为 Page Down。

In a battle, steps mission time up one level: 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and 10. Level 10 needs the Seat up or nobody left for you to fight as. It works from the Seat or from your hero's eyes, in single player only. Defaults to Page Up.
战斗中将时间速度提高一档，档位依次为 0.25、0.5、1、2、4 和 10 倍速。10 倍速仅在使用指挥视角，或已无可接管角色时可用。指挥视角和角色视角下均可使用，仅限单人模式。默认按键为 Page Up。

In a castle assault, in the campaign or in a Custom Battle, on a scene with recorded capture points, the attackers must take points A to D in order: outside the walls, the gatehouse, the courtyard and an inner point. Each captured point brings fresh troops from both armies. In the campaign, the attacker who takes D sends the defenders back to the lord's hall, and taking the hall's last room (point E) wins the castle. In a Custom Battle, taking D wins the battle. The defender who loses D loses. Scenes without recorded points stay vanilla, and in a staged siege the Reinforcement Wave Count option does not apply. Takes effect from the next battle. Default: off.

在战役或自定义战斗的城堡攻坚战中，如果场景已设置占领点，攻方就必须按顺序夺取A至D点，依次为城墙外、城门楼、庭院和内侧据点。每夺取一点，双方都会投入新的兵力。战役中，攻方夺取D点后，守军会退回领主大厅；再攻下大厅最后一个房间的E点，才能拿下城堡。自定义战斗中，夺取D点即告胜利。守方丢失D点即告失败。未设置占领点的场景仍用原版规则；分阶段攻城也不受“增援波次”选项影响。从下一场战斗开始生效。默认：关闭。

In a feud raid, I found a wounded boy of the rival clan hiding in a gully, and I lifted him onto my horse and carried him to his own people's tents. My clan called it treason, and my own chief had my herd driven off.
一次寻仇劫掠时，我在山沟里发现了敌对氏族一个受伤的男孩。我把他抱上马，送回他族人的帐篷。我的氏族说这是叛变，自己的酋长派人赶走了我的马群。

In a large field battle, when only a few enemy soldiers are left, none of them a hero and none still to arrive, the survivors are sent off the field after a pause so the battle ends in your win and they can be taken prisoner. Sieges and sally-outs are not changed. Default: on.
大规模野战只剩少数敌兵，既没有英雄，也没有待入场增援时，会在等待片刻后将幸存者移出战场，使战斗以你的胜利结束，并允许俘虏他们。不会改变攻城或突围出击。默认：开启。

In a skirmish I saw an orc band break, and I led the charge after them against orders. We cut down every one, even those who dropped their weapons, but two of my own died in an ambush I never scouted. The captain stripped me of my place before the whole watch.
一场遭遇战里，我看见奥克队伍溃败，就违令带人追杀。我们杀光了他们，丢下武器的也没放过，可我没先探清埋伏，自己人也死了两个。队长当着全队的面，撤了我的职。

In a wall battle, trolls never use siege ladders, towers or siege engines. Attacking trolls break the gate down instead, and defending trolls hold the ground behind it and stay off the walls while the AI commands them; a formation you give orders to obeys them. Takes effect from the next battle. When off, trolls behave as in vanilla. Default: on.
城墙战斗中，食人妖不使用云梯、攻城塔或攻城器械。进攻时改为破坏城门；防守时在 AI 指挥下守住城门后方，不登城墙。你直接下令的编队仍会服从命令。下次战斗起生效。关闭后恢复原版行为。默认：开启。

In the Discord halls, I found my true calling. While my brothers wage war with steel, I wage peace with knowledge. Every question answered, every problem solved, every newcomer welcomed - this is my battlefield, and I never tire.
在社群大厅里，我找到了真正的使命。我的兄弟们用钢铁发动战争，而我用知识促成和平。回答每一个问题，解决每一个麻烦，欢迎每一个新人，这就是我的战场，而我从不疲倦。
In the Seat, after your hero has fallen in a battle, takes the soldier at the middle of the screen, or the nearest one of the company you keep to, who then carries your orders. Defaults to Delete.
使用指挥视角时，如果你的角色已在本场战斗中倒下，就可以接管屏幕中央的士兵，或当前跟随编队中距离最近的士兵，继续亲自作战。默认按键为 Delete。
In the Seat, hides the whole interface for a clean view. Press it again to bring the interface back; it also comes back when you open the order panel. Defaults to End.
使用指挥视角时，隐藏整个界面，方便观察战场。再按一次恢复界面；打开命令面板时也会自动恢复。默认按键为 End。

In the Seat, keeps the view on the soldier at the middle of the screen, or under the cursor while one shows, or on the company you have selected in the order panel, and orbits it. Press it again, or fly, to let go. Defaults to Insert.
使用指挥视角时，跟随屏幕中央的士兵；显示光标时则跟随光标指向的士兵，也可以跟随命令面板中选中的编队，并围绕目标观察。再次按下此键，或自由移动镜头，即可取消跟随。默认按键为 Insert。

In the dungeon menu of a town or castle, adds under the engine's own line how many prisoners the dungeon holds against its capacity, how many of them are lords, each lord's chance to escape each day with the terms behind it (your clan holding him halves it; the governor's perks change it), and a line for a lord whose realm has a War of the Ring escape boost, or whom nothing lets escape. It only shows the odds the game already uses and changes no rule. Applies the next time the menu opens. Default: on.
在城镇或城堡的地牢菜单中，于引擎原有说明下方增加明细：当前俘虏数与容量、其中领主的人数，以及每位领主每天逃脱的概率和影响因素。你的家族亲自关押该领主时，概率减半；总督技能也会改变概率。某位领主的国家获得魔戒大战逃脱加成，或该领主完全无法逃脱时，还会单独说明。只显示游戏实际使用的概率，不改变规则。下次打开菜单时生效。默认：开启。

In the field, against bandits alone (cleared hideouts are thanked by vanilla): after you win, one random notable in each settlement near the battle gains relation with you, one point for every ten bandits killed, wounded or routed, at least 1 and at most 10. A village in the other side's land (Free against Evil) does not thank you. Default: on.
在野外只与匪徒作战并获胜后，战场附近每个定居点会随机有一位要人增加对你的好感。每击杀、击伤或击溃十名匪徒，增加1点关系，最低1点，最高10点。清剿藏身处的感谢由原版处理。位于对立阵营领地上的村庄不会感谢你，即自由人民与邪恶势力之间不生效。默认：开启。

In the measurement this feature is adapted from, every screen or menu that covered the campaign map left three colour targets and one depth target of the map view's old set behind (tens of megabytes of graphics memory per closed screen, more at a high resolution). That memory stays until a battle, or a town, village or arena scene, starts. When on, every Nth cover (see Map View Release Interval) has the map view release its graphics memory as you return to the map. The map then shows a short loading screen until its view is ready again, on one return in N (about 0.4 s instead of 0.08 s in that measurement). Takes effect at the next cover. Default ON.

本功能参考的测量中，每个覆盖战役地图的界面或菜单，都会遗留旧地图视图的三个颜色渲染目标和一个深度渲染目标，每关闭一个界面就多占数十兆显存，高分辨率下更多。直到进入战斗、城镇、村庄或竞技场场景才会释放。开启后，地图每被界面覆盖N次，就会在返回地图时释放一次地图视图显存，N由“地图视图释放间隔”设置。随后地图会短暂显示加载画面，直到视图重建完成，平均每N次返回出现一次；参考测量中约为0.4秒，而通常为0.08秒。下次覆盖地图时生效。默认：开启。
In the northern fells you see the goblin before it sees you, or you do not come home...
在北方山地，你得先看见半兽人，不然就回不了家……

In the shadow of ancient ruins, your youthful band of companions looked to you for guidance. Whether charting a safe path through the woods or rallying courage against imagined foes, your natural leadership shone like the banners of the kings of old.
在古老废墟的阴影下，儿时伙伴总会望向你，等你拿主意。不管是在林中找安全道路，还是鼓起勇气面对想象中的敌人，你天生的领导力都像旧日诸王的旗帜一样醒目。
In the shadows, one learns the true nature of power...
在阴影里，人会学到权力真正的样子……

In the smithy, hold Shift while you smelt or refine to do five at once, or Ctrl to do the whole stack (Ctrl wins when both are held). It stops when your stamina or the charcoal or materials run out, and each unit costs what a single one would. Applies at once, no restart. Default: on.
在铁匠铺熔炼或精炼时，按住Shift一次处理五份，按住Ctrl处理整组；同时按住时以Ctrl为准。耐力、木炭或材料不足时停止，每份消耗与单次处理相同。立即生效，无需重启。默认：开启。

In vanilla, forest makes other parties harder for you to see and slows your party by 20%; it never hides your party from anyone. With this on, your own sight on the campaign map also shrinks by 30% of your base sight while your party travels through forest, and by half that if your scout has the Keen Sight perk. It does not apply inside a settlement. A raised lookout, perks and a Far Watch ride still add to your sight, and the penalties together never take more than half of your base sight. Only your own party is affected; AI parties see as before. The map bar view distance shows the shorter range, but its tooltip has no line for the forest. Off = vanilla sight in forest. Applies immediately. Default: on.

Iáphel is renowned throughout Gondor as home to some of the finest vineyards in all the Southlands. The village's terraced hillside vineyards benefit from the maritime climate near the Bay of Belfalas, producing wines that have long graced the tables of the Stewards of Gondor and now King Elessar himself. The vintages of Iáphel are so exceptional that even Elves are rumored to favor them over wines crafted by their own kin, though none would openly admit such preference. The village consists of winemakers' estates, pressing houses, storage cellars carved into the hillsides, and a small market square where traders from Dol Amroth and Pelargir come to purchase casks. The wealth from wine trade has made Iáphel's stone buildings more refined than typical farming villages, with decorative archways and well-maintained walls.
