山地冲锋生效期间，会强化坐骑韧性。
Mountain Charge charge greatly reduced, ride without ceasing.
山地冲锋充能消耗大幅降低，可以不停骑行。
Mountain Charge charge reduced, swifter activation.
山地冲锋充能消耗降低，可以更快发动。
Mountain Charge duration extended, maintaining momentum.
山地冲锋持续时间延长，让势头保持更久。
Mountain Charge grants +5% melee damage, the ram lowers its horns.
山地冲锋提供 +5% 近战伤害，战羊会压低羊角向前猛撞。
Mountain Charge radius expanded, sweeping wider formations.
山地冲锋作用范围扩大，可以扫过更宽的阵型。
Mountain Charge radius greatly expanded, unstoppable impact.
山地冲锋作用范围大幅扩大，冲击势不可挡。
骑乘作战的诺多重骑兵。
Mounted bowman of the open plains.
Mounted elite guard of the King.
Mounted guard of the river roads.
Mounted lord of the King's household.
国王亲随中的骑乘领主。
Mounted on sturdy hill ponies, you rode with the Hill Riders of Dunland, learning to fight across the rough terrain of the highlands.
你骑着结实的丘陵小马，随黑蛮地丘陵骑手作战，学会在高地崎岖地形中战斗。
Mounted troop recruitment and upgrade costs reduced by 15%.
骑兵招募与升级费用降低15%。
Moved between villages as an unnamed wanderer.
作为无名漫游者往来村庄。
Moved contraband through Umbar's back alleys.
在乌姆巴尔后巷运送违禁品。
Moved through darkness as a courier of the Necromancer.
作为死灵法师信使穿行黑暗。
Moved through shadows as a spy of the Necromancer.
作为死灵法师间谍穿行阴影。
Moved unseen among the villages of the North.
在北方村庄间隐秘行动。
Moved with the nomadic clans across the eastern steppes.
随游牧氏族穿越东方草原。

Moves a soldier who stays stuck back to where he can walk: off the walkable ground or still in water for 10 seconds, he steps to the nearest good spot within 6 m at his own height; still stuck after 30 seconds, he moves to his place in his formation while you are at least 25 m away. A riderless horse gets the short step only. Never the player, fleeing men, creatures, men working a ladder or machine, or men holding a set post or waiting at a ladder. Field battles, sieges and sally-outs, not co-op. Default: on.
将持续卡住的士兵移回可行走位置：离开可行走地面，或在水中静止10秒后，移到同一高度、6米以内最近的有效位置；30秒后仍卡住，且你距其至少25米时，则移回其编队位置。无人骑乘的马只会进行短距离移动。绝不移动玩家、逃兵、生物、操作梯子或器械的士兵，也不移动坚守指定岗位或正在梯旁等待的士兵。适用于野战、攻城和突围出击，合作联机除外。默认：开启。
Moving will break your camp. Break camp and move on?
移动会拆除营地。要拔营继续前进吗？
Mughrim of the Throgmaw warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
穆格林是斯罗格莫战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Mughza of the Vrakmaw orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
穆格扎是弗拉克莫氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。

Mugzun is a heavy-handed orc enforcer, reminiscent of the whip-wielding orcs in the books' slave pits. In Gundabad, he maintains order among the ranks, crushing rebellions and ensuring unwavering obedience to the clan's directives.
穆格祖恩是手段强硬的奥克执法者，让人想起书中奴隶坑里挥鞭的奥克。在贡达巴德，他维持队伍秩序，镇压反叛，确保所有人毫不动摇地服从氏族命令。
Muinser commands raiders in the northern reaches.
穆因瑟统领北部地区的劫掠者。
Mukhali of House Kalkian is counted among the keen horse-archers of Rhûn, loosing his shafts from the saddle at a full gallop.
卡尔基安家族的木华黎是鲁恩出色的骑射手之一，能在战马全速奔驰时从马背上射出箭矢。
Multiplier applied to heroes in battle simulation. Vanilla = 1.5.
英雄在自动战斗结算中使用的战力倍率。原版为1.5。
Multiplier applied to mounted troops in battle simulation. Vanilla = 1.2.
骑乘兵种在自动战斗结算中使用的战力倍率。原版为1.2。

Multiplier on bandit party troop counts at PlayerProgress=1.0. Vanilla already scales 0.4 -> 1.2; this is a final multiplier on top. 1.5 (default) = up to 2.5x bandit party sizes in endgame. Each troop stack is capped at its party template's max_value, which binds before 2.5x is reached.
玩家进度达到1.0时，匪徒部队人数的附加倍率。原版已经按0.4到1.2缩放，此倍率在其基础上再乘一次。默认1.5表示后期最高2.5倍规模。每种兵种还受部队模板 max_value 限制，通常会在达到2.5倍前触及上限。
Multiplier on default unit spacing during line formation. 1.0 = vanilla. 1.2 (default) = slightly wider line for cleaner charge.
列阵时士兵间默认距离的倍率。1.0为原版，默认1.2会让队列稍微疏开，使冲锋更顺畅。
Multiplier on every release reward when you and the lord are on opposite sides, so freeing an enemy of your cause earns little. Default: 0.50.
你与被释放领主属于对立阵营时，各项释放奖励的倍率；释放与你立场相反的敌人，回报较少。默认：0.50。
Multiplier on every release reward when you and the lord are on the same side (both Free, or both Shadow). Results round half away from zero, and 0 grants nothing. Default: 1.00.
你与被释放领主同属自由人民或暗影时，各项释放奖励的倍率。结果取最近整数，恰好一半时向远离0的方向取整；0为没有奖励。默认：1.00。
Multiplier on every release reward when you or the lord is on neither side. Default: 0.75.
你或被释放领主不属于自由人民和暗影任何一方时，各项释放奖励的倍率。默认：0.75。

Multiplier on hideout count + parties-per-hideout at PlayerProgress=1.0. Curve: 1 + curve * progress. 0 = vanilla density throughout. 1.5 (default) = up to 2.5x density in endgame. Both caps below bind first.
玩家进度达到1.0时，藏身处数量和每个藏身处部队数量的倍率。曲线为1 + 曲线系数 × 进度。0表示始终使用原版密度；默认1.5表示后期最高2.5倍密度。下方两项上限会先起作用。

Multiplier on the FIRST fight's troop count inside hideouts at PlayerProgress=1.0. 1.5 (default) = up to 2.5x bandits in the camp-clearing phase of a hideout assault in endgame. The boss fight is not scaled: it is exactly the boss plus Hideout Boss Bodyguards below.
玩家进度达到1.0时，藏身处第一阶段战斗的人数倍率。默认1.5表示后期清理营地时，匪徒人数最高2.5倍。首领战不缩放，始终为首领加上下方设置的护卫人数。
Multiplier on the donation relation (vanilla's gain plus the bonus) when the captive is on the opposite side to the settlement owner, such as a Mordor captive handed to Minas Tirith. Default: 2.00.
俘虏与定居点所有者属于对立阵营时，移交俘虏的关系倍率，同时作用于原版奖励和额外奖励；例如把魔多俘虏交给米那斯提力斯。默认：2.00。

Multiplier on the donation relation when the captive and the settlement owner are on the same side. Zero means no reward, and no vanilla relation either, for jailing a friend of the owner. Default: 0.00.
俘虏与定居点所有者属于同一阵营时，移交俘虏的关系倍率。0表示把所有者的朋友送进监狱不会获得奖励，连原版关系奖励也不会获得。默认：0.00。
Multiplier on the donation relation when the captive or the settlement owner is on neither side. Default: 1.00.
俘虏或定居点所有者不属于自由人民和暗影任何一方时，移交俘虏的关系倍率。默认：1.00。
Multiplier on the loss when you and the village owner's realm are on opposite sides, such as an Evil warband raiding a Free village, where raiding is expected. Default: 0.10.
你与村庄所属国家属于对立阵营时，关系损失的倍率；例如邪恶战团劫掠自由人民村庄，这种情况下劫掠本就是预料之中的事。默认：0.10。
Multiplier on the loss when you and the village owner's realm are on the same side, both Free or both Evil: the harshest pairing. Default: 1.00.
你与村庄所属国家同属自由人民或邪恶阵营时，关系损失的倍率。这种情况下的惩罚最重。默认：1.00。
Multiplier on the loss when you or the village owner's realm is on neither side. Default: 0.50.
你或村庄所属国家不属于自由人民和暗影任何一方时，关系损失的倍率。默认：0.50。
Multiplier on the tournament relation with an owner or notable on the opposite side, who does not cheer a champion of the other cause. Default: 0.00.
赢得竞技大会时，与对立阵营城镇所有者或要人的关系奖励倍率；他们不会为敌对立场的冠军喝彩。默认：0.00。
Multiplier on the tournament relation with an owner or notable on your side. Default: 1.00.
赢得竞技大会时，与同阵营城镇所有者或要人的关系奖励倍率。默认：1.00。
Multiplier on the tournament relation with an owner or notable who, or whose realm, is on neither side. Default: 1.00.
赢得竞技大会时，与本人或所属国家保持中立的城镇所有者或要人的关系奖励倍率。默认：1.00。

Multiplies an AI lord's party size limit. Preserves clan-tier progression, so a tier-4 lord still outgrows a tier-1. 1.0 = vanilla, which is the default: this feature ships neutral and you opt in. Raise this and the Flat Bonus together: the bonus is added after the multiplier, so moving one alone shifts the total by less than you expect. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
AI领主部队人数上限的倍率。家族等级带来的成长仍然保留，因此四级家族领主的部队仍会比一级家族领主更大。1.0为原版数值，也是默认值；本功能默认不提供加成，由你自行调整。建议与固定人数加成一同提高：固定加成在倍率计算后才加入，只改其中一项，实际总人数的增幅可能低于预期。2026年11月以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。

Multiplies every settlement garrison's size limit, player-owned included. Siege balance, not an AI handicap: lords fielding thousands would walk over garrisons still capped near vanilla's 200. Raising this also gives lords more room to donate troops on entering a friendly fief. 1.0 = vanilla, which is the default. IMPORTANT: raise this only alongside the AI Lord multiplier above. Vanilla refuses to even target a settlement when the attacker is under twice the defender's strength, and that strength counts garrison AND militia, so a high garrison multiplier with vanilla-sized lord parties stops AI sieges happening at all. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.

所有定居点驻军人数上限的倍率，包括玩家的驻军。这是围城平衡调整，不是给AI单方面让利：如果领主能带数千人，而驻军仍只有原版的约200人，城池就会轻易失守。提高此值，也能让领主进入友方封地时捐赠更多士兵。1.0为原版数值，也是默认值。重要：只有同时提高上面的AI领主部队倍率时，才建议提高此项。进攻方实力不足守方两倍时，原版AI甚至不会把该定居点选为目标；守方实力同时计算驻军和民兵。如果驻军倍率很高，领主部队却保持原版规模，AI可能完全不再围城。2026年11月以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。

Multiplies every signature-strike cooldown (shipped: Sauron's Slam 20 s and Sweep 12 s, the Nine's Scream 15 s). Raise it if Sauron or the Nazgul feel overpowered; the JSON values need a full restart, this slider applies live.
调整全部专属攻击的冷却时间。随包值：索隆猛砸20秒、横扫12秒，九戒灵尖啸15秒。觉得索隆或那兹古尔过强时可以提高。JSON 数值需完全重启后生效，滑块即时生效。
Multiplies the morale a party round gives (20 to 40 before the scale, set in inn_rounds.json). 0 gives none; the party's morale never goes past 100. Between 0 and 3. Default: 1.
请部队喝酒时，士气加成的倍率。基础加成为20至40点，设在inn_rounds.json中。0为不增加；部队士气不会超过100。范围：0至3。默认：1。
Multiplies the renown a house round gives (1 to 3 before the scale, set in inn_rounds.json), rounded to a whole number. 0 gives none. Between 0 and 3. Default: 1.
请全酒馆喝酒时，声望加成的倍率，结果取整数。基础加成为1至3点，设在inn_rounds.json中。0为不增加。范围：0至3。默认：1。

Multiplies the skill XP that AI lords earn, so their skills climb faster. Skills only: a lord's hero level is not sped up. Never applies to you or to any lord of your clan, spouse and family included. In a co-op session only the host's value applies; while a co-op mod TAOM cannot probe (such as BannerlordTogether) is enabled, it is off for every player. 1 is vanilla. Between 1 and 2. Default: 1.25.
AI领主获得技能经验的倍率，使其技能提升更快。只影响技能，不会加快英雄等级提升。绝不影响你或你家族的任何领主，包括配偶和家人。合作联机只采用主机端的设置；启用了TAOM无法识别的合作联机MOD，例如BannerlordTogether时，对所有玩家停用。1为原版。范围：1至2。默认：1.25。
Multiplies the width of every border. Default: 1.
调整所有国境线的宽度倍率。默认：1。
Murgha leads a night-pack along the Mordor road, and it is said the Eye itself favours her cruelty.
穆尔加带着一支夜袭队在魔多的道路上活动。据说，就连魔眼本身也欣赏她的残忍。
Mute Menu Music Under The Video
播放视频时关闭菜单音乐
Mutiny against good sense, and I will not bargain with it. We sink you where you stand.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_insulted]
你是铁了心要犯傻，那就没得谈了。今天就在这儿送你沉底！[ib:aggressive][if:convo_insulted]
Muunokhoi of House Cilzeron rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
西尔泽隆家族的穆诺霍伊率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Muzgash leads the feared berserker units of Isengard. His warriors paint themselves with the blood of enemies before battle, striking terror into those who face them.
穆兹嘎什统领艾森加德令人畏惧的狂战部队。他的战士会在战前用敌人的血涂抹身体，让所有面对他们的人心生恐惧。
“乌鲁克狂战士队长”穆兹嘎什
Muzgash, the Great Goblin of Goblin Town, master of the warrens of the High Pass.
穆兹嘎什，半兽人镇的半兽人王，高隘口地穴的主人。
Muzgura rose through the ranks of the Red Echelon by her cunning and ferocity. She oversees the war preparations of her company.
穆兹古拉凭借狡诈与凶狠在赤红梯队中晋升。她负责监督本连队的战争准备。
Muzra is an orc herbalist, brewing potions from foul ingredients in Middle-earth's corrupted lands. Her elixirs enhance warriors' endurance in prolonged fights.
穆兹拉是奥克草药师，用中洲腐化土地上的污秽材料熬煮药剂。她的药液能增强战士在持久战中的耐力。
Muzrak, a curse caster, afflicts intruders, his hexes weakening foes like Sauron's debilitating influence.
穆兹拉克是诅咒施法者，用咒法折磨闯入者，使敌人像遭到索隆削弱影响一样衰弱。

My apprentices worked those forges as hard as I did. One of them lost his hand when a quench cracked the crucible, and his clan went to the guild. The guild said I drove the young too hard and sought a craft that was not mine to seek. They broke my mark and barred me from every forge in the Blue Mountains.
我的学徒跟我一样，在那些炉边拼命干活。一次淬火弄裂了坩埚，其中一个丢了只手，他的氏族便找上行会。行会说我把年轻人逼得太狠，还妄求不该碰的技艺。他们毁了我的匠印，不准我再用蓝色山脉的任何锻炉。
My blade has tasted the blood of many foes, yet I fight on...
我的刀刃尝过许多敌人的血，但我仍在战斗……
My blade is yours, if you'll have it.
如果你愿意接纳，我的刀就是你的。

My bloodline traces to old Númenor, the true Númenor that embraced greatness, not the weak remnants in Gondor. I served in the Morgul host as a lieutenant, commanding units of orcs and men. The blood of kings flows in my veins, yet I take orders from creatures that crawl in darkness. The irony isn't lost on me.
我的血脉可以追溯到古老的努门诺尔，那个拥抱伟大的真正努门诺尔，而不是刚铎那些软弱的残余。我曾在魔古尔军中担任副官，指挥奥克和人类部队。王者之血流在我体内，我却要听命于那些在黑暗里爬行的东西。这讽刺我当然明白。
My bow and knowledge are yours, if you'll trust them.
你若相信，我这张弓和所知的一切，都愿为你所用。
My bow and woodcraft are yours, if you'll have them.
我的弓箭和野外生存技能都愿意为你效劳，如果你需要的话。
My bow is steady and my aim is true. Will you have me?
我的弓很稳，准头也真。你愿意接纳我吗？

My captain called every ranger north to meet a Gundabad column on the North Downs. Duty bound me, so I went, and in nine days the column was beaten. When I returned Combe was ash, and a dozen of its children were gone, taken or dead; no one could say which.
队长召集所有游民北上，迎击北岗的一支贡达巴德纵队。职责在身，我去了，九天后我们打败了那支军队。可等我回来，库姆村已经成了灰烬，十几个孩子不见了，是被抓走还是死了，谁也说不清。

My captain called every ranger to the Barrow-downs to meet a Gundabad column. Duty bound me, so I went, and in nine days the column was beaten. When I returned Downsend was ash, and a dozen of its children were gone, taken or dead; no one could say which.
队长召集所有游民到古冢岗，迎击一支贡达巴德纵队。职责在身，我去了，九天后我们打败了那支军队。可等我回来，岗尾已经成了灰烬，十几个孩子不见了，是被抓走还是死了，谁也说不清。

My captain called every ranger to the Ettenmoors to meet a troll pack and its orc drovers. Duty bound me, so I went, and in nine days the pack was broken. When I returned the hamlet was ash, and a dozen of its children were gone, taken or dead; no one could say which.
队长召集所有游民到埃滕荒原，迎击一群食人妖和驱赶它们的奥克。职责在身，我去了，九天后我们打散了它们。可等我回来，小村已经成了灰烬，十几个孩子不见了，是被抓走还是死了，谁也说不清。
My captain didn't believe me, said I'd been drinking. The steward heard my tale and declared me mad, suggesting I be confined. I fled that night. What I saw was real, and the plains must be warned.
队长不信，说我喝多了。总管听了我的话，就说我疯了，还提议把我关起来。那天夜里我逃走了。我看见的都是真的，必须让平原上的人知道。
My captain didn't believe me, said I'd been drinking. Wormtongue heard my tale and declared me mad, suggesting I be confined. I fled that night. What I saw was real, and the Mark must be warned.
我的队长不信我，说我喝醉了。格里马·佞舌听了我的话，宣布我疯了，建议把我关起来。我当夜逃走。我看到的是真的，必须警告马克。

My captain ordered the lances to ride down a column of unarmed pilgrims on the Taskral's road, to make an example. I would not, and I said why before the whole host. They named me oath-breaker for breaking faith with my captain, never mind the faith I kept with the helpless.
我的队长命令骑枪队在塔斯克拉尔的道路上冲垮一队手无寸铁的朝圣者，用他们立威。我不肯，还当着全军说出了理由。他们说我是背誓者，因为我违背了队长，却不管我守住了对无助者的信义。

My captain took two thirds of every haul and called it the hold's share. I put an arrow in his thigh when he demanded the last of it. He lived. I did not stay to find out how long he would hold the grudge.
每次抢来的东西，队长要拿走三分之二，说是堡里该得的。他连最后那点也要，我就一箭射进他的大腿。他没死，我可没留下看他能记恨多久。
My caravans cannot pass for the raiders on the roads. Break enough of their bands and trade may flow again.
路上的劫掠者让我的商队寸步难行。多打垮几支劫掠队，生意才有机会恢复。
My daughter -- they have taken my daughter, traveller, and demand a ransom I cannot pay. Break the curs that hold her and bring her home to me.
我的女儿！旅人，他们抓走了我的女儿，还要我付一笔根本拿不出的赎金。打垮那群混蛋，把她带回家吧。
My enemies have set a company of sellswords on my lands. They burn and pillage under another's coin. Break them for me.
我的敌人派了一支佣兵团到我的领地上。他们拿着别人的钱，到处烧杀抢掠。替我打垮他们。

My experiments failed in Erebor, but the knowledge remains. I can forge weapons and armor beyond common craft, even if some techniques are... risky. There are places that value innovation over tradition, results over safety.
我的实验在孤山失败了，但知识还在。我能锻造出超越普通工艺的武器和护甲，哪怕有些技术……很冒险。有些地方看重创新胜过传统，看重结果胜过安全。

My family bred riding horses on the green slopes of Harlindon, selling to the rangers of Arthedain and the lords of the Havens alike. I rode before I could properly walk, and counted the herd before I could count much else.
我家在哈林顿的青翠山坡上养骑乘马，阿塞丹的游民、灰港的领主，都是买家。我还没走稳就会骑马，别的数目还没学会，先会数马群。
My family claims kinship with Girion, the last Lord of Dale before the dragon came, so I was taught young to lead men and to sit a horse. I rose to command thirty spears on the eastern road.
我家自称是吉瑞安的亲族，那是巨龙来临前河谷城的末代领主。所以我从小就学带兵、学骑马，后来升到带领三十名矛手，驻守东边大道。

My father bred horses, my mother was from the Southwood, where archery is prized. I combined both traditions, becoming one of the few horse archers in the realm. I could put an arrow through a ring at full gallop.
父亲养马，母亲来自看重箭术的南林。我把两边的本事合在一起，成了王国少有的骑射手。全速奔驰时，我也能一箭穿过圆环。

My father bred horses, my mother was from the Wold where archery is prized. I combined both traditions, becoming one of the few horse archers in the Mark. I could put an arrow through a ring at full gallop.
我父亲养马，母亲来自重视箭术的北高原。我把两种传统合在一起，成了马克少有的骑射手之一。我能在全速奔驰时一箭穿过圆环。

My father felled timber at Fellingwick and I felled it after him, swinging the axe at dawn and sharpening it at dusk. When the watch needed spears, I took up a boar-spear and a place in the line, being strong and no worse than most.
父亲在伐木村砍树，我也接着干这行，天亮挥斧，天黑磨刃。守卫队缺矛手时，我就拿起猎野猪用的长矛，进了阵列。我有力气，比多数人也不差。

My father fished the Great River and I fished it after him, hauling nets at dawn and mending them at dusk. When the watch needed spears, I took up the boat-hook and a place in the line, being strong and no worse than most.
父亲在大河打鱼，我也接着干这行，天亮拉网，天黑补网。守卫队缺矛手时，我就拿起船钩，进了阵列。我有力气，比多数人也不差。

My father fished the Long Lake and I fished it after him, hauling nets at dawn and mending them at dusk. When the watch needed spears, I took up the boat-hook and a place in the line, being strong and no worse than most.
父亲在长湖打鱼，我也接着干这行，天亮拉网，天黑补网。镇卫队缺矛手时，我就拿起船钩，进了阵列。我有力气，比多数人也不差。

My father fished the Sea of Rhûn and I fished it after him, hauling nets at dawn and mending them at dusk. When the watch needed spears, I took up the boat-hook and a place in the line, being strong and no worse than most.
父亲在鲁恩内海打鱼，我也接着干这行，天亮拉网，天黑补网。守卫队缺矛手时，我就拿起船钩，进了阵列。我有力气，比多数人也不差。

My father is a lord of the Firebeards, and my elder brother will hold his hall after him. I was raised to command all the same: drill, siegecraft, the keeping of stores and accounts. My tutors said I had the makings of a captain. Nobody said what I was to be captain of.
我父亲是火须族的领主，哥哥以后会继承他的厅堂。可我一样从小按带兵的人来教：操练、攻城、管物资、记账。老师们说我有当队长的本事，却没人说过，我能带哪支队伍。
My father spoke of great adventures in his youth. Now it's my turn to prove that dwarf steel and dwarf courage remain unmatched in all the realm.
我父亲常说起他年轻时的伟大冒险。现在该轮到我证明，矮人的钢铁和勇气在整个国度里依旧无可匹敌。

My father told the tale of Beorn every night of my childhood. The other boys named me Bear as a joke because I would not stop asking for more of it. At sixteen I took a spear from the armory of Beorn's Hall and swore to make the joke true.
小时候，父亲每晚都讲贝奥恩的故事。我没完没了地央求他多讲，别的男孩就开玩笑，叫我熊。十六岁时，我从贝奥恩大厅的军械库领了一支长矛，发誓要让这玩笑成真。

My father told the tale of Ostmar, who held Northgate through a whole winter, every night of my childhood. The other boys named me after the Warden as a joke because I would not stop asking for more of it. At sixteen I took a spear from the Vineholm armory and swore to make the joke true.
小时候，父亲每晚都讲奥斯特马尔的故事，他在北门守了整整一个冬天。我没完没了地央求他多讲，别的男孩就开玩笑，拿那位守望者的名字叫我。十六岁时，我从葡萄洲军械库领了一支长矛，发誓要让这玩笑成真。

My father told the tale of the dragon's fall every night of my childhood. The other boys named me after the dragon-slayer as a joke because I would not stop asking for more of it. At sixteen I took a spear from the Dale armory and swore to make the joke true.
小时候，父亲每晚都讲巨龙被杀的故事。我没完没了地央求他多讲，别的男孩就开玩笑，拿屠龙英雄的名字叫我。十六岁时，我从河谷城军械库领了一支长矛，发誓要让这玩笑成真。

My father told the tale of the great spider of Emyn Duir every night of my childhood. The other boys named me Spiderbane as a joke because I would not stop asking for more of it. At sixteen I took a spear from the armory at Thornhold and swore to make the joke true.
小时候，父亲每晚都讲埃敏杜伊尔巨蛛的故事。我没完没了地央求他多讲，别的男孩就开玩笑，叫我蜘蛛克星。十六岁时，我从荆棘堡军械库领了一支长矛，发誓要让这玩笑成真。

My father was a boy when Beorn's Hall was raised, timber by timber, and I grew up watching the Vales fill with farms. I rode the High Pass post for twenty years, carrying word between the old watch above the pass and the hall.
贝奥恩大厅一根根架起木梁时，我父亲还是个孩子。我从小看着河谷里渐渐布满农庄。在高隘口的邮路上，我跑了二十年，来往于隘口上方的老哨所和大厅之间传递消息。

My father was a boy when Woodmen-town was palisaded, and I grew up watching the clearings creep back into the forest's edge. I rode the Emyn Duir Watch post for twenty years, carrying word between the old watch above the trees and the gates.
林中居民镇立起木栅时，我父亲还是个孩子。我从小看着开垦的空地渐渐向林缘推进。在埃敏杜伊尔守望队的邮路上，我跑了二十年，来往于高出树梢的老哨所和城门之间传递消息。

My father was a boy when the dragon fell, and I grew up watching Dale rebuilt stone by stone. I rode the Ravenhill post for twenty years, carrying word between the old watch above the city and the gates.
巨龙死时，我父亲还是个孩子。我从小看着河谷城一砖一石地重建。在渡鸦岭的邮路上，我跑了二十年，来往于城上方的老哨所和城门之间传递消息。
My father's halls grew too confining. I seek to understand the wider world beyond our borders.
我父亲的殿堂让我觉得太过拘束。我想了解边境之外更广阔的世界。
My garrison is stretched thin and the enemy presses us at every turn. Break the bands that harry my walls and you will give my men room to breathe.
我的驻军兵力不足，敌人却步步紧逼。打垮那些骚扰城防的队伍，让我的士兵喘口气。

My grandfather died at Azanulbizar, my father at the Battle of Five Armies. War is in my blood. I trained harder than any, earned my place in the vanguard through skill alone. When raiders struck our convoys, I led the counter-attacks. Peace never suited me.
我的祖父死在阿扎努比扎，我父亲死在五军之战。战争流在我的血里。我比任何人训练得都刻苦，只靠本领赢得先锋位置。劫掠者袭击我们的车队时，是我带队反击。和平从来不适合我。

My grandfather fell at Azanulbizar under the gates of Moria, and my father in the wars against Blue Craig. I stood in the vanguard from the day I could lift a shield, and when raiders struck the Dwarf-road I led the company that hunted them down. We were never slow.
祖父死在墨瑞亚城门下的阿扎努比扎，父亲死在与蓝岩的战争里。从拿得动盾牌那天起，我就站在前锋。劫掠者袭击矮人路时，追杀它们的队伍由我带领。我们从不磨蹭。

My grandmother planted the first vines on the Amberslope terraces, and I grew up watching Dorwinion's presses and cellars rise year by year. I rode the Northgate post for twenty years, carrying word between the beacon tower above the keep and the gates of Vineholm.
祖母在琥珀坡的梯田种下了第一批葡萄，我从小看着多温尼安的压榨机和酒窖一年年建起来。在北门的邮路上，我跑了二十年，来往于堡垒上方的烽火塔和葡萄洲城门之间传递消息。

My grandmother rode with the host in her youth, before marriage tamed her. She taught me spear and horse in secret, despite my father's wishes. When raiders struck our village while the men were away, I led the defense.
祖母年轻时，嫁人还没收住她性子之前，曾随大军骑马出征。父亲不愿，她还是偷偷教我骑马、使矛。男人们不在村里时，劫掠者来了，是我带人抵抗。

My grandmother rode with the éoreds in her youth, before marriage tamed her. She taught me spear and horse in secret, despite my father's wishes. When raiders struck our village while the men were away, I led the defense.
我的祖母年轻时曾随伊奥雷德骑兵队驰骋，结婚后才安定下来。尽管我父亲反对，她还是偷偷教我使矛和骑马。村里的男人外出时，劫掠者袭击了村庄，是我带人守住了这里。
My heir must be schooled as befits our line, with fine raiment and the trappings of learning. Bring me what is needed and the boy will want for nothing.
我的继承人得接受符合家族身份的教育，体面的衣服和学习用具一样都不能少。把需要的东西带来，那孩子就什么也不缺了。
My heritage is both burden and duty. I am heir to a throne long empty, yet I have chosen the wild over the crown, at least for now.
我的血脉既是重担，也是责任。我是一座久已空悬的王座的继承人，但至少现在，我选择荒野，而不是王冠。
My house holds no lands to name. Why would you ask me that?
我家族没有领地可说，你问这个做什么？

My last assignment was eliminating a suspected traitor, a high-ranking sorcerer. I succeeded, but discovered too late he'd been innocent, framed by another who wanted his position. That other now holds power, and I'm evidence of his crime. He sent hunters. I killed the hunters, but more will come.
我最后一次任务，是清除一名涉嫌背叛的高阶巫师。我成功了，却太晚才发现他是无辜的，是另一个想夺他职位的人陷害了他。那个人现在掌握权力，而我是他罪行的证据。他派来了猎手。我杀了那些猎手，但还会有更多人来。
My line has died with an axe in its hand for three generations. I do not expect to break the habit...
我家三代人，都是握着斧头死的。我也不指望改这个惯例……

My lineage traces to Anárion himself, though our house fell to lesser standing long ago. Still, we maintained our pride, our traditions, and our skill at arms. I was raised believing nobility meant service.
我的血脉可追溯至阿纳瑞安本人，尽管我们家族早已没落。但我们依然保持着骄傲、传统与武艺。我自幼便相信，贵族意味着责任。

My lord was murdered anyway, by his own brother's hand, while I guarded a gate that was never the danger. I would have named the killer before the Châjaphân's court, but the brother sat the high seat now, and a guardsman's word weighs nothing against a House lord's. To stay was to swear loyalty to the man who killed my master. I would not.
可我的领主还是被杀了，死在他亲兄弟手里，而我守着一扇从来不是危险所在的大门。我本想在查贾凡的宫廷前说出凶手的名字，可那兄弟如今坐上了高位，一个卫兵的话，在家族领主面前没有分量。留下来就意味着向杀死我主人的人效忠。我不愿意。
My miners found it by luck: a seam of the metal the great armourers pay anything for. But the shaft is old, and without good timber to shore it up it will bury them and the seam together.
我的矿工运气好，找到了一条矿脉，那里的金属是铸甲大师们不惜重金收购的。但矿井太旧了，没有好木料撑住，矿工和矿脉都会被埋在下面。
My name is older than my fortune. Have you heard of the house of Girion?
我这家世，可比眼下的身家久远得多。听过吉瑞安家族吗？
My oath is yours so long as you keep faith. Break it, and I am gone.
只要你守信，我的誓言就是你的。你若背弃它，我就离开。

My operation expanded too successfully. Started employing others, moving significant quantities of material. Eventually caught selling Mordor military equipment to enemy traders. The profit margins were too good to resist. When they came to arrest me, I'd already prepared my exit with enough wealth to start fresh elsewhere.
我的生意扩张得太成功了。我开始雇人，搬运大量物资。最后，我因为把魔多军用装备卖给敌方商人而被抓住了把柄。利润太高，实在难以抗拒。他们来逮捕我时，我早已安排好退路，带着足够在别处重新开始的财富离开了。

My partner and I sold the tallies to the Lindon watch for a promise of a pardon. Círdan's people took the pardon back. They hanged my partner from a mooring post and left him to turn in the wind. I swam out in the fog and kept swimming.
我和搭档把记录卖给林顿的守卫，换来赦免的承诺。奇尔丹的人却收回了承诺，把我的搭档吊在系船桩上，让他在风里转。我趁雾游出去，一直往外游。
My purse is lighter now, and my company is gone entirely. I am an honest wanderer at last, though only for lack of offers. The grain, I admit, was not my finest work.
现在我的钱袋轻了，一个手下也没了。总算成了个老实流浪汉，虽说只是没人给买卖做。我承认，粮食那笔确实做得不太光彩。

My restlessness caused problems. During a feast, I spoke too freely about needing real battles, not just guard duty. Insulted a thane's son who'd never seen combat. The duel was legal, but killing him wasn't wise. Dáin suggested I travel until tempers cool.
我的不安分惹出了麻烦。一次宴会上，我说得太直，说我们需要真正的战斗，而不是光站岗。这话冒犯了一位从未上过战场的领主之子。决斗合法，但杀了他并不明智。戴因建议我出去走走，等怒气平息再回来。
My retainers are soft and untried, and soft men die in the first fight. Lead them against real foes and make hard soldiers of them.
我的扈从太娇弱，也没打过仗，这样的人第一次上战场就会送命。带他们去对付真正的敌人，把他们练成能打硬仗的士兵。

My scouts reported strange activity - trees being felled, fires burning day and night, and wolves unlike any we'd seen before. When I brought word to Edoras, Gríma Wormtongue dismissed my concerns, saying Saruman was our ally.
我的斥候报告了异动：树木被砍倒，火焰日夜不熄，还有我们从没见过的狼。当我把消息带到埃多拉斯时，格里马·佞舌驳回了我的担忧，说萨茹曼是我们的盟友。

My scouts reported strange activity: fires burning in the trees night after night, hunters who never came back, and wolves unlike any we had seen. When I brought word to Vidugard, the King's steward Aldwulf dismissed my concerns and said the hill was empty and the tales were for children.
斥候报告了些怪事：树间夜夜燃火，猎人一去不回，还有我们从未见过的狼。我把消息带到维杜加德，国王的总管阿尔德伍尔夫却不当回事，说那座山空着呢，都是些哄孩子的故事。
My shelves groan with ware no one here will buy, traveller. If my craft could reach a town that needs it, I would not starve at my own bench.
旅人，我的货架快被压垮了，可这里没人肯买。只要把这些货送到需要它们的城镇，我就不用守着手艺挨饿了。
My sire bade me carve our fortune in blood. Common among Gundabad's brood.
我爹要我用鲜血砍出我们家的富贵。这在贡达巴德的族裔里很常见。
My sire led raids from Gundabad's halls, but a dwarf-arrow felled him. We feasted on his spoils, slaves, dwarf-gold, but now I crave my own horde.
我爹曾从贡达巴德的大厅率队劫掠，却被一支矮人箭射倒。我们分吃了他的战利品、奴隶和矮人黄金，但现在我想要自己的兽群。

My sire stole shaggy ponies from the coastal farms, and I rode them back across the foothills to Blue Craig. I was young and a good rider. I kept every silver ear-ring, every iron nail, every pot of salt from the raids in a hollow in the cliff.
我爹从海边农场抢来毛茸茸的小马，我骑着它们翻过山脚的丘陵，赶回蓝岩。那时我年轻，骑术也好。每次抢来的银耳环、铁钉、盐罐，我一件不落，全藏在崖壁的洞里。
My soldiers gather, but a sword does not fill a belly. Without grain to feed them, this host will scatter before it ever takes the field.
我的士兵正在集结，但光有剑可填不饱肚子。没有粮食，这支大军还没上战场就会散了。
My spear and steed are yours, if you'll have them.
你若愿意，我的长矛和战马就为你效力。
My spear knows both land and sea combat, if you have need.
我通晓在陆地与海洋上持矛作战的技艺，或许你会用到我这种人。

My talents drew private commissions, wealthy individuals wanting rivals eliminated discreetly. Profitable work, until one client proved unable to keep secrets. Interrogators learned of my side business. Rather than face trial, I poisoned the interrogation team and everyone who'd heard their reports. Then I left before anyone realized they were dead.
我的才能引来了私人委托，一些富人想悄悄除掉对手。那活儿很赚钱，直到某个客户管不住自己的嘴。审讯者查到了我的副业。与其受审，我毒死了审讯小队，以及所有听过他们报告的人。然后在任何人发现他们已死之前离开了。
My wains dare not roll while raiders haunt the road. Break enough of their bands and the way will be open for honest trade once more.
路上到处都是劫掠者，我的货车根本不敢动身。多打垮几支劫掠队，正经商人才能重新做生意。
My work goes beyond anvil and hammer. I shape scenes and spaces, crafting the very landscapes of memory in three dimensions.
我的工作不止铁砧和锤子。我塑造场景与空间，把记忆中的地貌以三维的方式重现出来。
My work was the eyries. I crawled the ledges above the High Pass and counted the great eagles, their nests, their hunts. The chiefs paid in bones and I put aside a little each time.
我以前负责盯鹰巢。爬高隘口上面的岩壁，数大鹰、数鹰巢，看它们什么时候出去打猎。酋长们拿骨头付账，我每次都存一点。

My younger brother coveted our inheritance. He forged documents suggesting I conspired with Southron merchants against Gondor's interests. The court believed his lies, or perhaps they were simply paid to. My lands were seized, my name struck from the rolls.
我的弟弟觊觎我们的家产。他伪造了文件，诬陷我与南方商人勾结，损害刚铎的利益。法庭相信了他的谎言，或许他们只是收受了贿赂。我的领地被没收，我的名字也从名册上被抹去。
Mérthú is wife to Erkenbrand, Lady of the Hornburg.
梅尔图是埃肯布兰德的妻子，也是号角堡的女主人。
Mûzgash patrols the stairs below the Dark Tower, a silent killer who reports straight to the Mouth's household.
穆兹嘎什在邪黑塔下的阶梯上巡逻，是个沉默的杀手，直接向索隆之口的家臣汇报。
Naer-mauz sits in a deep canyon near Lûglurag. Its silver goes to Barad Dûr, where it buys the service of Easterling and Haradrim chieftains.
奈尔-毛兹坐落在卢格卢拉格附近一条幽深的峡谷中。这里的白银被送往巴拉督尔，用来雇佣东夷与哈拉德的部族首领为魔多效力。
Naergûr lies on stony slopes near Cirith Nargil. Its slave herders keep thin sheep whose wool is woven into cloaks for the orc host.
奈尔古尔位于纳吉尔隘口附近多石的山坡上。奴隶牧民饲养瘦弱的羊，羊毛被织成披风，供给奥克大军。
Naghza of the Hrakdûr orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
纳格扎是赫拉克杜尔氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Naglur, chieftain of the Maughâsh orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
纳格卢尔是毛嘎什奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Naktharil, daughter of the Dark Lord, is steeped in the dark arts of Dol Guldur and Lugbúrz. She walks the Shadow's hidden roads, and those who cross her are not heard from again.
纳克萨莉尔是黑暗魔君的女儿，深谙多古尔都和路格布尔兹的黑暗法术。她行走在黑暗势力的隐秘道路上，凡是与她作对的人，此后便再无音讯。
Name a scout for your party, or travel alone to scout yourself.
请为部队任命一名斥候，或独自出行，亲自侦察。
Name me a cause I can serve without lowering my sword, and I will follow you to the end of it.
给我一个不必违心收剑也能效力的目标，我就跟你走到底。
Name the holdings of your house, if you are willing to share them.
如果你愿意说，告诉我你们家族有哪些领地。
Names on a page can save lives, and you wrote them.
纸上的名字也能救命，而你把他们写下来了。
Namir commands archers of the desert tribes.
纳米尔统领沙漠部族的弓箭手。
Nan Angren lies in the valley of the Isen near Orthanc Gate. Its herders keep cattle for the garrison of the Wizard, and few of them now go near the walls at night.
南安格仁位于欧尔桑克大门附近的艾森河谷。牧民为巫师的驻军养牛，如今却很少有人敢在夜里靠近城墙。
娜仁格日勒·博佐加尼思
Narangerel of House Bozorganith is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
博佐加尼思家族的娜仁格日勒是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Narduk, a sky scourge, leads aerial assaults, diving upon foes like the Nazgûl attacks in lore.
纳尔杜克是天空灾星，率领空中突袭，像传说中的那兹古尔攻击那样俯冲敌阵。

Nargoth, a raiding orc warlord, embodies the pillaging hordes that sacked settlements in the North. His expeditions bring back slaves and spoils, enriching the clan and fueling the endless cycle of orcish aggression.
纳尔戈斯是劫掠型奥克军阀，体现曾洗劫北方聚落的掠夺大军。他的远征带回奴隶和战利品，让氏族更加富足，也继续推动奥克永无止境的侵略循环。
Nargra is an orc poisoner, crafting toxins inspired by the foul arts in Middle-earth lore. Her venoms weaken enemies before battles, tilting the odds in Gundabad's favor.
纳尔格拉是奥克毒师，制作的毒素来自中洲传说中的污秽技艺。她的毒液能在战前削弱敌人，让胜算倒向贡达巴德。
Nargrash, a web weaver, ensnares prey for Khamûl, her tactics mimicking the spider ambushes in the books.
纳尔格拉什是一名织网者，为可哈穆尔捕获猎物。她的战术模仿了书中蜘蛛伏击的方式。
Nargrim of the Lugbúrz warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
纳尔格林是路格布尔兹战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Narlog, a lore-keeper orc, recites tales of ancient grudges against Dwarves, inspired by Tolkien's deep orc history. He rallies the clan with stories of past glories and future vengeance.
纳尔洛格是奥克传说保管者，会吟诵针对矮人的古老仇怨，灵感来自托尔金笔下深厚的奥克历史。他用过去荣耀和未来复仇的故事鼓动氏族。
Narmir, younger brother of Angbor, serves in the defense of Lamedon. He shares his brother's courage if not yet his experience.
纳尔米尔是安格博的弟弟，参与拉梅顿的防务。他和兄长一样勇敢，只是经验尚浅。
Narsha, a dark enchantress, curses enemies with sorcery, her magic reflecting the corrupting influence of Dol Guldur on the forest in the tales.
纳尔莎是黑暗女咒师，以巫术诅咒敌人。她的魔法体现出故事中多古尔都对森林的腐化影响。
Narzia, a wraith binder, enslaves souls, bolstering Khamûl's ethereal forces.
纳尔齐亚是一名缚魂者，靠奴役灵魂来壮大可哈穆尔的幽灵军队。
Narzog is a harasser orc, using hit-and-run tactics from the lore of orc skirmishers. His mobility keeps pressure on neighboring realms.
纳尔佐格是骚扰型奥克，采用奥克散兵传说中的打了就跑战术。他的机动性让贡达巴德能不断压迫敌人边境。
Narzug commands the largest warg pack in Isengard's armies. His riders form the vanguard of every major assault.
纳尔祖格统领艾森加德军中规模最大的座狼群。他的骑手构成每一次大型进攻的先锋。
Narzugh, overlord of the Necromancer's Legion, summons undead legions, embodying Sauron's necromantic experiments in Dol Guldur from the appendices.
纳尔祖格是死灵法师军团的霸主，召唤亡灵大军，体现索隆在多古尔都进行的死灵术试验。
Narzuk serves as a messenger orc, carrying decrees swiftly like the runners in Sauron's armies. His speed ensures coordinated strikes across the mountains.
纳尔祖克是奥克信使，像索隆军中的传令兵一样迅速传达命令。他的速度确保山脉各处的突击能够协调发动。
Nashga of the Gashrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
纳什加是嘎什林氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。

Nauriel of the House of Halboronionath, sixty winters told and the institutional memory of her line, dwells in the upland halls of Lamedon above the cold rush of Ciril. In her middle years she rode with the hillmen against the brigands of the high passes, and she yet keeps the dented helm of that summer upon the mantel of her hall. She is among the firmest voices for the King returned, holding with Angbor and the stubborn lords of the dales that the long waiting has worn the realm thin, and that the oath must at the last be honoured.
哈尔博隆尼昂纳斯家族的瑙瑞尔已经六十岁，熟知家族的往事和规矩。她住在拉梅顿高地的厅堂中，下方是奇利尔河冰冷的急流。中年时，她曾与山民一起骑马讨伐高山隘口的强盗；那年夏天留下的凹陷头盔，如今仍摆在厅堂的壁炉台上。她坚定支持归来之王，与安格博和谷地那些执拗的领主立场一致，认为漫长等待已让王国日渐衰弱，终究必须履行誓言。
Navigated the Bay of Belfalas as a Corsair scout.
作为海盗斥候航行贝尔法拉斯湾。
Navigated the Corsair lanes from the crow's nest.
Nayantai serves as a captain in Gûrtilm's army.
纳延泰在古尔提姆军中担任队长。
Nazash of the Vrakmaw warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
纳扎什是弗拉克莫战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Nazgra is a venom-tongued archer of the wall, feared in the barracks more than on the field.
纳兹格拉是城墙上的弓箭手，说话恶毒。比起战场上的敌人，军营里的同伴反而更怕她。

Nazgul and Sauron drain the morale of enemy troops right beside them. The aura weakens them so they break sooner in the fighting, but it never routs anyone by itself. Takes effect immediately, but morale already drained is not restored when you switch it off.
那兹古尔和索隆会降低紧邻敌军的士气。光环会削弱他们，使其在战斗中更早溃逃，但本身不会直接使任何人溃逃。立即生效；关闭后，已经扣除的士气不会恢复。
Nazgûl, the Shadow of the Northmen
Naznur of the Throgmaw warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
纳兹努尔是斯罗格莫战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Nazza of the Morgrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
纳扎是莫格林氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Need a seal forged, a letter placed, an enemy's order turned against him? I am your man.
需要伪造一枚印章、安插一封信，或把敌人的命令反过来对付他？我就是你要的人。
Need something moved, found, or fetched unseen? That is my trade, and I am the best at it.
需要什么东西被悄悄运走、找到或取回来？这就是我的行当，而且我是最好的。
Needs concealing terrain - forest, hills, swamp, canyon, dunes, a bridge or a ford.
需要可供隐蔽的地形：森林、丘陵、沼泽、峡谷、沙丘、桥梁或浅滩。
Needs high ground or open vantage - mountains, hills, forest, steppe or plains.
需要高地或视野开阔的地形：山地、丘陵、森林、草原或平原。

Neida Zorian, a spiritual guide of Rhûn, inspires fanatical devotion to Sauron among her clan in the Third Age. Her rituals strengthen the warriors' resolve. Neida's faith unites the Easterlings in unholy purpose.
奈达·佐里安是鲁恩的精神导师。在第三纪元，她鼓动氏族成员狂热效忠索隆，用仪式坚定战士们的决心。她的信仰将东夷团结起来，追求邪恶的目标。
Nellas, a woodland guide, draws from the elf who aided Túrin, her tracking skills uncovering hidden paths and threats in the tangled woods.
妮尔拉丝是一名林地向导，原型来自曾帮助图林的那位精灵。她的追踪本领能在错综复杂的树林中发现隐秘道路与潜在威胁。
Nemos is a captain of the Tower Guard, sworn to protect the Steward.
内莫斯是塔卫队长，宣誓保护宰相。
Nergui of House Bozorganith is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
博佐加尼思家族的内尔贵是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
New breed seeking to prove superiority through action.
新一代品种，想用行动证明自己的优越。
达到{LEVEL}级可获得下一个点数
下一波敌军：生命值{HEALTH}%，伤害{DAMAGE}%
Nikath Adekig guards the southern passes into Rhun.
尼卡斯·阿德基格守卫通往鲁恩的南部山口。
Nikath, lord of House Adekig, holds the saddle-thrones of his Easterling kin east of the Sea of Rhûn and bends the tribes to the will of the Dark Tower.
尼卡斯是阿德基格家族的领主，统治着鲁恩内海以东的东夷骑马部族，迫使各部族服从邪黑塔的意志。

Nimethil, only daughter of Vorondir and Silmariel, was raised within sight of the beacon-fires and learned to ride ere she learned to weave. She is dark-haired and grey-eyed after the manner of her kindred, slender as a rowan and twice as proud. In the gathering quarrel she stands with her father for Denethor, though she has been heard to speak softly of the old prophecies of the king's return.
尼梅希尔是沃隆迪尔和西尔玛瑞尔唯一的女儿，在烽火台目光所及之处长大，还没学会编织就先学会骑马。她黑发灰眼，带有亲族风貌，身形如花楸般纤细，骄傲却加倍强烈。在逐渐聚拢的纷争中，她与父亲一起支持德内梭尔，虽然有人听见她轻声谈起国王归来的古老预言。
Nimlothiel orders the provisioning of the wardens upon the borders, and the talans of the Naith stand ready at her word.
宁洛希尔负责边境守卫的物资供应。她一声令下，耐斯的各处塔蓝便会备好物资。
Nimr was a Haradrim warlord who led the desert cavalry at the Battle of the Black Gate. He fell to Gondorian arrows but is revered as a martyr in the south.
尼姆尔是一位哈拉德人军阀，曾在黑门之战中率领沙漠骑兵。他死于刚铎人的箭下，在南方却被尊为殉道者。

Nimriel, Lady of the House of Caladionath, was born in Anfalas of the windward stock of Langstrand, daughter of a huntsman-lord whose hawks were prized in the courts of Dol Amroth. She came to Eldorion's hall in her twentieth year, bringing the sea-wisdom of the coast and a keen falconer's eye that has more than once warned the watch ere the beacons were lit. She is of the elder Númenórean cast, fair-skinned and tall, and walks the battlements at evening as her lord walks the muster-yards. With Eldorion she stands faithful to Denethor son of Ecthelion.
尼姆瑞尔夫人来自卡拉迪昂纳斯家族，出生在安法拉斯迎风的长滩一带，是一位猎人领主的女儿；她父亲的猎鹰在多阿姆洛斯宫廷中很受珍视。二十岁时，她来到埃尔多瑞昂的厅堂，带来海岸智慧和驯鹰者锐利的眼睛，曾不止一次在烽火点燃前提醒守望者。她有古老努门诺尔人的气质，肤色白皙，身形高挑；傍晚时她会在城垛上漫步，正如她的领主会在集结场上巡视。她与埃尔多瑞昂一样，忠于埃克塞理安之子德内梭尔。
Nimrien, a swift messenger, carries tidings across Mirkwood, her agility evoking the fleet-footed elves of old lore.
尼姆瑞恩是迅捷的信使，往来黑森林传递消息。她的敏捷让人想起古老传说中脚步飞快的精灵。
Nimrodel Blessing charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.
宁洛德尔的祝福充能消耗大幅降低，几乎随时可用。

宁洛德尔的祝福提供 +5% 抗性，溪水会治愈你的伤势。

宁洛德尔的祝福生效期间，会提供额外防御加成。
Nimrodel Blessing radius greatly expanded, devastating power.
宁洛德尔的祝福作用范围大幅扩大，庇护之力更加强大。
Nimrodel Blessing radius increased, empowering more warriors.
宁洛德尔的祝福作用范围扩大，可以庇护更多战士。
Nimrodel, named after the legendary elf-maid from lore, serves as a healer and scout in Nos Lasgalen, her knowledge of herbs and paths aiding in the protection of Mirkwood's ancient secrets.
宁洛德尔以传说中的精灵少女为名，在拉斯嘉兰一族中担任治疗者和斥候。她熟悉草药与林间小径，帮助守护黑森林古老的秘密。

Nine years I led the boat-raids from Blue Craig, taking coastal hamlets and the herring fleets, with the elven watch behind my back. My plans were slow and sure. My crews came back with their fingers.
九年里，我带船从蓝岩出发，抢海边小村和捕鲱鱼的船队，还得提防背后的精灵守卫。我的计划慢，却稳。船员们回来时，手指都还在。

有你守卫，敌人就休想穿过平原。+8%部队士气。
No factor trusts me now, and I trust none of them back. I carry my own pay and I count it twice.
现在没哪个商行管事信我，我也不信他们。我自己的工钱自己带着，每次都要数两遍。
No force on earth breaks the Dunlending warpack. +8% party movement speed.
世上没有任何力量能击垮黑蛮地战群。+8% 部队移动速度。
No guild will hire a man marked for that, so I ride for whoever pays, and I still stop at every farm on the way. I cannot seem to help it. My horse is all that is left of that life.
有了这笔记录，哪个行会都不肯再雇我，所以现在谁付钱，我就替谁跑，可沿途经过农庄，我还是每处都停。我就是改不了。过去那份日子，只给我留下了这匹马。
No hall will hire a man marked for that, so I ride for whoever pays, and I still stop at every farm on the way. I cannot seem to help it. My horse is all that is left of that life.
有了这笔记录，哪座厅堂都不肯再雇我，所以现在谁付钱，我就替谁跑，可沿途经过农庄，我还是每处都停。我就是改不了。过去那份日子，只给我留下了这匹马。

No lord of your realm can take it up.
你的国度中没有领主能担任此职。
No lust for binding, but kin chained me to a brute. Hated from first snarl. He mocked in horde; I cursed his weakness, he clawed, I drew fang, he his. I triumphed.
我不想被绑给谁，但族人把我拴给了一个蛮横东西。从他第一次冲我吼起，我就恨他。他在兽群面前嘲笑我，我咒骂他的软弱。他伸爪，我亮牙，他也亮牙。最后我赢了。
No man in the party is fit to work.
部队中没有适合干活的人。

No merchant wanted to go first with raiders on every shore. You sailed, settled the tolls and brought the vintners of Redwater and the buyers of the east to one table. The king's steward does not forget who filled the cellars.
各处海岸都有劫掠者，没有商人愿意第一个出航。你扬帆前去，谈妥通行费用，让红水酒商和东方买家坐到同一张桌前。国王的总管不会忘记，是谁装满了酒窖。
No more weakness. I seek a horde of true killers.
我不要再和软东西混在一起。我要找一支真正杀手组成的兽群。
No one can stand in two places. You did what duty asked.
人没法同时待在两个地方。你尽了自己的职责。

No one had been able to chart the extent of the spiders' underground passages without being caught in them. You went in small, moved carefully, and came out with a map that the Elvenking's scouts have used ever since. You declined to describe exactly how you got out.
此前没人能在不被蛛网困住的情况下弄清蜘蛛地下通道范围。你独自潜入，小心行动，带回的地图从此一直被精灵王斥候使用。你拒绝说明自己到底是怎么出来的。

没人能跑过斯那嘎骑手。+8% 部队移动速度。
No one outruns the clanguard. +8% party movement speed.
没人能跑过氏族卫骑。+8% 部队移动速度。
No one outside that post knows what I did, and that is somehow worse. I keep to the roads, shoot well, and do not look back toward the mountains.
哨所以外，没人知道我做了什么，可这反而更难受。我走大路，箭还是射得准，只是不再回头看群山。

No one should fear their strongest defender. I've proven my worth in single combat and mass battle. Somewhere there's a leader wise enough to value absolute loyalty backed by absolute skill. Until then, my blade is for hire to those who appreciate warriors, not servants.
没有人该害怕自己最强的守卫。我已经在单挑和大规模战斗中证明了价值。总有某个地方，会有足够明智的领袖懂得珍惜绝对技艺支撑下的绝对忠诚。在那之前，我的刀只租给欣赏战士、而不是只想要仆从的人。
No one trusts a truce that has been broken once.
停战的约定毁过一次，以后就再没人信了。
No reinforcements are for sale here.
这里没有可购买的增援。
没有剩余的重新抽取次数。
No secrets in my hunger for power.
我对权力的饥渴，没有什么好藏的。
没有地方出售这种商品。
在沙漠中不受减速惩罚（沙漠之子）
No sworn enemy at the start of a campaign
No town within reach will buy from us.
附近没有城镇愿意向我们买东西。
No trader trusts me now, and I trust none of them back. I carry my own pay and I count it twice.
现在没哪个商人信我，我也不信他们。我自己的工钱自己带着，每次都要数两遍。
No vintner will hire a man marked for that, so I ride for whoever pays, and I still stop at every farm on the way. I cannot seem to help it. My horse is all that is left of that life.
有了这笔记录，哪个酒商都不肯再雇我，所以现在谁付钱，我就替谁跑，可沿途经过农庄，我还是每处都停。我就是改不了。过去那份日子，只给我留下了这匹马。

No warband would take me. A marked one brings bad luck, they said, and every storm and cave-in was blamed on me. When a sapping tunnel fell in on its crew, the doom got the blame, never the rotten props I had warned them about.
没有战团肯要我，说带上我就要倒霉，暴风雨、塌方，全怪在我头上。有次攻城地道塌了，压住施工的人，他们怪我的厄运，却不怪那些早被我提醒过的烂支柱。
No wound stops the hunter. +7 health.
伤痛无法阻止猎手。+7 生命值。
No wound stops you for long. +9 health.
无论受了什么伤，你都能很快重返战场。+9 生命值。
No. I know whose war you fight, and I will not carry a blade for the Shadow, not for any price. Find another sword.
不。我知道你在替谁打仗，我不会为暗影卖命，再高的价钱也不行。另找个人吧。
No. Keep your commission; forget I spoke.
不。继续当你的军官，就当我没说过。
Noble blood means nothing when honor is lost...
当荣誉丧失，贵族血统便一文不值……
Nobody who heard that drum will go below again, and I was the one who barred the door. The forge-master wanted a smith who stays. I am not one who stays.
听过那鼓声的，谁也不肯再下去，何况锁门的还是我。锻坊主人想要一个肯留下的铁匠，我可不是。

还要打仗，现在不行。等战场平静了再来问我。

Now I carry my skills wherever I go, maintaining and improving the arms of those I travel with. A good blade in trained hands can change the course of a battle.
如今我把手艺带到任何地方，为同行者维护和改进武器。训练有素的人手里，一把好剑能改变一场战斗的走向。
Now I carry the whole mountain in my skull and no lair to put it in. I sell a way in, a way out, a way round, to whoever pays in iron. Never the same way twice.
现在整座山都装在我脑子里，却没有自己的窝。我卖进去的路、出来的路、绕过去的路，谁给铁器就卖给谁。同一条路绝不卖两次。

Now I go where the hurt are and ask few questions about which banner they bleed under. Hard times are coming for the steppe, and afterward there will be more wounded than healers to meet them. I would be one of the healers.
如今哪里有人受伤，我就去哪里，很少追问他们流血时举着哪面旗。草原将迎来艰难时日，之后伤员会比医者多得多。我想成为医者中的一个。
Now I hunt for myself along the river, with a price on me from both banks. A bowman with no captain eats badly but dies slowly.
现在我沿河自己打猎，两岸都有人悬赏我的脑袋。弓手没了队长，吃得差点，倒能多活几天。

Now I offer my counsel to younger captains with wisdom enough to want it. The tribes ride to the Dark Lord's war full of fire and short on memory, and someone must remember what oaths and feuds cost. Perhaps that someone can be of use to you.
如今我把建议献给那些足够聪明、愿意听取它的年轻队长。各部族带着烈火般的心气奔向黑暗魔君的战争，却缺少记忆。总得有人记得誓言和仇怨会带来什么代价。也许那个人能帮上你。
Now I practice my art wherever I can, helping the sick and wounded regardless of their allegiance. Death does not discriminate, and neither should healing.
如今我能在哪里行医，就在哪里行医，不论病人和伤者效忠于谁。死亡不会挑人，治疗也不该挑人。
Now I ride alone, my lance for hire to those who fight with honor. The open road suits me better than garrison duty ever did.
如今我独自骑行，把骑枪租给那些带着荣誉作战的人。比起守备驻地，开阔道路更适合我。
Now I ride alone, with a bow, a good eye, and a name the caravan masters speak quietly. Honest guards are rare, and the chiefs who pay them are rarer.
现在我独自骑行，带着一张弓、一双好眼睛，还有一个让商队首领只敢低声提起的名字。诚实的护卫少，肯给他们付钱的酋长更少。
Now I seek to rebuild, one deal at a time. The coming war will need supplies and logistics, and I know every trade route from Caras Galadhon to the far reaches.
如今我想一笔交易一笔交易地重建起来。即将到来的战争需要补给和后勤，而我知道从卡拉斯加拉松到远方边地的每一条商路。
Now I seek to rebuild, one deal at a time. The coming war will need supplies and logistics, and I know every trade route from the Dunland highlands to the far reaches.
如今我想一笔交易一笔交易地重建起来。即将到来的战争需要补给和后勤，而我知道从黑蛮地高地到远方边地的每一条商路。

Now I sell it to whoever pays, and there is no shortage of buyers with a war brewing. Give me a fortress to study and I will tell you how it falls. The Dark Lord's muster has every petty lord watching his neighbor, and a watcher is never out of work.
如今我把情报卖给付钱的人，而战争将起，买家从不缺。给我一座堡垒研究，我就能告诉你它会怎么陷落。黑暗魔君的征召让每个小领主都盯着自己的邻居，而一个盯梢的人永远不缺活干。
Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the Horse-lords of Rohan grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them.
如今我把刀租给值得效力的事业。洛汗驭马者一天比一天大胆，只要有人有勇气面对他们，就不会缺少战斗。
Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the Shadow in the East grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them.
如今我把剑租给值得效力的事业。东方的阴影一天比一天大胆，只要有人有勇气面对它，就不会缺少战斗。
Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the elves and men of the West grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them.

Now I tend whoever needs tending and keep a civil tongue. The Châjaphân musters the Houses for the Dark Lord, and war breeds fever and rot as surely as wounds. An army that survives its sicknesses outlasts one that does not. I would see yours outlast its enemies.
如今谁需要照料，我就照料谁，也尽量说话客气。查贾凡正为黑暗魔君召集各家族，而战争滋生热病和腐烂，就像它制造伤口一样必然。一支能熬过疾病的军队，会比熬不过的军队活得更久。我想让你的军队比敌人撑得更久。
Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the Horse-lords of Rohan has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them.
如今我除了自己谁也不信，不过比起永远躲在阴影里，我更愿意公开使用自己的本事。洛汗驭马者到处都有密探，总得有人反制他们。

Now I wander without title or home, using skills meant for governing estates to survive as a sellsword. The corruption in Minas Tirith runs deeper than the Enemy's shadow - at least orcs are honest about their nature.
现在我既无头衔也无家可归，只能用原本用来管理庄园的技能作为雇佣兵谋生。米那斯提力斯的腐败比敌人的阴影还要深——至少奥克对自己的本性很诚实。
Now I wander, offering my knowledge to those who value skill over politics. The Shadow grows, and the Corsairs of Umbar need fortifications more than ever.
如今我四处流浪，把知识献给那些重视本领胜过权谋的人。阴影正在增长，乌姆巴尔的海盗比以往任何时候都更需要坚固的防御。

Now I'm branded a traitor by some, though Captain Faramir himself said nothing when I left. I range alone, protecting those who cannot protect themselves, whether they're of Gondor or not.
如今我被一些人斥为叛徒，尽管法拉米尔队长在我离开时并未置一词。我独自游荡，保护那些无力自卫之人，无论他们是否来自刚铎。
Now and then a master armourer visits a town for a week, raising its armoury one level. Needs Armour Acquisition on.
铸甲大师偶尔会到城镇停留一周，让军械库暂时提高一级。需要开启“铠甲获取”。

Now my lance answers to coin, and to whoever rides against true enemies. The Taskral musters the tribes for the Dark Lord's war, and there will be plunder enough for any who can take it. I mean to be among them, on my own terms this time.
如今我的骑枪听命于金币，也听命于那些真正向敌人冲锋的人。塔斯克拉尔正在为黑暗魔君的战争召集各部族，到时候谁有本事，谁就能拿到足够多的战利品。我也要在其中占一份，只是这一次要按我自己的规矩来。

Now my pathfinding is for any captain who needs to go where his enemy does not expect him. War is won by the army that arrives first and unlooked-for, and I can put yours there. The Dark Lord's hosts will march through country that swallows the unprepared. I would see you among the prepared.
如今我的探路本事属于任何需要从敌人意想不到之处前进的队长。战争往往由先到且出其不意的军队赢下，而我能把你的军队送到那里。黑暗魔君的大军会穿过能吞掉无准备者的土地。我希望你属于有准备的人。

Now those routes and that knowing are for hire. With the Dark Lord's war coming, armies will need what I can move and the paths I can find. I do not pretend to fight for anyone but myself, and I have found honesty about that serves me better than oaths.
如今这些路线和门道都可以雇用。黑暗魔君的战争将至，军队会需要我能运的东西，也会需要我能找到的路。我不假装自己为任何人而战，除了我自己；我发现，在这一点上诚实比誓言更有用。
Number of in-game days to travel to a besieged settlement before the event expires.
事件失效前，可以用来赶往被围聚落的游戏天数。
Numberless bow-armed rabble of the high crags.
高崖上数不清的持弓乌合之众。
Numberless bow-armed rabble of the tunnels.
隧道中数不清的持弓乌合之众。
努门诺尔剑配重球 A
努门诺尔剑配重球 B
努门诺尔剑配重球 C
努门诺尔剑配重球 D
许多军阀随时准备行军
Nuqar commands the elite Serpent Guard of Harad.
努卡尔统领哈拉德的精锐巨蛇卫队。
Nurzga of the Uzgnâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
努尔兹加是乌兹格纳什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Nywin is wife to Ergeon, skilled in the arts of healing.
妮温是埃尔吉昂的妻子，精通医术。
Nûlubêth is a Black Numenorean sorceress in service to the Dark Tower. Her name means Night-Word in the old Adunaic speech, and she chose it herself.
努露贝丝是一名为邪黑塔效力的黑努门诺尔女巫。她的名字在古老的阿督耐克语中意为“夜语”，是她自己取的。
Nûrnhai is a slave farm in a sheltered hollow behind the Morannon. Its grain feeds the garrison of the Black Gate.
努尔恩海是位于魔栏农后方一处避风洼地的奴隶农场。这里出产的粮食供给黑门驻军。
Of course. I'll make sure to receive your messenger when they arrive.
当然。你的信使到了之后，我会接见他们。
Of the Wold? The horse-lords' grasslands?
北高原？就是驭马者的草原？

Off by default. Adds per-type attribution to the hitch probe's lines: times every mission behaviour's tick, every behaviour's spawn callback and every scene script component by type, and lists the slowest. Installed once at game start: turning it on takes effect after a restart; turning it off stops it from the next mission.
默认关闭。为卡顿探针添加按类型归因：测量各任务行为的更新、单位生成回调和场景脚本组件耗时，并列出最慢项。游戏启动时只安装一次；开启后需重启，关闭后从下次任务停止。

Off by default. Times the campaign map's frame: the campaign tick, every per-frame tick-event listener by its owner, the map screen and TAOM's map views, and TAOM's application tick. Writes a [MapProfile] line to the TAOM debug log every 5 seconds while the map runs and a [MapProfileSummary] line when the campaign ends. Turning it on takes effect after a restart (the profiler is installed once, at game start); turning it off stops measuring from the next campaign session.
默认关闭。测量战役地图每帧的战役更新、按所有者分类的逐帧事件监听器、地图界面、TAOM 地图视图及应用更新。地图运行时每5秒写一条 [MapProfile]，战役结束时写 [MapProfileSummary]。开启后需重启，因为分析器只在启动时安装一次；关闭后从下次战役会话停止测量。
Off: the Atlas look, a watercolour wash inside each border with a dash-dot ink line. On: two solid bands in each realm's colour with a gap on the line.
关闭：地图册风格，在国境内铺一层水彩色，边界是点划墨线。开启：使用两条国家颜色的实线色带，边界线上留出空隙。
Offer Leave When The Column Halts
部队停驻时询问是否休假
每场战斗的晋升建议上限

Offers the lore-locked dark lords as playable, here and on the Themed Faction & Hero Picker. On by default. The catch: TAOM's capture immunity defers to vanilla for the player character, so a player-controlled Sauron or Witch-king CAN be captured and ransomed like any other lord. Turn this off to keep that lore promise: this list then hides them, and a pick of one on the Themed Faction & Hero Picker only copies his look onto a new character. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
允许在此处和主题势力与英雄选择界面中，扮演通常受背景设定限制的黑暗领主。默认开启。但需注意：TAOM的免俘机制对玩家角色会遵循原版规则，因此玩家控制的索隆或巫王也能像其他领主一样被俘和赎回。若希望保留设定中的免俘特性，请关闭此项；本列表会隐藏他们，而在主题势力与英雄选择界面选中他们时，只会把其外貌复制给新角色。2026年11月以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。
Oh, another traveler. How rare, on a road the Havens have all but forgotten...
哦，又一位旅人。在这条几乎被灰港遗忘的路上，可真难得……
Oh, you want a story? I have one. It ends badly. Mine all do.
哦，你想听故事？我有一个。结局很惨，我的故事都这样。
Old wounds teach hard lessons. +5 health.
旧伤留下了惨痛的教训。+5 生命值。
Omens are for old men and fools.
凶兆是老头和傻子才信的东西。

On = your clan keeps every bonus but is never damped for the fiefs it already holds or for a culture mismatch. Off = your clan is scored like any other. Replaces the old Apply Penalties To Your Clan switch, which shipped with the exemption on and let a landed player out-score every AI clan for fiefs they never fought for; the switch was renamed so existing installs pick up the new default. The Absent From Siege Factor applies either way. Default: off.
开启：你的家族保留全部加成，但不因已有领地或文化不符而被扣分。关闭：与其他家族同样评分。替换旧的“对玩家家族应用惩罚”开关；旧默认值开启豁免，让已有领地的玩家即使没有参战，也能压过所有 AI 家族。重命名让现有安装采用新默认值。“未参加攻城的功绩系数”始终适用。默认：关闭。

On an Advance, a company of yours whose soldiers mostly carry javelins or other throwing weapons stops short of the enemy and throws, then goes in to melee when most have thrown, when the enemy comes close or after 40 seconds standing. A company holding the line, holding its fire, on a fire mode or in a shield wall, circle, square or column advances as before. Default: on.
你下达推进命令时，以标枪等投掷武器为主的编队会在接近敌人前停下投掷。大多数士兵已投掷、敌人靠近，或原地等待40秒后，再转入近战。维持阵线、停止射击、处于射击模式，或组成盾墙、圆阵、方阵、纵队的编队，仍按原有方式推进。默认：开启。

On by default. Times the parts of every mission frame TAOM can see (the wait for the agent tick, the mission tick, the camera and render preparation, scene scripts, agent spawns) and checks whether an animation clip is loading from disk, so each frame slower than the hitch threshold writes a hitch line and a detail line saying where the time went. Its measured cost is written to the TAOM debug log. Installed once at game start: turning it on takes effect after a restart; turning it off stops measuring from the next mission while 'Enable Tick Profiler' is off (the profiler measures through the probe's patches).
默认开启。统计TAOM可以观察到的每个任务帧阶段耗时，包括等待单位更新、任务更新、摄像机与渲染准备、场景脚本和单位生成，并检查是否正在从磁盘载入动画片段。某帧超过卡顿阈值时，会写入卡顿记录和耗时明细；检测自身的实测开销也会记入TAOM调试日志。补丁仅在游戏启动时安装一次，因此开启后需要重启；关闭后，只要“启用更新耗时分析器”也关闭，就会从下个任务停止测量，因为分析器会借用此探测补丁进行测量。
On first capture, calls ButterLib.ExceptionHandlerSubSystem.Disable() so TAOM's report wins. Default ON.
首次捕获异常时，调用 ButterLib.ExceptionHandlerSubSystem.Disable()，让TAOM的报告优先生效。默认开启。
On foot only, with no cavalry

On my first raid we burned a village that had given us no fight: old men, children, all of it, for serving the wrong lord. I had thought we rode to make Shaghâna strong. When I saw what we truly did, I slipped away in the smoke and have not stopped moving since.
第一次突袭时，我们烧掉了一个没有反抗的村子：老人、孩子，所有人，只因为他们侍奉了错误的领主。我原以为我们骑马是为了让沙加纳强大。等我看清我们真正做的事，我趁烟雾溜走，从那以后再也没停下脚步。

On patrol near the Gap of Rohan, we found burnt villages - not raided by orcs, but destroyed by men. The tracks led toward Isengard. When we reported this, we were told we were mistaken, that Dunlendings were to blame.
在洛汗隘口附近巡逻时，我们发现了被烧毁的村庄。那不是奥克劫掠，而是人干的。踪迹通向艾森加德。我们上报后，却被告知是我们看错了，黑蛮地人该为此负责。

On patrol near the Southwood eaves, we found burnt villages, not raided by Wainriders, but destroyed by men on foot. The tracks led toward Dol Guldur. When we reported this, we were told we were mistaken, that Wainrider raiders were to blame.
在南林边缘巡逻时，我们发现了被烧的村庄。毁掉它们的不是战车民，而是徒步来的人，脚印一路通向多古尔都。可我们报上去，他们却说是我们看错了，凶手就是战车民劫掠者。
再想想，我现在还不想入伍。

On the Members tab of the clan screen, gives the row of a companion of your clan a faint red tint when their relation with you has fallen below zero, a warning before they leave. The age beside each child's name is always shown. Applies the next time the clan screen opens. Default: on.
在家族界面的成员页中，如果家族同伴与你的关系降至0以下，就给其所在行加上淡红色，提醒你对方可能离开。每名儿童姓名旁的年龄始终显示。下次打开家族界面时生效。默认：开启。

On the character screen, marks the level past which the selected skill learns at its slowest: a red arrow and a red band to the end of the bar; hover the band for the details. Also adds a line to the learning limit tooltip. Applies the next time the character screen opens. Default: on.
在角色界面上，用红色箭头和一直延伸到进度条末端的红色条带，标出当前技能进入最低学习速度时的等级；鼠标悬停在条带上可查看详情。学习上限提示中也会增加一行说明。下次打开角色界面时生效。默认：开启。
On the first main menu after the game starts, offer to lower Number of Ragdolls to 5 and Number of Corpses to Low when yours are higher. Nothing changes unless you click Apply.
游戏启动后首次进入主菜单时，如果你的设置更高，会建议把布娃娃数量降至5、尸体数量降至“低”。只有点击“应用”才会修改。

On the party screen, a captive lord's row shows the clan's banner at the top left of the portrait, the kingdom's banner at the top right (when the clan belongs to a kingdom), and a gold noble icon at the bottom left when the lord leads the clan. Applies the next time the party screen opens. Default: on.
在部队界面中，被俘领主的头像左上角显示家族旗帜；家族属于某个国家时，右上角还会显示国家旗帜；领主是家族领袖时，左下角显示金色贵族图标。下次打开部队界面时生效。默认：开启。

On the town management window: the fief's name as the title, a Profit row with a daily breakdown, a Patrol row for towns, and tooltips on the stash and prison icons. When off, the title, rows and icons are vanilla; the step buttons have their own switch. Applies the next time the window opens. Default: on.
在城镇管理窗口中，把标题改为封地名称，增加带有每日明细的利润栏，为城镇增加巡逻栏，并为储藏箱和监狱图标添加提示。关闭后，标题、各栏和图标恢复原版；储备金增减按钮有独立开关。下次打开窗口时生效。默认：开启。
On the wide grasslands of Rhûn you make out the wagons and hide-tents of an Easterling raiding band camped in a gully.
在鲁恩辽阔草原上，你看见一支东夷劫掠队的马车和兽皮帐篷，他们正扎营在一道沟谷里。
On {DAY_OF_YEAR}, {YEAR}, {KING_NAME} was hailed as {?IS_KING_MALE}Brenin{?}Brenhines{\?} of Dunland.
{YEAR}年{DAY_OF_YEAR}，{KING_NAME}被拥戴为黑蛮地的{?IS_KING_MALE}国王{?}女王{\?}。
On: borders always show, drawn over hills and map figures. Off: borders lie on the ground and hide behind ridges.
开启：国境线始终显示在山丘和地图人物之上。关闭：国境线贴地绘制，会被山脊遮挡。
Once a forger. Killed in rage, couldn't pay tribute, fled. Common in Gundabad's pits. Accept destiny of gore.
曾经是锻工，怒火中杀了人，付不起赔偿后逃走。贡达巴德坑里常有这种事，只能接受流血的命运。

Once the battle has begun, a Square order on a company of yours that you command forms the plain square of the base game, which keeps the side you give it and grows only when its soldiers no longer fit, instead of the packed schiltron. A company of foot and ranged soldiers mixed keeps its mixed layout and ignores the side. Default: on.
战斗开始后，对你能指挥的编队下达方阵命令时，会组成原版的普通方阵，而不是密集矛阵。方阵保留你指定的边长，只有士兵容纳不下时才会扩大。步兵与远程士兵混编时，仍保留混合布局，忽略指定边长。默认：开启。

Once the battle has begun, a click or a drag on the ground moves several selected companies as one body: they keep their places relative to each other, and a drag turns and stretches the whole group. Hold the keep-the-widths key (default Left Alt) to turn the group without stretching it. Off, the companies line up side by side as in the base game. Default: on.
战斗开始后，同时选中多个编队，在地面点击或拖动时，会将其作为一个整体移动，保留彼此的相对位置；拖动会同时旋转、拉伸整个编队群。按住“保持宽度”键，默认左Alt，可以只旋转而不拉伸。关闭后，各编队像原版一样并排列开。默认：开启。
Once the hunter is within one and a half times your seeing range, it moves at least this many times your speed. Default 1.3.
追猎者进入你视野范围的1.5倍距离以内时，其移动速度至少为你的此倍率。默认：1.3。
One Iron and one Hardwood make one Tools. It costs {COST} smithy stamina and earns Smithing experience.
一份铁和一份硬木可制成一份工具，消耗{COST}点锻造耐力，并获得锻造经验。
One arrow, one kill -- every time. +12% ranged damage.
一箭一命，从不落空。+12% 远程伤害。

One autumn the grain wagon I was guarding came upon Hazelglade, burned out by orcs out of the shadow of Dol Guldur. I gave the families half the load without asking leave. The reeve called it theft and wrote my name in his ledger.
一个秋天，我护送的粮车经过榛林空地，那里刚被多古尔都阴影里出来的奥克烧光。我没请示，就把半车粮给了那些人家。管事说这是偷窃，把我的名字记进了账本。

One autumn the grain wagon I was guarding came upon a village burned out by orcs down from the High Pass. I gave the families half the load without asking leave. The steward called it theft and wrote my name in his tally.
一个秋天，我护送的粮车经过一座村子，那里刚被高隘口下来的奥克烧光。我没请示，就把半车粮给了那些人家。总管说这是偷窃，把我的名字记进了账本。

One autumn the grain wagon I was guarding came upon a village burned out by raiders from Rhun. I gave the families half the load without asking leave. The guild factor called it theft and wrote my name in his ledger.
一个秋天，我护送的粮车经过一座村子，那里刚被鲁恩来的劫掠者烧光。我没请示，就把半车粮给了那些人家。行会管事说这是偷窃，把我的名字记进了账本。

One autumn the grain wagon I was guarding came upon a village burned out by raiders from Rhûn. I gave the families half the load without asking leave. The wine factor called it theft and wrote my name in his ledger.
一个秋天，我护送的粮车经过一座村子，那里刚被鲁恩来的劫掠者烧光。我没请示，就把半车粮给了那些人家。酒商管事说这是偷窃，把我的名字记进了账本。

One grey morning in the sea-fog a small boat came in under my cliff. I loosed. The shaft took a man in the chest, and he was only a fisherman, not an elf, with nets in the boat. The captain of the wall said I had shamed the walls with a fishmonger's blood.
一个灰蒙蒙的早晨，海雾里有条小船靠到崖下。我放了一箭，射中船上那人的胸口。可他只是个渔夫，不是精灵，船里全是网。城墙的队长说，我让卖鱼人的血玷污了城墙。

One hard winter a border village begged me for horses to haul out their sick. I named a price I knew they could not pay and was within my rights. Some of them died on the road, and the rest remember my name.
一个严冬，边境村庄求我借马，把病人运出去。我开了个明知他们付不起的价钱，按规矩，我有权这么做。有些人死在路上，活下来的都记住了我的名字。
One line in the message log when five or more soldiers on either side fire the same ability within two seconds. Never one line per soldier.
任一方在两秒内有至少5名士兵触发同一种能力时，消息记录中显示一条提示。不会给每名士兵单独刷屏。
One must test what one creates. My arrows fly true because I understand the bow's soul - I gave it form. If you seek one who arms heroes and stands among them, I am ready.
创造之物必须亲自检验。我的箭能射得准，是因为我理解弓的灵魂，是我赋予它形体。若你需要一个既能武装英雄，也能与英雄并肩的人，我已经准备好了。

One night they took a wagon of ore and two carters on the Dwarf-road. I led my company after them into the Craig, through tunnels no dwarf had mapped, against the warden's order. We brought the carters back. We left four of our own in those tunnels, and the warden broke my rank at the gate.
一天夜里，它们在矮人路抢走一车矿石和两个车夫。我违背守将的命令，带队追进蓝岩，钻过了矮人从没绘过图的地道。车夫救回来了，我们却把四个自己人留在了地道里。守将在城门前撤了我的军衔。

One night, a lord's son committed murder in the Citadel - killed a rival over a woman. The Steward ordered us to blame it on a Southron spy. I refused to bear false witness, though my captain commanded it.
一天晚上，一位领主的儿子在城堡里因为一个女人杀死了他的对手。总管命令我们把这件事归咎于一个南方的间谍。尽管我的队长命令我这么做，但我拒绝作伪证。

One of the three kingdoms into which Arnor was sundered. Arvedui's line holds Fornost upon the North Downs and its Rangers keep the roads of Eriador, but Dunland and the orcs of Gundabad press on every border of a realm with too few swords.
阿尔诺分裂后的三个王国之一。阿维杜伊的后人统治着北岗上的佛诺斯特，游民守护着埃利阿多的道路。然而这个王国兵力不足，黑蛮地人和贡达巴德的奥克正从各处边境不断进逼。
One season the chief who hired me sold our route to the very raiders we guarded against. I warned the caravan masters and shot two of his men for it, and he had me dismissed before the rains came.
有一年，雇我的酋长把我们的路线，卖给了我们一直提防的那伙劫掠者。我向商队首领报了信，为这事还射杀了他两个人。雨季没来，他就把我赶走了。

One shipment 'lost' to bandits, bandits I'd paid to play the part. Would've worked, but a survivor talked. My clan disowned me before the king could judge me. I fled rather than face the shame of a public trial. My name is struck from the records.
有一批货“丢”给了强盗，而那些强盗是我付钱请来演戏的。计划本该成功，但有个幸存者开了口。国王还没审判我，我的氏族就先和我断绝了关系。我不想面对公开审判的羞辱，于是逃了。我的名字从记录里被划掉了。

One spring a goblin chieftain asked to parley at the foot of the Craig, to buy back his captured sons. I went with the warden's envoy, and when the chieftain came down to meet us I put a bolt through his throat. The warden called it murder under a flag of truce and took my company from me.
有年春天，一个半兽人酋长请求在蓝岩脚下谈判，要赎回被俘的儿子。我跟着守将的使者去，酋长下来见我们时，我一弩射穿了他的喉咙。守将说这是在停战旗帜下谋杀，收走了我的队伍。

One spring the beacon-keepers sent word of an Easterling muster in the east, and I rode to the council with it. The lord called beacon-smoke gossip and kept me waiting three weeks. By the time he believed it, the villages on the eastern slopes had burned.
有年春天，守烽火台的人传来消息，说东边的东夷正在集结。我骑马赶去禀报议事会。领主说烽烟传的不过是闲话，让我等了三个星期。等他肯信，东边山坡的村庄已经烧光了。

One spring the ravens brought news of an Easterling muster in the east, and I rode to the council with it. The lord called ravens gossip and kept me waiting three weeks. By the time he believed it, the villages on the eastern fells had burned.
有年春天，渡鸦捎来消息，说东边的东夷正在集结。我骑马赶去禀报议事会。领主说渡鸦不过是嚼舌头，让我等了三个星期。等他肯信，东部山地的村庄已经烧光了。

One spring the watch-smoke rose from Emyn Duir with news of an orc muster to the south, and I rode to the council with it. The lord called smoke-talk gossip and kept me waiting three weeks. By the time he believed it, the villages on the eaves had burned.
有年春天，埃敏杜伊尔升起烽烟，报来南方奥克集结的消息。我骑马赶去禀报议事会。领主说烟讯不过是闲话，让我等了三个星期。等他肯信，林缘的村庄已经烧光了。

One spring the watchmen saw a goblin muster gathering in the mountains, and I rode to the council with it. The elder called watch-tales gossip and kept me waiting three weeks. By the time he believed it, the villages under the pass had burned.
有年春天，哨兵发现山里的半兽人正在集结，我骑马赶去禀报议事会。长老说哨兵讲的不过是闲话，让我等了三个星期。等他肯信，隘口下的村庄已经烧光了。
One steading had a Beorning guest. He took the wolf by the throat and I watched it die under his hands. The raid broke, the loot went to the chieftain, and I came home with nothing but a torn cloak.
有个农庄住着一位贝奥恩客人。他掐住狼的喉咙，我就眼看着它死在他手里。这次劫掠败了，战利品归了酋长，我回家时只剩一件破披风。
One sword and no pay cannot feed forty.
一把剑，不领饷，养不活四十口人。
One sword and no wage will not feed forty mouths.
一把剑，不领饷，你养不活四十口人。

One tide the herd crossed the sands of the Lune estuary with me at the front. The sea came in faster than I had reckoned, and I would not drop my saddlebags. Thirty-eight ponies drowned. I kept the bags, and my sire kept the belt.
有一回，我带头赶着马群穿过路恩河口的沙滩。涨潮比我算得快，可我舍不得扔鞍袋。三十八匹小马淹死了。袋子我保住了，我爹的皮带也没闲着。
One town and a handful of hill-holds
只有一座城镇和少数山地堡垒
One try, and your Charm decides it. If you win, the price falls by a quarter.
只有一次机会，成败取决于你的魅力。成功后，价格降低四分之一。
One who eliminates obstacles, sometimes permanently.
一个会清除障碍的人，有时是永久清除。
One who embraces what he is without pretense.
一个毫不掩饰自己本性的人。
One who kills with patience and precision.
一个用耐心和精准杀人的人。
One who leads through proven courage.
一个用实打实的勇气带队的人。
One who sees coin where others see corpses.
一个在尸体堆里看见钱的人。
One who steals and sells secrets to the highest bidder.
一个偷走秘密，再卖给最高出价者的人。
One who thinks and fights, rare combination.
会思考，也会战斗，罕见的组合。
One who understands only total destruction.
一个只理解彻底毁灭的人。
One who understands that wars are won with logistics.
一个明白战争靠后勤取胜的人。
One who understands the language of fear.
一个懂得恐惧之语的人。
One who weaponizes both rage and cunning.
一个把怒火和狡诈都变成武器的人。
Only 150 troops in the field, and only six kinds.
战场上限仅150名士兵，且只有六种兵种。
Only a field camp can be fortified.
只有野战营地才能升级为设防营地。
Only a field or fortified camp can be raised into a refuge.
只有野战营地或设防营地才能扩建为避难所。
Only a field or fortified camp can forage.
只有野战营地或设防营地才能搜集补给。
Only a forest has timber worth felling.
只有森林里才有值得砍伐的木材。
Only a master armourer, at a level {LORD} armoury, can fit your {PIECE}.
只有{LORD}级军械库的铸甲大师，才能为你打造{PIECE}。
Only a patrol of the Steward's guard, traveller, resting on the way. Nothing here to concern you.
我们只是宰相卫队的巡逻兵，过路的，在路上歇一歇。没什么需要你操心的。
Only foresters, traveller, out gathering firewood. Nothing to fear from us.
我们只是林中居民，过路的，出来捡些柴火。没什么好怕的。
Only in a settlement or a ready field camp.
只能在定居点或已经备好的野外营地进行。
Only militia are always at hand.
Only miners and smiths, traveller, heading home with our tools. We want no trouble.
我们只是矿工和铁匠，过路的，带着工具回家，不想惹麻烦。
Only nomads of the southern sands, traveller. We mean no harm to anyone.
我们只是南方沙漠里的游牧人，过路的，不想伤害任何人。
Only the first wars of the age may be declared now.
现阶段只能发动这个时代最初的几场战争。
Only the general of this battle can assign heroes.
只有本场战斗的指挥官可以分配英雄。
Only the general of this battle can use presets.
只有本场战斗的指挥官才能使用预设。
Only the heir of its old kings can take up this throne.
只有历代国王的继承人才能登上这个王位。
Only the host can seal an oath in a shared campaign.
合作战役中，只有主机玩家能订立效忠誓约。
Only the host's quartermaster can issue kit in this campaign.
只有主机端的军需官能在本战役中发放装备。
Only the realm that holds this village may rebuild it.
只有控制这个村庄的国家才能重建它。
Only the ruler of the realm can rename its fiefs.
只有国家统治者才能为本国封地改名。
Opacity of a neutral settlement's plate. Vanilla uses 35, which can be faint over dark terrain. Tracked settlements keep vanilla's 80. Applies immediately. Default 35.
中立定居点名称牌的不透明度。原版35，在深色地形上可能不明显；已标记定居点保持原版80。立即生效。默认：35。

Opacity of a plate owned by your own faction, an enemy or an allied kingdom. Vanilla uses 50 for your own faction and 35 for the others. Tracked settlements keep vanilla's 80. Applies immediately. Default 50.
自己势力、敌人和盟国名称牌的不透明度。原版自己势力50，其他35；已标记定居点保持原版80。立即生效。默认：50。
Open plains with Dunland across the Greyflood
平原开阔，灰水河对岸便是黑蛮地
Opens the Clan screen faster by building its parties list once instead of three times. Turning it off restores vanilla's build for this screen. Read on every open. Default ON.
家族界面只构建一次部队列表，不再重复构建三次，以缩短打开时间。关闭后恢复该界面的原版构建方式。每次打开时读取设置。默认：开启。
Opens the Inventory and trade screen faster by skipping work the screen repeats. Turning it off restores vanilla's build for this screen. Read on every open. Default ON.
跳过物品栏与交易界面中的重复工作，以缩短打开时间。关闭后恢复该界面的原版构建方式。每次打开时读取设置。默认：开启。
Opens the Party screen faster by caching lookups the screen repeats for each troop. Turning it off restores vanilla's build for this screen. Read on every open. Default ON.
缓存部队界面对每种士兵重复执行的查询，以缩短打开时间。关闭后恢复该界面的原版构建方式。每次打开时读取设置。默认：开启。
Opens the Quest log faster by building finished quests only when you select them. Turning it off restores vanilla's build for this screen. Read on every open. Default ON.
只有选中已完成任务时，才构建该任务的详情，以缩短任务日志的打开时间。关闭后恢复该界面的原版构建方式。每次打开时读取设置。默认：开启。
Oragur leads the Arkit horse archers.
奥拉古尔率领阿尔基特骑射手。

Orc and goblin warriors in a battle line no longer walk in lockstep: each soldier's step size is scaled by a random factor between the minimum below and 1.0, fixed for that soldier. Applied when a soldier spawns, so it takes effect in the next battle.
战列中的奥克和半兽人士兵不再迈着完全一致的步子：每名士兵的步幅会乘以随机系数，范围为下方设置的最小值至1.0，且对这名士兵保持不变。生成士兵时应用，因此从下一场战斗开始生效。
Orcs and wolves of the Misty Mountains at the door
迷雾山脉的奥克与狼就在家门口
Orcs are very weak. Uruks and Numenoreans cost a lot.
奥克十分弱小，乌鲁克和努门诺尔人的费用很高。

Orcs came down at harvest and drove off our herd and half our village. I rode to Beorn's Hall for help, but the council would not hear me before morning, so I gathered the farmhands and went after them myself.
收获时节，奥克下来抢走了马群，也掳走了半个村子的人。我骑马去贝奥恩大厅求援，可议事会非要等到天亮才肯听我说。我便召集农工，自己追了上去。
Orcs settle scores with blades. No witnesses? Fight. Weak? Hire a slayer. I thrive on blood, offer my fangs for iron.
奥克用刀子了结恩怨。没有见证人？那就打。太弱？那就雇个杀手。我靠鲜血活着，把我的獠牙租出去换铁。
Orda of House Zorian rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
佐里安家族的斡儿答率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。

Order resupply convoys from a town, castle or friendly lord: goods from real market stock, troops from volunteers, delivered to you on the map. When off, the order option disappears and no new orders can be placed; convoys already on the road still arrive.
从城镇、城堡或友方领主处订购补给，由运输队在地图上送到你的部队。货物来自真实市场库存，士兵来自可招募的志愿兵。关闭后，订购选项消失，也不能下新订单，但已经在路上的运输队仍会抵达。

Orders came to abandon the eastern shore entirely, ceding half the city without a fight. I protested - we could hold with reinforcement. But the Steward's advisors deemed it 'strategically unnecessary.' We retreated, and orcs now mass where we once stood guard.
可是某一天，上面下令彻底弃守东部，也就是让我们不战而逃地丢掉半座城。我抗议过——只要增援到位，我们本有机会守住的。可宰相的顾问们却觉得这是“战略上的无用举措”。我们撤退了，曾要誓死坚守的地方如今布满了奥克。
Origins lost. Wandered with cursed whelps, scavenging. Stole fang from sleeping filth, now remade.
出身已不可考。曾和一群被称作受诅咒的幼崽一起流浪、搜刮。从沉睡的脏东西那里偷来第一把刀，如今重塑了自己。

Orlathiel, daughter of Eldorion and Nimriel, is two-and-twenty, and counted among the fairest of the ladies of the upper hall, grey-eyed and dark-haired in the manner of her father's line. She was schooled in the histories of the House of Húrin and in the songs of the Stewards, and rides with her husband's archers upon the long patrols toward the eastern fences. The folk of the hall name her the Lady of the Morning Watch. In the present sundering she follows her father's faith, and the Steward's banner.
奥拉希尔是埃尔多瑞昂和尼姆瑞尔的女儿，二十二岁，灰眼黑发，继承父系风貌，被认为是上厅最美的夫人之一。她受教于胡林家族的历史和宰相之歌，并与丈夫的弓手一起巡逻通往东部栅线的漫长道路。厅堂百姓称她为晨望夫人。在如今的分裂中，她追随父亲的信念，也追随宰相旗帜。

Orlendir came from the Morthond Vale, of an archer-house that has kept the Stone of Erech in its long sight since the breaking of the oath of old. He is two-and-twenty years of age, dark of hair and quiet of bearing, reckoned the keenest bowman to ride beneath the banner of Caladionath. His marriage to Orlathiel bound the watchful Blackroot to the northern bulwark of Eldorion's hall. He holds, as his good-father holds, with the Steward of Gondor.
奥伦迪尔来自墨松德山谷的一支弓手家族；自古老誓言破裂以来，他们一直把埃瑞赫巨石纳入远望。他二十二岁，黑发，举止沉静，被认为是卡拉迪昂纳斯旗帜下最敏锐的弓手。他与奥拉希尔的婚姻把警觉的黑源河山谷和埃尔多瑞昂厅堂的北方屏障连在一起。他与岳父一样，支持刚铎宰相。
Oromar, husband of Anariel, joined the house of Halboronionath through their union. He serves the Lord of Pinnath Gelin faithfully.
奥洛玛尔是阿纳瑞尔的丈夫，通过婚姻加入哈尔博隆尼昂纳斯家族。他忠诚侍奉品那斯盖林领主。

Orondir, Lord of Baranionath, came to the headship of his house at nineteen, when his father Baranor was slain upon the eastern shore of Anduin in a sortie against Ithilien orc-bands. Now two and twenty, he rules the coastal fastness of his fathers at Edhellond in southern Belfalas, and the weight of an ancient name lies heavy upon young shoulders. He bears Calanaith, his father's blade, recovered with grim cost from the field where Baranor fell, and the swan-prowed ships of his haven answer to his horn. In the gathering quarrel he keeps faith with Lord Denethor, holding that vigilance, not hope, is the bulwark of these dark years.

奥隆迪尔，巴拉尼昂纳斯家族之主，十九岁时继承家族；当时他的父亲巴拉诺尔在安都因河东岸一次针对伊希利恩奥克队伍的突袭中阵亡。如今他二十二岁，统治着贝尔法拉斯南部埃蒂尔泷德的家族海岸要塞，古老姓氏的重量压在年轻肩头。他持有父亲的剑卡拉奈斯；这把剑是在巴拉诺尔倒下的战场上以沉重代价夺回的，而港中的天鹅首船只也会回应他的号角。在日益聚拢的纷争中，他仍效忠德内梭尔领主，认为这些黑暗年代真正的屏障是警惕，而不是希望。

Oropherion, leader of Nos Oropher, honors the legacy of Thranduil's father Oropher, slain in the Last Alliance, by commanding veteran Sindar warriors in defense of Mirkwood's northern borders against Angmar's remnants.
欧洛斐瑞昂是欧洛斐尔一族的首领。他继承瑟兰杜伊之父欧洛斐尔的遗志；欧洛斐尔曾在最后联盟之战中阵亡。欧洛斐瑞昂统率辛达老兵，守卫黑森林北部边境，对抗安格玛残余势力。
Orthanc messenger who sold Saruman's secrets. Fled with stolen intelligence worth fortunes.
欧尔桑克信使，出卖萨茹曼的秘密。带着价值连城的偷来情报逃走。

Orweniel, daughter of Orondir and Falathwen, was born with her twin brother Talendir under the harvest-moon of a year of dark tidings. At fourteen she is already tall, grey-eyed and quiet, and has begun her lessons in the lore of her foremothers of Belfalas. The household reckons that the line of Baranionath shall not fail while she yet draws breath.
奥玟妮尔是奥隆迪尔和法拉斯玟的女儿，与孪生兄弟塔伦迪尔出生在一个噩耗之年、收获月之下。十四岁的她已经身材高挑、灰眼而安静，并开始学习贝尔法拉斯女性祖辈的传承。家族认为，只要她还在呼吸，巴拉尼昂纳斯的血脉就不会断绝。
Osgiliath's ruins must hold against the Shadow. Prove yourself worthy of the rank of Captain — win Gondor's battles, master the blade, and let your renown spread along the Anduin.
欧斯吉利亚斯的废墟必须挡住阴影。证明你配得上队长之衔，赢下刚铎的战斗，磨练剑术，让你的声名沿安都因河传开。

Ost Arndir is the primary stronghold and seat of power in Pinnath Gelin, one of the fertile green hill-lands of southern Gondor. The fortress serves as the capital settlement of this important agricultural region, which functions as a breadbasket for the kingdom.
奥斯特阿恩迪尔是品那斯盖林的主要要塞和权力中心。品那斯盖林是刚铎南部肥沃的绿色丘陵地之一，也是王国重要的产粮区；这座堡垒则是该地区的首府聚落。
Otgon of House Mithruntai rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
米斯伦泰家族的鄂特根率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Othric the Wild is a chieftain whose unpredictable tactics have won him many victories. His clan claims descent from ancient Dunlending kings.
“狂野者”奥瑟里克是一名酋长，靠难以预测的战术赢得了许多胜利。他的氏族自称是古代黑蛮地国王的后裔。
Othrod of the Grobûrz warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
奥斯罗德是格罗布尔兹战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Our forces slew {CASUALTIES} enemies in battle.
我军在战斗中击杀了{CASUALTIES}名敌人。

Our halls grow fat on trade now, and Elves from the Havens walk our market as if they owned it. One of them called our steel crude, so I broke his jaw. The lords paid the Havens for his teeth, and they paid me with dismissal.
如今我们的厅堂靠贸易越发富足，灰港的精灵在市场上走得像自家地盘。有一个说我们的钢粗劣，我就打断了他的下巴。领主们赔给灰港一笔牙钱，给我的报酬却是开除。
Our oxen were taken -- some by raiders, some by hunger. Without beasts to pull the plough, the soil lies hard and the fields go unsown.
我们的耕牛没了，有些被劫掠者抢走，有些活活饿死。没有牲畜拉犁，硬土翻不开，田地也没法播种。
Our plan is to advance behind the bows and let the arrows open the way.
我们要跟在弓手后面推进，让箭雨开路。
Our plan is to come at them from three sides and close the jaws.
我们要从三面夹击，把他们围住。
Our plan is to fight for the objective.
我们的计划是争夺目标。
Our plan is to hold the line until they commit, then advance as one.
我们要守住阵线，等敌人投入战斗后一起推进。
Our plan is to hold two lines: the front stands, the second waits, then strikes.
我们要布置两道阵线：前排坚守，后排等待时机再出击。
Our plan is to lock shields and hold our ground.
我们要组成盾墙，守住阵地。
Our plan is to ride them down and let the foot finish what the horse begins.
我们要让骑兵先冲垮他们，再由步兵解决剩下的敌人。
Our plan is to ring our archers with spears and let the arrows do the work.
我们要用长矛保护弓手，让箭雨解决敌人。
Our plan is to screen the flanks with our riders and charge once they commit.
我们要用骑兵掩护两翼，等敌人投入战斗后再冲锋。
Our plan is to send the mumakil in first and follow in their wake.
我们要让猛犸先冲进去，再跟着它们前进。
Our plan is to swarm them with our numbers.
我们要靠人数优势一拥而上，压倒他们。
Our plan is to throw, fall back, and throw again until their line breaks.
我们要反复投掷、后撤，直到敌人的阵线崩溃。
Our scythes are rusted through and our hammers broken. Honest work is slow work without honest tools.
我们的镰刀已经锈穿了，锤子也坏了。再勤快的人，没有趁手的工具也干不快。
Out among the dunes of Harad you come upon a camouflaged Southron camp gathered about a hidden desert well.

Pelamir, only son of Amandir and Ciriel, has stood three and forty years in the long shadow of his father, learning patience as other men learn the sword. He is grey already at the temples though his sire yet lives, and the hill-folk of Lamedon call him quietly the Waiting Lord. With Amandir he has declared for the king out of the North, and many say that when the old lord at last passes, Pelamir shall ride east at the claimant's banner without a backward glance.
