Pelargir stands at the confluence of the River Sirith and the Great River Anduin in the heart of Lebennin. The city occupies both banks of the Sirith where it joins the Anduin, approximately 100 miles upriver from the Mouths of Anduin (Ethir Anduin) where the Great River empties into the Bay of Belfalas, and roughly 126 miles downriver from the ruins of Osgiliath and the approach to Minas Tirith. This positioning grants Pelargir extraordinary strategic value. The Anduin here flows wide, deep, and calm - ideal for large ships and extensive port facilities. The city serves as the nexus point between Gondor's inland territories and the sea, where goods from Minas Tirith, Lossarnach, and the northern provinces meet cargo from coastal regions and distant ports. More crucially, Pelargir functions as the gateway controlling access to Gondor's heartland via the Great River - any fleet moving up the Anduin to threaten Minas Tirith must pass through or bypass Pelargir's waters.When first founded in the Second Age, Pelargir stood mere miles from the coast of the Bay of Belfalas. However, after the catastrophic Downfall of Númenor reshaped the world's geography, the coastline retreated dramatically westward and southward, leaving Pelargir far inland at the head of what became the Anduin's extensive delta region. This geographical transformation actually enhanced the city's security - Corsair raiders could no longer strike directly from the sea but had to navigate the treacherous channels of the Ethir Anduin or sail far upriver to reach the city, giving defenders time to prepare and respond.

佩拉基尔位于莱本宁腹地，坐落在西瑞斯河与安都因大河的交汇处。城市横跨西瑞斯河两岸，距安都因河口约一百英里，那里就是大河注入贝尔法拉斯湾的埃希尔安都因；从欧斯吉利亚斯废墟和通往米那斯提力斯的道路往下游约一百二十六英里，也会抵达这里。这样的地理位置赋予佩拉基尔极高的战略价值。此处的安都因河宽阔、深邃而平缓，非常适合大型船只和港口设施。城市是刚铎内陆领地与海洋之间的枢纽，来自米那斯提力斯、洛斯阿尔那赫和北方诸省的货物，会在这里与沿海地区和远方港口的货物交汇。更重要的是，佩拉基尔扼守着经由大河进入刚铎腹地的门户；任何想沿安都因河北上威胁米那斯提力斯的舰队，都必须经过或绕过佩拉基尔水域。第二纪元初建时，佩拉基尔距离贝尔法拉斯湾海岸只有数英里。然而努门诺尔沦亡重塑了世界地貌，海岸线大幅向西南退去，使佩拉基尔留在内陆深处，成为后来安都因广大三角洲的上端。这种地理变化反而加强了城市安全：乌姆巴尔海盗无法再直接从海上袭击，而必须穿过埃希尔安都因危险的水道，或沿河远航才能抵达，守军因此有时间准备和应对。

Presets save and load the formation types, captains and hero troops of the Order of Battle, per campaign. Off by default until it is checked in game; opt in to try it. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.

Press with a company selected to switch its archers between firing at will, drawing their bows to hold until your word (or for 14 seconds at most), and drawing and holding until most of them are ready, when the word is given for you. Defaults to Comma.
选中编队后按下此键，可在三种模式间切换：自由射击；拉弓等待命令，最多等待 14 秒；拉弓准备，等大多数弓兵就绪后自动下令齐射。默认按键为逗号键。

Press with a company selected: its shielded foot soldiers in a shield wall, circle or square stop attacking and keep their places, and strike back for a few seconds when wounded. A charge, a retreat or a second press lets them fight. Defaults to Period.

Problem was, I also took what I wanted from fellow soldiers. Weaker ones. Their rations, their loot, their lives if they objected too strongly. Officers said I was 'disrupting unit cohesion.' Cohesion? We're orcs! We take what we can take. When they tried to discipline me, I took the sergeant's head. Then I left.
问题是，我也会从战友那里拿走我想要的东西。那些更弱的家伙，他们的口粮、他们的战利品；如果反抗得太厉害，连命也一起拿走。军官们说我“破坏部队凝聚力”。凝聚力？我们是奥克！能拿就拿。当他们想惩罚我时，我拿走了军士的头，然后离开了。

Problem was, I liked the work too much. Started taking trophies, heads, weapons, valuables from the dead. Saruman's lieutenants called it 'undisciplined.' During one mission, when they tried to restrain me, I turned on them instead. Killed two officers. After that, staying wasn't an option.
问题是，我太喜欢这活儿了。我开始收集战利品：头颅、武器，还有死者身上的财物。萨茹曼的副官说这叫“缺乏纪律”。一次任务中，他们想约束我，我就反过来对他们动手。杀了两个军官。从那以后，我就不能再留下了。

QA only. Throws a tagged TaomDevTriggerException from a TAOM mission behavior's AfterStart on the next mission start, the #699 shape. Needs Enable Crash Capture on. With Survive Mission Start Failures on, the mission starts with that behavior's AfterStart cut short, and one message shows. With it off, the throw escapes once, TAOM's crash capture shows its crash dialog and writes a bundle, and the engine loads the mission again. Auto-resets to OFF after firing.
仅供测试。在下次任务启动时，由TAOM任务行为的AfterStart抛出带标记的TaomDevTriggerException，复现#699形式的问题。需要开启“启用崩溃捕获”。开启“容错处理任务启动异常”时，会中断该行为的AfterStart，显示一条消息，任务仍可启动。关闭容错时，异常会向外抛出一次，TAOM崩溃捕获会显示崩溃对话框并写出报告包，随后引擎重新加载任务。触发后自动重置为关闭。
QA only. Throws a tagged TaomDevTriggerException on the next Mission.Tick to exercise the crash capture pipeline. Auto-resets to OFF after firing.
仅供测试。在下一次 Mission.Tick 中抛出带标记的 TaomDevTriggerException，测试崩溃捕获流程。触发后自动关闭。
QA only. Throws a tagged TaomDevTriggerException on the next Module.OnApplicationTick to exercise the capture pipeline without entering a mission. Auto-resets to OFF after firing.
仅供测试。在下一次 Module.OnApplicationTick 中抛出带标记的 TaomDevTriggerException，无需进入场景即可测试捕获流程。触发后自动关闭。

Quiet steps. Quiet words. The old stones do not like loud.

Raiders from Rhun came at harvest and drove off our herd and half our village. I rode to Dale for help, but the council would not hear me before morning, so I gathered the farmhands and went after them myself.
收获时节，鲁恩来的劫掠者抢走了马群，也掳走了半个村子的人。我骑马去河谷城求援，可议事会非要等到天亮才肯听我说。我便召集农工，自己追了上去。

Raiders from Rhûn came at harvest and drove off our herd and half our village. I rode to Vineholm for help, but the council would not hear me before morning, so I gathered the farmhands and went after them myself.
收获时节，鲁恩来的劫掠者抢走了马群，也掳走了半个村子的人。我骑马去葡萄洲求援，可议事会非要等到天亮才肯听我说。我便召集农工，自己追了上去。

Raiders out of the south came at harvest and drove off our herd and half our village. I rode to Woodmen-town for help, but the council would not hear me before morning, so I gathered the farmhands and went after them myself.
收获时节，南方来的劫掠者抢走了马群，也掳走了半个村子的人。我骑马去林中居民镇求援，可议事会非要等到天亮才肯听我说。我便召集农工，自己追了上去。

Raise a field or fortified camp into a persistent, garrisonable base. When off: no founding, no upgrading, and your party is not held in place during a build. Standing refuges persist, builds in progress still finish, and refuges can still be entered, managed and dismantled.
将野战营地或设防营地发展为能够长期保留、容纳驻军的据点。关闭后，不能新建或升级，建设期间也不再让你的部队原地等待。已有避难所保留，正在进行的建设仍会完成，也仍可进入、管理和拆除避难所。
Raise the ancient warcry of Eorl the Young — boosts +25% charge damage, +20% mount speed, and +10% melee damage for 8s.
高呼年少的埃奥尔传下的古老战吼：+25% 冲锋伤害，+20% 坐骑速度，+10% 近战伤害，持续 8 秒。
Raise the warcry of the horse-lords: boosts +25% charge damage, +20% mount speed, and +10% melee damage for 8s.
发出驭马者的战吼：+25%冲锋伤害，+20%坐骑速度，+10%近战伤害，持续8秒。

提高资金不足的商队的购买能力，让它们采购多种货物，而不是只买一种。0为原版表现，即贫穷商队只购买一种货物；数值越高，采购越丰富。默认：0.35。
Rally your crew with promises of plunder — boosts +25% charge damage, +20% mount speed, and +10% melee damage for 8s.
用战利品的承诺集结船员：+25% 冲锋伤害，+20% 坐骑速度，+10% 近战伤害，持续 8 秒。
Rally your soldiers with iron discipline — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
以铁一般的纪律稳住士兵：50 米内的盟友获得 +15% 近战伤害和 +10% 伤害减免，持续 8 秒。
在艾森加德阴影中传递情报。

拉祖克因狡诈而获提拔，在巴拉督尔下方统领一支塔卫部队。他连自己的队长都不信任。

Reads how full those two buffers get during every mission, not only battles, and writes the peaks to the log when the mission ends, with how many times each guard had to step in. Relation added to what vanilla gives with the settlement owner's clan leader for each hero prisoner donated, before the alignment multiplier. Vanilla itself pays nothing when the captive likes the owner. Default: 5.

Relation asked for with the leader of the lord's clan, before the alignment multiplier. While Personal Relations is off, the lord and the clan leader share one relation, so only the larger of the two is paid. Default: 2.

Relation asked for with the lord you release, before the alignment multiplier. Vanilla pays another 4 in the conversation. Your Charm can add to what lands. Default: 5.
释放领主时，在阵营倍率计算前请求增加的关系值。原版对话还会另外奖励4点，你的魅力也可能提高最终增幅。默认：5。
Relation asked for with the lord's living spouse, before the alignment multiplier. Default: 2.
在阵营倍率计算前，请求增加与该领主仍在世配偶的关系值。默认：2。
Relation asked for with the town owner's clan leader and with each notable in the town when you win its tournament, before the alignment multiplier. Between 0 and 10. Default: 1.
赢得城镇竞技大会时，在阵营倍率计算前，请求增加与城镇所有者家族领袖，以及每位城内要人的关系值。范围：0至10。默认：1。

Relation gained with each lord who fought on your side in a battle, once per lord per battle (once per clan when Personal Relations is off, because a clan then shares one relation). Your own clan, an army you lead and lords leading no party earn nothing; after a win, the side leader you came to help is thanked by vanilla's own conversation instead, but only when vanilla pays him something (a small contribution earns him this bonus). 0 = none. Default: 1.
每次战斗中，与每位同侧作战领主增加的关系，每位领主每战结算一次。关闭个人关系时，则每个家族只结算一次，因为家族共享关系。自己家族的领主、你率领的军团中的领主，以及未带领部队的领主不获得加成。胜利后，你前来支援的己方领队改由原版感谢对话处理，但仅当原版实际给予关系奖励时，才跳过本项加成；贡献较少、未获原版奖励时，仍给予本项加成。0为不增加。默认：1。
Relation lost with every notable of the village after a whole raid, before the alignment multiplier. Vanilla takes its own share as well. Between 0 and 100. Default: 50.
完整劫掠一次村庄后，与村内每位要人损失的关系值，之后再计算阵营倍率。原版惩罚也会另外计算。范围：0至100。默认：50。
Relation lost with every notable of the village each time you force it to give goods or recruits, before the alignment multiplier. Between 0 and 50. Default: 25.
每次强迫村庄交出货物或提供新兵时，与村内每位要人损失的关系值，之后再计算阵营倍率。范围：0至50。默认：25。
Relation lost with the clan leader who owns the village after a whole raid, before the alignment multiplier. Vanilla takes its own share as well. Between 0 and 100. Default: 50.
完整劫掠一次村庄后，与其所有者家族领袖损失的关系值，之后再计算阵营倍率。原版惩罚也会另外计算。范围：0至100。默认：50。
Relation lost with the clan leader who owns the village each time you force it to give goods or recruits, before the alignment multiplier. Between 0 and 50. Default: 20.

Relation with lords and notables is earned on campaign: fighting beside a lord, clearing bandits near a settlement, handing a lord troops, and overpaying in a barter. Off restores vanilla on all four. Does nothing while you are enlisted. Default: on.
在战役活动中增进与领主和要人的关系，包括并肩作战、清剿定居点附近的匪徒、向领主移交士兵，以及在交易中多付钱。关闭后，这四项都恢复原版规则。参军服役时无效。默认：开启。

Release the map view's memory on every Nth cover of the map. Default 20. A lower number gives memory back sooner but shows the short loading screen on more returns to the map (about 0.4 s in the measurement this feature is adapted from); 1 releases on every cover. Takes effect at the next cover.

Releasing a captured lord from your party (in conversation or on the party screen) or from your own dungeon earns relation with the lord, with the lord's living spouse and with the lord's clan leader. The post-battle "free to go" choice, ransom, peace, escape and any AI release earn nothing. Default: on.
从自己的部队中释放被俘领主，无论通过对话还是部队界面，或从自己的地牢放走领主，都会增加与该领主、其仍在世的配偶，以及其家族领袖的关系。战后选择放人、赎回、议和、逃脱，以及AI主动释放，都没有此奖励。默认：开启。

Remove killed horses, wargs and other mounts a few seconds after they die instead of leaving them on the field. A mount is a full agent with a skeleton and a live ragdoll, so a cavalry battle piles up corpses that cost frame time and do nothing. Field battles, sieges and sally-outs only; towns, arenas and tournaments keep their bodies. Side effect: freeing agent slots lets reinforcements arrive slightly sooner than vanilla.
马匹、座狼及其他坐骑死亡几秒后便会被移除，不再一直留在战场上。坐骑是包含骨骼和布娃娃物理的完整战场实体，骑兵战斗中堆积的尸体会消耗性能，却没有实际作用。仅应用于野战、围城和突围战，城镇、竞技场及比武大会仍保留尸体。附带影响：释放战场实体名额后，援军会比原版稍早抵达。

Rhudaur is the hill kingdom of old Arnor, between the Hoarwell and the Loudwater. Its Dúnedain lords hold the Angle and the tower of Cameth Brin and rule a people of hill-men who never loved the West. The line of its first king still endures, but its holds are cold, its fells are full of trolls, and the orcs of the mountains watch every pass.

Richer orders for your companies in a battle. Rondamir, head of the House of Hýarthulionath, holds the upland fastness of Erech-march in Lamedon, where his forefathers swore fealty to Mardil Voronwë in the dimming after Eärnur rode forth. Tall and grey-eyed in the old Númenórean mould, he bears the sword Calanril, drawn in his great-grandsire's hand at the Crossings of Erui. In this hour of sundering he holds firm to the Steward of Gondor, deeming the oath unbroken while the Tower of Ecthelion yet stands. Now, as the shadow grows long upon the Ephel Dúath, he summons his hillmen to the muster of Minas Tirith.

隆达米尔是希阿尔苏利昂纳斯家族之主，掌握拉梅顿埃瑞赫边境高地要塞。自埃雅努尔出征后日渐昏暗的岁月里，他的祖先便向马迪尔·沃隆威宣誓效忠。隆达米尔身材高大，灰眼睛，有古老努门诺尔人风范，佩剑名为卡兰瑞尔；他的曾祖父曾在埃茹伊河渡口挥舞此剑。如今王国分裂之际，他坚定站在刚铎宰相一边，认为只要埃克塞理安之塔仍然矗立，誓言就未曾断绝。现在，阴影在埃斐尔度阿斯上越拉越长，他召集自己的山民前往米那斯提力斯集结。

Rondiel, wedded to Lord Rondamir, was born of a lesser branch of the House of Ecthelionath in Lossarnach, and brought to her husband's hall the gentle learning of the Vale of Flowers. She is versed in the Sindarin tongue and in the lore of healing herbs gathered ere the frost. Her marriage knit the stern hill-folk of Lamedon to the orchard-lords of the south, and she is held in honor as a Lady of measured counsel. With her lord, she stands faithful to Denethor son of Ecthelion.
隆迪尔嫁给隆达米尔领主，出身洛斯阿尔那赫埃克塞理安纳斯家族的旁支，并把花谷温和的学问带进丈夫的厅堂。她熟悉辛达语，也通晓霜降前采集的疗愈草药。她的婚姻把拉梅顿严厉的山民与南方果园领主连在一起，因此她作为审慎建言的夫人受到尊敬。她与自己的领主一样，忠于埃克塞理安之子德内梭尔。
Rosfin, wife of Duinhir, manages the affairs of the Black Root Vale in her husband's absence.
罗斯芬是杜因希尔的妻子，在丈夫离开时打理黑源河山谷的事务。

Rukthar, a grim and indomitable warlord of the Black Echelon, leads his Uruk-hai with a chilling blend of discipline and cruelty. His unwavering devotion to Saruman fuels his relentless campaigns, his forces striking with precision and terror under his command. Rukthar's disdain for weakness and his strategic brilliance make him a fearsome adversary, his troops a scourge upon Middle-earth's Free Peoples. With a heart as cold as Isengard's forges, he advances Saruman's ambitions, leaving only ruin in his wake.
鲁克萨尔是黑色梯队阴沉而难以撼动的军阀，以纪律与残忍交织的方式统率自己的乌鲁克。他对萨茹曼毫不动摇的忠诚推动着一次次无情战役，他的部队在其命令下以精准和恐怖打击敌人。鲁克萨尔鄙视软弱，又有出色的战略头脑，因此成为可怕的对手；他的士兵则是中洲自由人民身上的灾祸。他的心像艾森加德的熔炉一样冰冷，所到之处只留下废墟，也让萨茹曼的野心得以推进。
Rulers call hosts for less influence
统治者召集军队消耗更少影响力
Ruma is wife to Haldir, managing their coastal holdings.
鲁玛是哈尔迪尔的妻子，负责管理他们的沿海领地。
Rumil, a scholar and warrior, preserves ancient grimoires, using knowledge to forge defenses against the Necromancer's curses.
儒米尔既是学者也是战士，保存古老的魔法书，并运用其中知识构筑防御，抵挡死灵法师的诅咒。
Running from a lost fight is not the same as cowardice. You kept your arm.
打输了再逃命，不等于胆怯。你保住了持弓的手。
Running from your destiny? Or preparing for it?
你是在逃避命运，还是在为它做准备？

Runs the War Chronicle: lore events of the War of the Ring at set points, and the great sieges (Helm's Deep, Osgiliath, Minas Tirith and others) as timed windows whose result gives both sides small, temporary effects. Off stops new events and clears the army focus; the saved progress is kept. Default on.
启用战争纪事：在指定节点触发魔戒大战的背景事件，并为海尔姆深谷、欧斯吉利亚斯、米那斯提力斯等大战设置限时围城事件，结果会给双方带来小幅临时效果。关闭后不再触发新事件，并清除军团的目标偏重，但已保存的进度会保留。默认：开启。

Rurazaur Bozorganith, a beast-master of Rhûn, commands fearsome creatures in battle during the Third Age for Sauron. His bond with wild beasts sows chaos among foes. Rurazaur's monstrous allies amplify the terror of the Easterling assaults.
鲁拉扎乌尔·博佐加尼思是鲁恩的驯兽师，在第三纪元为索隆指挥可怖生物投入战斗。他与野兽之间的联系会在敌人中制造混乱。鲁拉扎乌尔的怪物盟友放大了东夷进攻时的恐怖。
Rurik Fanghew is son of the old chieftain, and eager to prove himself in battle.
“断牙”鲁里克是老酋长的儿子，迫切想在战斗中证明自己。
Rustica rides to war alongside her father Tormund, a fierce young warrior of the clan.
卢斯提卡是氏族中一名勇猛的年轻战士，随父亲托蒙德一同骑马出征。
冷酷的安加拉兹毛皮商人
冷酷的多古尔都割喉者
冷酷的多温尼安毛皮商人
冷酷的洛丝罗瑞恩哨卫
无情的乌鲁克斗坑主管
冷酷的安都因河谷毛皮商人
冷酷的瓦里亚格走私者
冷酷的瓦里亚格香料商
冷酷的黑暗奥克补给商
Ruthless on the steppe, ruthless in my service. I can use that.
在草原上狠，在我手下也狠。我用得上这样的人。

Rúmen of the line of Cirdacar rode out of Pinnath Gelin to wed Nimethil, bringing the green banner and the troth of shepherd-spears unto Garvirionath. Though yet young in years, he proved his valor at a skirmish nigh Cair Andros, where he held a broken ford against orc-scouts until the beacon-riders came. He follows his lord-father Vorondir in the cause of the Steward, and dreams of a sword-name of his own ere his beard is grown.
奇尔达卡一脉的鲁门从品那斯盖林骑马而来，迎娶尼梅希尔，将绿色旗帜和牧民矛手的誓约带到加尔维瑞昂纳斯家族。虽然年纪尚轻，他已在凯尔安德洛斯附近的一场冲突中证明了自己的勇气。当时他守住一处残破的浅滩，抵挡奥克斥候，直到烽火骑手赶来。他追随岳父沃隆迪尔支持宰相，希望在胡须长成前就靠战功赢得自己的名声。
Rúmil, elder brother of Forlong, is a steady presence in the House of Ausirionath. His long years of service have earned him the respect of his kin.
儒米尔是佛朗的兄长，是奥西瑞昂纳斯家族中稳定的存在。多年效力为他赢得亲族尊重。

Rûklash holds his banner in the slag-pits and forges of Gorgoroth, under the red light of Orodruin, where his sire was a taskmaster of the bellows. He clawed up out of the labour-gangs by breaking the captain who had flogged him as a snaga, and dragged the body up the slag-heap so the smiths would see who walked down. The men of Gondor know nothing of him yet, but the smith-orcs name him the Hammer of the Pit. He despises the Arki of Udun, who he says do nothing but stand in lines and be counted.
卢克拉什在欧洛朱因的红光下，统领着戈埚洛斯平原的渣坑和锻炉。他的父亲曾是看管风箱的工头。他原本只是劳工队中的斯那嘎，后来杀死了曾鞭打他的队长，又把尸体拖上渣堆，让铁匠们看清是谁活着走下来。刚铎人还没听过他的名字，但铁匠奥克已经称他为“坑场之锤”。他瞧不起乌顿的阿尔基氏族，说他们除了列队等人清点，什么都不会。
听着像一连串悲惨的低吼。
虐待成性的乌鲁克监工
Saghost of House Bozorganith rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
博佐加尼思家族的萨戈斯特率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Salma is wife to the frontier commander.
萨尔玛是这位边境统帅的妻子。
Samga of House Adekig is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
阿德基格家族的萨姆加是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Sanit is heir to the serpent riders.
萨尼特是巨蛇骑手的继承人。
Sarangerel of House Vazevian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
瓦泽维安家族的萨仁格日勒是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
尖刻的巴德一族亡命徒
刻薄的贝奥恩族亡命徒
刻薄的多温尼安亡命徒
刻薄的林中居民亡命徒
Sarnai of House Cilzeron is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
西尔泽隆家族的萨日娜是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。

Sarnion, son of Pelamir and Dorwen, is two and twenty and the youngest sword of Hirilionath, dark-haired and lean as a hill-hound. He was sent in his fifteenth year to foster with kinsmen in Morthond, that he might learn the bow of his mother's people alongside the spear of his father's. He follows his grandsire and his father in the cause of the King, and burns with the hot certainty of the young.
萨尼昂是佩拉米尔和多玟之子，二十二岁，是希瑞利昂纳斯最年轻的剑士，黑发，瘦得像山地猎犬。十五岁时，他被送往墨松德的亲族家寄养，以便同时学习母族的弓和父族的矛。他追随祖父和父亲支持国王事业，怀着年轻人炽热而笃定的信念。
Sartaq of House Mithruntai rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
米斯伦泰家族的撒里答率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Saruman breeds warriors, but even perfection can become inconvenient...
萨茹曼能培育战士，但就算是他眼中的完美作品，也可能变成麻烦……

Saruman made us to destroy, yes, but I discovered a different power - creation. Through code and craft, I forged the Realms Forgotten, breathing life into dead pixels. My claws that once gripped swords now shape entire civilizations.
萨茹曼造出我们，是为了毁灭。没错。但我发现了另一种力量，创造。凭借代码和手艺，我锻造了被遗忘诸界，让死寂的像素获得生命。曾经握剑的爪子，如今塑造着完整的文明。

Saruman rewards sycophants over warriors. Out here, I'll build my own force, answer to no wizard. I'm skilled at reconnaissance, ambush, elimination. Those talents have value beyond Isengard's politics. When war truly comes, those who planned ahead will rise highest.
萨茹曼奖赏谄媚者，多过奖赏战士。在外面，我会建立自己的力量，不听命于任何巫师。我擅长侦察、伏击和清除目标。这些才能的价值不该困在艾森加德的权力斗争里。真正的战争到来时，提前布局的人会爬得最高。
Saruman rewards your obedience. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
萨茹曼奖赏你的服从。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。

Saruman taught me to think strategically, to see war as a calculated enterprise. Those lessons serve me well outside his control. I understand warfare, logistics, the management of lesser creatures. My intelligence and ruthlessness need not serve only one white wizard.
萨茹曼教会我从战略上思考，把战争看成一门需要计算的事业。这些东西离开他的控制后同样有用。我懂战争，懂后勤，也懂得管理那些低我一等的生物。我的智慧和冷酷，不必只为一个白袍巫师效力。

Saruman the White, once head of the Istari sent to Middle-earth, turned the wisdom of his order toward his own ambition. From Orthanc he bent Isengard's furnaces and pits to arm the Uruk-hai, and set himself against both Sauron and the Free Peoples in hope of ruling in his master's place. His counsel is unmatched, his stewardship of Isengard absolute, and his tongue capable of swaying even the wary. His fall was not a failure of skill but of pride: certain his cunning could outlast every rival, he broke faith with the White Council and staked Isengard's strength on his own ambition.
“白袍”萨茹曼曾是派往中洲的伊斯塔尔之首，却把同伴的智慧用来满足自己的野心。他在欧尔桑克指挥艾森加德的炉场和矿坑，为乌鲁克打造武器，并同时对抗索隆与自由人民，企图取代自己的主人。他善于谋划，牢牢掌控着艾森加德，言辞甚至能说动心怀戒备的人。他的堕落不是因为能力不足，而是因为骄傲：他相信自己的计谋足以压倒所有对手，于是背弃白道会，把艾森加德的力量押在自己的野心上。

Saruman wanted controlled warriors. Instead he made me, cunning wrapped in brutality, patience hiding behind fury. I do what benefits me, nothing more. Killing, stealing, betraying, just tools. Out here, no one expects a berserker to think. That's my advantage.
萨茹曼想要受控制的战士。结果他造出了我：残暴包着狡诈，怒火后面藏着耐心。我只做对自己有利的事，仅此而已。杀人、偷窃、背叛，都只是工具。在外面，没人会想到狂战士也会思考。这就是我的优势。

Saruman wastes his best warriors on human kingdoms and forest trees. Out here, I'll find battles worthy of my breeding. Let the old and weak serve in ranks, I'll carve my own path. The strong shouldn't apologize for taking what they've earned.
萨茹曼把最好的战士浪费在人类王国和森林树木上。在外面，我会找到配得上我培育血统的战斗。让老的、弱的去队列里服役吧，我会砍出自己的路。强者拿走自己挣来的东西，不需要道歉。
萨茹曼的掌控损害外交

Saruman's agents came through the northern holds with sacks of coin and maps, and I was the one who drew up the marches. I was good at it. Cutting a throat takes a moment, but a plan lasts for seasons.
萨茹曼的使者带着钱袋和地图，走遍北方堡垒，行军计划都是我做的。我拿手。割喉咙只要一瞬，计划却能管上好几个季节。

Saruman's industrial fortress at Orthanc. The Ring of Isengard runs day and night — Uruk-hai legions, forge-line crossbows, war wargs. Isengard's one town swells to twenty notables: a recruitment hub equal to many cities of Rohan. Saruman's Grip alienates every neighbor.
艾森加德是萨茹曼位于欧尔桑克的工业堡垒。艾森加德环场日夜运转，组建乌鲁克军团，批量打造弩，并培育战争座狼。艾森加德唯一的城镇聚集了二十名要人，成为足以媲美洛汗多座城市的招募中心。萨茹曼的掌控让他们与每个邻国都日渐疏远。
萨茹曼的棋子，外交糟糕

Saruman's plan called for a breach before dawn. Your column hit the gate first and you were the one who placed the blasting-fire charge at its base. The explosion lit the sky. The assault followed. What happened inside the Deep is your business.
萨茹曼的计划要求天亮前打开缺口。你的纵队最先冲向城门，放置爆火装药的人也是你。爆炸照亮天空，突击随即开始。深谷里面发生了什么，那是你自己的事。
Sasaitha manages the desert trade routes.
Sauron and the Nazgûl Cannot Be Captured
索隆和那兹古尔无法被俘虏

Sauron the Great, Dark Lord of Mordor and Lord of the Rings, has risen again. From the black tower of Barad-dûr his Eye sweeps the lands of the West, and the legions of Gorgoroth muster beneath his banner. The Free Peoples reckoned him beaten, but the Shadow only bided its time. Now he marches to break them and bind all of Middle-earth under one dominion. Let the kings of Men despair, for the age of Sauron is come.
伟大的索隆再次崛起。他是魔多的黑暗魔君，也是魔戒之主。魔眼从巴拉督尔的黑塔上扫视西方各地，戈埚洛斯的军团在他的旗帜下集结。自由人民以为已将他击败，可黑暗只是一直在等待时机。如今，他要出兵击溃他们，让整个中洲臣服于同一个统治者。人类的诸王尽管绝望吧，索隆的时代已经到来。

Sauron's Black Land. The Dark Lord's Will lets armies muster at minimal influence cost; Nurn Farmlands feed the hordes; Sauron's Wrath turns raids into slaughter; Creatures of the Dark march faster at night than any free people in daylight. Dark Tribute drains the treasury.
魔多是索隆的黑暗之地。黑暗魔君的意志让军队几乎不需要影响力就能集结；努尔恩农田供养大军；索隆之怒把劫掠变成屠杀；黑暗生物在夜间行军，比任何自由人民在白天都更快。黑暗贡赋则会不断消耗国库。
Sauron's blessing multiplies your shafts. +15% ammo.
索隆的赐福让你的箭矢更多。+15% 弹药。
Sauron's command fuels your will. -4% troop wages.
索隆的号令支撑着你的意志。-4% 部队工资。
Sauron's dark will empowers the rage to envelop all nearby. Bloodrage radius +5.
索隆的黑暗意志让怒火笼罩附近所有人。嗜血狂怒作用范围 +5。
Sauron's grace keeps you swift and hidden. +10% stealth bonus.
索隆的恩赐让你行动迅捷，也更善于隐藏。+10% 潜行加成。
Sauron's power sustains the warhost. -5% troop wages.
索隆的力量维系着战团。-5% 部队工资。
Savage Rush grants +5% melee damage and channels the fury of the Dunlending clans.
蛮勇突袭提供 +5% 近战伤害，并唤起黑蛮地氏族的怒火。

Say the word Carrock to me. Go on. See what I do.
你在我面前提一句卡尔岩。说啊，看看我什么反应。

Scales every War of the Ring catch-up and event effect (a higher daily volunteer roll, which fills recruit slots faster and promotes waiting recruits sooner; faster escapes of captured lords). 0 turns them off, 1 is the authored size, 2 doubles it. Default 1.
调整魔戒大战中所有追赶加成和事件效果的强度，包括提高每日征募兵员的判定值，让空缺兵位更快补足、待招募兵员更快升级，以及加快被俘领主逃脱。0为关闭，1为预设强度，2为双倍。默认：1。

Scales the influence a tournament winner earns in a town of their own kingdom (base: 2 plus 1 per 4 lords or heroes in the field, times the winner's culture factor). 1.00 = as designed. Default: 1.00.
调整冠军在自己王国的城镇赢得竞技大会时获得的影响力（基础值为2，每4名参赛领主或英雄再加1，最后乘以冠军的文化系数）。1.00表示按设计值计算。默认：1.00。
Scales the renown a tournament winner earns (base: vanilla's 3 plus 1 per lord or hero in the field, times the winner's culture factor). 1.00 = as designed. Applies to every winner. Default: 1.00.
调整竞技大会冠军获得的声望（基础值为原版的3，再加上每名参赛领主或英雄带来的1，最后乘以冠军的文化系数）。1.00表示按设计值计算，对所有冠军生效。默认：1.00。
Scattered Orc tribes in the frozen northern wastes near the Ice Bay of Forochel. Savage raiders who prey on the Lossoth and any who venture north.
分散在佛洛赫尔冰湾附近北方冻原上的奥克部族。他们是野蛮劫掠者，袭击洛斯索斯人和任何冒险北上者。
Scavenger, lurker. Pits unsafe, join horde as shadow-eye.
拾荒者，潜伏者。坑里不安全，于是想作为暗处的眼睛加入兽群。
工于心计的艾森加德恶棍
善于算计的乌姆巴尔商人
工于心计的乌鲁克囤货者
诡计多端的蓝岩勒索者

工于算计的黑暗奥克敲诈者

Score multiplier applied to the first settlement in a faction's priority list. Decays linearly to 1.0 at the last entry. Affects Mordor, Isengard etc.

Score multiplier on defending one of your own settlements. Raise it if AI kingdoms keep besieging abroad while their own fiefs fall. 1.0 = vanilla.

Scout commander who engineered a rival's death. Fled when suspicion mounted.
斥候指挥官，设计害死了竞争对手。怀疑加深后逃走。
Scout who uncovered conspiracy, discredited by those involved. Truth and skill for hire.
揭露阴谋的斥候，被涉事者毁掉名声。真相与本领都可受雇。
Scouted far ahead of the eastern war-host.
远远侦察在东方战军前方。
Scouted the foothills of the Lonely Mountain.
Scouted the plains of Rohan for Saruman's eyes.
为萨茹曼侦察洛汗平原。
Scouted the slopes below Blue Craig.
Scouting from camp is not available in a shared campaign.
合作战役中无法从营地派出斥候。

Scouting near Dol Guldur, I saw things that shouldn't exist: pits, strange fires, and twisted creatures. When I tried to get closer, wolves pursued me, but wolves that ran upright and spoke in dark tongues.
在多古尔都附近侦察时，我看到了不该存在的东西：深坑、怪火，还有扭曲的生物。我想再靠近些，却被狼追赶。可那些狼竟直立奔跑，还会说黑暗的语言。

Scouting near Isengard, I saw things that shouldn't exist - vast pits, strange fires, and twisted creatures. When I tried to get closer, wolves pursued me - but wolves that ran upright and spoke in dark tongues.
在艾森加德附近侦察时，我看见了不该存在的东西：巨大的坑洞，奇怪的火，还有扭曲的生物。我想靠近些，却被狼追赶；可那些狼直立奔跑，还用黑暗的语言说话。
Scouts of the Tower Hills read the road before it is walked. We watch the north for the Havens, and we do not flatter what we see.
塔丘的斥候，总比赶路的人先一步看清道路。我们替灰港守望北方，不会为了讨好谁，改变看到的事情。
Scraped by around the Forest Gate.
在森林之门周围勉强度日。

在金鸢尾河岸边勉强度日。
Scraped by on the margins of the Lake-town docks.
在长湖镇码头边缘勉强糊口。

Scrounged along the Great East Road.
Scrounged among the ruins of Osgiliath.
在欧斯吉利亚斯废墟中搜刮。

镰刃冲锋会在冲锋期间强化坐骑韧性。
Scything Charge charge greatly reduced, the wheels grind ceaselessly.
镰刃冲锋充能消耗大幅降低，车轮不断碾过战场。

Sea fog today. A bad day for doom. A fine day for a joke.
今天起海雾，不适合闹厄运，倒适合讲笑话。

海门齐射所需充能大幅减少，箭矢连绵不绝。

海门齐射生效期间，提供额外破甲。
Seagate Volley grants +5% ranged damage in honor of the bowmen of the Redwater.
海门齐射提供+5%远程伤害，向红水弓手致敬。
Seagate Volley radius greatly expanded, inescapable volleys.
海门齐射的作用范围大幅扩大，敌人难逃齐射。

海门齐射的作用范围扩大，覆盖更广的杀伤区域。

开启袭击后，在避难所周围搜索可能来袭部队的半径。默认：6。
Sechen is heir to Oragur's command.
塞琴是奥拉古尔指挥权的继承人。
Second sons of the Dúnedain houses of Cardolan inherit a sword and not much else. Some of us write our own legends to make up the difference.
卡多蓝的杜内丹家族，次子们只能继承一把剑，别的没多少。我们有些人只好自己编点英雄事迹，弥补一下。

Seconds a body stays on the field, counted from when it settles, before it fades. Default 60. The engine's own default is an hour, so without this a body only goes when the corpse cap pushes it out. Values outside 10-300 fall back to 60.
从尸体落定开始计时，经过多少秒后消失。默认60秒。引擎默认一小时，因此没有此功能时，尸体通常只会在数量超过上限后被移除。10到300以外的数值按60处理。
Seconds between [MemSample] lines. Default 30s (~120 lines per hour of play). Takes effect on the next sample — no restart needed.
两条 [MemSample] 记录之间的间隔秒数。默认30秒，每小时游玩约120行。下次采样时生效，无需重启。
Seconds between a creature's pounces or bites. Applies to creatures spawned after the change.
怪物两次扑击或撕咬之间的间隔秒数。更改后新生成的怪物起生效。
Seconds between a creature's swipes. Applies to creatures spawned after the change.
怪物两次横扫之间的间隔秒数。更改后新生成的怪物起生效。
Seconds between a mount's death and its fade. Default 5. Below 3 the corpse pops while the death animation is still playing, so values outside 3-30 fall back to 5.
坐骑死亡到尸体淡出的等待秒数。默认5秒。低于3秒时，死亡动画尚未结束，尸体就会突然消失，因此不在3至30秒范围内的设置会回退为5秒。
Seconds the battle must stay down to the last few before the survivors are sent off, one a second. Default: 30.
战场持续只剩最后少数敌兵多少秒后，才开始每秒移出一名幸存者。默认：30。
See the quartermaster's wagon — your kit is in your baggage.
去军需官的货车那里，你的装备已经放进行囊了。
Seems like you traded your shield for a keyboard.
看起来你把盾牌换成了键盘。

塞因统领一支瓦里亚格骑兵。

Send paid messengers to heroes. The price grows with distance. They travel for several days and trigger a conversation on arrival. Disable to grey out the encyclopedia button and stop the dialog line.
付费派信使去找英雄，费用随距离增加。信使会赶路数天，到达后触发对话。关闭后，百科中的按钮会变灰，相关对话选项也会停用。
Sensible. A rider respects a traveller who counts the arrows before speaking. What do you offer?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
还算识相。开口前知道先数清有多少支箭的人，值得我们骑手敬重。你出多少？[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
Sensible. Believe me, none of us wants a fight. We have buried enough comrades. What can you give?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
这才明智。相信我，我们谁都不想打，已经埋过太多战友了。你能给多少？[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
Sentries keep watch: your towers fire 30% faster.
哨兵警戒：你的防御塔射速提高30%。
肖纳格是布兰诺克的妻子。
Sergeant. Retired, you might say. Not by choice.
军士。算是退下来了吧，不是我自愿的。
Serpent-Venom Blades boosts attrition, sapping enemy will to fight.
蛇毒利刃的消耗效果增强，削弱敌人的战斗意志。
Serpent-Venom Blades charge greatly reduced, constant attrition.
蛇毒利刃充能消耗大幅降低，持续消耗敌人。
Serpent-Venom Blades charge reduced, strike more frequently.
蛇毒利刃充能消耗降低，可以更频繁地发动。
Serpent-Venom Blades duration extended, the toxin lingers.
蛇毒利刃持续时间延长，毒素久久不散。

蛇毒利刃提供+5%近战伤害，并施加消耗效果。

蛇毒利刃作用范围扩大，毒素传播得更广。
Sertac of House Cilzeron is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
西尔泽隆家族的塞尔塔奇是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。

Serve as a soldier in a lord's party — enlist, take a rank, draw wages, follow the column into battle. Turn OFF to remove the feature: the option to enlist disappears, and if you are already serving you are released honourably (you keep your pay and your gear) rather than being left parked on the map. Takes effect within three in-game hours (in a battle, once it ends); no restart. Default ON.
以士兵身份加入领主的部队，获得军衔、领取军饷，并随军作战。关闭后移除此功能，参军选项会消失；如果你已在服役，会正常退役并保留军饷和装备，不会被留在地图上动弹不得。三个游戏小时内生效；若正在战斗，则在战斗结束后生效。无需重启。默认：开启。

Set me at the front and tell me when to stop, and I will stop.
把我放前头，告诉我何时停，我会停。
Set me over your stores and your accounts, and you will campaign longer on less.
让我管理你的仓库和账目，你就能用更少的东西打更久的仗。
Set me up with a forge and iron, and I will arm your people better than any smith in the south.
给我炉子和铁料，我给你手下打造的兵器，比南方任何铁匠的都好。
Set traps for the spiders of Mirkwood.
为黑森林蜘蛛布设陷阱。
Set your spear and hold the terrace wall: boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
架好长矛，守住梯田石墙：50米内的盟友获得+15%近战伤害和+10%伤害减免，持续8秒。
Set your spear in the path and hold the line: boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
在道路上架好长矛，守住阵线：50米内的盟友获得+15%近战伤害和+10%伤害减免，持续8秒。

Seven patrols had looked and found nothing. You took a different approach — you tracked not the Orcs but the things that avoided them, reading the silence in the bird calls and the gaps in the wolf tracks. The camp was where the absences converged. The Rangers cleaned it out.
七支巡逻队找过，却一无所获。你换了办法：不追奥克，而是追踪那些躲开奥克的东西，从鸟鸣中的沉默和狼迹中的空白读出位置。缺失汇聚之处就是营地。游侠随后清理了它。
Several wounded need attention before the surgeon reaches them all.
几名伤员需要照料，可军医还没来得及顾上他们。
Sevin is wife to the distant chieftain and holds his camp while he rides.
辞温是这位远方酋长的妻子，在丈夫出征时负责管理营地。

Shadows can serve the light, if properly directed...
若能善加引导，阴影亦可为光明效力……
阴影里的多古尔都议价商
Shagash of the Morzûk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
沙嘎什是莫尔祖克战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。

Shaghâna is the eastern reach of Harad, a land of sun-scorched steppes and ancient fortresses. Its nine tribal clans are fierce riders and raiders, bound together by oath and blood, who strike fear into all who dare oppose them. They answer to their Taskral, and through him to the will of Sauron.
沙加纳是哈拉德东部边境，一片烈日灼烧的草原和古老要塞之地。当地九个部族氏族都是凶悍的骑手与劫掠者，以誓言和血脉维系在一起，让所有胆敢反抗他们的人心生恐惧。他们听命于塔斯克拉尔，并通过他服从索隆的意志。

Shaghâna is the eastern reach of Harad, a land of sun-scorched steppes and ancient fortresses. Its nine tribal clans are fierce warriors, bound together by oath and blood, striking fear into those who dare oppose them.
沙加纳是哈拉德东部边境，一片烈日灼烧的草原和古老要塞之地。当地九个部族氏族都是凶悍战士，以誓言和血脉维系在一起，让胆敢反抗他们的人心生恐惧。
Shaghâna's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #DC7FA8.
沙加纳在地图上的颜色，格式为 #RRGGBB。留空使用默认值 #DC7FA8。
Shagrala was bred in the pits of Mordor and has fought her way up to a command of her own.
沙格拉拉在魔多的深坑中被培育出来，靠一次次厮杀爬到了能独自领兵的位置。
Shagrat, Captain of Cirith Ungol, guards the pass into Mordor. He is known for his cruelty even among Orcs.
“奇立斯乌苟队长”沙格拉特负责守卫通往魔多的隘口。即使在奥克中，他的残酷也出了名。
沙伊玛是欧洛芬的妻子。
Shakhal II Shakhalian rules a wealthy trading clan of the Sea of Rhun.
沙卡尔·沙卡利安二世统治着鲁恩内海沿岸一个富有的贸易氏族。
Shank can track prey across any terrain. His hunters never return empty-handed, whether pursuing game or fleeing enemies.
尚克能在任何地形中追踪猎物。无论追的是野兽还是逃敌，他的猎手从不空手而归。
Share of damage a creature takes from arrows, bolts, javelins and thrown weapons (100 = normal). Applies at once.
怪物承受箭矢、弩矢、标枪和投掷武器伤害的比例，100表示正常伤害。立即生效。
Share of damage a creature takes from blunt melee blows: maces, hammers, charges (100 = normal).
怪物承受钉锤、战锤、冲撞等近战钝伤的比例，100表示正常伤害。
Share of damage a creature takes from cutting melee blows: swords, axes (100 = normal).
怪物承受剑、斧等近战砍伤的比例，100表示正常伤害。
Share of damage a creature takes from piercing melee blows: spears, thrusts (100 = normal).
怪物承受长矛和突刺等近战刺伤的比例，100表示正常伤害。

Share of the kingdom's towns and castles above which the ruling clan loses its right to overrule the council. Vanilla lets a king with enough influence override every grant, and his pick is always himself. 1.00 = vanilla. Default: 0.34.
统治家族拥有的城镇和城堡占王国总数的比例超过此值后，会失去推翻议会决定的权利。原版国王只要影响力足够，就能否决每次封地分配，而且总会选择自己。1.00为原版。默认：0.34。
Share out {PROV_BUY_COUNT} {PROV_BUY_ITEM} among the host, buying {PROV_BUY_EXTRA} here for {PROV_BUY_GOLD} gold.
向部队分发{PROV_BUY_COUNT}份{PROV_BUY_ITEM}，在此处另买{PROV_BUY_EXTRA}份，花费{PROV_BUY_GOLD}金。
Shared loot keeps the pack loyal. -5% troop wages.
共享战利品能让狼群保持忠诚。-5% 部队工资。

Sharku, a fierce and calculating leader, commands his Uruk-hai with a blend of brute force and sharp intellect. His allegiance to Saruman drives him to crush any who oppose Isengard's might, his troops forged into a relentless war machine under his exacting standards. Gurzod's cold pragmatism and utter lack of pity make him a dreaded foe, his strategies leaving enemies broken and scattered. With every triumph, he strengthens Isengard's grip, embodying the Red Echelon's merciless resolve.
沙库是一名凶狠而善于算计的领袖，以蛮力和锐利头脑并用来指挥乌鲁克。他效忠萨茹曼，誓要碾碎一切反对艾森加德力量的人；在他的严苛标准下，部队被锻造成不知疲倦的战争机器。他冷酷务实，毫无怜悯，因此成为令人畏惧的敌人；他的战略常让敌人崩溃四散。每一次胜利都加强艾森加德的控制，也体现赤红梯队无情的决心。
Sharlug is a battle-hardened lieutenant of the Black Echelon. Her tactical instincts have saved her company from ambush many times.
沙尔卢格是黑色梯队久经战阵的副官。她的战术直觉多次让自己的连队避开伏击。
Shazga of the Grobûrz orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
沙兹加是格罗布尔兹氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。

She said I would die under the shadow of wings, and would be last of the pack. So the pack stopped sleeping next to me. One by one they took other captains, and I walked alone at the back, grinning, since there was nothing else to do with my mouth.
她说我会死在翅膀的阴影下，还会是这帮家伙里最后一个死的。从那以后，他们连睡觉都不肯挨着我，一个接一个投了别的队长。我就独自走在最后，咧着嘴笑，不笑，这张嘴还能干什么？
She-orc scorning weakness, wielding fang over fate. If more, hire me, point foes, I'll demonstrate.
女奥克，蔑视软弱，用獠牙对抗命运。想知道更多就雇我，指给我敌人，我会演示给你看。
She-orc with repute for out-bruting males. Rarity, though surprises me.
一个女奥克，名声是比雄性还凶。罕见，虽然连我自己都觉得意外。
Shelgra rides the Dagorlad as a scout-captain for the Gate, and brings back more heads than reports.
谢尔格拉是黑门的斥候队长，骑马巡视达戈拉德。她带回的人头比情报还多。
Shieldwall charge greatly reduced, the legion never yields.
盾墙充能消耗大幅降低，军团永不退让。
Shieldwall charge reduced, rallying the wall more often.
盾墙充能消耗降低，可以更频繁地重整防线。
Shieldwall duration extended, enduring the longest assaults.
盾墙持续时间延长，可以承受更久的猛攻。
Shieldwall fortifies troop armor while the wall holds.
盾墙坚守期间，会强化部队护甲。
Shieldwall grants +5% resistance and your formation holds firm against all odds.
盾墙提供 +5% 抗性，让你的阵型在绝境中仍能站稳。

盾墙作用范围扩大，可以保护更宽的阵型。

盾墙作用范围大幅扩大，形成难以突破的阵线。
Shimra is wife to the Mumak lord.
希姆拉是这位猛犸领主的妻子。
Shipwrights of Mithlond build for the West, but not all of us take the passage. Some of us walk inland instead.
米斯泷德的造船匠造船去西方，可不是每个人都会登船。有些人，反而往内陆走。
Shock troop leader demoted for excessive brutality. Seeks those who appreciate absolute methods.
因过度残暴被降职的突击部队领袖。正在寻找欣赏绝对手段的人。
Shop and horn available between waves
两波之间可使用商店和号角
Shore Gallop boosts mount resilience while active.
河岸驰骋生效期间，提高坐骑的韧性。
Shore Gallop charge greatly reduced, ride without ceasing.
河岸驰骋所需充能大幅减少，策马奔行不息。

河岸驰骋所需充能减少，可以更快发动。

河岸驰骋提供+5%近战伤害，并让战马跑得更快。

河岸驰骋的作用范围扩大，可以冲击更宽的敌军阵线。
Shore Gallop radius greatly expanded, unstoppable impact.
河岸驰骋的作用范围大幅扩大，冲击势不可挡。

Shrewd, if crooked. A good quartermaster is worth a little crookedness.
精明，虽然不太老实。好军需官，稍微有点歪心思也值得。
Siaramus commands the chariot warriors of Khand.
西亚拉穆斯统领可汗德战车战士。
围城坐骑处理（0=原版，1=预留，2=放入物品栏，3=自动恢复）
详细记录围城道具诊断
Siege commander who abandoned Mordor rather than face corrupt superiors. Leads through earned respect.
攻城指挥官，不愿面对腐败上级而抛弃魔多。靠赢得的尊重来统率部下。
Siegeberht patrols the borders of Rohan.
西格伯特巡视洛汗边境。
Sifra Bonewalker walks among the fallen after battle, collecting trophies from the slain.
“行骨者”西弗拉会在战后走到死者之间，从阵亡者身上收集战利品。
Sigga Wyrmbane earned her name slaying a great serpent in the mountain passes.
“斩龙”西加因在山口斩杀一条巨蛇而赢得这一名号。
Sigrun Boarfang is known for her fearless charges into enemy ranks.
“野猪牙”西格伦以无所畏惧地冲入敌阵而闻名。
Silenced for speaking truth, all too common.
因说出真相而被堵住嘴，这太常见了。
Silivren tends the stores and songs of Nos Malgalad alike, for in Lorien the two have never been far apart.
熙利弗仁既照管瑁加拉德家族的物资，也传承家族的歌谣。在罗瑞恩，生活与歌谣从来就密不可分。

Silmador, kinsman of Lord Rondamir and second of the hall, is reckoned the swiftest rider of the house and warden of its eastern marches toward the Mering Stream. He bears a coat of mail wrought in the smithies of Erech, bequeathed to him by his uncle who fell on the Pelennor of an older war. By his wedding to Galinwen of Pelargir he has drawn the salt-wind of the haven into the high vales. He holds, as his kinsman holds, with Denethor of the House of Húrin.
希尔玛多尔是隆达米尔领主的亲族，也是厅堂中的第二号人物，被认为是家族最快的骑手，并守卫通往梅尔林河的东部边境。他穿着一件埃瑞赫铁匠打造的锁子甲，这件甲由一位在旧日佩兰诺战场阵亡的叔父传给他。通过与佩拉基尔的加林玟成婚，他把港口的咸风引入了高地山谷。他和自己的亲族一样，支持胡林家族的德内梭尔。

Silmariel, born of the lesser house of Tarondor in Lebennin, came to Garvirionath in her twenty-second summer bringing a dowry of fair river-meadows and the loyalty of pikemen of the Five Streams. She is a lady of soft speech and unbending mind, and the hearth-hall of Amon Din has prospered under her hand. In the matter of the Steward and the claimant from the North, she counsels her lord to keep faith with Minas Tirith ere all is sundered.
西尔玛瑞尔出身莱本宁塔隆多尔小家族，二十二岁那年带着富饶河畔草地的嫁妆，以及五溪长枪兵的忠诚来到加尔维瑞昂纳斯。她说话温和，意志却不弯；阿蒙丁的炉厅在她手中日益兴旺。在宰相与北方宣称者的问题上，她劝自己的领主在一切分裂之前先守住对米那斯提力斯的信义。
Silver Rain charge greatly reduced, relentless fire.
银雨充能消耗大幅降低，可以持续倾泻箭火。

银雨充能消耗降低，可以持续压制敌人。

银雨持续时间延长，可以维持更久的齐射。

银雨生效期间，会获得额外破甲能力。

银雨提供 +5% 远程伤害，箭镞闪耀着星光。

银雨作用范围大幅扩大，箭雨让敌人无处可逃。

银雨作用范围扩大，覆盖更宽的杀伤区域。
Silver cannot steady this place beyond what it holds now.

钱用对了地方，卫队才能稳住局面。这里的忠诚度是{TAOM_WSILVER_LOYALTY}，你打算花多少？
Silvina serves in the garrison of the spider's pass.
西尔维娜在蜘蛛隘口的守军中效力。
Silvind is a shieldmaiden of the Westfold.
西尔温德是西伏尔德的盾女。

Silwen, brought in dower from a sister-house of Pelargir to the House of Eärnurionath, has the bearing of the sea-roads in her speech and the wariness of the haven-watch in her eye. She wedded Calion in the autumn of her three and thirtieth year, and to her dowry she added a chart of the southern shoals drawn by her grandsire who fell at the burning of the quays. With her husband she holds for the King returned, for she has seen, year upon year, how the Corsairs grow bold while the City waits, and waiting alone shall not now suffice.
希尔玟作为嫁妆从佩拉基尔的姐妹家族进入埃雅努瑞昂纳斯家族；她说话里带着海路的气息，眼中有港口守望者的警惕。三十三岁那年秋天，她嫁给卡利昂；除嫁妆之外，她还带来一张南方浅滩海图，那是她祖父所绘，而祖父死于码头焚毁之时。她与丈夫一样支持归来的国王，因为她年复一年看见乌姆巴尔海盗变得大胆，而白城只是等待；如今单靠等待已经不够。

Simple existence, fight, kill, win. Led assault teams against Rohan's outlying fortresses. First through the breach every time, blade red with enemy blood. My warriors followed because I never asked them to do what I wouldn't do. Earned my position through strength, not breeding or favor.
我的活法很简单：战斗，杀敌，取胜。我曾率领突击队攻打洛汗边境要塞。每次都是第一个冲进缺口，刀上满是敌人的血。我的战士追随我，因为我从不要求他们做我自己不肯做的事。我的位置靠力量赢来，不靠培育出身，也不靠偏爱。
只有一处咽喉要地聚落
Sire forged siege-engines for dark lords. I scratched runes, steady claw. Roamed pits, just us, bliss, till he rotted.
我爹曾为黑暗领主打造攻城器械。我用稳稳的爪子刻符文。我们在坑里来回奔走，只有我们俩，那日子很好，直到他腐烂死去。
Sire slain young. Dam bound to another. He coveted our pit. Hired sly goblin, law-twister.
我爹死得早。我娘被绑给了另一个家伙。他贪我们的坑，雇了个滑头半兽人，专门扭曲规矩。

Skarnak leads a company of Mordor orcs, a brutal captain who claws his way up the muster by breaking those above him. The lash and the Eye are the only laws he keeps.
斯卡纳克率领一支魔多奥克部队，是个残暴的队长。他靠打垮上级不断往上爬，只服从鞭子和魔眼。
Skarnash of the Uzgnâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯卡尔纳什是乌兹格纳什战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Skarnza of the Bûrzghâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯卡尔恩扎是布尔兹加什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Skarza of the Hrakdûr orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯卡尔扎是赫拉克杜尔氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Skill like yours should not rot unused.
你这样的箭术，不该白白荒废。

技艺精湛的贝奥恩族铁匠

Skills honed in darkness, terrible but useful.
在黑暗中磨出的本事，残酷，却有用。

跳过马匹和其他坐骑。默认：开启。
受过散兵训练的海战士。
Skraa keeps the under-cells of the Tower-guard, where the questioning is done and seldom finished quickly.
斯克拉看守塔卫的地下牢房。审讯都在那里进行，而且很少会很快结束。
Skrelga of the Skarnâk orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯克雷尔加是斯卡尔纳克氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Skrunak, chieftain of the Hrakdûr orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
斯克鲁纳克是赫拉克杜尔奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Slave trader and murderer who fled Mordor after killing his partner. Works for coin, nothing more.
奴隶贩子兼杀人犯，杀死同伙后逃离魔多。只为钱办事，仅此而已。
Slayer, she-orc as shadows whisper. Common in depths. Perhaps met kin before.
杀手，女奥克，如阴影低语般的人物。深处并不少见这种事。也许你以前见过她的亲族。
Sleeping men are not a fleet, whatever flag they sailed under.
睡着的人可不算舰队，不管他们挂什么旗。
你杀了自己的伴侣？离我远点！
Slow your steps, traveller. The desert gives nothing for free, and the road through it is ours to sell. Pay the toll, or the sand will take the rest.
慢点，过路的。沙漠里没有白拿的东西，走这里的路，也得向我们买。交过路费，不然剩下的一切就留给沙子。
超过{LEVEL}级后，学习速度降至最低
狡猾的罗瓦尼安走私贩
狡诈的黑蛮地人走私者
小额赏钱：每名士兵的金币
Smell that? Burnt iron. Good. That is my work on me.
闻到了吗？烧过的铁味。好，那是干活留下的味道。

Smelting a weapon returns at most the number set below of each iron grade, of iron ore and of hardwood, and no hardwood at all when any metal comes out. Charcoal use is unchanged. This curbs the loop of selling looted weapons as iron. Default: on.
熔炼一件武器时，每种品级的铁、铁矿石和硬木的产量，分别不超过下方上限；只要产出任何金属，就完全不产出硬木。木炭消耗不变。这能抑制靠熔炼战利品武器、出售金属反复赚钱的玩法。默认：开启。
Smoke brings rumor. A sensible lord waits for proof.
烽烟传来的不过是传言。明智的领主会等证据。
Snaga is a servant of the Shadow.
斯那嘎是黑暗势力的仆从。
Snaga riders attack in packs. +2% troop damage.
斯那嘎骑手成群发动攻击。+2% 部队伤害。
Snagash of the Morzûk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯纳嘎什是莫尔祖克战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Snagrat drives the field-gangs of Nurn from horseback, and has never once walked among the slaves he herds.
斯纳格拉特总是骑在马上，驱赶努尔恩田地里的劳工。他从未走到这些受他驱使的奴隶当中。
Snagrat of the Maughâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯纳格拉特是毛嘎什战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Snarl, I'm here to gorge, not yap. But fine, quick.
吼，我是来吃饱的，不是来闲扯的。行吧，快点说。
Snarla keeps the forges of the Ash Guard burning day and night. Her weapons arm the armies that march from Isengard.
斯纳拉让灰烬卫的熔炉日夜燃烧。她打造的武器武装着从艾森加德出征的军队。
龇牙咧嘴的半兽人打手
Snazga of the Maughâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯纳兹加是毛嘎什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Sneak-Creeping grants +5% movement speed and lets the rider vanish into Mordor's shadow.
潜行突进提供 +5% 移动速度，并让骑手消失在魔多的阴影中。
Snurga of the Gashrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯努尔加是嘎什林氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。

So I carry my lance to where it is paid for honestly. The war the Taskral is raising will need men who do not break, and I have never broken at anything. Let others fight for a cause. I fight to be the best, and to be paid like it.
所以我把骑枪带到能诚实付钱的地方。塔斯克拉尔正在掀起的战争需要不会崩溃的人，而我从未在任何事上崩溃过。让别人为了事业战斗吧。我战斗是为了成为最强，也为了拿到配得上最强的报酬。

So I carry my reckoning elsewhere. A war-band is only a small House, and it runs on the same arithmetic: coin in, coin out, and no waste. The Dark Lord's war will ruin the careless and enrich the precise. I intend to be precise, and to serve someone who values it.
所以我把自己的算账本事带到了别处。一支战团不过是个小家族，也遵循同样的算术：钱进来，钱出去，不许浪费。黑暗魔君的战争会毁掉粗心的人，也会让精明的人发财。我打算继续精明，也打算为懂得重视它的人效力。

So I carry my sword to where loyalty still means something. I am young, I know, and I have seen one hard year where older men have seen twenty. But I keep my word past breaking, and a captain who can trust the man at his back has something many lords would envy. I would be that man for you.
所以我把剑带到忠诚仍有意义的地方。我知道自己年轻，也知道年长者见过二十个艰难年头，而我只见过一个。但我会守信到最后一刻，而一个能信任背后之人的队长，拥有许多领主都会羡慕的东西。我愿为你做那个人。
So I do neither. I walk, I eat, and I keep a count of every grey-feathered arrow I find. When I have enough, I will walk up to Mithlond's gate and ask for the patrol-captain.
那我就一样也不干。我走路、吃饭，捡到一支灰羽箭就记下一支。等攒够了，我会走到米斯泷德大门前，点名找那个巡逻队长。

So I drift, and there is always need for a man who knows horseflesh and how to acquire it quietly. The tribes are mustering and good mounts will be worth their weight in silver soon. I would rather break and tend them than steal them, if the work is honest enough.
所以我到处漂泊。总有人需要一个懂马，也懂得如何悄无声息弄到马的人。各部族正在集结，好马很快就会比等重的银子还值钱。若这活儿足够正当，我更愿意驯养并照料它们，而不是偷它们。

So I drill other men's companies now, and choose lords who fight like soldiers rather than butchers. The Dark Lord's war will be no gentle thing, I know. But there is a difference between a hard war and a foul one, and I will only lend my craft to the former.
所以如今我训练别人的连队，也选择那些像士兵而不是屠夫一样作战的领主。我知道黑暗魔君的战争不会温和。但艰苦的战争和肮脏的战争并不是一回事，我只会把手艺借给前者。

So I keep my own counsel and my own oath now, and sell my sword only to those who will not make me ashamed to draw it. There is a war coming that will swallow honest men whole. I would rather choose where I spend mine.
所以如今我只听自己的判断，也守自己的誓言，只把剑卖给那些不会让我羞于拔剑的人。一场战争正在逼近，它会把诚实的人整个吞下去。我宁愿自己选择把命花在哪里。
So I left before he finished the sum. Honor is a tale for the dead. A plan is what lives, and mine are still good.
所以他还没算完，我就走了。荣誉是讲给死人听的，计划才让人活着。我的计划照样管用。

So I left the beasts I loved rather than watch them die for nothing, and that grief rides with me still. I know warfare and I know command, but I have no taste for throwing lives, beast or man, away for show. Give me a captain who spends his strength wisely, and I will serve him well.
所以我宁愿离开自己爱的巨兽，也不愿看着它们白白死去，而这份悲伤至今仍跟着我。我懂战争，也懂指挥，但我不愿把生命，无论野兽还是人，拿去做给别人看。给我一个懂得明智使用力量的队长，我就会好好为他效力。
So I left, and I have been unlucky in a wider world ever since. Strange, though: the arrows still miss me. Perhaps the doom is waiting for something larger.
我就走了，从那以后，换了更大的天地倒霉。倒也奇怪，箭还是射不中我。也许那场灾还在等更大的事。

So I rebuild, the only way I know, by making myself useful to someone with a war to fund. The Dark Lord's muster will bankrupt the foolish and enrich the shrewd, and I have learned, expensively, how to tell them apart. Let me keep your army in the field, and I will keep myself in coin.
所以我用自己唯一懂的方法重建一切：让自己对某个需要军费的人有用。黑暗魔君的征召会让蠢人破产，也会让精明人发财，而我用昂贵的代价学会了分辨两者。让我让你的军队留在战场上，我也会让自己继续有钱可赚。

So I sold some of it. A Bree-land gang paid well to learn which wagons carried ore and which carried silver, and when to expect them. It went smoothly for three seasons, until the Bree watch took the gang and the gang named its friends. My house struck my name from its rolls before the warden could send for me.
所以我卖了点消息。布理乡的一个匪帮肯出好价钱，打听哪辆车装矿石、哪辆装银子，什么时候会到。三个季度都顺顺当当，后来布理卫队抓了他们，他们就把朋友的名字都供了。守将还没来传我，家族就先把我除名了。
So be it. Form up, as we were taught. If this is the end, it is at least a soldier's end.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
那就这样吧。按教过的办法列阵！如果今天就是最后一天，至少让我们像士兵一样死。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
So be it. I will tell you what you want to know.
好吧，我告诉你想知道的事。
So here I am, a watchman without a ford, holding a tally nobody wants. I keep it anyway, in case a better council ever asks.
所以我到了这儿，成了个没渡口可守的卫兵，攥着一本谁都不想要的账。我还是接着记，万一哪天有个像样的议事会肯问呢。
So here I am, a watchman without a harbor, holding a ledger nobody wants. I keep the tally anyway, in case a better council ever asks.
所以我到了这儿，成了个没港口可守的卫兵，攥着一本谁都不想要的账。我还是接着记，万一哪天有个像样的议事会肯问呢。
So here I am, a watchman without a town, holding a ledger nobody wants. I keep the tally anyway, in case a better council ever asks.
所以我到了这儿，成了个没城镇可守的卫兵，攥着一本谁都不想要的账。我还是接着记，万一哪天有个像样的议事会肯问呢。

So my craft is for hire, on either side of a wall. With the Dark Lord's war coming, every lord will want his strongholds sound and his enemy's breached. I am too old to climb the ladders, but I can tell you precisely where to set them. Or where to fear them set against you.
所以我的手艺现在可以雇用，墙的哪一边都行。黑暗魔君的战争将至，每个领主都希望自己的要塞牢固，也希望敌人的城墙被攻破。我太老了，爬不上攻城梯，但我能准确告诉你该把梯子架在哪里，或者该害怕敌人把梯子架在哪里。

So my learning travels with me now. A captain who can read a captured order, parse a treaty, or know an enemy lord's blood-claims has an edge over one who cannot. The Dark Lord's war is fought with words and lineages as much as spears, and I can fight on that ground at least.
所以如今我的学问跟着我旅行。一个队长若能读懂缴获的命令、解析条约，或知道敌方领主的血统主张，就比做不到这些的人更有优势。黑暗魔君的战争既用文字和血脉来打，也用长矛来打，至少在那片战场上，我能出力。

So my talents are on the market, for those with the stomach to use them. In war, a forged order in the right hands is worth a thousand spears in the wrong place. I do not pretend my trade is honest, but it is effective, and the Dark Lord's war will have ample need of it.
所以我的才能现在摆在市场上，给那些有胆量使用它们的人。战争中，一份落到合适人手里的伪造命令，胜过一千支站错地方的长矛。我不假装自己的行当诚实，但它很有效，而黑暗魔君的战争会非常需要它。
So you choose the sword. The dunes have swallowed greater hosts than yours.
这么说，你选了刀剑。比你庞大得多的军队，也被这些沙丘吞没过。
So you nurse a grudge and call it thrift.
你只是心怀怨恨，却管它叫节俭。
索哈泰是瓦赫拉坦的妻子。

Rather than submit to punishment for being right, I took my gear and left. Strength should be rewarded, not punished.

Take a chance on me and I will repay it. I only ask that the cause be one I can stomach.
给我一次机会，我会报答你。我只要求这份事业别让我反胃。
Take a soldier after your hero falls
Take an enemy lord prisoner in battle and the deed is done. You will be richly rewarded.
在战斗中俘虏一名敌方领主，任务就算完成。你会得到丰厚的奖赏。
Take it, then. The shame is yours, not mine.
拿去吧。丢脸的是你，不是我。
Take me along and I will bring your enemies' walls down; if the doom comes, it will find a bigger prize than me standing next to you.
带上我，我能弄塌敌人的城墙。厄运真来了，站你旁边，总能找到比我更大的目标。

带我同行吧。我能替你找到食物，赢来好感，也结交可靠的盟友。
Take me on and I will put an arrow wherever you point. Do not ask me for more than that.
雇我吧，你指哪儿，我的箭就射到哪儿。别指望我做别的。
Take me on and your wounded will walk again, the ones who can.
雇我吧。你的伤员里，只要还有希望的，我就让他们重新站起来。
Take me on, and I swear to report only what happened. Mostly.

Take me on, and I will find you what your enemies hide, and keep my hands to myself, mostly.
雇我吧，我能替你找出敌人藏着的东西，也会管住自己的手。大致上会。
Take me with you, and I will find you provisions, goodwill and honest allies.
带我同行吧。我能替你找到补给，赢来好感，也结交可靠的盟友。
Take me with you. I see what is behind the next ridge.
带上我。我能看出下道山脊后面有什么。
Take me. I know every unguarded door in the old halls.
带上我，古老大厅里哪道门没人守，我都知道。

Takes the giant spiders out of the game. Spider riders ride wargs instead. New volunteers, upgrades and the Elite Emissary no longer lead to a spider troop, and spider troops leave the encyclopedia and the Custom Battle troop list. Spider broods leave the campaign map, most within a day. The rest applies the next time you start or load a game. Spider troops that already exist stay, on wargs: in parties, garrisons, prisons and volunteer slots. Fords of War still offers its Spider Riders, on wargs. Lore text, and cobwebs in some scenes, stay. Default: off.
移除游戏中的巨型蜘蛛，蜘蛛骑兵改骑座狼。新招募的兵员、升级路线和精锐招募使者不再提供蜘蛛兵种，百科和自定义战斗的兵种列表也会移除这些兵种。战役地图上的蜘蛛群会陆续离开，大部分在一天内消失；其他效果在下次新开或载入游戏时应用。现存蜘蛛士兵仍保留在部队、驻军、监狱和待招募兵位中，但改骑座狼。渡口之战仍提供蜘蛛骑兵，同样改骑座狼。背景文本和部分场景中的蛛网不变。默认：关闭。

Talborin, fifty winters told, wedded into the House of Olindurionath out of a kindred-hall of the Langstrand, and he bears upon his shield the grey gull of his fathers quartered with the device of his wife's line. In his youth he sailed with the watch-galleys that ward the long coast against the corsair sail, and a scar of that work yet runs from his temple to his jaw. He stands with his house for the King returned, for he has watched too many years of vigilance go unrewarded by the lords of the inland City.
塔尔博林今年五十岁，来自长滩的一个家族，后来与奥林杜瑞昂纳斯家族联姻。他盾牌上四分的纹章同时绘有父辈的灰鸥和妻子家族的标志。年轻时，他曾随巡逻桨帆船守卫漫长的海岸，抵御海盗船袭击；那段岁月留下的伤疤至今仍从太阳穴延伸到下颌。他与家族一起支持归来的国王，因为他亲眼见过，海岸守军多年的警戒与坚守，始终没有得到内陆白城诸领主应有的回报。

Talendir, twin-brother to Orweniel, is fourteen and the hope of Baranionath, fair-haired after his mother and grey-eyed after his sire. He rides daily upon the strand at Edhellond and is taught the sword by old men who served his grandfather. In the quarrel of these days he knows only that his father stands with the Steward, and that is enough.
塔伦迪尔是奥玟妮尔的孪生兄弟，十四岁，是巴拉尼昂纳斯的希望。他继承母亲的金发和父亲的灰眼，每天在埃蒂尔泷德海岸骑马，由曾侍奉祖父的老人教授剑术。对于当下的纷争，他只知道父亲站在宰相一边，而这已经足够。
Talk is cheap, and I do not give it away. But for you I will make an exception.

Talk, talk. Fine. How much shiny? Show us, and be fast, the cold makes us cruel.[ib:hip][rf:convo_angry]
说啊说的。行吧，有多少亮闪闪的？拿出来，快点，天一冷，我们下手可更狠。[ib:hip][rf:convo_angry]

Tamir of House Mithruntai is counted among the keen horse-archers of Rhûn, loosing his shafts from the saddle at a full gallop.

Terrace Wall radius increased, empowering more warriors.
梯田壁垒的作用范围扩大，更多战士获得增益。
Terror finishes more men than steel does.
被恐惧毁掉的人，比刀剑杀的还多。

Tests alternative swing clips: when a mission has act_taom_ swing codes loaded, it counts which clip each swing plays and where in the clip a hit lands, and only logs; it changes nothing in the game. While such codes exist it costs a per-frame sweep of every person in every mission, towns included; with none loaded it writes one log line per mission. Read at the start of each mission.
测试替代挥击动画：任务加载了act_taom_挥击代码时，统计每次挥击实际播放的动画片段，以及命中发生在片段的哪个位置。只写日志，不改游戏行为。只要存在这些代码，就需要每帧扫描各任务中的所有人物，包括城镇场景；没有加载时，每个任务只写一条日志。在每个任务开始时读取此设置。
卡拉斯加拉松的沙理安
Thalion, a mighty warrior, channels the strength of ancient heroes, defending the clan's star-gazing clearings from nocturnal assaults.
沙理安是一名强大的战士，承载古代英雄的力量，守卫族人观星的林间空地，抵挡夜间袭击。
Thalka, a ritual master, performs sacrifices, empowering the clan with Sauron's dark rites.
萨尔卡是仪式大师，主持献祭，用索隆的黑暗仪式强化氏族。
Thalka, a web strategist, plans entanglements, trapping foes in Dol Guldur's schemes.
萨尔卡是蛛网战术家，专门布置缠绕陷阱，把敌人困进多古尔都的阴谋里。
Thalrug serves as a cavalry orc rider, commanding warg packs akin to those in the Battle of Five Armies. His swift strikes harass foes from afar, extending Gundabad's reach.
萨尔鲁格是奥克骑兵，统率类似五军之战中出现的座狼群。他的快速打击从远处骚扰敌人，也把贡达巴德的触手伸得更远。
Thamza leads caravans across the desert wastes.
萨姆扎带领商队穿越沙漠荒原。
Thandirion, Warden-captain of the Naith, commands the hidden crossings of the Celebrant and answers only to the Lord and Lady of the Galadhrim.
桑迪瑞安是耐斯的守卫队长，负责守住凯勒布兰特河上隐秘的渡口，只听命于加拉兹民的领主和夫人。
Thanes of the plains hold small halls and large pride. When a hall falls, its lord rides on with nothing but his name.
平原上的领主，厅堂虽小，傲气却大。厅堂一倒，主人继续骑行，除了名字什么也不剩。
Thank you. I mean it, and I hate that I do. Name an offer. We have not eaten properly in a week.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
谢谢，是真心的。可我真恨自己落到了这一步。你出多少？我们一周没吃顿像样的饭了。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
Thank you. I will not forget this kindness.
谢谢你。我不会忘记这份恩情。
Thank you. That is kind of you.

Tharzog, a shrewd and savage leader, commands his Uruk-hai with a ruthless efficiency that embodies Isengard's dark might. His loyalty to Saruman is matched by his cunning, orchestrating battles with a keen eye for exploiting any flaw in his enemies' defenses. Bruzgash's harsh demeanor and unrelenting drive inspire dread in both allies and foes, his forces a relentless tide of destruction. Under his banner, the Black Echelon spreads fear, furthering Saruman's dominion with every brutal conquest.
萨尔佐格是一名精明而野蛮的领袖，以无情的效率指挥乌鲁克，体现艾森加德的黑暗力量。他对萨茹曼的忠诚与他的狡猾同样深厚，能以敏锐眼光发现敌方防线的每一处破绽。他严酷而执着，让盟友和敌人都感到恐惧；他的部队像毁灭的潮水般不断推进。在他的旗帜下，黑色梯队散播恐惧，并以每一次残暴征服扩张萨茹曼的统治。
That boon is not on offer.
当前没有这项祝福可选。
That cannot be done just now.
That cannot be done now. Speak to me of it another time.
现在还办不到，改天再来谈吧。
That chieftain burned two of our steadings the year before, and I would shoot him again. But the warden wants scouts who keep their word to goblins, so I sell my eyes and my bolts elsewhere.
那个酋长前一年烧了我们两处农庄，再来一次，我照样射死它。可守将要的斥候，连对半兽人也得守信，我就把眼力和弩箭卖到别处去。
That command cannot be given now.
现在无法下达这项命令。
That companion could not be discharged right now.
现在无法撤去这名同伴的任命。

That day shattered my world. A rival goblin clan from the depths assaulted us, seeking our forges and slaves. They slew my dam and the brute I was bound to serve. Our lair burned, treasures looted. The survivors scattered into the frozen peaks.
那一天毁掉了我的世界。一个来自深处的敌对半兽人氏族袭击了我们，想抢我们的锻炉和奴隶。他们杀了我娘，也杀了那个我被迫侍奉的蛮横东西。我们的巢穴被烧，财宝被抢。幸存者逃散进冰封山峰。
That feeds us until the first frost. You are kinder than the Steward ever was to us. Go on, and keep your head down.
这些够我们吃到初霜了。你比宰相对我们还好。走吧，路上低调些。
That hero is already in the field.
That is a generous thought. Bring them forward and let us see them.
你可真慷慨，带他们过来，让我们看看。
这里已经叫这个名字了。
That keeps the fires lit through the winter. Go on, and tell the valley lords the hills still have owners.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
这下冬天的炉火有着落了。走吧，告诉谷地那些领主，这些山还是有主的。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
That lane already has packs waiting.
That market will not have us just now.
那个集市现在不肯接待我们。
That order is still cooling down.
That pack is not for sale.
That party has no room for so many.
那支部队容不下这么多士兵。
That was a generous thing to give away.
能让出这样的东西，你真慷慨。

The AI builds a Guard House in its towns and castles ahead of other buildings: always while it has none, and about 60 percent of the time while it can still be upgraded (guardHousePriorityChance in castle_patrols.json). Your own fiefs are never touched. Default: on.
AI会优先在城镇和城堡建造卫兵营房：尚未建造时始终优先；仍可升级时，约有60%的概率优先升级，概率由castle_patrols.json中的guardHousePriorityChance设置。不会改动你自己的封地。默认：开启。
The Anduin flows dark, and strange ships sail at night...
安都因河暗流涌动，奇怪的船只在夜间航行……

The Axemen of Erebor are veterans of King Thorin's battles who found peacetime ill-suited to their temperament. Trained in the close-quarter fighting of the Dwarven halls — shield wall, short axe, mattock — they are formidable on any terrain but excel in the mountain passes that connect Erebor to the kingdoms of men. They take contracts from any who can afford their fee, but will not raise an axe against Erebor or Rivendell.
孤山斧兵是曾跟随梭林国王作战的老兵，和平生活并不合他们的脾气。他们受过矮人厅堂近身战训练，精通盾墙、短斧和鹤嘴锄，在任何地形上都很难对付，尤其擅长在连接孤山与人类王国的山道上作战。他们会接受任何付得起酬金者的雇佣，但绝不会向孤山或幽谷举斧。

The Bardings of Dale, descendants of Bard the Bowman, are a proud and industrious people living in the shadow of Erebor. Renowned for their skilled archers and disciplined warriors, they safeguard their thriving city and the trade routes of the north. United by a strong sense of community and honor, the Bardings stand firm against the darkness threatening their lands.
河谷邦的巴德一族是神箭手巴德的后裔，生活在孤山阴影之下，是骄傲而勤勉的人民。他们以熟练弓手和纪律严明的战士闻名，守护繁荣的城市和北方贸易道路。巴德一族重视共同体和荣誉，在威胁家园的黑暗面前坚定不退。

The Bardings of Dale, named for Bard the Bowman, are a proud and industrious people who rose to prominence after reclaiming their homeland from the shadow of Smaug. Nestled between the Lonely Mountain and the Long Lake, Dale thrives as a hub of trade and culture. Known for their resilience and craftsmanship, the Bardings excel in forging weapons and armor, rivaling even the Dwarves of Erebor. Their armies, composed of disciplined archers, stalwart swordsmen, and agile skirmishers, defend their lands with fierce determination. United under noble leaders, the Bardings are ever watchful, guarding against the encroaching darkness and preserving their rich heritage.
河谷邦的巴德一族得名于“神箭手”巴德。他们骄傲而勤勉，在摆脱斯毛格的阴影、夺回家园之后崛起。坐落在孤山与长湖之间的河谷城，是贸易与文化的中心。巴德一族坚韧顽强，工艺精湛，尤其擅长锻造武器和铠甲，足以与孤山矮人媲美。他们的军队由纪律严明的弓手、坚定的剑士和敏捷的散兵组成，始终坚决保卫自己的土地。在高贵领袖的团结下，他们警惕着逼近的黑暗，守护着深厚的文化传承。

The Beornings and the Woodmen of the Vales hold the upper Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood, with the Carrock and the Old Ford as their keys. Farmers, herdsmen and honey-keepers, they stand apart from the War of the Ring, but the orcs and wolves of the mountains test their few halls every year.
贝奥恩一族和安都因河谷的林中居民守着迷雾山脉与黑森林之间的安都因河上游，以卡尔岩和老渡口为要地。他们种地、放牧、养蜂，置身魔戒大战之外，但山中的奥克与狼每年都会侵扰他们为数不多的厅堂。

The Beornings and the Woodmen of the Vales hold the upper Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood. They keep the High Pass and the Old Ford open for honest travellers and take a heavy toll of orcs and wolves. Their chieftains hold Beorn's Hall and the Carrock and want no part in the wars of kings.
贝奥恩一族和安都因河谷的林中居民守着迷雾山脉与黑森林之间的安都因河上游。他们保障高隘口和老渡口畅通，让正派的旅人安全通行，也让奥克与狼付出惨重代价。他们的酋长掌握着贝奥恩大厅和卡尔岩，不愿卷入诸王的战争。

The Beornings are the great woodmen who dwell in the vale of the Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood, led by the skin-changers of Beorn's line. They allow no Orc to cross their territory, charge a toll at the Ford of Carrock to fund their watch, and answer to no king in Middle-earth. Though they will trade and talk with Elves and Dwarves, any army that marches through their forest without leave will find that the Beornings have very large teeth.
贝奥恩一族是居住在安都因河谷的高大林中人，生活在迷雾山脉与黑森林之间，由贝奥恩血脉中的换皮人统领。他们不准任何奥克穿越自己的领地，并在卡尔岩渡口收取通行费来维持守望；他们也不向中洲任何国王效忠。虽然他们会与精灵和矮人贸易交谈，但任何未经许可便穿过其森林的军队，都会发现贝奥恩一族的牙齿非常大。

The Beornings keep the upper vale of the Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood, a folk of farmers, herdsmen and honey-keepers who share the river meadows with the Woodmen of the Vales. They hold the Carrock and the Old Ford, take no toll from honest travellers and a heavy one from orcs and wolves. Their chieftains are chosen for strength and plain speech, and they follow no king into a war that is not their own.
贝奥恩一族守着迷雾山脉与黑森林之间的安都因河上游，与河谷中的林中居民共享河畔草甸。他们种地、放牧、养蜂，掌握着卡尔岩和老渡口，不向正派的旅人收取过路费，却会让奥克与狼付出惨重代价。酋长凭力量和坦诚赢得推举，他们不会跟随任何国王卷入与自己无关的战争。
The Betrayer was once a king in the East before his corruption.
背叛者曾是东方的一位国王，最终堕入腐化。
The Black Númenóreans remember when they ruled, and some still hunger for power...
黑努门诺尔人还记得自己曾经统治过什么，有些人至今仍渴望权力……

The Blind Eye is a brotherhood of smugglers, fences, and hired killers operating across the coasts of Harad and the deep desert. They are said to descend from a cult of assassins who served a forgotten Haradrim king, and their methods — poison, shadow, and the leveraging of secrets — remain unchanged. Lords who wish to quietly remove a rival, or merchants who need cargo moved without customs inspection, know where to leave a gold coin and a sealed letter.
盲眼会是一个由走私者、销赃者和雇佣杀手组成的兄弟会，在哈拉德海岸和深漠中活动。据说他们源自一个侍奉过被遗忘哈拉德国王的刺客教团，他们的方法至今未变，仍是毒药、阴影和秘密勒索。想悄悄除掉对手的领主，或需要货物避开关税检查的商人，都知道该把金币和密封信件留在哪里。

The Broadbeams closed the hospice doors to me, and no house in the Blue Mountains will cross them for a bone-setter. So I walk the Dwarf-road with my satchel and sell what I know to whoever has wounded to mend.
宽梁族不许我再进医馆，而蓝色山脉没有哪家肯为一个接骨师得罪他们。我便背着药包走上矮人路，谁有伤员要治，我就把本事卖给谁。
The Broadbeams of Belegost stood against a dragon once. We have not forgotten how to stand...
贝烈戈斯特的宽梁族曾顶住过巨龙。该怎么站稳，我们还没忘……
德鲁怀斯伊阿乌诸氏族。

The Corsair Blades are veteran sea-fighters from the harbours of Umbar who have taken to selling their skills on land. They fight as crossbowmen — the preferred arm of shipboard warfare — and are as comfortable in a siege as they are on a rolling deck. Their captain, a scarred Númenórean exile, keeps them to their contracts with iron discipline, knowing that their reputation is their most valuable cargo.
海盗刀锋是来自乌姆巴尔港口的老练海战者，如今把自己的本事卖到陆地上。他们作为弩手作战，弩正是登船战最偏爱的武器；他们在围城战中和在摇晃甲板上一样自在。他们的船长是一名满脸伤疤的努门诺尔流亡者，以铁一般的纪律让部下遵守契约，因为他知道名声才是他们最有价值的货物。
The Corsairs of Umbar sail to {settlement}!

The Corsairs of Umbar, seafaring raiders and master sailors, are a ruthless and cunning people allied with Sauron. Known for their swift ships and relentless naval warfare, they strike fear into the coastlines of Middle-earth. Proud of their maritime heritage, they bring the chaos of the seas to the land, raiding and pillaging in the name of their dark alliances.
乌姆巴尔的海盗是海上劫掠者，也是老练的水手；他们残酷狡诈，并与索隆结盟。他们以迅捷船只和毫不留情的海战闻名，让中洲的海岸线人人畏惧。他们为自己的航海传统而自豪，把海上的混乱带上陆地，以黑暗盟约之名劫掠和掠夺。
The Creator? You mean you shaped all of this?
创造者？你的意思是，这一切都是你塑造的？

The Cult of the Lidless Eye is a secret society rooted in the Black Númenórean tradition, venerating Sauron as a god-king who will restore his faithful to glory when he rises again. They recruit among the dispossessed of Dunland and the forgotten corners of the realm, promising divine favour and earthly power. In truth, their leaders answer to agents of Barad-dûr, and their cell-based structure makes them nearly impossible for any lord's justice to eradicate.
无睑魔眼教团是一个扎根于黑努门诺尔传统的秘密结社，他们把索隆敬为神王，相信当他再次崛起时，会让忠信者重返荣耀。他们从黑蛮地失去一切的人，以及王国被遗忘的角落中招募成员，许诺神恩与尘世权力。事实上，他们的领袖听命于巴拉督尔的密探，而他们以小据点分散运作的结构，也让任何领主的审判都几乎无法将其铲除。
The Dark Lord is pleased. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
黑暗魔君对你的表现很满意。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
The Dark Lord's eye sweeps the field. Voice radius +5.
黑暗魔君之眼扫过战场。至尊魔戒之声作用范围 +5。
The Dark Marshall commands the Nazgûl in battle, second only to the Witch-King.
黑暗元帅在战场上统领那兹古尔，地位仅次于安格玛巫王。
The Defense of the East Bank

The Drúedain, known to Men as Woses or the Wild Men of the Woods, are an ancient people who dwell in the deep forest of Drúadan and the hidden valleys of the White Mountains. They clear ground with fire, grow what they need on the ash-rich soil, and move on when the land is spent — a way of life the settled peoples of Middle-earth have never understood and never bothered to. The Drúedain want no lord, pay no tax, and ask only to be left to the forest's silence.
德鲁伊甸人被人类称为野人或林中野人，是居住在德鲁阿丹森林深处和白色山脉隐秘谷地中的古老民族。他们用火清理土地，在富含灰烬的土壤上种出所需作物，土地耗尽后便继续迁徙。这种生活方式，中洲的定居民族从未理解，也从未愿意理解。德鲁伊甸人不要领主，不纳税，只希望别人让他们留在森林的寂静中。

The Dunedain watched the Shire from beyond its borders, but sometimes information required closer observation. You entered, spent three days moving through the farmland, gathered what was needed, and left without disturbing a single garden gate. The Hobbits never knew. That was the point.
杜内丹在夏尔边界之外守望，但有些情报需要更近观察。你进入其中，在农田间行动三天，收集所需信息，然后没有惊动任何一扇花园门便离开了。霍比特人从不知道。这正是重点。

The Dunlending Reavers are the broken remnant of a hill-clan that once dwelt in the valleys now ruled by the Rohirrim. Their grandfathers were driven from fertile land into the rocky heights, and they have nursed that bitterness into a raider's philosophy: everything taken from a southron or a king's man is merely the restoration of what was stolen. In practice they are brigands, but dangerous ones who know every goat-track through the hills.
黑蛮地劫掠者是一个破碎山地氏族的残余，他们曾居住在如今由洛希尔人统治的山谷里。他们的祖父被从肥沃土地赶进岩石高地，而他们把这份怨恨酿成了劫掠者的信条：从南方人或王家人手里夺走的一切，都只是取回被偷走的东西。实际上他们是强盗，但也是危险的强盗，熟悉山中每一条羊道。

The Dunlendings are a rugged and fierce people, dwelling in the wild hills and untamed lands west of Rohan. Long resentful of the Rohirrim, whom they see as invaders of their ancestral homes, the Dunlendings are united by their shared heritage and fierce independence. Skilled in guerrilla warfare and survival, they rely on cunning and ferocity to overcome their enemies. Though often dismissed as simple hill folk, the Dunlendings are a proud and enduring people, fiercely protective of their lands and ways of life. Driven by a deep-seated grudge against Rohan, they have allied themselves with the forces of darkness, seeking revenge and the restoration of their lost lands.
黑蛮地人粗犷凶悍，居住在洛汗以西荒凉的丘陵和未开垦的土地上。他们长期怨恨洛希尔人，认为对方是侵占祖传家园的侵略者。共同的传承和对独立的坚决追求将各部团结在一起。他们擅长游击战，也精于在荒野中生存，靠机智与凶悍击败敌人。外人常以为他们只是普通山民，却没看见他们的骄傲与坚忍。他们会拼命捍卫自己的土地和生活方式。对洛汗根深蒂固的仇恨，促使他们与黑暗势力结盟，希望报仇并夺回失地。
The Dunlendings move like mountain goats. +8% party movement speed.
黑蛮地人能像山羊一样穿行山地。+8% 部队移动速度。

The Dunlendings, fierce hillmen of the western highlands, are a proud and ancient people. Resentful of the Rohirrim, they are known for their guerilla tactics and tenacity in battle. United under strong leaders, they fight for their survival and to reclaim the lands they believe are rightfully theirs.
黑蛮地人是西部高地上强悍的山民，也是一个骄傲而古老的民族。他们怨恨洛希尔人，擅长游击战，在战斗中极其顽强。只要有强有力的首领把他们团结起来，他们就会为了生存而战，也为了夺回他们认为本该属于自己的土地而战。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that Blue Craig used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在蓝岩冬季掠袭必经的山口筑起工事，封住了通路，让山中的族人整整一季都没能外出抢掠。你策划进攻，亲自带领先锋，一次冲锋就撞开了哨站大门。山口重新畅通，矮人再也没有回来。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that Goblin-town used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在半兽人镇冬季掠袭必经的山口筑起工事，封住了通路，让山中的族人整整一季都没能外出抢掠。你策划进攻，亲自带领先锋，一次冲锋就撞开了哨站大门。山口重新畅通，矮人再也没有回来。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that Gundabad used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在贡达巴德冬季劫掠常用的一处山口筑起工事，切断通路，让山中少了整整一季掠获。你规划突击，率领先锋，一次冲击便撞开前哨大门。山口重新开放，矮人再没回来。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that the Misty Mountains used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在迷雾山脉冬季掠袭必经的山口筑起工事，封住了通路，让山中的族人整整一季都没能外出抢掠。你策划进攻，亲自带领先锋，一次冲锋就撞开了哨站大门。山口重新畅通，矮人再也没有回来。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and Blue Craig needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人正在灰色山脉绘制地图，蓝岩需要弄清他们在测绘什么。你悄悄跟着他们穿过高处的山口，等他们扎营后偷走地图，在他们发出警报前就回到了要塞。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and Goblin-town needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人正在灰色山脉绘制地图，半兽人镇需要弄清他们在测绘什么。你悄悄跟着他们穿过高处的山口，等他们扎营后偷走地图，在他们发出警报前就回到了要塞。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and Gundabad needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人在灰色山脉测绘某些东西，而贡达巴德必须知道他们在做什么。你无声跟随他们穿过高山口，等他们扎营后拿走地图，并在他们发出警报前回到要塞。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and the Misty Mountains needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人正在灰色山脉绘制地图，迷雾山脉的族人需要弄清他们在测绘什么。你悄悄跟着他们穿过高处的山口，等他们扎营后偷走地图，在他们发出警报前就回到了要塞。

The Dúnedain of Arthedain are the last heirs of Arnor, the North-kingdom Elendil founded. From Fornost upon the North Downs the line of Arvedui still keeps the watch that Isildur's heirs have kept for a thousand years, though their towns are few, their lords are poor and the shadow of Angmar never leaves the hills. They are fewer than their southern kin and prouder than their numbers warrant, and every season the wild lands press closer.
阿塞丹的杜内丹人是阿尔诺最后的继承者，那是埃兰迪尔建立的北方王国。阿维杜伊的后人依然在北岗上的佛诺斯特坚守，延续着伊熙尔杜的继承者千年来的守望，只是城镇已所剩无几，领主贫困，安格玛的阴影始终笼罩丘陵。他们比南方的同族更少，却有着与人数不相称的骄傲，而荒野正一季又一季地向他们逼近。

The Dúnedain of Cardolan hold the south of old Arnor, the plains and river country between the Baranduin and the Greyflood. Their kings lie in the barrows of Tyrn Gorthad, their barges still come up to Tharbad, and their riders are the best of the three northern kingdoms. Their towns are few and their lords quarrel with Arthedain and Rhudaur over the old crown, while the wild lands grow bolder every year.
卡多蓝的杜内丹人守着古代阿尔诺的南部，也就是巴兰都因河与灰水河之间的平原和沿河地带。他们的历代国王长眠于提殒戈沙德的古冢，驳船仍驶向沙巴德，骑兵则是北方三个王国中最出色的。这里城镇稀少，领主们为古老的王冠与阿塞丹、鲁道尔争执不休，而荒野的威胁一年比一年猖獗。
The East Road companies hold the way between Last Bridge and the Trollshaws for the king. We are sworn to each other, and the Gundabad raiders have given many of us cause for hatred.
东西大道的守军替国王守着最后大桥到食人妖森林的道路。我们彼此立过誓，而贡达巴德的劫掠者，让我们很多人都有了恨他们的理由。

The Easterlings are a diverse and fearsome people from the distant lands of Rhûn. Known for their loyalty to Sauron, they march to war with precision and discipline, wielding curved blades, spears, and massive war-drums that echo across the battlefield. Their golden armor and crimson banners reflect their fierce pride and martial prowess. Divided into clans and tribes, the Easterlings unite under powerful chieftains to bring the might of Rhûn against the Free Peoples of Middle-earth.
东夷来自遥远的鲁恩，族群众多，作战凶悍。他们以对索隆的忠诚闻名，军纪严明，步伐整齐。他们手持弯刀和长矛，巨大战鼓的轰鸣在战场上回荡。金色铠甲与猩红战旗展现出他们的自豪和精湛武艺。他们分属不同的氏族和部落，却会在强大首领的号令下联合起来，将鲁恩的力量投入与中洲自由人民的战斗。

The Easterlings are a proud and disciplined people, hailing from the vast eastern lands beyond Mordor. Renowned for their resilience and mastery of warfare, they are both farmers and warriors, blending agrarian traditions with a fierce martial culture. Their armies are known for their fearsome cavalry, adorned in ornate armor and carrying deadly spears and bows. With a rich heritage of craftsmanship and loyalty to their kin, the Easterlings march to war under vibrant banners of gold and crimson, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies. Their allegiance to Sauron has made them a formidable force, uniting under his shadow to expand their dominion across Middle-earth.
东夷来自魔多以东辽阔的土地，是骄傲而纪律严明的民族。他们以坚韧和精通战争闻名，既是农民也是战士，把农耕传统和强悍的尚武文化结合在一起。他们的军队以可怖的骑兵著称，战士身披华丽盔甲，手持致命的长矛和弓箭。东夷有深厚的工艺传统，也忠于自己的族人；他们在金红相间的鲜明旗帜下奔赴战场，让敌人心生畏惧。他们效忠索隆，因此成为一股强大的力量，在他的阴影下联合起来，试图把统治扩展到中洲各地。

The Easterlings of the eastern plains. A deep-rooted steppe cavalry tradition pairs with the Easterling Outriders' speed and the Easterling Host's numbers. Heavy cavalry that arrives in force, bringing tribute as well as spears.
东部平原上的东夷人，将根深蒂固的草原骑兵传统与东夷游骑兵的速度、东夷大军的人数优势结合起来。重骑兵成群到来，带来的不只有长矛，还有贡赋。
The Elven Volley is fully upgraded.
The Elven Volley is loosed during a wave.
只能在敌军进攻时发动精灵齐射。
The Elven Volley is not ready yet.

The Elven border wardens had held the approach for two seasons. You identified the gap in their rotation, timed your crossing to the minute, and brought your patrol through and back without a casualty. The shadow-masters noted your report and gave you a permanent command.
精灵边境守卫已经守住这条通道两个季节。你发现他们轮换中的空隙，把越界时间精确到分钟，并带着巡逻队毫发无损地穿过去又回来。阴影大师记下了你的报告，并给了你永久指挥权。

The Elves of Lothlórien, known as the Galadhrim, are a noble and enigmatic people dwelling in the Golden Wood. Guided by the wisdom and power of Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn, they are guardians of one of the last bastions of elven beauty and tranquility in Middle-earth. The Galadhrim are unmatched archers, blending seamlessly with the golden Mallorn trees of their homeland.
洛丝罗瑞恩的精灵被称为加拉兹民，是居住在金色森林中的高贵而神秘的族群。在加拉德瑞尔夫人和凯勒博恩领主的智慧与力量引导下，他们守护着中洲最后几处仍保有精灵之美与宁静的堡垒。加拉兹民是无可匹敌的弓手，能与故土金色的瑁珑树融为一体。
The Elves of Rivendell march to {settlement}!

The Elves pay well and check little, or so I thought. For two years my bars to Harlond carried a core of slag under good iron, until a shipwright of the Havens split one on his anvil. The Elves shut their quays to Thorin's Halls for a season, and the merchants' guild handed me to the king to open them again.
精灵出价高，又不怎么查货，至少我原来这么想。两年里，我送到哈泷德的铁条，都是外包好铁、内填矿渣。后来灰港一个造船匠在铁砧上敲开了一根。精灵整整一季不准梭林大厅的船靠码头，商人行会为了让码头重开，就把我交给了国王。
The Enemy uses such weakness against us.
敌人利用了我们的这种弱点。
The Eotheod are faster than legend. +8% party movement speed.
伊奥希奥德的速度胜过传说。+8% 部队移动速度。
The Eotheod ride the wind itself. +5% movement speed.
伊奥希奥德仿佛乘风而行。+5% 移动速度。
The Eye of Sauron has turned upon you. {HUNTER} rides out with a host to destroy you.
索隆之眼已盯上你。{HUNTER}正率领大军前来消灭你。

The Falathrim of Lindon are the last of the Sindar shipwrights, dwelling at Mithlond where the Gulf of Lune meets the sea. Círdan has kept the Grey Havens since the First Age, and it is from his quays that the white ships pass into the West.
林顿的法拉斯民是最后一批辛达族造船者，居住在路恩湾通向大海的米斯泷德。自第一纪元起，奇尔丹便一直守护着灰港，白船从他的码头启航，驶向西方。
The Felling of the Dark Wood

The Firebeard dwarves broke through from below, and a flood of mine-water came with them. The smelters went cold, fire to steam in one breath. Forty of my forge-brothers boiled. I carried the last of the good ore out on my back, and the overseer took it, and took my hammer too.
火须族矮人从下方打通了过来，矿井里的水也跟着涌进来。一口气的工夫，熔炉就灭了，烈火变成蒸汽，四十个锻坊兄弟被活活烫死。我背出最后一批好矿石，监工拿走矿石，还拿走了我的锤子。

The Galadhrim needed to know how many were garrisoned at the southern fortress before any action was planned. You volunteered to go and look. You were gone six days. What you brought back gave Galadriel the information she needed to make her decision.
加拉兹民需要在行动前知道南方要塞驻扎了多少人。你自愿前去查看，离开六天。你带回的情报给了加拉德瑞尔作出决定所需的信息。

The Galadhrim of Lothlórien, dwellers of the Golden Wood, are an ethereal and noble people led by Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn. Masters of archery and woodland warfare, they guard their enchanted realm with unmatched skill. Their loyalty to their kin and homeland is unwavering, and their subtle magic preserves Lothlórien as a sanctuary of hope and light amidst the growing shadow.
洛丝罗瑞恩的加拉兹民居住在金色森林中，是由加拉德瑞尔夫人和凯勒博恩领主统领的高贵精灵。他们精通弓术和林地战法，以无可匹敌的技艺守卫这片受祝福的国度。他们对族人和家园的忠诚从不动摇，而他们细腻的魔力让洛丝罗瑞恩在日渐扩大的阴影中仍是一处希望与光明的庇护所。

The Goblins of Goblin-town swarm the tunnels beneath the High Pass of the Misty Mountains. Cowardly alone but overwhelming in number, they breed endlessly in the dark and pour out to ambush travellers on the mountain roads. Under their Great Goblin and his captains they harry Elves, Dwarves, and Men alike, serving the growing Shadow for plunder and spite.
半兽人镇的半兽人挤满了迷雾山脉高隘口下方的隧道。他们单独行动时胆怯，但数量足以压倒敌人；他们在黑暗中无休止地繁殖，涌出洞穴伏击山路上的旅人。在半兽人王和其头目的统领下，他们骚扰精灵、矮人和人类，为日渐壮大的阴影效力，也为了掠夺与恶意而战。

The Goblins of the Ered Luin are a teeming, vicious rabble dwelling in the warrens of Blue Craig. Led by their Great Goblin and petty captains, they raid the mountain roads without end, driven by greed and an ancient hatred of the Free Peoples.
埃瑞德路因的半兽人数量众多、凶残成性，挤在蓝岩纵横交错的洞穴里。在半兽人王和众多小头目的率领下，他们受贪欲和对自由人民的古老仇恨驱使，不断劫掠山间道路上的行人。

The Goblins of the High Pass are a teeming, vicious rabble dwelling in the warrens of Goblin-town. Led by their Great Goblin and petty captains, they raid the mountain roads without end, driven by greed and an ancient hatred of the Free Peoples.
高隘口半兽人是居住在半兽人镇巢穴中的庞大而凶恶的乌合之众。他们由半兽人王和小队长统领，无休止地劫掠山路，受贪婪和对自由人民的古老仇恨驱使。
