The Goblins of the High Pass swarm the tunnels beneath the Misty Mountains, the spawn of the host the Great Goblin once led against dwarf and wayfarer alike. Numberless and vicious, they pour from Goblin-town to raid the mountain roads.
高隘口的半兽人在迷雾山脉下方的隧道中蜂拥而动，他们是半兽人王昔日率领、同时袭击矮人与旅人的那支大军的余孽。他们数量众多，凶狠恶毒，从半兽人镇涌出，劫掠山路。

The Golden Flower earned its glory through deeds, not words. My blade sings with centuries of elven technique, and my oath binds me to protect all free peoples. I would bring that same dedication to your company.
金花家族的荣耀靠的是行动，不是言辞。我的剑承载着数百年的精灵技艺，我的誓言也约束我守护所有自由人民。我愿把同样的忠诚带到你的队伍中。

The Golden Flower once stood against the greatest darkness and fell with honor. We who bear their name now must ensure their sacrifice was not in vain. Beauty, wisdom, and valor - these are our watchwords.
金花家族曾经直面最深的黑暗，最终在英勇的战斗中覆灭。如今沿用这个名字的我们，不能让他们的牺牲白费。美、智慧与勇气，是我们牢记的信条。
The Golden Flower? That order fell long ago in Gondolin...
金花家族？那个骑士团不是早已在刚多林陷落了吗……

The Golden Wood lies nestled between the Silverlode and the mighty Anduin. Guarded by the will of Galadriel and Celeborn, it stands as a bastion of Elven grace and defiance - a land untouched by time, where the leaves do not fall.
金色森林坐落在银脉河与浩荡的安都因河之间。它受加拉德瑞尔与凯勒博恩的意志守护，是精灵优雅与抗争的堡垒，一片仿佛不受时间触及、叶子也不会凋落的土地。

The Golden Wood, realm of Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn. Wardens of Lorien defend the mallorn-forests cheaply; Lembas Bread sustains every march; Elven Harmony keeps morale unshakable. Timeless Craft means every change is slow.
金色森林是加拉德瑞尔夫人和凯勒博恩领主的国度。罗瑞恩守卫能以较低成本守护瑁珑林；兰巴斯面包供养每一次行军；精灵和谐让士气不可动摇。永恒工艺意味着任何改变都很缓慢。

The Gondorian square had held through three direct assaults and the battle-lord was considering withdrawal. You identified the timing of their shield rotation, requested the flanking cavalry, and committed the charge at exactly the right moment. The square broke. The battle was won.
刚铎方阵撑过三次正面突击，战领已在考虑撤退。你看准他们盾牌轮换的时机，请求调动侧翼骑兵，并在正好的一刻投入冲锋。方阵崩溃，战斗获胜。

The Gondorians, descendants of the Númenórean exiles, are the proud stewards of the greatest kingdom of Men in Middle-earth. Known for their towering stone fortresses and unwavering courage, Gondor is a bastion of hope against the looming shadow of Mordor. Its disciplined armies, comprised of valiant infantry, skilled archers, and mounted knights, stand as a shield for all free peoples. Guided by noble stewards and captains, the Gondorians hold fast to their traditions, unyielding in their duty to protect the realm and its legacy.
刚铎人是努门诺尔流亡者的后裔，也是中洲最伟大人类王国的骄傲守护者。刚铎以高耸石砌堡垒和不屈勇气闻名，是抵挡魔多阴影的希望堡垒。它纪律严明的军队由英勇步兵、熟练弓手和骑士组成，是所有自由人民的盾牌。在高贵宰相和将领的引领下，刚铎人坚守传统，毫不退缩地履行守护王国和传承的职责。

The Great Goblin's tithe-collector took half my kill-share every moon. Said it was the chief's right. One night the share was short. I shot him from the shelf, clean, in the throat, and watched him fall down the steps. Nobody saw. Everybody knew.
半兽人王的收税人每个月都要拿走我一半的击杀分成，说是酋长应得的。一天晚上，分到手的少了，我就在岩台上给了他一箭，正中喉咙，看着他滚下台阶。没人看见，人人都知道。
The Greenway companies hold the road between Bree and the Barrow-downs for the king. We are sworn to each other, and the Gundabad raiders have given many of us cause for hatred.
绿大道的守军替国王守着布理到古冢岗的道路。我们彼此立过誓，而贡达巴德的劫掠者，让我们很多人都有了恨他们的理由。
The Greenway companies hold the road from Sarn Ford to Tharbad for the king. We are sworn to each other, and the Dunlending raiders have given many of us cause for hatred.
绿大道的守军替国王守着萨恩渡口到沙巴德的道路。我们彼此立过誓，而黑蛮地的劫掠者，让我们很多人都有了恨他们的理由。

The Grey Company are the last organised brotherhood of the Dúnedain Rangers, descendants of the kings of Arnor who lost their kingdom ages ago. They ride across the North without a home of their own, keeping the peace in lands that have forgotten their names. Though their first loyalty is to the line of Elendil, they take contracts from lords across Middle-earth when their wandering brings them through civilised lands.
灰衣劲旅是杜内丹游侠最后一支有组织的兄弟会，他们是久远年代失去王国的阿尔诺诸王后裔。他们没有自己的家园，骑马穿行北方，在那些已经忘记他们姓名的土地上维持安宁。虽然他们最忠于埃兰迪尔一脉，但流浪经过文明土地时，也会接受中洲各地领主的雇佣。

The Gundabad Orcs of the Misty Mountains are savage and relentless. From the ancient stronghold of Mount Gundabad, they raid the surrounding lands, driven by a thirst for vengeance and conquest. Under the rule of powerful chieftains, they amass legions of goblins, wargs, and trolls. Gundabad's warriors are brutish and cunning, masters of ambush and overwhelming force.
迷雾山脉的贡达巴德奥克野蛮而残忍。他们从贡达巴德山这座古老要塞出发，袭扰周边土地，被复仇与征服的渴望驱使。在强大酋长的统治下，他们聚集起半兽人、座狼和食人妖组成的大军。贡达巴德战士既蛮横又狡诈，擅长伏击和以数量压倒敌人。

The Haradrim are a proud and fierce people hailing from the deserts and savannahs of the distant south. Renowned for their mastery of exotic beasts such as mûmakil, their warriors combine skill, resilience, and deadly precision in battle. Harad is a land of extremes, with its scorching sun, golden sands, and vibrant oases. Its people are united by ancient traditions, loyalty to their tribes, and the call of their chieftains and kings. Often allied with the forces of darkness, the Haradrim are driven by vengeance against Gondor and the promise of power and dominion offered by Sauron.

哈拉德是位于刚铎以南的广袤之地，地域辽阔多样，既有炽热的沙漠，也有郁郁葱葱的丛林与富饶的绿洲。其地貌如其民族般多元，绵延的沙丘与纵横的河流交织成壮丽的景观。哈拉德的历史源远流长，雄伟的古城与堡垒遍布其间，昔日的统治者之名仍回荡在传说之中。哈拉德怀斯大沙漠将北部边疆与腹地分隔，而南方沿岸的港口与海盗活动频繁。如今，在索隆的旗帜下，众多部族与王国团结一体，将他们深厚的传统与勇武精神化为战争的力量，使这片充满活力的土地成为文化与征伐的交汇之地。

The Haradrim host moved toward Gondor and you rode at the front of the war-column, fighting the skirmishes that cleared the way. When the great battle came you were among those whose name the Black Serpent knew when it was over — for those who survived to tell him.
哈拉德人大军向刚铎推进，你骑在战斗纵队前列，参与清路的小规模战斗。大战结束时，黑蛇记住了你的名字，至少那些活着能告诉他的人会这么说。

The Haradrim of Harwan, sons of the sun. A long desert heritage underlies the Sons of the Sun +10% speed bonus and the Haradrim Warbands' larger numbers, built on a thriving caravan economy. Mumakil rule the southern plains.
哈拉德的哈拉德林是太阳之子。悠久的沙漠生活赋予太阳之子10%的速度加成，繁荣的商队经济则支撑起人数众多的哈拉德林战帮。猛犸主宰着南方平原。

The Haradrim, warriors of the southern deserts, are a fierce and resilient people allied with Sauron. Known for their exotic war beasts and skilled cavalry, they march to war under crimson banners. Proud and deeply rooted in their traditions, they bring the savagery of the desert to the battlefields of Middle-earth.
哈拉德人是南方沙漠中的战士，也是与索隆结盟的强悍民族。他们以异域战兽和精锐骑兵闻名，在深红旗帜下踏上战场。他们骄傲而深深扎根于自身传统，把沙漠的凶悍带到中洲的战场上。
The Havens learned who held the pen, and I left before the council finished its sentence. I still have the silver. I find I cannot spend it.
灰港查到了绘图的人。议会还没念完判决，我就离开了。白银还在我手里，可我发现，自己花不下去。

The Hill-Men of Dunland, ancient enemies of the Rohirrim. Generations in the deep woods and high moors shaped the Hill Marchers and Hill-Tribe Levies, cheap, fast, angry warbands that march on plain and forest alike. Their smiths are slow, but their warbands are not.
黑蛮地的山民是洛希尔人世代的仇敌。深林与高原上的生活，造就了山地行军兵和山地部落征召兵：他们成本低、行军快、满怀怒火，无论平原还是森林都能前进。他们的铁匠动作慢，战帮却不慢。
The Houses of Healing grow crowded, yet fewer healers remain...
诊疗院被越来越多的伤员塞满，可医生总是短缺……
The Iron Hills breed warriors as hard as the metal they're named for...
铁丘陵孕育出的战士，像那片土地名字里的金属一样坚硬……

The Iron Hills dwarves caught us at a ford. I gave them the wounded and the weak flank, bought an hour, and marched the rest away. Thirty-one stayed behind in the mud. The captain saw the count and called it murder.
铁丘陵的矮人在渡口截住我们。我把伤兵和薄弱的侧翼丢给他们，换来一个小时，带着剩下的人撤走。三十一个留在泥里。队长看了伤亡数，说这是谋杀。
The King's guard of Vidugard rides at his side in every hall and on every field. When the court rots, some of us ride away.
维杜加德的王家卫士，无论在厅堂还是战场，都随侍国王身侧。可王廷腐烂时，我们有些人会骑马离开。

The King, in his befuddled state, stripped me of lands and title. My own people were told I was a traitor. Now I wander, a thane without a hall, seeking to restore my name through deeds since words failed me.
国王神志昏沉，就这样剥夺了我的土地和头衔。我的子民被告知我是叛徒。如今我四处流浪，成了没有厅堂的领主；言辞已经救不了我，我只能靠行动恢复名誉。

The King, once mighty, now sits grey and weary while Aldwulf whispers poison. I heard orders given that made no sense: troops withdrawn from threatened borders, supplies sent to uncertain destinations.
国王过去威风凛凛，如今却一脸灰败、满身疲惫地坐着，任阿尔德伍尔夫在耳边灌毒。我听过一些毫无道理的命令：从受威胁的边境撤军，把补给送到不明去处。

The King, trusting his steward, stripped me of lands and title. My own people were told I was a traitor. Now I wander, a thane without a hall, seeking to restore my name through deeds since words failed me.
国王信他的总管，夺了我的土地和头衔，还告诉我的百姓，我是叛徒。如今我成了没有厅堂的领主，到处流浪。既然说话洗不清名声，我就靠行动把它挣回来。
The Knight of Umbar was once a lord of the Corsairs before taking the Ring.
乌姆巴尔骑士曾是海盗领主，后来接受了那枚戒指。
The Lady of the Wood is grateful. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
森林夫人感谢你的援助。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
The Last Stand at the Carrock

The Lindon watch laid a net for me at the river-mouth. I saw the white sails too late. I let the second boat take the arrows and slipped away with the first. The second boat's crew were mine for nine years, and they drowned in the shallows within sight of land.
林顿守卫在河口给我设了个圈套，我发现白帆时已经晚了。我让第二条船挡箭，自己乘第一条溜了。第二条船的人跟了我九年，最后淹死在看得见岸的浅水里。
The Lonely Mountain is reclaimed, but not all dwarves found peace in its halls...
孤山已经被夺回，但不是所有矮人都在它的大厅里找到了安宁……

The Lonely Mountain reclaimed. Master Smiths cut smithing energy by 30%; Dwarven Honor adds loyalty every day; Dwarven Stubbornness keeps morale unshakable. Slow to build a wall — but the wall holds until the mountain itself falls.
孤山已经被夺回。工匠大师让锻造精力消耗减少 30%；矮人荣誉每天增加忠诚；矮人固执让士气不可动摇。他们修墙很慢，但墙一旦建成，就会坚守到山本身崩塌为止。

The Lonely Mountain, Erebor, stands as the greatest of the Dwarven kingdoms in the north. Rich in gold and mithril, it is home to the line of Durin. The Dwarves of Erebor are renowned craftsmen and fierce warriors, their halls echoing with the songs of their ancestors.
孤山，又称埃瑞博山，是北方最伟大的矮人王国。这里盛产黄金和秘银，也是都林一脉的家园。孤山的矮人以精湛工艺和勇猛善战闻名，他们的厅堂中回荡着祖先的歌声。
The Lonely Mountain. My kin hold its halls again, and the forges burn day and night. Ask me again once we have shared more fires.
孤山。我的族人又回到了那里的厅堂，锻炉日夜不熄。等我们再一起度过几个围坐营火的夜晚，你再来问我吧。
The Long Defeat could not start. The log has the reason.
无法启动漫长的败仗，具体原因见日志。
The Long Defeat has no fortress to defend. Check long_defeat/fortresses.json.
漫长的败仗没有可防守的要塞，请检查long_defeat/fortresses.json。
The Long Defeat needs the game client and cannot start here.
漫长的败仗需要游戏客户端，无法在此启动。
The Long Lake's +10% village grain and the Lake-town Muster's -50% army influence cost come together; relationship penalty +20% on kingdom decisions.
长湖让村庄谷物产量增加10%，长湖镇集结让组建军团的影响力花费降低50%；王国决策造成的关系惩罚增加20%。

The Longbeards came in force and the shift-boss ordered the tunnel sealed. I refused. I stood in the gap with the haft and held it until the roof came down on half my crew. The boss lived. He called it my doing.
长须族大举进攻，工头下令封死地道，我不肯。我抡着镐柄堵住缺口，撑到顶上塌下来，压住半数工友。工头活了，还说全是我干的。

The Longbeards of Erebor are a proud and industrious race, dwelling in the halls of the Lonely Mountain. Masters of craftsmanship and mining, they are renowned for their skill in forging weapons, armor, and treasures of unrivaled beauty. Led by their King under the Mountain, the dwarves of Erebor are a resilient people, fiercely protective of their homeland and its riches.
孤山的长须族是骄傲而勤劳的矮人，居住在孤山深处的厅堂中。他们精于工艺与采矿，善于打造武器、盔甲和精美无比的珍宝。在山下之王的统领下，孤山矮人坚韧不屈，誓死守护家园与财富。
The Lost? That's an ominous title for a Haradrim.
迷途者？对哈拉德人来说，这称号可不太吉利。
The Mark needs warriors who won't be silenced.
马克需要不会被堵住嘴的战士。
The Mark wastes half its strength ignoring women warriors.
马克无视女战士，是在浪费自己一半的力量。
The Mark's finest guardian. +12% battle renown gain.
马克最优秀的守护者。+12% 战斗声望获取。

The Men of Dorwinion tend the vineyards on the warm slopes above the Sea of Rhûn, and their wine goes up the Redwater and the River Running to the halls of Elves and Men far to the west. They are vintners, boatmen and river traders, a Northman folk who would rather sell to a stranger than fight him. Their king keeps his court at Vineholm, and every year the Easterlings across the inland sea look harder at his rich and lightly guarded land.
多温尼安人在鲁恩内海上方温暖的山坡经营葡萄园，葡萄酒沿红水河与奔流河运往遥远西方的精灵和人类厅堂。他们是酒商、船夫和沿河贸易商，也是北方人的一支，比起打仗，更愿意向陌生人卖东西。他们的国王在葡萄洲设立王庭，而内海对岸的东夷一年比一年觊觎这片富饶而守备薄弱的土地。
The Mouth of Sauron speaks with the Dark Lord's authority. Once a Black Numenorean, he has forgotten his own name after ages of service to evil. He commands the garrison of the Black Gate.
索隆之口以黑暗魔君的权威发言。他曾是黑努门诺尔人，但在漫长的邪恶侍奉中早已忘记自己的本名。如今他统领黑门守军。

The Mouth's Servants are the Eyes of Barad-dûr operating beyond the Black Gate — informants, enforcers, and spies embedded among the peoples bordering Mordor. Where Sauron's armies cannot yet reach, these agents collect tribute and silence dissent. They work through bribery, blackmail, and quiet murder, ensuring that no conspiracy against the Dark Lord takes root before it is uprooted and crushed.
索隆之口的仆从是在黑门之外活动的巴拉督尔之眼，他们是线人、执行者和间谍，潜伏在魔多边境各族之中。在索隆的军队尚未抵达之处，这些密探负责征收贡赋并压制异议。他们依靠贿赂、勒索和无声谋杀行事，确保任何反对黑暗魔君的阴谋都来不及扎根，便被连根拔起并碾碎。

The Necromancer's inspectors had rejected two previous batches from the fortress's smiths. You reworked the smelting process, accepted no compromise on the quench, and delivered a batch that the inspector examined in silence before marking as approved. It was the first such approval in three years.
死灵法师的检验官已经退回要塞铁匠两批成品。你重做熔炼流程，对淬火不作任何妥协，交出的一批武器让检验官沉默检查后盖上合格标记。这是三年来第一次合格。

The Necromancer's southern hold in Mirkwood. Shadow Command rallies hordes at almost no influence; Dark Conscription drills militia veterans; Shadow Captains swell the one town to twenty notables. Voracious Hordes eat as much as they slay.
多古尔都是死灵法师在黑森林南部的据点。阴影指挥能几乎不耗影响力地召集部落；黑暗征兵会训练老兵民兵；阴影队长让唯一的城镇膨胀到二十名要人。贪婪部落吃得和杀得一样多。

The Noldor Elves of Rivendell are a wise and ancient people, renowned for their unmatched knowledge, artistry, and valor. Under the guidance of Lord Elrond, they preserve the fading beauty and lore of the Elder Days within the hidden sanctuary of Imladris. Masters of both the sword and the bow, the Noldor combine martial skill with the grace and precision of their kind.
幽谷的诺多精灵古老而睿智，以无人能及的学识、艺术和勇气闻名。在埃尔隆德领主的指引下，他们在这处隐秘的庇护所中保存着远古时代渐渐消逝的美与知识。诺多精灵精通剑术与弓术，将出色的武艺与精灵一族的优雅、精准融为一体。
The North owes your people more than it knows.
北方人欠你们太多了，只是他们自己不知道。
The Northmen are faster than legend. +8% party movement speed.
北方人行军之快，胜过传说。+8%部队移动速度。
The Northmen crash over the enemy like a wave. +6% troop damage.
北方人如浪潮般冲垮敌军。+6%部队伤害。

The Northmen of South Rhovanion ride the wide plains between the southern eaves of Mirkwood and the Brown Lands, a free people of horse-breeders who count the Éothéod of the north as their kin. Their fathers were the lords of the Northmen in the days of the old kings, and the barrows of those kings still stand on the grasslands. Twice the Wainriders came out of the East with wagon and fire and broke them, and the riders of the plains have not forgotten it.
南罗瓦尼安的北方人在黑森林南部边缘与褐地之间的辽阔平原上驰骋。他们以养马为生，崇尚自由，视北方的伊奥希奥德为同族。古代诸王在位时，他们的祖先曾是北方人的领主，那些国王的古冢至今仍矗立在草原上。战车民曾两次带着大车与烈火从东方而来，摧毁了他们的家园，平原上的骑手至今没有忘记。

The Northmen of South Rhovanion ride the wide plains between the southern eaves of Mirkwood and the Sea of Rhûn. They are horse-lords, kin of the Éothéod who rode north long ago, and they have not forgotten the Wainriders who once burned their halls. Their kings hold Vidugard and owe no lord in the West or the East.
南罗瓦尼安的北方人在黑森林南部边缘与鲁恩内海之间的辽阔平原上驰骋。他们是驭马者，与很久以前向北迁徙的伊奥希奥德同源，至今没有忘记战车民焚烧厅堂的往事。他们的国王统治维杜加德，不向西方或东方的任何领主效忠。
The Northmen ride the wind itself. +5% movement speed.
北方人如同乘风而行。+5%移动速度。
The Old Forest Road from Woodmen-town to the Forest Gate is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，沿老密林路从林中居民镇到森林之门，比看起来远得多。
The One's blessing shields the faithful. +5 health.
至尊魔戒的赐福庇护着虔诚的信徒。+5 生命值。
The One's eye is upon you. +8% resistance to ranged.
至尊魔戒之眼正注视着你。+8% 远程抗性。

The Orc scouts had slipped the outer markers and were moving toward the heart of the wood. You picked them out of the darkness from sixty yards — three shots, three falls, no alarm given. The patrol found them in the morning and could not tell from which direction the arrows had come.
奥克斥候越过外围标记，正向森林心脏移动。你在六十码外的黑暗中找出他们，三箭三倒，没有响起警报。巡逻队清晨找到尸体时，甚至看不出箭从哪个方向射来。

The Orcs of Gundabad, residing in the mist-shrouded mountains, are a brutal and savage force. Led by their warlords, they wage endless raids on neighboring lands. Driven by hatred and cruelty, they are relentless in their quest to dominate the north.
贡达巴德奥克居住在雾气笼罩的群山中，是残暴而野蛮的力量。在军阀统领下，他们不断袭击周边土地。仇恨与残忍驱使着他们，让他们执着于支配北方。

The Orcs of Mordor are a brutal and relentless force, bred in the dark pits of Barad-dûr to serve the will of Sauron. Cruel and savage, they march to war in endless hordes, wielding crude but deadly weapons forged in the fires of Mount Doom. Clad in jagged armor and bearing black banners emblazoned with the Red Eye, they bring fear and destruction wherever they tread. Bound by the iron will of their Dark Lord, the Orcs of Mordor are divided into warbands led by ruthless captains, united only in their desire for conquest.
魔多奥克是在巴拉督尔黑暗深坑中孕育出的残暴军队，只为服从索隆的意志。他们残忍而野蛮，成群结队奔赴战场，挥舞着在末日山烈焰中锻造的粗糙凶器。他们身披锯齿般的甲胄，举着绘有红眼的黑旗，所到之处只留下恐惧与毁灭。在黑暗魔君的铁腕之下，魔多奥克分成由残酷头目率领的战团，只因征服欲望而暂时团结。

The Orcs of the Misty Mountains are a brutal and numberless host of the high peaks. Led by their warlords, they wage endless raids on the lands below, relentless in their cruelty and their hunger for conquest.
迷雾山脉奥克是高峰之上的残暴大军，数量多到难以计数。他们由各自战领统率，无休止地劫掠山下土地，残忍而贪婪，从不停止征服的欲望。

The Orcs of the Misty Mountains are a savage war-host dwelling among the high peaks and deep places of the range. Driven by an ancient hatred of Elves and Dwarves, they muster vast and ill-armed legions and fall upon the lands below, serving the dark powers that stir in the East.
迷雾山脉奥克是盘踞在群峰与深穴中的野蛮战群。出于对精灵和矮人的古老仇恨，他们集结起庞大但装备粗劣的军团，扑向山下诸地，为东方正在苏醒的黑暗力量效力。
The Order of the Silver Swan taught me that wisdom and warfare go hand in hand. Every mountain pass marked, every river crossing noted - these save more lives than any single sword stroke.
银天鹅骑士团教会我，智慧与战争本就相辅相成。每一条山口、每一处渡河点，只要标注清楚，救下的人命就可能比一次挥剑更多。
The Pathfinder? That's an intriguing title.
探路者？这个称号倒是有意思。
The Provender-master's cut at Trade 250. Never read above the largest cut. Between 0 and 90. Default: 10.
军需官交易技能达到250时收取的佣金比例。实际采用的数值不会高于最高佣金。范围：0至90。默认：10。

The Provender-master's cut, in percent of a town's price, when you send goods to be sold there and the Provender-master has no Trade skill. It falls to the smallest cut at Trade 250, and each town further down the list adds 5. Between 0 and 90. Default: 30.
把货物送到城镇出售时，若军需官的交易技能为0，按城镇售价的此百分比收取佣金。交易技能达到250时，降至最低佣金；城镇在列表中每靠后一位，再增加5个百分点。范围：0至90。默认：30。

The Ranger patrol was three days from help when a rock fall crippled two members. You set the worst injuries, built shelter from what the mountain offered, and kept the party alive for eleven days until the rescue party found you. Everyone came home.
游侠巡逻队距援助还有三天路程时，落石砸伤两名成员。你固定最严重的伤处，用山中能提供的材料搭建庇护所，让队伍撑了十一天，直到救援找到你们。所有人都回来了。
The Rangers of the North, the last of Númenor's blood in the wild. We guard the Shire and the roads, and no one thanks us for it. We prefer it so.
北方游民，荒野中最后的努门诺尔后裔。我们守护夏尔和道路，却没人为此道谢。我们更喜欢这样。

The Riddermark of the Horse-lords. Horse-lord Heritage cheapens every mounted recruit and upgrade; Riders of the Mark cuts mounted wages; Horse-lord Fellowship binds the Mark in loyalty. Cavalry Dependent — parties heavy with infantry slow to a crawl.
这里是驭马者的里德马克。“驭马者传承”降低骑乘兵种的招募和升级费用；“马克骑手”降低骑兵工资；“驭马者同袍情谊”则增强马克人民的忠诚。但他们也依赖骑兵：部队中步兵过多，就会走得十分缓慢。
The Riders of Rohan ride to {settlement}!
The Rohirrim crash over the enemy like a wave. +6% troop damage.
洛希尔人如浪潮般冲垮敌军。+6% 部队伤害。
The Rohirrim sing of your courage! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
洛希尔人会歌颂你的勇气！影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。

The Rohirrim, known as the Horse-lords, are the proud and noble people of Rohan, a realm of wide open plains and rolling hills. They are renowned for their skill as riders and their unmatched cavalry, which forms the backbone of their military strength. Living in a tightly-knit feudal society, the Rohirrim are led by a king and a loyal nobility who are bound by honor and tradition to protect their land and people. They are fiercely independent, valuing freedom above all, and their warriors are trained to fight with spears, swords, and bows, all while astride their powerful steeds.
洛希尔人以驭马者之名闻名，是洛汗骄傲而高贵的人民。洛汗由辽阔平原和起伏丘陵组成，他们以精湛骑术和无可匹敌的骑兵著称，骑兵也是他们军力的核心。洛希尔人生活在紧密的封建社会中，由国王和忠诚贵族统领，他们以荣誉和传统守护自己的土地与人民。他们极其重视自由，战士们善用长矛、刀剑和弓箭，也能在强健战马背上作战。

The Rohirrim, or Horse-lords of Rohan, are renowned for their unmatched cavalry and deep bond with their steeds. Proud and free-spirited, they dwell in the rolling plains of the Riddermark, living in villages and strongholds like Edoras. Guided by their King and loyal to their people, the Rohirrim prize honor, loyalty, and courage. Their warriors ride fearlessly into battle, forming the backbone of Middle-earth’s resistance against the shadow. Though steadfast in their traditions, the Rohirrim are ever ready to defend their land and allies, wielding spears, swords, and shields with precision.
洛希尔人也被称为洛汗的驭马者，以无可匹敌的骑兵和与战马之间的深厚感情闻名。他们骄傲而向往自由，生活在里德马克起伏的平原上，居住在村落和埃多拉斯这样的要塞中。洛希尔人服从国王的领导，忠于自己的人民，重视荣誉、忠诚和勇气。他们的战士无畏地策马迎敌，是中洲抵抗阴影的重要力量。他们坚守传统，也随时准备以娴熟的矛术、剑术和盾术保卫家园与盟友。

The Sand-Riders are the nomadic desert clans of the deep Harad interior, masters of the waterless wastes between the Ephel Dúath and the distant southern sea. They range across routes known only to themselves, demanding tribute from any caravan bold enough to cross their territory. The settled lords of Near Harad treat them as a nuisance; the Sand-Riders consider the settled lords thieves who stole what the desert had already given freely.
沙骑者是哈拉德内陆深处的游牧沙漠氏族，掌握着埃斐尔度阿斯与遥远南海之间的无水荒原。他们沿着只有自己知道的路线游走，向任何胆敢穿越其领地的商队索要贡赋。近哈拉德的定居领主把他们视为麻烦；沙骑者则认为那些定居领主才是小偷，偷走了沙漠本已无偿赐下的东西。
The Seat of Seeing failed and is off until this scene ends. Your own view is back.
观望之椅发生错误，已停用至本场景结束。已恢复你的正常视角。

The Serpent Guard are mounted soldiers in the service of the Serpentlord of Near Harad. Bred in the saddle on the rolling plains south of the Ephel Dúath, they are unmatched as horse-archers in all of Middle-earth's southern lands. In times of peace between Harad and Mordor, the Guard hires its services to Haradrim lords and to any other power rich enough to afford their golden fee.
巨蛇卫队是为近哈拉德巨蛇领主效力的骑兵。他们从小就在埃斐尔度阿斯以南起伏平原的马背上长大，是中洲南方诸地无可匹敌的骑射手。在哈拉德与魔多和平时期，卫队会向哈拉德领主，以及任何付得起高昂酬金的势力出租武力。
The Serpent Lord is satisfied. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
巨蛇领主对你很满意。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
The Shadow of Umbar haunts the southern coasts.
乌姆巴尔之影徘徊在南方海岸。
The Shadow of the Northmen hunts in the cold lands.
北方人之影在寒冷土地上游猎。
The Shadow: enemy towers fire a quarter slower.
暗影：敌方防御塔射速降低四分之一。

The Shaghâna are a fierce tribal people of the eastern Harad steppes, renowned as relentless raiders and skilled horsemen. Bound by oath and clan, they answer to their Taskral and serve the dark designs of Sauron from their sun-scorched fortresses.
沙加纳人是哈拉德东部草原上的凶悍部族民族，以不知疲倦的劫掠者和熟练骑手闻名。他们受誓言和氏族约束，听命于塔斯克拉尔，从烈日灼烧的要塞中为索隆的黑暗谋划效力。

The Silvan Elves of Mirkwood, also known as the Woodland Realm, are a proud and resilient people who call the vast forest their home. Ruled by King Thranduil, they are skilled hunters and warriors, navigating the shadowed woods with unmatched agility and precision. The Mirkwood Elves are masters of the bow, striking swiftly and silently from the trees.
黑森林的西尔凡精灵，又称林地王国的精灵，是以广阔森林为家的骄傲族群。他们由瑟兰杜伊王统治，擅长狩猎与作战，能在阴影笼罩的林间迅捷而精准地行动。黑森林精灵精通弓术，常从树影中迅速而无声地发动攻击。
The Tainted spreads corruption wherever he rides.
污秽者所到之处都会散播腐化。
沙加纳塔斯克拉尔领地。

The Tower of Guard, Gondor's capital and greatest fortress-city, built in seven concentric levels on the Hill of Guard at the eastern end of the White Mountains with Mount Mindolluin behind it. The White City houses the Citadel with the Tower of Ecthelion, the Court of the Fountain with the White Tree, and serves as seat of the Stewards of Gondor (and later King Elessar). Surrounded by the fertile Pelennor Fields enclosed by the great defensive wall called the Rammas Echor.
守卫之塔，刚铎的首都，也是王国最伟大的要塞城市。它建在白色山脉东端的守卫山上，背靠明多路因山，由七层同心城区构成。白城的王城内矗立着埃克塞理安之塔，白树生长在涌泉庭院。这里是刚铎宰相们的治所，后来也成为埃莱萨王的驻地。城外是肥沃的佩兰诺平野，外围环绕着名为拉马斯埃霍尔的宏伟防御长墙。
The Undying was a sorcerer-king who sought immortality and found only eternal servitude.
不死者曾是一位追求永生的巫王，但他得到的只有永恒奴役。

The Variag Ravagers are war-bands of young Variag warriors from the steppes of Khand who spend their early manhood in a state of ritual warfare: they may own no cooked food, sleep under no permanent roof, and take no mercy. While most eventually return to the settled life of their clans, some never do, and these form the Ravagers — outlaws who prey on the roads of Khand and raid across its borders into Harad and Gondor.
瓦里亚格劫掠团由可汗德草原上的年轻瓦里亚格战士组成，他们在成年初期会进入一种仪式性的战争生活：不能拥有熟食，不能睡在固定屋顶之下，也不得心怀怜悯。大多数人最后会回到氏族的定居生活，但也有人再也回不去，这些人组成了劫掠团，成为袭击可汗德道路并越境劫掠哈拉德和刚铎的亡命徒。
The Variag of Khand. A tradition of woodland militia blends with the Steppe Charioteers' +10% speed across open ground. Mercenary bands ride for whoever pays the most coin.
可汗德的瓦良格人，将林地民兵传统与草原战车兵在开阔地上增加10%的速度结合起来。他们的雇佣兵团为出价最高的人而战。
The Variags honor the bold. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
瓦里亚格人敬重勇敢的人。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。

The Variags of Khand are a fierce and warlike people, hailing from the dry and rugged lands east of Mordor. Known for their mercenary prowess and loyalty to Sauron, the Variags fight with unmatched ferocity. They ride swift warhorses into battle, wielding curved blades and long spears with deadly precision. Their bronze and crimson armor, adorned with intricate designs, reflects their proud and martial heritage. Divided into tribes and clans, the Variags unite under powerful warlords, bringing fear and chaos to the enemies of the Dark Lord.
可汗德的瓦里亚格人是凶悍好战的民族，来自魔多以东干燥崎岖的土地。他们以雇佣兵本领和对索隆的忠诚闻名，作战时凶猛无匹。他们骑着迅捷战马冲入战场，以弯刃和长矛进行致命打击。他们的青铜与深红铠甲饰有复杂纹样，反映出骄傲而尚武的传统。瓦里亚格人分成部族和氏族，在强大军阀下联合起来，为黑暗魔君的敌人带来恐惧与混乱。

The Variags of Khand are a ruthless and warlike people from the eastern steppes. Known for their mastery of horses and deadly chariots, they bring a unique and brutal style of warfare. Aligned with Sauron, the Variags fight for power and plunder, spreading fear across Middle-earth.
可汗德的瓦里亚格人来自东方草原，是残酷好战的民族。他们精通骑术，也善于使用致命的战车，带来独特而凶狠的战争方式。瓦里亚格人与索隆结盟，为权力和劫掠而战，把恐惧散播到整个中洲。
The Variags of Khand march to {settlement}!
可汗德的瓦里亚格人向{settlement}进军！
The War of the Ring has not yet begun. No kingdom may declare war.
魔戒大战尚未开始，任何王国都不能宣战。
The War of the Ring rages. There can be no peace.
魔戒大战正烈，没有和平可言。

The Warden forbade me from joining field units, saying a woman's place was in the Houses, not the battlefield. When I continued practicing combat medicine with willing soldiers, they threatened to revoke my healer's seal.
监护人禁止我参军，说什么女人就该待在家里，而不是跑到战场上。当我继续和愿意教我的士兵学习战场救护时，他们威胁说要撤销我的医师资格。

The Wild Easterlings are the unconquered steppe clans of the Sea of Rhûn, who have resisted the authority of every lord who has tried to bring them to heel — Rhûn chieftain, Mordor lieutenant, and King of Dale alike. They range across the grasslands east of the Celduin, rounding up horses, raiding flocks, and collecting road tribute from any caravan foolish enough to cross their steppe without an armed escort.
野性东夷是鲁恩内海一带尚未被征服的草原氏族，他们抗拒过每一位试图迫使他们臣服的领主，无论是鲁恩酋长、魔多副官，还是河谷城国王。他们游荡在凯尔都因河以东的草原上，驱赶马群，劫掠牲畜，也向任何没有武装护卫却愚蠢穿越草原的商队收取过路贡赋。
The Witch-King of Angmar, Lord of the Nazgûl, is Sauron's most terrible servant. He was once a great king of Men, corrupted by his Ring of Power into an undying wraith.
安格玛巫王是那兹古尔之首，也是索隆最可怕的仆从。他曾是人类中的伟大国王，却被力量之戒腐化，变成了不死的戒灵。
The Wood is content. Keep to the path, stranger, and do not look back at the shadows. They are not all ours.[ib:closed]
林子满意了。沿着小路走，外乡人，别回头看那些阴影，里面可不全是我们的人。[ib:closed]

The Wood-Elves of Mirkwood, led by King Thranduil, are guardians of the vast and mysterious forest. Known for their agility and mastery of the bow, they blend into the shadows, striking with precision and grace. Their realm is one of beauty and peril, protected by the resolve of its warriors and the timeless wisdom of their king. Fiercely independent, the Elves of Mirkwood fight to preserve their forest against encroaching darkness.
黑森林的森林精灵由瑟兰杜伊国王统领，是这片辽阔神秘森林的守护者。他们以敏捷和弓术闻名，能隐入阴影，以精准而优雅的方式发动攻击。他们的国度美丽而危险，由战士的决心和国王悠久的智慧共同守护。黑森林精灵极其独立，为了保卫森林免受逼近的黑暗侵蚀而战。

The Woodland Realm of Mirkwood has endured much hardship over the years. Under the leadership of Thranduil, the Woodelves have become reclusive and wary of strangers. Yet in the heart of Thranduil lingers a fire kindled in the ancient days of the First Age.
黑森林的林地王国多年来历经苦难。在瑟兰杜伊统治下，森林精灵变得避世，也对陌生人保持戒备。但在瑟兰杜伊心中，仍有一团从第一纪元远古岁月点燃的火焰。
The Woodmen hunt me for the ambush, and my own warband hunts me for the betrayal. I sleep in different holes. I have never been so alert, and never so poor.
林中居民因为伏击的事追杀我，自己的战团因为背叛追杀我。我换着洞睡，从没这么警觉，也从没这么穷。

The Woodmen of Angáladh live under the western eaves of Mirkwood, where their fathers cleared steads among trees so hard that axes ring on them like iron. They are bowmen, woodcutters and hunters, few in number and slow to trust, at peace with the Elves of the northern wood. Every year the shadow in the south of the forest grows, and every year their king sends more of his archers to watch the Narrows.
安加拉兹的林中居民生活在黑森林西部边缘。他们的祖先在树木间开垦农庄，那些树木十分坚硬，斧头砍上去会发出金铁般的声音。他们是弓手、伐木工和猎人，人数不多，不轻易相信外人，与森林北部的精灵和平相处。森林南方的阴影一年比一年深重，国王每年都会派更多弓手前去守望狭地。

The Woodmen of western Mirkwood cleared their steads under the eaves of the forest and named their realm for the iron-hard trees that ring Woodmen-town. They are bowmen and woodwards, few in number, at peace with the Elves to the north and ever watchful of Dol Guldur to the south.
黑森林西部的林中居民在森林边缘开垦农庄，以环绕林中居民镇、坚硬如铁的树木为自己的国家命名。他们是弓手和护林人，人数不多，与北方精灵和平相处，时刻警惕南方的多古尔都。

The Wreckers of the Long Lake live in the reed-beds and rotting old jetties of the Long Lake's shadowed shores, far from the respectable lights of Esgaroth. They make their living by luring barges onto hidden shoals with false lanterns, then stripping the cargo and selling it through fences in the town itself. Despite the efforts of the Lake-town Master and the Dale merchants, the Wreckers have too many friends in the dockside taverns to be easily driven out.
长湖诱船者住在长湖阴暗岸边的芦苇丛和腐朽旧码头中，远离埃斯加洛斯体面灯火。他们靠假灯引诱驳船撞上暗滩谋生，随后剥走货物，再通过镇里的销赃者卖出去。尽管长湖镇镇长和河谷商人一直试图打击他们，但诱船者在码头酒馆中有太多朋友，很难被彻底赶走。

The accusation was true but unprovable, the thane had covered his tracks well. It became my word against his gold and influence. Rather than see me martyred, King Dáin suggested a pilgrimage, a journey to 'seek wisdom.' Exile disguised as honor.
指控是真的，却无法证明。那个领主把痕迹抹得很干净。最后变成我的证词，对上他的黄金和影响力。戴因国王不愿看我成为殉道者，便建议我去朝圣，踏上一段“寻求智慧”的旅程。说到底，那是披着荣誉外衣的流放。
The ancestors ride with you always. Warcry charge cost -20.
先祖永远与你同骑。埃奥尔战吼充能消耗 -20。
The ancient clan's fury envelops the entire battlefield. Savage Rush radius +5.
古老氏族的怒火笼罩整片战场。蛮勇突袭作用范围 +5。
The approach goes wrong early and you pull back with what you brought.
刚接近目标就出了岔子，你只得带着原来的人手撤回。
The archers draw and hold until you give the word, or for 14 seconds at most.
弓兵拉弓待命，等候你下令，最多保持14秒。
The archers draw and hold, and the word is given for you once most of them are ready. A bow is held for 14 seconds at most.
弓兵拉弓待命，多数人准备好后便会自动下令齐射，每张弓最多保持14秒。
The archives of Minas Tirith hold many secrets, yet some truths must be sought beyond stone walls...
米那斯提力斯的档案馆中藏有许多秘密，但有些真相必须在石墙之外寻找……
The arena master has no answer for you now.
竞技场老板现在无法回答你。
The arena master knows of no tournament in a friendly town. You keep your coin.
竞技场老板不知道有哪个友好城镇正在举办竞技大会，你无需付钱。
The arena master names the nearest tournaments:{newline}{LIST}
竞技场老板告诉你最近的几场竞技大会：{newline}{LIST}

The armies of Isengard, led by Saruman the White, are a formidable force of Uruk-hai and mercenaries. Forged in the fires of industry, their weapons and armor are crafted for destruction. The forces of Isengard march to war with ruthless efficiency, bent on conquest and domination.
艾森加德的军队由白袍萨茹曼统领，是由乌鲁克和雇佣兵组成的可怕力量。他们的武器和盔甲在工业炉火中锻成，只为毁灭而生。艾森加德军队以冷酷高效的方式奔赴战场，一心追求征服和支配。

The armies of Mordor, forged in the shadow of Mount Doom, are a relentless force of darkness commanded by Sauron, the Dark Lord. Comprised of orcs, trolls, and wicked men, they march to war under the burning Eye, sowing fear and destruction. These legions are driven by cruelty and servitude, wielding jagged blades and crude armor. Bound by Sauron's iron will, the forces of Mordor are a deadly tide seeking to engulf all of Middle-earth in shadow.
魔多的军队在末日山的阴影中锻成，是一股由黑暗魔君索隆指挥的无情黑暗力量。奥克、食人妖和邪恶人类组成这些军团，他们在燃烧之眼下奔赴战争，播撒恐惧与毁灭。这些军团由残忍和奴役驱动，挥舞锯齿般的刀刃，穿着粗糙盔甲。在索隆铁一般的意志束缚下，魔多大军如致命潮水般涌来，想把整个中洲吞没在阴影中。
The armourer cannot take up your commission today.
铸甲师今天无法接受你的委托。
The armourer has no {PIECE} for your people yet.
铸甲师暂时还没有你所属文化的{PIECE}。
The armourer takes the materials. Your {PIECE} waits at any level {LORD} armoury.
铸甲师已收下材料。你的{PIECE}可以在任意{LORD}级军械库领取。
The armourer takes them, and a master armourer at a level {LORD} armoury will fit you with your {PIECE}.
铸甲师收下材料后，{LORD}级军械库的铸甲大师便会为你打造{PIECE}。
The armourer will rework it into {TARGET} for {PRICE}.
铸甲师会以{PRICE}的费用，将它改造成{TARGET}。
The armourer works only for the host of this campaign.
铸甲师只为本次合作战役的主机玩家提供服务。
The arrows are already nocked. You were never alone out here.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]
箭早就搭好了。你在这里从来就不是一个人。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]

The autumn the Angmar host came down the North Road, villagers crowded the postern begging shelter we could not feed. I advised that the gate stay shut, and it did. The garrison lived through the winter, and the marshal never looked at me again.
安格玛大军沿北大道南下的那个秋天，村民挤在城墙暗门外求庇护。我们没粮食养他们，我建议关着门，门就没开。驻军熬过了冬天，元帅却再也不肯看我一眼。

The autumn the trolls came down from the Ettenmoors, hill families crowded the gate begging shelter we could not feed. I advised that the gate stay shut, and it did. The garrison lived through the winter, and the castellan never looked at me again.
食人妖从埃滕荒原下来的那个秋天，山里人拖家带口挤在城门外求庇护，可我们没粮食养他们。我建议关着门，门就没开。驻军熬过了冬天，堡主却再也不肯看我一眼。
The baggage and the wounded need hands.
辎重和伤员都需要人照料。

The band had struck three caravans on the Dwarf-road east of the mountains and slipped away before anyone could follow. You went alone into the hills, found the camp, counted them, sketched the approach, and brought the report back in time for the wardens to act on it.
这群奥克在山脉东边的矮人路上袭击过三支商队，每次都在别人追来前逃掉。你独自进山，找到营地，清点人数，画下进攻路线，并及时带回情报，让守卫能够采取行动。

The band had struck three times from the same direction and slipped away before anyone could follow. You went alone into the pines, found the camp, counted them, sketched the approach, and brought the report back in time for the garrison to act on it.
这支队伍已经从同一方向袭击三次，每次都在别人追上前逃走。你独自进入松林，找到营地，数清人数，画下接近路线，并及时带回报告，让守军能够行动。

The base knockdown penetration of a charge at the neutral ratio and full speed. Default 0.4, vanilla's value, which cancels a troop's 0.4 base resistance so only Athletics protects him. 0.5 and up floors an ordinary man on any head-on hit that does damage; 0.3 needs a hard hit.
基准重量比、全速下的基础击倒穿透值。默认0.4，与原版相同，会抵消士兵0.4的基础抗性，因此只有跑动技能继续提供保护。0.5及以上时，任何造成伤害的正面撞击都能撞倒普通人；0.3则需要较重的撞击。
The battle is paused. Press Stay time (Home unless rebound) again to go on.
战斗已暂停。再次按“暂停时间”继续，默认Home，除非已改键。

The battle-lord needed to know whether the fortress could be bypassed or had to be reduced. You went forward alone, spent four days observing from the river's eastern bank, and returned with a detailed assessment of its garrison strength, supply schedule, and the approach that gave the best odds. The battle-lord called it the most useful report he had received in a campaign.
战领需要知道这座要塞能否绕过，还是必须攻下。你独自前出，在河东岸观察四天，带回一份详细评估，写明守军强度、补给时间和胜算最高的接近路线。战领说，这是他整场战役收到过最有用的报告。
The best horsemen of the three northern realms
北方三个王国中最出色的骑兵
The best scouts see danger before it sees them...
最好的斥候，总能在危险发现自己之前先发现危险……

The blood feud had been running for three years and was costing both tribes more than either would admit. You asked to speak at the gathering, laid out the numbers without sentiment, and proposed terms that neither side loved but both could accept. They accepted.
血仇已经持续三年，双方付出的代价都超过了他们愿意承认的程度。你请求在集会上发言，不带感情地摆出数字，并提出一套双方都不喜欢、却都能接受的条款。他们接受了。
The blood of Eorl runs hot in my veins, demanding action...
埃奥尔的血在我体内滚烫，催我行动……
The blood of enemies wards off further harm. +8% cut resistance.
敌人的鲜血会挡下后续伤害。+8% 劈砍抗性。
The blood of the old kings of Vidugard runs hot in my veins, demanding action...
维杜加德昔日诸王的热血在我血管里奔涌，催着我行动……
The blood-frenzy holds longer. Bloodrage duration +2s.
鲜血引发的狂怒持续更久。嗜血狂怒持续时间 +2 秒。

The border was tense and no one wanted to go first. You went, established contact, made the first exchange, and survived long enough to make a second. Within a year, two other merchants had followed. The trading house you founded became the model for the rest.
边境气氛紧张，没人愿意第一个去。你去了，建立联系，完成第一笔交换，并活到能做第二笔。一年内，另外两名商人跟着你来了。你创办的商行成了后来者的样板。
The bow sings truest from horseback...
在马背上，弓弦的歌声才最真……
The boy knew the danger and chose to stay. The guild wanted a reason, and I gave them one. I can still forge what no smith west of the Misty Mountains can, and I mean to finish what Telchar began.
那孩子知道危险，还是自己选择留下。行会只想找个理由，我给了他们一个。我如今还是能锻出迷雾山脉以西任何铁匠都做不出的东西，我也一定要完成铁尔哈开创的事业。

The buyers from the south had come expecting to set the price as they always did. You organized the Rohirrim sellers before the fair, agreed on a floor, and held it. The buyers paid what the horses were worth. The sellers remembered who had made it happen.
南方买主来时还以为能像往常一样压价。你在马市前组织洛希尔卖家，约定底价并坚持到底。买主付出了马匹真正的价值，卖家也记住了是谁办成这件事。
The buyers from the south had come expecting to set the price as they always did. You rallied the breeders, held out together, and the herds sold at a price the fair still remembers.
南方来的买家本以为还能像往常一样由自己定价。你召集育马人，大家一起坚持不让步，最后卖出的价格，马市至今还记得。
The camp is cold ash by the time you leave it.
你离开时，营地已化成一片灰烬。
The camp is still being set up.
The camp must be raised before a scout rides out.
派斥候出发前，必须先扎营。
The camp was struck; {SCOUT} rejoins the party.

The campaign map updates every settlement nameplate every frame (about a thousand in TAOM), hidden ones included. When on, a nameplate that is hidden and cannot become visible this frame (out of height range, not tracked, not in range, nothing about its settlement changed) is left alone, which saves frame time on the map, most in fast forward. Everything else updates exactly as in the vanilla game. Takes effect on the next frame, so it can be switched with the map profiler on to compare the [MapProfile] lines. Default ON.
战役地图每帧都会更新全部定居点名称牌，TAOM约有一千个，包括已隐藏的名称牌。开启后，已隐藏且本帧不可能变为可见的名称牌会跳过更新，条件包括高度不符、未被追踪、不在范围内，以及定居点信息未变化。这能节省地图帧耗时，快进时尤其明显。其他名称牌仍完全按原版更新。下一帧生效，可在地图分析器开启时切换，对比[MapProfile]日志。默认：开启。

The captain had heard of your work and commissioned a sword for the ceremony of his promotion. When he drew it before the assembled guard and it rang true, you knew the craft had repaid every sore morning in the smithing quarter.
那位队长听说过你的手艺，委托你为晋升仪式打造一柄剑。当他在集结的卫兵面前拔剑，剑身发出清亮声响时，你知道铁匠区每个酸痛清晨都得到了回报。

The caravan carried tribute and was attacked twice by rival tribes. You fought at the front both times and held the column's order. The Mumak arrived, the tribute was delivered, and the merchants paid your fee without argument, which was the strongest praise they gave.
商队载着贡品，两次遭到敌对部族袭击。你两次都在前方作战，稳住队列。猛犸抵达，贡品送到，商人毫不争辩地付了你的报酬，这就是他们能给出的最高称赞。

The champion had broken his previous bow in the defence of the eastern passes and needed a replacement before the season's tournament. You worked three days without rest on the stave. When the champion drew it the first time he nodded once and walked away without speaking. That was enough.
那位冠军在防守东部山口时折断旧弓，季赛前急需替代品。你连续三天不休息地处理弓身。他第一次拉开那张弓时点了点头，什么也没说就走了。这已经足够。
The chance each second that an idle archer in range fixes on you. 0 never, 1 always. Default: 0.25.
射程内的空闲弓兵每秒转而瞄准你的概率。0为从不，1为始终。默认：0.25。
The chanting saps enemy will. +8% troop morale.
吟诵会削弱敌人的意志。+8% 部队士气。

The chief ordered me to forge collars and chains for his slave caravans, and I refused, though he offered twice the silver. He burned my forge to the ground, with the tools my father left me inside it.
酋长命我替贩奴商队打项圈和锁链，给双倍银子，我也不肯。他把我的铁匠铺烧成平地，父亲留给我的工具也全在里面。
The claimant must serve its realm.
宣称者必须效忠于该国度。
The clan provides for its own. -5% troop wages.
氏族会供养自己的战士。-5% 部队工资。

The clans had always traded east, but the best steel came from the west. You made the first contact, found a merchant willing to make the journey to the Sea of Rhun, and negotiated terms that made the exchange worthwhile for both parties. The tools that came back transformed three winters of work.
氏族一直向东贸易，但最好的钢来自西方。你建立第一次联系，找到愿意前往鲁恩内海的商人，并谈成让双方都觉得值得的条款。带回来的工具改变了之后三个冬天的劳作。
The clans have old scores to settle. Savage Rush charge cost -20.
各氏族有旧账要清算。蛮勇突袭充能消耗 -20。
The clans ride as one unstoppable force. +6% troop damage.
各氏族骑手齐心协力，势不可挡。+6% 部队伤害。
The clans united are unstoppable. +6% troop damage.
联合起来的氏族势不可挡。+6% 部队伤害。
The cleanup starts when this many enemy soldiers or fewer are left. Default: 3.
敌方剩余士兵不超过此数时，开始清退流程。默认：3。
The coastal realm of Bellakar, settled by Numenorean Faithful who remained true to the Valar. A bastion of civilization on the southern shores.
贝拉卡尔的沿海国度，由仍忠于维拉的努门诺尔忠实者建立，是南方海岸上的文明堡垒。

The collapse had trapped eight Orcs in the lower gallery. You assessed the stress pattern, directed the reinforcement work, and got the crew to safety before the secondary collapse that followed would have killed them. The warchief's engineer gave you the plans to keep.
塌方把八个奥克困在下层矿廊。你评估受力走向，指挥加固工作，并在随后二次塌方本会杀死他们之前把队伍救到安全处。战酋的工程师把图纸交给你保管。

The colour of your realm when it is none of the kingdoms above: your clan's land while it serves no kingdom, then a kingdom you found. Written #RRGGBB. Blank gives it a free colour. In one of the kingdoms above, that kingdom's own field applies.
不属于上述王国时，你所在国家的颜色：未效忠任何王国时是家族土地，之后是自己建立的王国。格式为 #RRGGBB，留空使用可用颜色。身处上述王国时，使用该王国自己的设置。
The column can no longer account for {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} of your back pay.
部队已无法再兑现拖欠你的{AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}军饷。
The column fought without you, and you had no way into the line.
队伍在你缺席时参加了战斗，你当时无法加入。

The coming war will create demand for my expertise. Poisons can eliminate key leaders, contaminate supplies, create chaos without attributable cause. I carry my knowledge and recipes. Those who appreciate surgical precision over blunt force will find my services invaluable, for appropriate compensation.
即将到来的战争会制造对我专长的需求。毒药可以清除关键领袖，污染补给，在找不到源头的情况下制造混乱。我随身带着知识和配方。那些欣赏精准处理、胜过蛮力砸烂的人，会发现我的服务极有价值，当然，报酬也要合适。

The commission came from the stables — a request for a blade that could be carried on horseback without awkwardness. You studied the problem, adjusted the balance, and presented the result. Theoden's captain tested it in the yard and had it sent to the king's armory the same afternoon.
委托来自马厩，需要一把能在马背上携带而不碍事的剑。你研究问题，调整重心，并呈上成品。希奥顿的队长在训练场试剑，当天下午就把它送进国王武库。

The contact was a disgruntled stable-hand who wanted money more than loyalty to the Mark. You cultivated the relationship carefully and received two seasons of patrol schedules in exchange for a sum the chief considered modest. The clan raided without incident for the year that followed.
那名线人是个心怀不满的马厩帮工，比起对马克忠诚，他更想要钱。你小心经营这层关系，用酋长认为不算多的一笔钱，换来了两个季节的巡逻表。接下来一年里，氏族劫掠都没有出事。

The corsair haven and Black Numenorean port-city on the southern bays. Corsair Trade slashes caravan costs, Corsair Glory adds renown, Desert Corsairs march fast across the sands — but Corsair Greed inflates every wage bill.
乌姆巴尔是南方海湾上的海盗港，也是黑努门诺尔人的港口城市。海盗贸易大幅降低商队花费，海盗荣耀增加声望，沙漠海盗能快速穿越沙地；但海盗贪婪会抬高每一笔工资。
The council counted the stores first, and rightly.
议事会先清点存粮，这没什么错。

The council praised the ford and then quietly passed me over for every command, because I had named my captain's flight aloud. I carry the eleven names with me. A man who will not lie for his betters finds few doors open.
议事会夸我们守住渡口，后来每次任命指挥官，却都悄悄把我跳过去，就因为我当众说出了队长逃跑的事。那十一个名字，我一直记着。一个不肯替上司撒谎的人，能走的门可不多。
The council was right to count the stores before it counted feelings.
先算粮食再谈感受，议事会没做错。
The council was right to count the stores before the sentiment.
先算粮食再谈同情，议事会没做错。
The country has been picked over, and recently.
这一带刚被搜刮过不久。

The creature had driven three scouting parties back and killed two. You studied its web-patterns, identified the anchoring tree it returned to, and took it at dawn with a long Elven blade while it was feeding. Thranduil's captains hung the trophy at the path's entrance.
那只怪物逼退了三支侦察队，还杀死两人。你研究它的织网规律，找出它总会返回的锚定树，并在黎明时趁它进食，用精灵长刃将其拿下。瑟兰杜伊的队长把战利品挂在道路入口。
The cry of Rhovanion heartens all who hear it. +8% troop morale.
罗瓦尼安的呼喊鼓舞着每个听见它的人。+8%部队士气。
The cry of Rohan heartens all who hear it. +8% troop morale.
洛汗的呼声会鼓舞所有听见它的人。+8% 部队士气。
The cult's network keeps the host provisioned. +13% ammo.
教团的关系网确保军队补给充足。+13% 弹药。

The culvert was needed to keep the pit floors dry through the flood season. Saruman had given thirty days. You reorganized the labour gangs, simplified the routing, and finished in twenty-two. Saruman examined the work without comment, which meant it was acceptable.
这条涵洞用于在洪水季保持坑底干燥。萨茹曼给了三十天。你重组劳工队，简化路线，二十二天便完成。萨茹曼查看工程后一言不发，这就说明它合格。
The damage of the head butt and the drop kick, as a percentage of their normal damage. Armour does not reduce it. At 0 the attacks still play but hurt no one and knock no one down. Default: 100.
头槌与飞踢相对于正常伤害的百分比，不受护甲减免。设为0时，仍播放攻击动作，但不会造成伤害，也不会击倒敌人。默认：100。
The damp of the river country makes you resilient. +5% blunt resistance.
河乡的潮湿环境让你更能硬扛。+5% 钝击抗性。
The dark host swells beyond measure. +6 party size.
黑暗军势膨胀到无法衡量。+6 部队规模。
The dark protects you longer. Sneak-Creeping duration +4s.
黑暗会更久地庇护你。潜行突进持续时间 +4 秒。

The darkness from Dol Guldur had seeped into a clearing near the realm's edge, blackening the soil and killing what grew there. Over two seasons you worked to remove the taint and replant, and the saplings took. Thranduil's foresters came to see it for themselves.
多古尔都的黑暗渗入王国边缘一处空地，使土壤发黑，植物枯死。你用两个季节清除污秽、重新栽种，幼树终于成活。瑟兰杜伊的林务官亲自来看过。
The dead don't care about justice.
The deeds of the Eotheod are sung for ages. +14% battle renown gain.
伊奥希奥德的事迹会被世代传唱。+14% 战斗声望获取。
The deeds of the Northmen are sung for ages. +14% battle renown gain.
北方人的事迹将传唱千古。+14%战斗声望获取。
The deeps of Nogrod have lain flooded since the First Age. I meant to drain them...
诺格罗德的深处，自第一纪元起就泡在水里。我原想把它排干……
The defenders fall back to the lord's hall
The desert taught me to see beauty in emptiness, to build something from nothing. Now I sculpt entire realms from the void, each creation a piece of the home I carry within rather than behind.
沙漠教会我从空旷中看见美，也教会我从无到有建立事物。如今我从虚无中雕琢出一个个完整的国度，每件作品都像是我随身带着的故乡碎片，而不是被我抛在身后的过去。

The deserter had killed two overseers and vanished into Gorgoroth's wastes. You went alone, followed the trail for four days across the ash flats, and came back with proof of what you found. No one asked for details.
那个逃兵杀了两名监工后消失在戈埚洛斯荒地里。你独自出发，沿灰烬平地追踪四天，带回了发现目标的证据。没有人追问细节。
The diggings need workers and free men won't go down there. Bring me captives in chains and they'll earn their keep with a pick.
矿坑里缺工人，可自由民都不肯下去。给我带些戴着镣铐的俘虏，他们得靠挥镐干活换口饭吃。

The discipline of Sparta serves many purposes. While my brothers trained for phalanx formations, I found patterns in code more elegant than any shield wall. Every XML node precisely placed, every function a calculated strike.
斯巴达的纪律有许多用途。我的兄弟们训练方阵，而我在代码中找到了比盾墙更优雅的秩序。每个节点都精确归位，每个函数都是一次计算好的打击。
The dispatch arrives late, and you cannot swear it arrived unread.
急件送迟了，你也无法保证途中没人拆看。
The dispatch is in the right hands, and no others.
急件送到了该收的人手里，没经任何旁人的手。
The dread realm of the Witch-king of Angmar in the far north. From his fortress of Carn Dum, the Witch-king wages war upon the remnants of Arnor.
这是远北安格玛巫王的恐怖国度。巫王从卡恩督姆堡垒出发，向阿尔诺残余势力发动战争。

The dwarf kingdom of the Blue Mountains. Durin's Folk made Thorin's Halls there in their exile, and in this age the Broadbeams and the Firebeards hold Belegost and Nogrod again. Its lords are few and its halls are poorer than those of its kin in the east, but its smiths are the oldest in the West, and its axes keep the goblins of Blue Craig from the roads to Lindon.
蓝色山脉的矮人王国。都林一族流亡时在这里建起梭林大厅，如今宽梁族和火须族也重新掌握了贝烈戈斯特与诺格罗德。这里领主不多，大厅不如东方同族的富有，但铁匠传承在西方最为悠久，他们的战斧让蓝岩的半兽人无法侵扰通往林顿的道路。

The dwarf-halls of the Blue Mountains at the western edge of Middle-earth. Durin's Folk made Thorin's Halls in their exile, and the Broadbeams and the Firebeards keep Belegost and Nogrod again. They mine iron and sell it to the Elves of Lindon and the Men of Eriador, while the goblins of Blue Craig gnaw at their roads.
中洲西端蓝色山脉中的矮人厅堂。都林一族流亡时建起梭林大厅，如今宽梁族和火须族也重新守住了贝烈戈斯特与诺格罗德。他们开采铁矿，将铁料卖给林顿精灵和埃利阿多的人类，而蓝岩的半兽人始终侵扰着他们的道路。

The dwarves of Ered Luin dwell in the Blue Mountains at the western edge of Middle-earth. Durin's Folk came there in exile and made Thorin's Halls, and in this age the Broadbeams and the Firebeards keep Belegost and Nogrod again, the oldest dwarf-cities of the West. They are miners and smiths, poorer than their kin in the east, and they trade iron with the Elves of Lindon and the Men of Eriador while the goblins of Blue Craig gnaw at their roads.
埃瑞德路因的矮人生活在中洲西端的蓝色山脉。都林一族流亡至此，建起梭林大厅；如今宽梁族和火须族也重新守住了贝烈戈斯特与诺格罗德，那是西方最古老的矮人城市。他们是矿工和铁匠，不如东方的同族富有，靠着向林顿精灵和埃利阿多人类出售铁料维生，而蓝岩的半兽人始终侵扰着他们的道路。

The eastern of Arnor's three successor kingdoms, a hill realm between the Hoarwell and the Loudwater. Its Dúnedain lords hold Cameth Brin and the Angle and rule a hard people of hill-men. It stands apart from the War of the Ring, but trolls walk its fells and the orcs of Gundabad and the mountains watch every pass.
阿尔诺分裂后的三个王国中，最东边的一个，是苍泉河与响水河之间的山地王国。杜内丹领主据守卡梅斯布林和河角地，统治着强悍的山民。它没有卷入魔戒大战，但食人妖在高地出没，贡达巴德及群山中的奥克紧盯着每一处隘口。

The eastern of the three realms into which Arnor was sundered, a hill kingdom between the Hoarwell and the Loudwater. Its Dunedain lords hold Cameth Brin and the Angle and rule a hard people of hill-men, with trolls in the fells and orcs on every pass.
阿尔诺分裂出的三个王国中，鲁道尔位于东方，是苍泉河与响水河之间的山地王国。杜内丹领主掌握着卡梅斯布林和河角地，统治着坚韧的山民；高地有食人妖出没，每处山口都有奥克盘踞。

The eastern ruins of Gondor's ancient capital across the Anduin from West Osgiliath, now a haunted battlefield contested between Gondor's Rangers and Mordor's forces. The broken eastern half of the great bridge leads to collapsed buildings and flooded streets where Orcs lurk among fallen towers. Strategic crossing point controlling access to Ithilien and the road to Minas Morgul.
这里是刚铎古都的东部废墟，隔安都因河与西欧斯吉利亚斯相望，如今成了刚铎游侠与魔多军队争夺的阴森战场。大桥东半部已经崩裂，通向倒塌的建筑和被水淹没的街道，奥克潜伏在倾覆的高塔之间。此地是控制伊希利恩通路和通往米那斯魔古尔道路的战略渡口。
The emissary could not complete the deal.
使者未能完成这笔交易。
The emissary has no elite units to offer right now.
使者目前没有可供招募的精锐兵种。
The emissary only deals with the host of this campaign.
使者只与本场合作战役的主机玩家交易。
The enemy capture is slipping back: {PERCENT}%
敌方占领进度正在回退：{PERCENT}%
The enemy holds a capture point.
敌方控制了一个占领点。

The engine reserves room for the skeletons drawn in each frame in two per-frame buffers (65,536 and 262,144 entries) and never checks that the next one fits; one skeleton too many (about 2,340 in view for the first buffer) freezes the battle for good. When on, TAOM bounds-checks both buffers by rewriting 13 bytes of the engine at launch at each one, so a skeleton that would not fit is drawn from that buffer's first slots instead (its bones may look wrong for that frame). TAOM installs each check only where the exact engine bytes are found exactly once: a build that only moves the function is still patched, and a changed build gets nothing written. It also writes nothing for a buffer another module already guards, and guards the other one regardless. Takes effect at the next launch. Default ON.

引擎为每帧绘制的骨骼预留两个缓冲区，容量分别为65,536和262,144项，却不检查下一个骨骼能否放入。多出一个骨骼就可能使战斗永久卡死，第一个缓冲区大约在视野内有2,340个骨骼时达到上限。开启后，TAOM在启动时分别改写两处引擎代码，每处13字节，为两个缓冲区增加边界检查。放不下的骨骼改用该缓冲区开头的槽位绘制，因此那一帧的骨骼外观可能有误。每处补丁只有在精确引擎字节序列仅找到一次时才会安装：仅移动函数位置的版本仍可匹配，代码已经改变的版本不会写入。其他模块已保护的缓冲区也不会被改写，但不妨碍保护另一个缓冲区。下次启动生效。默认：开启。
The envoy bows to your words: the price falls to {PRICE} denars.
使者被你说服，将价格降到了{PRICE}第纳尔。
The envoy returns in {DAYS} {?DAYS>1}days{?}day{\?} at the same price. Nothing is spared until you pay.
使者会在{DAYS}{?DAYS>1}天{?}天{\?}后带着同样的开价回来。在付款前，你的村庄仍可能遭到劫掠。
The envoy will not be moved: the price stays at {PRICE} denars.
使者不肯让步，价格仍为{PRICE}第纳尔。

The existing channels had not been extended in a generation. You surveyed the terrain, proposed a new branch, organized the labor, and finished the construction before the spring floods. The oasis produced twice as much as the previous year. Three other settlements sent messengers to learn how.
现有水渠已经一代人没有延伸。你勘察地形，提出新支渠，组织劳力，并在春洪前完工。绿洲产量达到上一年的两倍。另有三个聚落派信使来学习做法。

The existing process wasted a third of the steel through brittle failures at the quench. You identified the temperature as the problem, proposed a fix, tested it against Saruman's overseer's skepticism, and proved it in a single shift. Production doubled within the month.
原有流程在淬火时会因脆裂浪费三分之一钢材。你找出问题在温度，提出修正，并顶着萨茹曼监工的怀疑完成测试，一个班次内就证明有效。一个月内产量翻倍。

The existing routes had been taxed to the point where merchants were looking for alternatives. You identified an underused passage through the bay islands, arranged the fees, and brought three new merchant houses into the harbor within a season. The harbormasters were irritated but richer.
旧路线税负太重，商人已经在寻找替代选择。你找出一条穿过海湾群岛的冷门航道，安排费用，一个季节内就把三家新商行带进港口。港务长们很不高兴，但也更富了。
The faction that rules the majority of Middle-earth.
统治中洲大部分地区的势力。
The faithful march without weariness. +5% party movement speed.
虔信者行军不知疲惫。+5% 部队移动速度。
The farms owe me their tithe and pay it in grain, not coin -- when they pay at all. Collect what is owed and bring it in, and you will have a cut.
农场欠我什一税，要用粮食交，不是钱币。当然，得他们肯交才行。把欠的收上来交给我，你也能分到一份。
The farthest the hunter closes in one hour while out of your sight, in map units. Default 15.
追猎者在你的视野之外时，每小时最多向你接近的距离，以地图单位计算。默认：15。

The fewest days a clan that signs on as a mercenary stays with its kingdom. Until then it cannot leave a ruler who is in debt, be hired away by another kingdom, or leave in its daily consideration of whether to stay. A clan with more time left is not shortened. Your own clan is not bound, and neither is dismissing or hiring away a mercenary yourself. 0 turns it off. Applies when a clan signs on; clans already serving get it at their next signing. Between 0 and 120. Default: 30.
家族签约成为佣兵后，至少为该国效力的天数。在此之前，不会因统治者欠款而离开，也不能被其他国家挖走，或在每日去留判断中自行离职。原有剩余期限更长时，不会被缩短。你自己的家族不受约束，你亲自解雇或挖走佣兵也不受此限制。0为关闭。家族签约时生效，已经服役的家族会在下次签约时采用。范围：0至120。默认：30。
The fief hub cannot be opened right now.
现在无法打开封地管理界面。
The fiercest warriors are often too fierce for their own armies...
最凶悍的战士，往往连自己的军队都嫌他太凶……
The finest bowmen of Rhovanion rally to your banner. +5 party size.
罗瓦尼安最优秀的弓手聚集在你的旗帜下。部队人数上限+5。
The finest bowmen of Rohan rally to your banner. +5 party size.
洛汗最优秀的弓手聚集到你的旗帜下。+5 部队规模。
The finest riders serve truth, not corrupted counsel...
最好的骑手忠于真相，不会听信腐败的谗言……
The finest riders serve truth, not corrupted kings...
最好的骑手效忠真相，而不是腐败的国王……

The finest weapons of your people go to those whose deeds match the names they carry. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take enemy lords captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.
你所属文化最精良的武器，会交给功绩配得上它们名声的人。亲手击倒敌人、俘获敌方领主、赢得战斗，或者向铸甲师交付你所属文化的领主级材料，大师便会为你打造武器。
捕鱼的士兵带回了{N}份鱼。
The fleet remembers your service. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
舰队会记住你的贡献。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
The folk of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} have lost their seed grain and will go hungry unless the fields are sown.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的居民失去了粮种。如果不能及时播种，他们就要挨饿了。
The folk of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} lack the tools to work their land and craft their goods.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的居民缺少耕种和制作货物所需的工具。
The folk of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} need livestock driven to them to rebuild their flocks.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的居民需要有人运来牲畜，让畜群重新繁衍。

The food order never spends the gold your party needs for this many days of wages, so buying food cannot leave your troops unpaid. 0 lets it spend the whole purse. Morale purchases are not limited: they show their price. Between 0 and 30. Default: 3.
买粮指令始终保留足以支付此天数军饷的金币，避免买粮后无钱发饷。0为允许花光全部钱款。鼓舞士气的付费选项不受此限制，但会显示价格。范围：0至30。默认：3。
The forest teaches you to sense danger early. +10% party spotting range.
森林教会你更早察觉危险。+10% 部队侦察范围。
The forge grows cold when there are no deeds to inspire the songs. I seek glory and gold, as any proper dwarf should!
若没有值得写进歌里的事迹，熔炉也会冷下去。我追求荣耀和黄金，任何像样的矮人都该如此！
The forge stands cold, traveller. Without iron the smith cannot shoe a horse nor mend a ploughshare, and the village suffers for it.
旅人，锻炉的火已经熄了。没有铁料，铁匠既不能给马钉蹄铁，也不能修补犁铧，整个村子都受到了影响。
The forges of Erebor burn bright, but some smiths seek different fires...
孤山的锻炉烧得明亮，但有些铁匠想寻找不同的火……
The fortress of Isengard, domain of Saruman the White.
艾森加德要塞，白袍萨茹曼的领地。
The full host of the Eotheod rides to war. +6 party size.
伊奥希奥德全军驰向战场。+6 部队规模。
The full host of the Northmen rides to war. +6 party size.
北方人全军策马出征。部队人数上限+6。
The fury does not abate. Savage Rush duration +2s.
怒火不会衰退。蛮勇突袭持续时间 +2 秒。
The game is rebuilding its shaders after a change to your mod list or to the game. It is not frozen.
MOD列表或游戏发生变化后，游戏正在重新编译着色器，并未卡死。
The gardens of Ithilien still bloom, though shadow creeps ever closer...
伊希利恩的花园依旧繁花盛开，尽管阴影正悄然逼近……
The garrison does not trust me with a command now, and my father will not speak of it. I would sooner die useful than live as a joke. I still carry the spear.
如今驻军不信任我，不再让我带兵，父亲也不肯提那件事。与其活着被人当笑话，我宁可死得有点用。我还带着那支长矛。
The garrison eats from the stored goods; keep the stash provisioned or it will starve.
驻军会消耗仓库里的食物，请及时补充，否则他们会挨饿。
The garrison of {FORT} harries your march, slowing it: {KILLED} killed, {WOUNDED} wounded and {FOOD} food lost.
{FORT}的驻军袭扰你的行军，使行军减慢：{KILLED}人阵亡，{WOUNDED}人受伤，损失{FOOD}份食物。
The gate needs a steady pair of eyes on who comes and goes.
城门需要有人认真盯着，留意进出的人。

The gatekeeper at the Morannon had been taxing every band that passed and pocketing half the take. You documented the scheme, presented it to his superior at exactly the right moment, and watched the post change hands. You made sure it changed to yours.
魔栏农的守门人向每支经过的队伍收税，并把一半收入装进自己口袋。你记录下整套手法，在正合适的时候呈给他的上级，看着岗位易手。你确保它落到了自己手里。

The goblin-warrens of Blue Craig in the Blue Mountains (Ered Luin) of the far west, hard by the Grey Havens of Lindon. A distinct, numberless host of goblin-kind — separate from their Misty Mountains cousins of Goblin Town — they swarm the western crags and trouble the Elves of the western shore.
蓝岩的半兽人巢穴位于遥远西方的蓝色山脉，也就是埃瑞德路因，紧邻林顿的灰港。它们是一支独立而数量庞大的半兽人族群，与迷雾山脉半兽人镇的同类不同，常在西方峭壁间蜂拥而出，骚扰西岸的精灵。

The goblins of Blue Craig hold the western spurs of the Ered Luin, cut off from their kin under the Ered Luin by the length of Eriador. They raid the Dwarf-roads and the shores of Lune, and the Elves of Mithlond count them the nearer enemy.
蓝岩的半兽人占据着埃瑞德路因西侧的支脉，与埃瑞德路因山下的同族隔着整个埃利阿多。他们劫掠矮人的道路和路恩沿岸地区，是米斯泷德精灵身边更近的敌人。
The gold in the largest purse you can give a companion. A purse is worth 1 relation per 500 gold, at most 10 (5000 gold). Between 500 and 5000 gold. Default: 5000.
可以赠送给同伴的大钱袋金额。每500金币价值1点关系，最多10点，即5000金币。范围：500至5000金币。默认：5000。
The gold in the middle purse you can give a companion. A purse is worth 1 relation per 500 gold, at most 10 (5000 gold). Between 500 and 5000 gold. Default: 2000.
可以赠送给同伴的中钱袋金额。每500金币价值1点关系，最多10点，即5000金币。范围：500至5000金币。默认：2000。

The gold in the smallest purse you can give a companion. The gold leaves you and goes to the companion. A purse is worth 1 relation per 500 gold, at most 10 (5000 gold), before the scaling and the cap. Between 500 and 5000 gold. Default: 500.
可以赠送给同伴的小钱袋金额。钱款从你这里转给同伴。在关系折算和上限计算前，每500金币价值1点关系，最多10点，即5000金币。范围：500至5000金币。默认：500。

The great Houses of Âbanissa rule the deep south of Harad, a land of humid jungles, ancient stone palaces and towering war-beasts. Their armies march beneath banners of dynasty, commanding respect and terror across the southern lands.
阿巴尼萨各大家族统治着哈拉德极南方，那是一片潮湿丛林、古老石宫和高大战兽组成的土地。他们的军队在王朝旗帜下前进，在南方诸地赢得敬畏，也散播恐惧。
The greatest charge in the age of men. Warcry radius +5.
这是人类纪元最伟大的冲锋。埃奥尔战吼作用范围 +5。
The greatest riders follow you. +9 health.
最出色的骑手会追随你。+9 生命值。

The green land west of the Blue Mountains, last realm of the High Elves on the shores of Middle-earth. From the Grey Havens of Mithlond the white ships sail into the West. Círdan the Shipwright, eldest of the Eldar, keeps the fading light of the Falathrim — wise, few, and each blade irreplaceable. Lindon shares the Falathrim strength of Mithlond.
林顿是蓝色山脉以西的绿色土地，也是中洲海岸上高等精灵最后的国度。白船从米斯泷德的灰港驶向西方。造船者奇尔丹是最年长的埃尔达，守护着法拉斯民渐渐消逝的光辉。他们睿智、人数稀少，每一柄剑都无可替代。林顿与米斯泷德同享法拉斯民的力量。
The ground here does not suit this camp.
这里的地形不适合建立这种营地。
The ground shakes as the riders descend. Warpack Charge radius +3.
骑手冲下时，大地也随之震动。战群冲锋作用范围 +3。

The guild cheats with its own weights, only more carefully. I fled before the hearing with what I could carry. I still know every price and every buyer in Eriador, and a captain who wants his stores bought cheap has a use for me.
行会自己也拿秤砣骗人，只不过更小心。我没等开审，就带着拿得动的家当逃了。埃利阿多每种货的价钱、每个买主，我还是都熟。想便宜买补给的队长，用得着我。

The guild displayed twelve pieces per year from craftsmen across the region. You submitted three — a blade, a lock mechanism, and a decorative fitting — and all three were accepted. The guild master told you it was the first time a single craftsman had placed three pieces in the same year.
行会每年从整个地区工匠中挑选十二件作品展出。你提交了三件：一把刀、一套锁具和一件装饰配件，三件全被选中。行会大师告诉你，这是第一次有一名工匠同年入选三件。
The halls of Erebor honor your bravery! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
孤山大厅会铭记你的英勇！影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
The hammering does not let up. Hammer Down duration +4s.
连续重击不会停下。重锤压顶持续时间 +4 秒。
The harsh hills of Dunland make you resilient. +5% resistance to melee.
黑蛮地严酷的丘陵让你更加坚韧。+5% 近战抗性。

The harvest had failed and the winter stores were low. You went to Isengard alone, spoke to the right man, and came back with grain in exchange for iron ore the clan had been sitting on for years. The chief was astonished; the clan ate.
收成失败，冬储见底。你独自前往艾森加德，找对人谈话，用氏族多年搁置的铁矿换回粮食。酋长惊讶不已，氏族则有饭可吃。

The heir ordered a surrendered caravan guard put to the axe, and I stepped between them. He struck me across the face, and his clan named me oath-breaker, which in Khand is worse than being named dead.
继承人下令用斧头砍死一个投降的商队护卫，我挡在了中间。他一巴掌打在我脸上，他的氏族还说我是背誓者。在可汗德，这比被叫作死人还糟。
The herds are sold now, and the stud-lands have grown over. I have gone looking for work that will let me earn back what that winter cost, though I have never been able to say how much that is.
如今马群卖了，育马的土地长满荒草。我出来找活，希望能赚回那个冬天赔进去的东西，可我从来说不清，那究竟值多少。
The high towers are fully manned.
The hill-folk are tougher than they look. +6 health.
山民比外表看上去更结实。+6 生命值。
The hill-songs raise your warriors' spirits. +8% troop morale.
山丘之歌会振奋你的战士。+8% 部队士气。
The hills forge you like iron. +6 health.
丘陵中的生活让你变得像钢铁一样坚韧。+6 生命值。
The hills make the skull thick and the will unbreakable. +10% resistance to blunt.
丘陵造就厚硬头骨，也造就不可动摇的意志。+10% 钝击抗性。
The horde devours everything — +20% party food consumption.
这支群潮会吃掉一切；部队食物消耗 +20%。
The horn can only sound between waves.
只能在两波之间吹响号角。
The horn pays half as much.
The horn pays twice as much for the time it skips.
吹号提前开战时，按跳过时间获得的奖励变为2倍。
The horse-lords of Harlindon breed good mounts for Arthedain and the Havens alike. Trade is old among us, and so are its debts.
哈林顿的驭马者为阿塞丹和灰港培育好马。我们做买卖的历史很久，欠下的债也一样。

The horses began refusing to go near the Gap of Rohan - even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training.
马匹开始拒绝靠近洛汗隘口，就连最勇敢的种马也会立起前蹄逃开。动物比人更早感知邪恶。我把这事报告给马师，他们却怪训练不当。

The horses began refusing to go near the road toward Dol Guldur, and even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training.
马开始不肯靠近通往多古尔都的路，连最勇敢的公马也会扬起前蹄，掉头逃走。牲畜比人更早察觉邪恶。我告诉管马的人，他们却说是没驯好。
The horses grow restless, and strange wolves prowl our borders...
战马开始不安，奇怪的狼也在边境游荡……
The horses grow restless, and strange wolves prowl the southern eaves...
马群越来越不安，奇怪的狼也在南边林缘游荡……
The horses whisper of storms approaching...
马儿低声诉说，风暴正在逼近……
The host could not be mustered here.
The host needs its spirits lifted.
The host raids your villages as it raids any others.
这支大军仍会劫掠你的村庄，与你之外的村庄一视同仁。
The host shares out {COUNT} of the stores. Spirits rise, but the camp falls into disorder.
部队分发了{COUNT}份储备物资。士气提高了，但营地也变得混乱。
The hosts of Gundabad march to {settlement}!
The hosts of Rhun march to {settlement}!
The hunt is over, for now.
The hunt never ends for you. +9 health.
对你来说，狩猎永不结束。+9 生命值。
The hunter's host is filled to this many times your strength (your army's, when you lead one). Default 1.3.
将追猎者的军队补充至你当前实力的此倍率；你率领军团时，则按军团实力计算。默认：1.3。
The hunters of Mirkwood march to {settlement}!
狩猎的士兵带回了{N}份肉。

The influence an office such as the Steward of Gondor or a Marshal of the Mark pays its holder's clan each week, as a percentage of its amount in realms_titles.xml. 0 stops it. Between 0 and 300. Default: 100.
刚铎宰相、洛汗元帅等官职每周向任职者家族提供的影响力，按realms_titles.xml中数值的百分比计算。0为停止提供。范围：0至300。默认：100。

The influence it costs to usurp, form, restore or revoke a title, as a percentage of its cost in realms_titles.xml. Restoring Gondor's throne for Aragorn costs 2500 at 100. Applies to AI lords too. Between 10 and 500. Default: 100.
夺取、设立、恢复或剥夺头衔所需的影响力，按realms_titles.xml中费用的百分比计算。设为100时，为阿拉贡恢复刚铎王位需要2500影响力。也作用于AI领主。范围：10至500。默认：100。

The intelligence taken from the Elven warden described the full rotation of Thranduil's eastern border patrol. It was the most useful strategic information Dol Guldur had received in a year. No one asked how you got the prisoner out. You did not explain.
从那名精灵守卫口中得到的情报，说明了瑟兰杜伊东部边境巡逻的完整轮换。这是多古尔都一年里得到的最有用战略信息。没人问你怎么把囚犯带出来，你也没有解释。
The isolation of Stangard breeds iron resolve. +6 health.
斯坦加德与外界隔绝的生活磨炼了你的意志。+6 生命值。
The isolation of Wainwatch breeds iron resolve. +6 health.
战车哨站的孤寂铸就钢铁般的决心。生命值+6。
The jungle hides everything and forgives nothing. I learned to move through it unseen. Listen, and I will tell you how.
丛林会藏下一切，却什么也不会原谅。我学会了在其中无声穿行。听着，我告诉你我是怎么学会的。
The keep can hold 30 more defenders.
主堡可容纳的守军减少40名。
The keep takes 40 percent longer to fall.
The king's treasurers at Cameth Brin keep the counts of grain and refugees. A few of us have spoken up for the hill families and been sent away for it.
卡梅斯布林的王室财务官们清点粮食和难民人数。我们有些人替山民家庭说过话，也因此被赶了出来。
The king's treasurers at Caras Gorthad keep the counts of grain and refugees. A few of us have spoken up for the border farmers and been sent away for it.
卡拉斯戈沙德的王室财务官们清点粮食和难民人数。我们有些人替边境农民说过话，也因此被赶了出来。
The lads call me Bear, after the old chieftain. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
伙伴们叫我熊，就像那位老首领。我还配不上，可迟早会配得上。
The lads call me Spiderbane. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
伙伴们叫我蜘蛛克星。我还配不上，可迟早会配得上。
The lads named me after Ostmar the Warden. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
伙伴们拿守望者奥斯特马尔的名字叫我。我还配不上，可迟早会配得上。
The lads named me after the dragon-slayer. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
伙伴们拿屠龙英雄的名字叫我。我还配不上，可迟早会配得上。
The lancers of Lindon have ridden north to Arnor since the days of Elendil. The old alliance is no small thing to those of us who kept it.
从埃兰迪尔的时代起，林顿的枪骑兵就曾北上阿尔诺。对我们这些守住承诺的人，古老的联盟从来不是小事。

The last bastion of the Dunedain in the south. Tower Guard hold the line, Gondorian Discipline rallies armies cheaply, and the Men of the Fields march on plains. War-Depleted Lands grow slowly — but Gondor stands.
刚铎是南方杜内丹人最后的堡垒。圣白塔卫队坚守阵线，刚铎纪律让军队能以较低成本集结，原野之民能在平原上行军。战火耗尽的土地增长缓慢，但刚铎仍屹立不倒。

The last of the three realms into which Arnor was sundered, Arthedain did not fall. Arvedui's line still holds Fornost upon the North Downs, though its lords are few, its towns poor, and Angmar's shadow lies always on the northern hills.
阿尔诺分裂出的三个王国中，阿塞丹坚持到了最后，至今仍未陷落。阿维杜伊的后人依然统治着北岗上的佛诺斯特，只是领主所剩无几，城镇贫困，安格玛的阴影始终笼罩着北方丘陵。

The last raid, I saw the trap early. Beornings in the trees, both sides. I took the strong ones and ran. The rearguard I left to hold the pass, and they held, and they died. The Great Goblin counted the dead and asked who gave the order.
最后一次，我早早看出是陷阱。路两边的树里，全是贝奥恩一族的人。我带着强壮的跑了，留下后卫守隘口。他们守住了，也死了。半兽人王数完死人，问是谁下的令。

The least relation you lose with an army's leader when you pay influence to disband it. The cost is a random whole number between the least and the most. If the least is above the most, the two swap. Applies only in single player, and only while Enable Personal Relations is on. Default: 28.
花费影响力解散军团时，与军团长最少损失的关系值。实际损失在最小值和最大值之间随机取整数；最小值高于最大值时，两者会互换。只在单人模式且开启个人关系时生效。默认：28。

The ledgers had been misaligned since the reclamation, with losses no one could explain. You spent three months cross-referencing records and identified the error — a simple conversion mistake compounded across twenty years of entries. The King's treasurer shook your hand.
自孤山收复以来，账簿一直对不上，有些损失没人解释得清。你花三个月交叉核对记录，找出了错误：一次简单的换算失误，在二十年记录中不断累积。国王的司库和你握了手。

The ledgers of Thorin's Halls had been misaligned for years, with losses no one could explain. You spent three months cross-referencing records and found the error: a simple conversion mistake compounded across twenty years of entries. The King's treasurer shook your hand.
梭林大厅的账目多年对不上，亏空也没人说得清。你花三个月交叉核对记录，终于找到原因：一个简单的换算错误，在二十年的账目中不断累积。国王的财务官握住了你的手。
The long work wears on the men (morale -{N}).
长时间劳作让士兵疲惫不堪（士气 -{N}）。
The lord of Egladil called it butchery and broke the company. Half my men went home; the rest followed other captains. I am not sorry, only alone.
埃格拉迪尔的领主说这是屠杀，解散了队伍。一半人回了家，其他人跟了别的队长。我不后悔，只是剩下了自己。
The lord warden called it butchery and broke the company. Half my men went home; the rest followed other captains. I am not sorry, only alone.
守将说这是屠杀，解散了队伍。一半人回了家，其他人跟了别的队长。我不后悔，只是剩下了自己。

The lord's harness is the last armour a master armourer forges, and only for a proven captain. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take enemy lords captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.
领主铠甲是铸甲大师最后打造的装备，只属于经过考验的指挥官。亲手击倒敌人、俘获敌方领主、赢得战斗，或者向铸甲师交付你所属文化的领主级材料，大师便会为你打造铠甲。
The lords of Rhun acknowledge your service. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
鲁恩的领主们认可你的贡献。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
The map shows the Free Peoples and the Shadow.
地图显示自由人民与暗影阵营。
The map shows your allies and your enemies.
地图显示你的盟友和敌人。
The mark is set deep and does not fade. Marked Prey duration +2s.
标记已经刻得很深，不会轻易消退。标记猎物持续时间 +2 秒。
The mark of the Wolfskin leaves no survivors. Marked Prey radius +5.
月獠的标记不会留下活口。标记猎物作用范围 +5。
The mark persists through the chaos of battle. Marked Prey duration +4s.
即使战场一片混乱，标记也会继续存在。标记猎物持续时间 +4 秒。
The marshal called it butchery and broke the company. Half my men went home; the rest followed other captains. I am not sorry, only alone.
元帅说这是屠杀，解散了队伍。一半人回了家，其他人跟了别的队长。我不后悔，只是剩下了自己。
The master armourer fits you with {ITEM}.
The master armourer of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} has a heavy harness half-forged and no steel to finish it.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的铸甲大师有一副重甲只打造了一半，缺少钢料，没法完成。
The master armourer will fit you with one of these. Choose it.
铸甲大师会为你打造其中一件。请选择。
The men are already at work.
The men are felling timber for the camp.
士兵正在为营地砍伐木材。
The men are fishing the waters near the camp.
士兵正在营地附近的水域捕鱼。
The men are out hunting game for the camp.
士兵已外出为营地狩猎。
The men cannot be set to work during an encounter.
遭遇期间无法安排士兵干活。
The men cannot work while a scout is out.
斥候在外侦察时，无法安排士兵干活。
The men stand down. The work is abandoned.
士兵停止干活，工作已放弃。
The mere sight of you breaks enemy morale. +12% troop morale.
敌人光是看见你就会士气崩溃。+12% 部队士气。

The messenger had been ambushed east of the Ford and could not ride unaided. You found him, fought off the Orc stragglers still searching the road, and brought him in. Cirdan himself spoke to you briefly before turning to the message.
那名信使在渡口以东遭到伏击，已经无法独自骑马。你找到他，击退仍在沿路搜寻的零散奥克，将他带了回来。奇尔丹亲自同你说了几句话，随后才查看那封信。

The messenger had been ambushed east of the Ford and could not ride unaided. You found him, fought off the Orc stragglers still searching the road, and brought him in. Elrond himself spoke to you briefly before turning to the message.
那名信使在渡口以东遭伏击，已经无法自行骑马。你找到他，击退仍在搜寻道路的奥克散兵，并把他带回。埃尔隆德本人在转向查看消息前，曾简短地与你说话。
The messenger seems confused — they were trying to reach someone in your own party!
信使似乎有些困惑：他们要找的人就在你的队伍里！
The messenger system is disabled in settings.
信使系统已在设置中关闭。

The mind is the sharpest weapon. I debug problems others can't even see, and my solutions are elegant and deadly. In battle or in code, precision is everything. Allow me to demonstrate by joining your cause.
头脑才是最锋利的武器。我能调试别人甚至看不见的问题，我的解法优雅而致命。无论在战斗里还是在代码中，精准都是一切。让我加入你的事业，亲自证明给你看。
The miners of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} have struck a seam of the rare metal a lord's armour is forged from, and the shaft needs timber before it falls in.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的矿工发现了一条稀有金属矿脉，这种金属可以打造领主铠甲。矿井需要木料支撑，否则就会坍塌。

The minions of Dol Guldur, under the command of the Necromancer, are a dark and sinister force. Hidden within the corrupted forest of Mirkwood, they employ treachery and shadow to weaken their enemies. Orcs, wargs, and other foul creatures march forth to spread fear and decay across Middle-earth.
多古尔都的爪牙听命于死灵法师，是一股阴暗邪恶的力量。他们藏身在黑森林被腐化的林地深处，利用背叛与阴影削弱敌人。奥克、座狼和其他污秽生物从那里出发，把恐惧和腐败散播到中洲各地。

The mistake was selling some of that information to private buyers, wealthy lords who wanted intelligence on their rivals, merchants seeking trade secrets. The profit was substantial until someone noticed classified information appearing in unexpected places. I destroyed evidence and fled before the investigation reached me.
错误在于，我把一部分情报卖给了私人买家：想掌握对手动向的富有领主，寻找贸易秘密的商人。利润很可观，直到有人发现机密情报出现在不该出现的地方。我销毁证据，在调查追到我身上前逃走了。
The most enemy archers that hold you as their target at the same moment. Default: 8.
同一时刻最多有多少名敌方弓兵持续把你作为目标。默认：8。
The most men the hunter's party holds after its host is topped up. Default 250.
补充追猎军队后，其部队最多容纳的士兵数。默认：250。
The most of each iron grade, of iron ore and of hardwood that one smelt returns while the cap is on. Between 1 and 10; a value outside that range counts as 1. Default: 1.
开启产量限制后，每次熔炼最多产出的各品级铁、铁矿石和硬木数量。范围：1至10；超出范围按1处理。默认：1。

The most promotion prompts a single won battle may raise. Each prompt pauses the game, so a large number after a large battle means a long queue of dialogs. Merit above the cap is not lost — it carries to the next battle. Default: 2. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
赢得一场战斗后，最多弹出多少次晋升提示。每次提示都会暂停游戏，大战后提示过多就需要连续处理大量对话框。超出上限的功绩不会丢失，会留到下一场战斗。默认：2。2026年11月以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。

The most relation one barter can buy by offering more than the goods are worth. The loop buys at most 3 points in vanilla (the setting here), before the Tribute perk (x1.2, rounded up) and the Charm relation bonus the engine adds when it applies the change. Points cost more the further relation is from 0, so only a large overpay reaches the cap. Default: 15.
一次交易中，主动多付钱最多能增加多少关系。原版这项循环最多买到3点关系，这里的设置会调整该上限；之后还会计算“以礼相待”技能的1.2倍效果并向上取整，以及引擎结算时附加的魅力关系加成。关系偏离0越远，每点关系的费用越高，因此只有多付较大金额才能达到上限。默认：15。

The most relation one gift asks for, after the taste bonus and the scaling by relation (above relation 0 a gift adds (90 minus relation) / 90 of its worth, so a 1-point gift stops working near relation 45 and nothing helps at 90). A companion's gift starts at 1 to 5 by the item's value; a lord's starts at the catalog's value for the goods (1 to 10), and a hero who prizes the goods adds a bonus. Your Charm can add to what lands. Default: 15.
一份礼物在计算喜好加成和现有关系折算后，最多请求增加的关系值。关系高于0时，礼物价值会乘以“90减当前关系，再除以90”，因此基础价值1点的礼物在关系约45时就会失效，关系达到90时，任何礼物都不再有效。同伴礼物的基础加成为1至5点，取决于物品价值；领主礼物按目录中货物的基础值计算，为1至10点。英雄特别喜欢该物品时还会加成，你的魅力也可能提高最终增幅。默认：15。
The most relation you lose with an army's leader when you pay influence to disband it. Applies only in single player, and only while Enable Personal Relations is on. Default: 32.
花费影响力解散军团时，与军团长最多损失的关系值。只在单人模式且开启个人关系时生效。默认：32。

The most you may bet in each tournament round. 0 = unlimited (up to your purse); raise this slider for a bigger cap, or back to 0 to remove it. Roguery's Deep Pockets doubles any other value. Vanilla is 150. Default: 15,000. Saved values from before 2026-11-10 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
每轮竞技大会的最高投注额。0表示不设上限，但不能超过你持有的钱；提高滑块数值可以提高上限，设回0则取消上限。流氓习气的“钱袋颇深”技能会使非零上限翻倍。原版为150，默认：15,000。2026-11-10以前保存的数值已重置为此默认值；若你曾自行调整，请重新设置。

The mountain grows soft with prosperity. Merchants outnumber warriors, gold matters more than iron. When I said as much at council, they suggested I was too 'Iron Hills' for Erebor's new age. The dismissal was polite but clear.
孤山在繁荣中变软了。商人多过战士，黄金比铁更重要。我在议会上这么说，他们暗示我对孤山的新世代来说太“铁丘陵”了。那番打发很客气，但意思很清楚。

The mountain has its warriors, but the world needs them more. Darkness spreads from Mordor, Dol Guldur threatens the north. I'll find real fights, real purpose. When Erebor calls its sons to war, and it will, I'll be ready, battle-hardened from the outside world.
山中有自己的勇士，但世界更需要他们。黑暗从魔多蔓延，多古尔都威胁北方。我要去寻找真正的战斗，真正的目标。等孤山召唤子民参战时，而那一天一定会来，我会带着外界磨出的战斗经验准备好。
The mountain's mechanisms are wondrous, but some engineers dream beyond...
山中的机关令人惊叹，但有些工程师的梦想还要更远……
The mountains are cruel; weakness invites the blade.
群山残酷，软弱只会招来刀子。
The newest breeds are strongest, and they know it...
最新的品种最强，他们自己也清楚……
The next host of its side rides against your kingdom first, and every tribute after this one costs more.
对方下一支大军会优先进攻你的国家，此后的每次贡金也都会涨价。
The next patrol needs someone to lead it out and bring it back whole.
下一支巡逻队需要有人带队出去，再把所有人平安带回来。

The noble Dwarves of Erebor, are renowned for their craftsmanship, resilience, and pride. From their halls in the Lonely Mountain, they forge mighty weapons and treasures of unmatched beauty. Clad in mail and armed with axes, they defend their kin with steadfast courage, seeking to reclaim their legacy and preserve their heritage against all who threaten it.
孤山的高贵矮人以工艺、坚韧和自豪闻名。他们在孤山厅堂中锻造强大的武器和无与伦比的珍宝。他们身披锁甲、手持战斧，以坚定勇气保卫族人，也努力夺回自己的遗产，守住不容敌人侵犯的传承。
The nock and release is pure muscle memory. Light Fletching charge cost -30.
搭箭与松弦已经成了纯粹的肌肉记忆。轻羽箭充能消耗 -30。
The northern borders grow wild, and few watch them now...
北方的边境变得越来越荒凉，现在很少有人守卫了……

The oasis had been considered legend. You read the old accounts, identified the geographic clues, and went into the deep desert with ten days of water. On the ninth day you found it. The return took longer than expected but the route you marked brought caravans there within the season.
那片绿洲一直被认为只是传说。你阅读旧记载，找出地理线索，带着十天的水进入深沙漠。第九天你找到了它。回程比预想更久，但你标出的路线在同一季就把商队带到了那里。
The officers are arguing over the next march and want another voice at the table.
军官们正为接下来的行军争论不休，想再听听别人的意见。

The official had been diverting cargo for three years and everyone knew it, but no one had the documentation. You got the documentation, recovered the cargo on behalf of the merchants, and presented the accounts to the town council along with a list of recipients. The official left Dale quietly.
那名官员截留货物三年，人人都知道，却没人有证据。你拿到了证据，代表商人追回货物，并把账目连同收货人名单交给镇议会。那名官员悄悄离开了河谷邦。
The old Wainrider road lies open in the East
战车民昔日的进军道路在东方畅通无阻
The old alliance still means something to me, even if the Havens would rather forget it...
那个古老的联盟，对我仍有分量，尽管灰港宁愿忘记……

The old drydock could only handle one hull at a time and the fleet was backing up. Your redesign allowed parallel work on two vessels simultaneously. The ship-masters were skeptical until the first simultaneous completion came in ahead of schedule. They were not skeptical after that.
旧干船坞一次只能处理一条船体，舰队已经排起长龙。你的重新设计允许两艘船同时施工。船主们一开始怀疑，直到第一次双船同时提前完工。那之后他们就不再怀疑。

The old grounds had been grazed out and the elder council was divided on where to go next. You proposed a route, argued the case with numbers and precedent, and led the migration yourself. Three hundred animals and eighty-two people made it to the new grounds intact.
旧牧地已经被啃光，长老议会也对下一步去向争执不下。你提出路线，用数字和先例说明理由，并亲自带队迁徙。三百头牲畜和八十二个人完整抵达新牧地。

The old hall had stood for three generations before the riders put a torch to it. You designed the new one, organized the timber cutting, and led the build yourself. The hall that stands now is stronger and larger than the one that burned. That was the point.
旧大厅立了三代人，最后被骑手一把火烧掉。你设计新厅，组织伐木，并亲自带队施工。如今矗立的新厅比被烧毁的那座更坚固、更宽大。这正是意义所在。

The old maps showed a collapse, but you followed the sound of water in the deep stone and found the gallery intact behind the rubble. The mithril seam within was modest, but the engineers who mapped it added your name to the survey record.
旧地图上写着塌方，但你顺着深层岩石中的水声前进，在碎石后发现矿廊完好无损。里面的秘银矿脉不算大，但负责测绘的工程师把你的名字写进了勘查记录。
