The old maps showed a collapse, but you followed the sound of water in the deep stone and found the gallery intact behind the rubble. The seam within was rich, and the engineers who mapped it added your name to the survey record of Thorin's Halls.
旧地图标着那里已经坍塌，可你循着深处岩石间的水声，发现碎石后面的矿道完好无损。里面的矿脉十分富饶，测绘的工程师把你的名字写进了梭林大厅的勘测记录。

The old warriors say darkness is coming, that we'll all be tested soon. I intend to be ready, experienced, not some green recruit when that day comes. Let me earn my beard-rings in the wild, not the training yard.
老战士们说黑暗正在逼近，很快我们都会受到考验。我打算准备好，积累经验，而不是等那天到来时还像个新兵。让我在荒野里赢得胡须环，而不是在训练场上。
The one you were keeping to is gone.
之前跟随的目标不见了。
The ones who hold this town do not know you well enough yet. I keep my talk of the roads for friends.
这座城镇的统治者还不够信任你，道路消息只向朋友说。

The operation moved goods that could not be declared through channels that did not officially exist, to buyers who paid in coin that was never counted. You ran it cleanly enough that no watch captain was ever able to make a case. When you closed it, you did so because you chose to.
这套生意把不能报关的货物通过官方不存在的渠道送给买家，买家用从不入账的钱付款。你经营得足够干净，没有任何巡守队长能立案。你关掉它，只是因为你自己选择关掉。

The orc-host of the Misty Mountains holds the high places and deep delvings from Mount Gram to the gates of Moria. Bred for war in the cold peaks, they answer the call of the Shadow and hunger to reclaim the mountains for their own.
迷雾山脉的奥克大军占据着从格拉姆山到墨瑞亚大门之间的高地和深窟。他们在寒冷山峰中为战争而生，回应阴影的召唤，渴望夺回群山据为己有。

The orc-host that holds the deep places of the Misty Mountains — the black pits of Moria, won from the Dwarves, and the cold peaks from Caradhras to Methedras. Larger and better-armed than the goblin rabble of the High Pass, they muster vast war-hosts for almost no influence and march hungry but tireless across the snows.
这支奥克大军占据着迷雾山脉深处：从矮人手中夺来的墨瑞亚黑暗坑道，以及从卡拉兹拉斯到美塞德拉斯的寒冷峰峦。他们比高隘口的半兽人乌合之众更庞大、装备更好，几乎不耗影响力就能集结大战群，饥饿却不知疲倦地穿越雪地。
The order could not be placed.

The others may crawl back to rebuild under a new tyrant, but not I. I refuse to grovel in a pit where any snarling beast can claim dominance. I'll peddle my curses and poultices among warbands, learning to twist fates and spill blood. If I ever claim a lair, it'll be under a dark lord's banner, not amid the chaos of goblin squabbles.
其他人也许会爬回去，在新的暴君手下重建巢穴，但我不会。我不愿在那种坑里低头讨活，随便一头龇牙咧嘴的野兽都能称王。我会在战团之间兜售诅咒和药膏，学会扭转命运、放出更多血。若我有一天占下一座巢穴，也会是在黑暗领主的旗帜下，而不是陷在半兽人内斗的混乱里。

The overseer had promised punishment if the forge-tower was not ready before the Dark Lord's inspection. You drove the work gangs harder than anyone thought possible and the tower stood complete with two days to spare. The overseer took the credit; you took the survival.
监工放话，如果熔炉塔不能赶在黑暗魔君视察前完工，就会有人受罚。你把工队逼得比任何人想象中更狠，塔提前两天完工。功劳归了监工，活命归了你。
The pack is always ready to charge. Warpack Charge cost -20.
战群随时准备发起冲锋。战群冲锋充能消耗 -20。

The pass was narrow enough for one to hold, and someone had to stay. You volunteered, held the Orcs for long enough, and then retreated the way you had agreed. The company made it out. So did you, though you chose not to discuss how.
那处山口窄到一个人就能守住，而必须有人留下。你自愿留下，拖住奥克足够久，然后按约定路线撤退。队伍逃了出去，你也逃了出去，只是不愿谈怎么做到的。
The patrol captains of Barad Forn walk the Greenway and the North Downs, and we know every ford and track. Some of us sell that knowledge more freely than we should.
巴拉德佛恩的巡逻队长走遍绿大道和北岗，每处渡口、每条小径都熟。我们有些人卖起这些消息来，实在太随便。
The patrol captains of Last Bridge walk the East Road and the Hoarwell crossings, and we know every ford and track. Some of us sell that knowledge more freely than we should.
最后大桥的巡逻队长走遍东西大道和苍泉河各处通道，每处渡口、每条小径都熟。我们有些人卖起这些消息来，实在太随便。
The patrol captains of Tharbad walk the Greenway and the river tracks, and we know every ford and landing. Some of us sell that knowledge more freely than we should.
沙巴德的巡逻队长走遍绿大道和沿河小径，每处渡口、每个泊船处都熟。我们有些人卖起这些消息来，实在太随便。
The paychest is short — {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} of your wages is owed against later.
军饷不足，暂欠你的{AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}军饷将留待以后补发。
The people of Dale honor your courage! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
河谷邦人民敬重你的勇气！影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。

The people of Gondor are a proud and resilient folk, heirs to the greatest kingdom of Men in Middle-earth. Founded by the Númenórean exiles Isildur and Anárion, Gondor stands as a bastion of strength and hope against the encroaching darkness of Mordor. Its stone cities, crowned by the majestic Minas Tirith, are marvels of engineering and endurance. Guided by noble stewards and valiant captains, they field disciplined armies of steadfast infantry and swift mounted knights, a shining beacon of defiance in the face of despair.
刚铎人是骄傲而坚韧的民族，继承了中洲最伟大人类王国的遗产。刚铎由努门诺尔流亡者伊熙尔杜和阿纳瑞安建立，是抵御魔多黑暗扩张的力量与希望堡垒。以雄伟的米那斯提力斯为冠冕的石城，是工程与耐力的奇迹。在高贵摄政和勇敢将领的带领下，刚铎军队拥有纪律严明的坚定步兵和迅捷骑士，是绝望面前的一道明亮烽火。

The people of Isengard are Saruman's legions, forged through industry and fueled by a dark vision of domination. Centered around the impenetrable tower of Orthanc, Isengard is home to the Uruk-hai, bred for strength, endurance, and obedience. With machines of war and the cunning of their master, they crush all opposition with ruthless precision.
艾森加德的军队是萨茹曼的军团，由工业铸成，也由统治中土世界的黑暗野心驱动。坚不可摧的欧尔桑克塔是他们的中心，艾森加德也是乌鲁克的巢穴；这些战士为力量、耐力和服从而生。依靠战争机器和主人的狡诈，他们会以冷酷而精准的手段碾碎一切抵抗。

The people of Umbar are seafaring warriors and corsairs, masters of the seas south of Gondor. Descended from Númenórean exiles, they are known for their cunning and ferocity in battle. Under black sails, their fleets raid the coasts, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies. While their allegiances lie with Sauron, the Corsairs of Umbar are fiercely independent, valuing strength and cunning above all.
乌姆巴尔，是位于刚铎南部的一个地区。它在历史上曾经数度易手，成为被乌姆巴尔海盗控制的独立国家，直到埃莱萨王的时代才被刚铎王国彻底收复。乌姆巴尔位于贝尔法拉斯湾南部、安都因河入海口以南，其东面是辽阔的哈拉德地区，南边则是不为人知的远哈拉德。“乌姆巴尔”这一名称来源于某种人类语言，其含义并不清楚。它和昆雅语词汇“乌姆巴尔”（意为“命运”）没有任何关系。
The people of {TOWN} honor your victory.
The people of {VILLAGE} will long remember the raid.
{VILLAGE}的人民会长久记住这次劫掠。
The people of {VILLAGE} will long remember what was taken from them by force.
{VILLAGE}的人民会长久记住被强行夺走的东西。

The piece — a detailed relief map of Eriador's ancient road network, reconstructed from fragmentary sources — was considered accurate enough to be copied into the library's archives. Three loremasters disagreed about two valleys; you were right about both.
那是一幅埃利阿多古道路网的精细浮雕地图，由零碎来源重建而成，被认为准确到足以复制进图书馆档案。三位学识大师对两处山谷意见不一；你两处都判断对了。
The pilots of the Gulf know every cove and shoal after dark. We carry cargo that others cannot find their own way to.
海湾的领航员，天黑也认得每处小湾和浅滩。有些货，别人自己找不到路去送，我们能送。
The plain's finest guardian. +12% battle renown gain.
平原最出色的守护者。+12%战斗声望获取。
The plains hold no secrets from you. +8% party spotting range.
平原对你没有秘密。+8% 部队侦察范围。
The plains need warriors who won't be silenced.
平原需要不肯闭嘴的战士。
The plains taught me more than any hall of warriors ever could...
平原教会我的，比任何战士厅堂都多……
The player switcher could not start and is disabled for this session.
角色切换功能无法启动，本次游戏中已停用。

The poison was fast-acting and the shaman said there was nothing to be done. You remembered a different teaching — a preparation from the cold steppe plants that worked against this type of wound. You prepared it, applied it, and sat through the night. The chieftain recovered. He gave you a place at his council.
毒发得很快，萨满说已经无能为力。你记起另一种教法：用寒冷草原植物制成的配方，能对付这类伤口。你调制、敷用，并守了一整夜。酋长康复了，还给了你议事席位。
The pony's strength becomes your own. +7 health.
矮马的力量也成了你的力量。+7 生命值。

The post covered both approaches and could not be left unmanned. You kept the full vigil yourself through a cold night and a half a day's shift without rest, reporting three incidents that the relief watch found exactly as you described them.
这个哨位覆盖两条通路，不能无人驻守。你独自熬过寒夜和半个白班，没有休息，并报告了三处情况；接替守望者后来发现，一切都和你说的一样。
The power to create from nothing? Impressive indeed.
从无到有创造事物的力量？确实令人佩服。

The previous courier had been bleeding supply convoys for months through bad routing and worse deals. You cut the dead weight, renegotiated the toll agreements, and doubled throughput inside a season. The overseers rewarded you with a better cut and a worse conscience.
前任信使因为糟糕路线和更糟的交易，已经让补给车队流血数月。你砍掉累赘，重新谈判过路协议，一个季节内就让吞吐量翻倍。监工给了你更高分成，也给了你更沉重的良心。
The prey can never escape your mark. Marked Prey charge cost -30.
猎物永远逃不出你的标记。标记猎物充能消耗 -30。

The price of Dwarvish iron at the Grey Havens had not been revised in a lifetime of Men. You assembled the facts and put the case to the Elves of Lindon with such clarity that the agreement was rewritten within the month, and King Farin's treasurer learned your name.
以人类的寿命算，灰港的矮人铁料价格已经一辈子没调整过了。你整理事实，把道理向林顿精灵讲得清清楚楚，一个月内就改订了协议，法林王的财务官也记住了你的名字。

The price of buying a claim on a title, as a percentage of its price in realms_titles.xml (40 for a Barony up to 500 for a Kingdom, in your people's own resource). AI lords pay for theirs in gold, at the same percentage. Between 10 and 500. Default: 100.
购买头衔宣称的费用，按realms_titles.xml中价格的百分比计算。基础费用从男爵领的40到王国的500不等，使用所属民族的专属资源。AI领主使用金币支付，采用相同百分比。范围：10至500。默认：100。
The price of good leather has climbed beyond all reason, and my craft dies for want of it. Bring me some at an honest cost and I will remember it.
好皮革的价格涨得太离谱了，再弄不到，我的生意就要做不下去了。按公道的价钱给我带一些来，我会记住你的帮助。
The quartermaster has kit for your new rank.
军需官已经为你的新军衔准备好装备。
The quartermaster has nothing in his stores for your company.
军需官的库存里没有适合你这支队伍的装备。
The quartermaster is short on supplies and needs a hand sorting it out.
军需官的物资不够了，需要有人帮忙解决。
The quartermaster takes back your service kit: {COUNT} item(s).
军需官收回了配发给你的装备，共{COUNT}件。
The quartermaster wants every soldier's kit checked before the muster.
军需官要求在集结前检查每一名士兵的装备。
The quartermasters of Cameth Brin keep the grain and the wall-works, and we answer for every hard sum the tower demands. Few in the town thank us for it.
卡梅斯布林的军需官管粮食，也管城墙修缮。为了守住高塔，那些难算的账都得我们负责，镇上却没几个人谢我们。
The quartermasters of Fornost Erain keep the grain and the siege works, and we answer for every hard sum the walls demand. Few in the capital thank us for it.
佛诺斯特·埃莱因的军需官管粮食，也管攻城工事。为了守住城墙，那些难算的账都得我们负责，都城却没几个人谢我们。
The quartermasters of Tharbad keep the wharves and the granaries, and we answer for every hard sum the river gate demands. Merchants seldom thank us for it.
沙巴德的军需官管码头和粮仓。河门开不开，那些难算的账都得我们负责，商人却很少谢我们。
The rage burns longer in your breast. Savage Rush duration +4s.
怒火在你胸中燃烧得更久。蛮勇突袭持续时间 +4 秒。
The rage needs little provocation. Savage Rush charge cost -30.
这股怒火不需要多少挑衅就会爆发。蛮勇突袭充能消耗 -30。
The rage of your ancestors flows through you. Savage Rush radius +3.
先祖的怒火在你体内流淌。蛮勇突袭作用范围 +3。

The raiders had timed their strike for the harvest period when the farmsteads were exposed. You had anticipated the possibility, organized the local levies in advance, and met them at the valley entrance. The raid broke on the spear-line before it reached a single farmstead.
劫掠者把袭击选在农庄暴露的收获期。你提前想到这种可能，先组织好当地征召兵，并在山谷入口迎上他们。劫掠还没碰到任何农庄，就撞碎在长矛阵线上。
The raiders had timed their strike for the harvest, when the farmsteads lay open. You gathered the levy, met them on foot at the stream-crossing and held them there until the riders came.
劫掠者专挑收获季节发动袭击，那时农庄缺少防备。你召集征召兵，在溪流渡口徒步迎敌，把他们挡在那里，直到骑兵赶到。
The rain of arrows does not abate. Light Fletching duration +2s.
箭雨不会停歇。轻羽箭持续时间 +2 秒。
The rangers who ward the hamlets of Ettendale swear to keep their roofs from burning. Duty calls us away as often as it keeps us home.
守护埃滕谷小村的游民，都发誓不让村民的屋顶烧起来。可职责让我们留守家乡，也同样常把我们召去远方。
The rangers who ward the villages of Bree-land swear to keep their roofs from burning. Duty calls us north as often as it keeps us home.
守护布理乡村庄的游民，都发誓不让村民的屋顶烧起来。可职责让我们留守家乡，也同样常把我们召去北方。
The rangers who ward the villages of Cardolan swear to keep their roofs from burning. Duty calls us away as often as it keeps us home.
守护卡多蓝村庄的游民，都发誓不让村民的屋顶烧起来。可职责让我们留守家乡，也同样常把我们召去远方。
The realm wastes half its strength ignoring women warriors.
不肯用女战士，王国就白白浪费了一半力量。
The realms of Men and Elf alike have been crushed. Long live Sauron!
人类与精灵的国度都已覆灭。索隆万岁！

The recruits were the worst draft Isengard had seen — underfed, undisciplined, and convinced of their own worthlessness. After twelve weeks under your instruction they held the line in a training exercise that the Uruk-hai observers called adequate. Coming from them, that was high praise.
那批新兵是艾森加德见过最糟的征召：吃不饱、没纪律，还确信自己一无是处。经过你十二周训练，他们在演习中守住阵线，乌鲁克观察员评价为合格。出自他们之口，这已经是很高的称赞。
The refuge is dismantled; its garrison and stores return to your party.
避难所已拆除，驻军和物资已归入你的部队。
The refuge is raised. It stands as your forward base; manage it to deposit troops.
避难所已建成，可以作为你的前进基地。进入管理界面即可安排士兵驻守。
The refuge is still being raised.

The riders had taken the clan's breeding stock before anyone raised the alarm. You assembled six men, tracked the party through the night, caught them at the Isen ford, and brought the cattle back before morning. The chief added your name to the stronghold's stone.
骑手在警报响起前偷走了氏族种牛。你召集六个人，连夜追踪，在艾森河渡口赶上他们，并在天亮前把牛带回。酋长把你的名字刻进了堡垒石上。
The riders of Rhûn are satisfied. Go west, and say the grass was kind to you.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
鲁恩骑兵满意了。往西走吧，就说这片草原待你不薄。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
The riders of Wainwatch hold the eastern plains against every raid, and we carry the old kings' pride into every charge. Some of us ride on alone.
战车哨站的骑兵在东部平原抵挡每一次劫掠，每次冲锋都带着昔日诸王的骄傲。我们有些人，如今独自骑行。
The riders of the Wainwatch frontier learn war without mercy. Not all of us can live with what we learn.
战车哨站边境的骑兵，学的是不留情的打法。可我们不是人人都能跟学来的这些东西过一辈子。
The ring of hammer on steel is the music I was born to play...
锤子敲在钢上的声音，是我天生该演奏的音乐……

The rival had been blocking your advancement for two years through bribes and better connections. You identified what he valued, arranged for the right objects to be in the wrong place at the wrong time, and made the discovery at the right moment. You had his position before the month was out.
那个对手靠贿赂和更好的关系挡了你两年晋升。你弄清他重视什么，把正确物件安排到错误地方，再在正确时机完成发现。月底之前，他的位置已经是你的。

The rival tribe had prospered for years through unfavorable toll agreements imposed on your trade routes. You studied their caravan schedules for a season, chose the right moment in the deep desert, and took back what had been taken. Your tribe considered it justice; the rival tribe called it something else.
敌对部族多年靠对你们商路强加不利通行费而兴旺。你研究他们商队时间表一个季节，在深沙漠中选准时机，把被拿走的东西夺了回来。你的部族认为这是正义，对方则另有说法。
The river holds no fear for you. +5% movement speed.
这条河吓不倒你。+5% 移动速度。
The river's control is vital to Gondor.
河流的控制权对刚铎至关重要。
The road from Dale to the lake is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，从河谷城到湖边的路，比看起来长得多。
The road from Vineholm to Redwater is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，从葡萄洲到红水的路，比看起来长得多。
The road from the Old Ford to the Carrock is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，从老渡口到卡尔岩的路，比看起来长得多。

The road had been effectively closed for two seasons by spider and Orc harassment. You mapped the safest remaining corridors, negotiated guard arrangements with Thranduil's captain, and led the first merchant convoy through to success. Trade resumed within the month.
这条路因蜘蛛和奥克骚扰，实际上已关闭两个季节。你绘出剩余最安全通道，与瑟兰杜伊的队长谈妥护卫安排，并带领第一支商队成功通过。一个月内贸易便恢复了。
The road is quiet behind you, and stays quiet.
你经过后，道路恢复了平静，也一直没有再出乱子。
The roof fell on your crew because you were stubborn.
就是你不肯让步，才让工友被塌下来的石头压住。
The same precision that guides my art guides my blade. A master craftsman must defend their works. Besides, one who can create such beauty knows exactly how to unmake one's enemies. Shall I join you?
指引我创作的精准，同样也指引我的剑。大匠必须守护自己的作品。更何况，懂得创造美的人，也最清楚该如何拆解敌人。要我加入你吗？

The scouts had been taken deep in the corrupted southern wood where the patrols would not go. You went alone at night, cut them free, and led them out through three spider-guarded paths. Two of them asked how you knew the way. You told them it was instinct.
斥候被带到腐化南方森林深处，巡逻队不会去那里。你夜里独自前往，割开蛛网，把他们带出三条有蜘蛛守卫的道路。其中两人问你怎么知道路。你说那是直觉。
The sea takes more than ponies.
大海拿走的，可不止小马。
The sea-watch archers of the Falathrim guard the coast and the foothills. We are trained to shoot true and to hold the line.
法拉斯民的海防弓手，守着海岸和山麓。我们练的不只是射准，还得守住阵线。
The selected companies hold the line: shielded foot soldiers in a shield wall, circle or square stop attacking until you press Hold the Line again or order a charge.
所选编队开始维持阵线：盾墙、圆阵或方阵中的持盾步兵停止攻击，直到你再次按下“维持阵线”或下达冲锋命令。
The sergeant needs someone to walk the night rounds before the watch changes.
军士需要有人在换岗前完成夜间巡逻。
军士们对你的表现做了评价：{GRADE}。
The servants of Dol Guldur march to {settlement}!
多古尔都的仆从向{settlement}进军！

The settlement's supply line had been cut and the tools were failing. You assessed what could be recovered, salvaged the best material from broken pieces, and reforged it into working equipment. Three Rangers asked for your work over new supply when the line reopened.
聚落补给线被切断，工具也在损坏。你评估哪些还能回收，从破损物件中取出最好的材料，重新锻成可用装备。补给线恢复后，仍有三名游侠宁愿要你的作品，不要新货。
The shadow cavalry's deeds are legendary. +14% battle renown gain.
暗影骑兵的功绩已成传说。+14% 战斗声望获取。
The shadow clings to you longer. Sneak-Creeping duration +2s.
阴影会更久地缠绕在你身边。潜行突进持续时间 +2 秒。
The shadow has been hard on us, traveller. Rats and a bitter winter took our seed-corn. Without grain to sow, we will not last the year.
旅人，黑暗笼罩下的日子可不好过。鼠患和严冬毁掉了我们的粮种。没有粮食播种，我们就撑不过这一年。
The shadow is appeased. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
阴影得到了安抚。影响力+{influence}，关系+{relation}。
The shadow of the south of Mirkwood at the border
黑森林南方的阴影逼近边境
The shield-maidens of old knew no fear, neither should I...
从前的持盾女战士无所畏惧，我也该一样……
The shop is closed during a wave.
敌军进攻期间，商店不开放。
The siege drags on: every tower and keep now weakens by the minute.
战斗拖延太久，所有防御塔和主堡都会每分钟继续衰弱。
The slaughter order always leaves this many head of each livestock type alive. The game itself still slaughters livestock when every other food is gone. Between 0 and 20. Default: 2.
宰杀指令始终为每种牲畜保留此数量。其他食物耗尽时，游戏自身仍会宰杀牲畜。范围：0至20。默认：2。

The slave pits at the Front Porch had a ring, and I ruled it for four winters. Dwarf captives, men, a Beorning cub once, I broke them all while the crowd screamed. The Great Goblin's own sons put bones on me.
前门廊的奴隶坑里有个斗场，我在那里称霸了四个冬天。矮人俘虏、人类，还有一次是个贝奥恩小崽子，都被我打垮了，观众叫得震天响。半兽人王的儿子也拿骨头押我赢。
The slave pits were mine, in a way. I kept the tally, the chains, the price of a dwarf, of a Rohirric farm-girl, of a Beorning cub. The Great Goblin paid me a tenth. He is generous, as spiders are.
奴隶坑也算归我管。我记人数、管锁链，知道一个矮人、一个洛汗农家姑娘、一个贝奥恩小崽子各值多少。半兽人王给我一成抽佣，他跟蜘蛛一样慷慨。
The smashing continues. Hammer Down duration +2s.
破坏还会继续。重锤压顶持续时间 +2 秒。
The smith of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} has run dry of iron and cannot mend tool nor blade.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的铁匠耗尽了铁料，没法修理工具和刀剑。
The smiths of Forlindon work the iron that comes down from the Blue Mountains. We make good blades, and we ask what they are for.
佛林顿的铁匠，用蓝色山脉运来的铁打剑。我们造好剑，也会问，这剑拿来干什么。
The soldier who fires an ability, and a few of the kin who join him, shout in their own voice.
触发能力的士兵，以及部分响应的同族士兵，会用自己的声音喊叫。
The song of the Eotheod carries the riders onward. Warcry duration +2s.
伊奥希奥德的歌声带着骑手继续向前。埃奥尔战吼持续时间 +2 秒。
The song of the Northmen carries the riders onward. Warcry duration +2s.
北方人的歌声引领骑手前进。战吼持续时间+2秒。
The sons of Dale's old houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
河谷城古老家族的子弟，从小就学带兵，号角一响便跨马出征。我们有些人得去别处找带兵的差事。
The sons of Dorwinion's old vintner houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
多温尼安古老酿酒家族的子弟，从小就学带兵，号角一响便跨马出征。我们有些人得去别处找带兵的差事。
The sons of the old Vale houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
河谷古老家族的子弟，从小就学带兵，号角一响便跨马出征。我们有些人得去别处找带兵的差事。
The sons of the old Woodmen houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
林中居民古老家族的子弟，从小就学带兵，号角一响便跨马出征。我们有些人得去别处找带兵的差事。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Blue Craig had tinkerers but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有铁料，却没有铁匠；蓝岩有工匠，却缺少粮食和皮毛。你促成了第一笔交易，定下条件，还让双方暂时放下了厮杀，直到交易成了常事。战酋也分给了你一份利润。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Goblin-town had tinkerers but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有铁料，却没有铁匠；半兽人镇有工匠，却缺少粮食和皮毛。你促成了第一笔交易，定下条件，还让双方暂时放下了厮杀，直到交易成了常事。战酋也分给了你一份利润。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Gundabad had smiths but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有铁却没有铁匠，贡达巴德有铁匠却需要食物和毛皮。你促成第一批交换，定下条款，并让双方在足够长时间里没有互相砍死，使交易变成习惯。战酋分给了你一成。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Moria had smiths but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有铁料，却没有铁匠；墨瑞亚有铁匠，却缺少粮食和皮毛。你促成了第一笔交易，定下条件，还让双方暂时放下了厮杀，直到交易成了常事。战酋也分给了你一份利润。

The southern of Arnor's three successor kingdoms. Its kings lie in the barrows of Tyrn Gorthad and its riders keep the plains between the Baranduin and the Greyflood. It stands apart from the War of the Ring, but Dunland, the goblins and the orcs of the mountains test its few towns every year.
阿尔诺分裂后的三个王国中，最南边的一个。历代国王长眠于提殒戈沙德的古冢，骑兵守护着巴兰都因河与灰水河之间的平原。它没有卷入魔戒大战，但黑蛮地人、半兽人和山中的奥克每年都会侵扰它为数不多的城镇。

The southern of the three realms into which Arnor was sundered. Its kings lie in the barrows of Tyrn Gorthad and its riders keep the plains between the Baranduin and the Greyflood, but its towns are few and its lords contend with Arthedain and Rhudaur for the crown of Arnor.
阿尔诺分裂出的三个王国中，卡多蓝位于南方。历代国王长眠于提殒戈沙德的古冢，骑兵守卫着巴兰都因河与灰水河之间的平原。这里城镇稀少，领主们仍与阿塞丹、鲁道尔争夺阿尔诺的王冠。
The spearmen of Sarn Ford are first into the water and last to hear an order. Most of us have paid for it at least once.
萨恩渡口的矛手，第一个下水，最后一个听见命令。我们大多数至少为此受过一次罚。
The spearmen of the Egladil watch are first over the ditch and last to hear an order. Most of us have been punished for it at least once.
埃格拉迪尔守卫队的矛手，第一个越过壕沟，最后一个听见命令。我们大多数至少为此受过一次罚。
The spearmen of the Emyn Beraid watch are first over the ditch and last to hear an order. Most of us have been punished for it at least once.
埃敏贝莱德守卫队的矛手，第一个越过壕沟，最后一个听见命令。我们大多数至少为此受过一次罚。
The spearmen of the Woodmen hold the Emyn Duir road beside the Wardens, and the work there is not gentle. We learn it, and we do not forget it.
林中居民的矛手跟守望者一起守着埃敏杜伊尔大道，那里的差事可不温和。我们学会了，也就忘不了。

The spy had been in the city for two years, passing information to the clans about Rohirrim garrison strengths. You noticed the pattern in what went wrong on raids where only a few people had been told the details. Three conversations later you had the name and the method of transfer.
那名间谍在城里潜伏两年，把洛希尔守军实力情报传给氏族。你从几次只有少数人知情的劫掠为何出错中看出规律。三次谈话后，你知道了名字，也知道了传递方式。
The spy had been in the town for two years, passing word of the herds and the garrison to the east. You watched him until you knew the pattern, and delivered him to the king's wardens.
这名间谍在城里待了两年，一直把马群与驻军的消息送往东方。你盯着他，直到摸清他的活动规律，再把他交给国王手下的守卫。
The steppe breeds hard riders, and the Ezarkia hardest of all. Ask, and I will tell you how I came to ride alone.
草原会养出强悍的骑手，而埃扎基亚氏族又是其中最硬的。你问吧，我会告诉你自己为什么会独自上路。

The steward Aldwulf came with tax collectors, demanding twice our usual tribute. When I protested, he accused me of hoarding wealth while the King's treasury ran thin. He had documents, forged but convincing, showing I'd traded with the Wainriders.
总管阿尔德伍尔夫带着税吏上门，索要平时两倍的贡赋。我提出异议，他就指控我在国库空虚时私藏财富。他拿出一批文书，虽是伪造，却做得像真的，声称我跟战车民做过买卖。
The stores and the market here do not hold enough.
现有储备加上本地集市的存货也不够。
The stores are in my keeping. What would you have me do?
物资都由我保管，有什么吩咐？
The stores are thin tonight and there isn't enough to go around.
今晚存粮不多，已经不够大家分了。
The stores do not hold enough, and there is no market here to buy the rest.
现有储备不足，这里也没有集市可以买齐剩下的。
The strongest warriors sometimes outgrow their masters...
最强的战士，有时会强到不再适合服从主人……
The stronghold is complete; its walls and garrison stand stronger.
堡垒已建成，城墙更加坚固，驻军的防御也更强了。
The sun smiles on you today. Go in peace, and tell others the southern road has keepers.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
今天太阳照顾你。平安走吧，也告诉别人，南方这条路是有人看着的。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
The supply caravan could not be assembled.

The supply fleet was three hours out when you noticed the way the coastal birds were behaving around a particular headland. You called for a halt, went ahead in a small craft, and found a Gondorian squadron waiting in the calm water behind it. The fleet turned back. The admiral gave you the next command.
补给舰队离港三小时时，你注意到某处岬角附近海鸟的异常行为。你下令停船，乘小船先行侦察，在岬角后方平静水面中发现一支刚铎分舰队。舰队返航，海军上将把下一次指挥权交给了你。
The supply screen failed to open (see log). Returning to the map.
补给界面打开失败（请查看日志）。正在返回地图。
The swan ships sail less often now, and corsairs grow bold...
如今天鹅船已经不怎么出海了，海盗们的胆子也越来越大了……

The teeming goblin-warrens beneath the High Pass of the Misty Mountains. Since the fall of the Great Goblin the tribes have multiplied without number — vast, ill-armed swarms that win by sheer weight and breed faster than any foe can cull them. They run swiftest over the snows of their mountain home, but such hordes are ever ravenous.
这里是迷雾山脉高隘口下方挤满半兽人的地穴。半兽人王死后，各部族不断繁衍，如今已经多得数不清。他们装备简陋，却能靠数量压倒敌人，繁衍的速度更是让敌人杀不胜杀。他们在家乡的山间雪地上跑得飞快，但如此庞大的群体也总是缺吃少粮。

The terms on Erebor's iron exports had not been renegotiated since the Mountain's reclamation. You identified the imbalance, assembled the facts, and presented the case to King Dain's steward with such clarity that the agreement was revised within the month.
孤山铁器出口条款自山中王国收复以来就没重新谈过。你看出其中失衡，整理事实，并清楚地向铁足戴因的管家陈述理由，一个月内协议便完成修订。
The themed, layered banner editor, both during character creation and in a running campaign. Takes effect the next time it opens.
在创建角色和战役进行期间，使用带主题样式和图层的旗帜编辑器。下次打开编辑器时生效。

The three chiefs had not spoken in a generation, and the Rohirrim were counting on their division. You rode between camps for a week, said the right things to the right people in the right order, and on the day of the expedition's arrival, three clans stood together on the ridge. The Rohirrim turned back.
三位酋长已经一代人不说话，洛希尔人也正指望他们继续分裂。你在各营地间奔走一周，按正确顺序对正确的人说了正确的话。远征队到来那天，三个氏族一同站在山脊上。洛希尔人退了回去。
The thunder rolls on. Warcry of Eorl duration +4s.
雷鸣般的战吼久久不息。埃奥尔战吼持续时间 +4 秒。
The thunder rolls on. Warcry of Vidugard duration +4s.
雷鸣滚滚不息。维杜加德战吼持续时间+4秒。
The title alone: its lands stay with their lords.
仅授予头衔：土地仍归原领主所有。
The tournament master offers a choice of prizes. Choose the one you will fight for; it is yours if you win.
竞技大会主持人提供了几种奖品。选择你想争取的那一件；赢得比赛后，它就归你。
本次竞技大会锻炼了你的{SKILL_NAME}。

The tournament was fought across three brutal rounds in the main hall. You came in as no one's favourite and left with a warchief's silver arm-ring and a better bunk. The other competitors respected you more for winning than they had for anything before.
比武在主厅中进行了三轮残酷较量。你入场时没人看好，离开时却戴着战酋赐予的银臂环，还换到更好的铺位。其他竞争者终于比以往任何时候都更尊重你，因为你赢了。
The tower at Cameth Brin stands because someone counted every stone and every mouth...
卡梅斯布林的高塔还立着，是因为有人数清每块石头、每张嘴……

The trade routes are compromised, but the guild won't listen. I take my knowledge freelance now, which paths are safe, which merchants are honest, where the shadows gather. War and trade will mix soon enough, and those prepared will profit... or at least survive.
商路已经被渗透，但行会不肯听。如今我把自己的知识拿出来单干：哪些路安全，哪些商人诚实，阴影在哪里聚集。战争和贸易很快就会搅在一起，准备好的人会获利……至少能活下来。

The traveller had taken a Morgul-tainted wound and the senior healers were already preparing their regrets. You had read a different account of the toxin's behavior in the library's older texts. You applied what you had read and the traveller recovered.
那名旅人受了带有魔古尔污染的伤，高阶医者已准备表示遗憾。你曾在图书馆更古老的文本中读到过这种毒素的另一种变化。你照着所读方法处理，旅人活了下来。
The truth is worth any price.
真相值得付出任何代价。

The truth remains whether they believe it or not. Dark forces gather intelligence on Erebor's defenses, and I know who helps them. Out here, my skills and knowledge serve those who value truth over comfortable lies. My crossbow and keen eyes seek honest employment.
真相不会因为他们不信就消失。黑暗势力正在收集孤山防御的情报，而我知道谁在帮他们。在外面，我的本事和知识会服务于那些重视真相、胜过舒适谎言的人。我的弩和敏锐眼睛，只寻找诚实的雇主。

The unexpected often proves the most valuable. My southern eyes see angles others miss, my desert heritage brings different perspectives to northern lands. Perhaps being lost was just the beginning of being found. May I travel with you?
出乎意料的东西，往往最有价值。我的南方眼光能看见别人错过的角度，沙漠出身也让我能以不同方式看待北方土地。也许迷失只是被找回的开始。我可以与你同行吗？

The unnatural cold and the stillness of the birds were the first signs. You reported what you felt to the Galadhrim command before anyone else had noticed. The Lady's power moved to reinforce the borders. Afterward, Celeborn said your instincts were unusually sharp.
不自然的寒意和鸟群的静默是最早迹象。你在其他人察觉前，把自己的感受报告给加拉兹民指挥。夫人的力量随后加强了边界。事后，凯勒博恩说你的直觉异常敏锐。
The unseen hand protects you. +10% resistance to melee.
看不见的手会护住你。+10% 近战抗性。

The valley settlement had been subsistence farming on old methods for a generation. You had seen better approaches on the trade routes and applied them carefully, crop by crop, year by year. By the third season the settlement was producing surplus for the first time anyone could remember.
这个山谷聚落用旧方法勉强糊口已经一代人。你在商路上见过更好的办法，于是谨慎地逐片作物、逐年推广。到第三季时，聚落第一次生产出人们记忆中的余粮。
The village has given all the sons it intends to.
这个村子愿意送去参军的年轻人都已经走了。
The village of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} has lost its draught oxen and cannot work the fields.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}村失去了耕牛，已经无法耕种田地。
The villagers finished the work without you.
The vintners commissioned a new press for the king's cellar. You designed it and cut its beams yourself, and when the first juice ran the cellarmen named it after you.
酒商委托你为王家酒窖建造一台新压榨机。你亲自设计，亲手砍削梁木。第一股葡萄汁流出时，酒窖工人便用你的名字为机器命名。

The vintners of Dorwinion tend the warm slopes where the River Running meets the Sea of Rhûn. Their wine goes up the river to Dale, to the Elves of Mirkwood and to every hall that can pay for it, and their kings grow rich on it. They keep out of the wars of the West and buy peace from the East when they must.
在奔流河汇入鲁恩内海的地方，多温尼安酒商经营着温暖山坡上的葡萄园。他们的葡萄酒沿河运往河谷邦、黑森林的精灵领地，以及一切买得起酒的厅堂，国王也因此积累了财富。他们置身西方的战争之外，必要时便花钱向东方势力买取和平。
The voice carries further. Voice of the One duration +4s.
那道声音传得更远。至尊魔戒之声持续时间 +4 秒。
The voice requires less sacrifice to invoke. Voice charge cost -30.
唤起那道声音所需的献祭更少。至尊魔戒之声充能消耗 -30。
The volley cannot be loosed now
The vote on "{VOTE}" no longer applies and has been withdrawn.
关于“{VOTE}”的投票已不再适用，现已撤回。
The wagons are backed up and someone needs to get them moving again.
货车堵在了路上，需要有人让车队重新动起来。
The wagons are lighter and the stores are fuller.
货车卸了货，仓库里的储备更充足了。
The wall at Fornost Erain stands because someone counted every stone, every sack of grain, every mouth...
佛诺斯特·埃莱因的城墙还立着，是因为有人数清每块石头、每袋粮食、每张嘴……
The war is over. The Free Peoples have persevered, and won the future for their children. Long live freedom!
战争结束了。自由人民坚持到底，为子孙赢得了未来。自由万岁！
The war takes every bar of good steel before it reaches my forge. I have a harness on the anvil that would turn an arrow, and nothing left to finish it with.
战争把好钢都拿走了，根本送不到我的炉子里。我在铁砧上有一副能挡箭的甲，可手头已经没料把它做完了。

The warband had struck four settlements without the Rangers catching them. You read the pattern, anticipated their next target, and moved to intercept rather than chase. Three of the Rangers with you said afterward that they had not expected you to be right. You were.
那支战帮袭击了四个聚落，游侠却一直没抓住他们。你读懂规律，预判下一个目标，选择拦截而不是追赶。与你同行的三名游侠事后说，他们本没想到你会猜对。但你就是猜对了。

The warband needed to reach the southern approaches without crossing the open country where the Rohirrim patrols could see them. The only path ran along Fangorn's border. You led them through in two nights, keeping the party quiet and the Ents undisturbed. Both groups arrived safely, which was not guaranteed.
战帮需要抵达南方入口，却不能穿过会被洛希尔巡逻队看见的开阔地。唯一道路沿着范贡边界延伸。你用两个夜晚带他们穿过，保持队伍安静，也没有惊扰恩特。两队人都安全抵达，而这本来并不稳妥。
The warcry echoes across the plain. Warcry of Eorl radius +3.
战吼响彻平原。埃奥尔战吼作用范围 +3。

The warship was twice the size of your vessel and her crew outnumbered yours. You closed in a fog, went over the side first, took the helm, and had the crew disarmed before they fully understood what was happening. The ship was in Umbar's harbor within two days.
那艘战船大小是你的两倍，船员也更多。你在雾中逼近，第一个翻过船舷，夺下舵位，并在敌人完全明白发生什么前缴了全船武装。两天内，这艘船就停在乌姆巴尔港里。
The watch here could use some silver to keep the peace.
给这里的卫队一些赏钱，能帮助他们维持秩序。
The watch is always maintained. River Navigator charge cost -30.
守望始终不会松懈。河道巡守充能消耗 -30。
The watch is always maintained. Stand Fast charge cost -30.
守望从不间断。坚守不退充能消耗-30。
The watch is maintained through all trials. River Navigator duration +4s.
无论经历多少考验，守望都不会中断。河道巡守持续时间 +4 秒。
The watch is maintained through all trials. Stand Fast duration +4s.
无论经受怎样的考验，守望都不会中断。坚守不退持续时间+4秒。
守望永不结束。+9 生命值。
The watch on the Ered Luin is a hard post, and it makes hard people. We stand between Lindon's last farms and the goblins of Blue Craig.
埃瑞德路因的守卫不好当，待久了，人也会变硬。我们挡在林顿最远的农庄与蓝岩半兽人之间。
The way ahead is clear, and you can say why.
你已确认前方道路安全，也能说清判断的依据。
The weak die so the strong might live - such is war...
弱者死去，强者才能活下去，这就是战争……
The weak die so the strong might live, such is war...
弱者死，强者活，战争就是这样……

The weirs had been destroyed in the raids and the lake catch had fallen to a fraction of its normal yield. You organized the reconstruction, solved the structural problem that had plagued the old design, and had the new weirs producing within a month. The fishermen named one of the weirs after you.
鱼梁在劫掠中被毁，湖中渔获降到平日一小部分。你组织重建，解决旧设计长期存在的结构问题，并让新鱼梁一个月内恢复产出。渔民把其中一座鱼梁用你的名字命名。

The western ruins of the ancient capital on the Anorien bank of the Anduin, held by Gondorian forces as a forward defensive position despite being mostly abandoned after the Great Plague. The western side of the shattered bridge connects to a causeway leading toward Minas Tirith, with Rangers maintaining a garrison among the ruins to prevent Mordor from using the crossing. Haunted by memories of former glory when it was Gondor's greatest city for over a thousand years.
这片西部废墟位于安都因河阿诺瑞恩一侧，曾是古都的一部分。大瘟疫之后这里大多被废弃，但刚铎仍将其作为前沿防御阵地驻守。断桥西侧连接着通往米那斯提力斯的堤道，游侠们在废墟中维持守军，防止魔多利用这处渡口。这里仍被旧日荣光的记忆萦绕；欧斯吉利亚斯曾是刚铎千余年间最伟大的城市。
The whole pack descends without warning. Marked Prey charge cost -20.
整支猎群会毫无预警地扑向目标。标记猎物充能消耗 -20。
The wild has taught you to survive anything. +6 health.
荒野教会你在任何处境下活下去。+6 生命值。
The wild lands of Enedwaith between Arnor and Gondor. Home to scattered clans of Men who answer to no king, living as hunters and herders.
埃奈德是阿尔诺与刚铎之间的荒野之地。这里居住着分散的人类氏族，他们不服从任何国王，以狩猎和放牧为生。
The wild places hold secrets that town-folk never dream of...
荒野藏着城镇居民做梦也想不到的秘密……

The winter Dunlending bands crossed the Greyflood ice, farm folk crowded the quay begging passage into the town, and we had bread for half of them. I advised that the river gate stay barred, and it did. The garrison ate until spring, and the warden never spoke to me again.
那年冬天，黑蛮地人踏着灰水河的冰面杀来，农民挤在码头求着进城，可我们的面包只够一半人吃。我建议继续锁着河门，门就没开。驻军吃到了春天，守将却再也没和我说过话。

The winter the east gallery fell, a Broadbeam lord's son was carried out beside a dozen hewers. His wound would have taken all my poppy and all my night, and he would still have died. I tended the hewers. Every one of them walked out of that mine, and his father has not forgiven me.
东边矿道塌掉的那个冬天，一个宽梁族领主的儿子和十几个开凿工一起被抬出来。治他的伤，得用光我的罂粟药、花掉整整一夜，结果他还是会死。我救了那些开凿工，他们每个都自己走出了矿井，可他父亲一直没原谅我。
The wolf pelt keeps you warm and unseen. +6 health.
狼皮让你保暖，也让你更难被发现。+6 生命值。
伐木的士兵带回了{N}份硬木。

The work had stalled for a season due to seeping groundwater and failing supports. You redesigned the drainage, replaced the compromised timbers, and completed the level on the revised schedule. The Necromancer's overseers moved prisoners in the same week.
工程因地下水渗出和支撑失效停滞了一个季节。你重新设计排水，更换受损木梁，并按修订后的期限完成这一层。同一周，死灵法师的监工便把囚犯迁了进去。
The work on {SETTLEMENT} stops short: you need {ITEMS}.

The world is full of opportunities for someone willing to do what others won't. Slavery, theft, murder, just business. I have no illusions about honor or glory. I work for coin, and I'm very good at work others find distasteful. Mordor's reach is long, but there are always dark corners to hide in.
这个世界到处都是机会，只要有人愿意做别人不肯做的事。奴役、偷盗、杀人，不过都是生意。我对荣誉或荣耀没有幻想。我为钱办事，而且很擅长处理那些别人嫌脏的活儿。魔多的手伸得很长，但总有黑暗角落可以藏身。

The wound had been treated by two healers who agreed recovery was unlikely. You recognized a different preparation of kingsfoil from an older text and applied it over their objections. The Elf recovered. The two healers subsequently asked you about the preparation.
两名医者都处理过那道伤，并认为康复希望不大。你从一份更古老的文本中认出另一种王叶配方，顶着反对使用了它。那名精灵康复了。随后，那两名医者来向你询问配方。

The year the floods came early, a troop of horsemen rode through asking for food in the king's name. My father gave them half our store, and by midwinter my brother was dead of hunger. Nobody from the capital ever came back to repay it.
那年洪水来得早，一队骑兵路过，奉国王之名讨要食物。父亲把一半存粮给了他们，到了隆冬，我兄弟就饿死了。都城从没来人偿还过。

The year the snow came early, a patrol of the lords' men passed through asking for food in the king's name. My father gave them half our store, and by midwinter my brother was dead of hunger. Nobody from Cameth Brin ever came to repay it.
那年雪下得早，领主们的一支巡逻队路过，奉国王之名讨要食物。父亲把一半存粮给了他们，到了隆冬，我兄弟就饿死了。卡梅斯布林从没来人偿还过。

The year the snows came early, a band of rangers passed through asking for food in the king's name. My father gave them half our store, and by midwinter my brother was dead of hunger. Nobody from Fornost ever came back to repay it.
那年雪下得早，一队游民路过，奉国王之名讨要食物。父亲把一半存粮给了他们，到了隆冬，我兄弟就饿死了。佛诺斯特从没来人偿还过。
The young and ambitious rise quickly in Mordor, or fall just as fast...
年轻而野心勃勃的人，在魔多升得很快，也摔得一样快……
主题势力与英雄选择器
Then I am done with your company. I take my leave, oath or no.
那我不在你的部队里待了。管它什么誓言，我现在就走。
Then I go back to the line. It was an honor to carry the rank.
那我就回去当兵了。能担任这个职位，是我的荣幸。

Then I sold the same lot of iron to the Krathol quartermaster twice, and he found the second bill in his own hand. He did not shout. He sent two throwers to find me. I will say only that I am grateful for the fog.
后来，同一批铁，我卖给克拉索尔军需官两次。他在自己手里找到了第二张账单，没嚷，派了两个投掷手来找我。我只能说，多亏有雾。

Then a blood-feud took my cousins, and the elders judged that I had spilled kin to settle it. Whether the charge was true or merely convenient, the oath that bound me to the clan was cut. A rider without a clan is a dead man on the steppe, so I rode west before they could make it so.
后来一场血仇夺走了我的几个堂兄弟，长老们裁定是我为了了结仇怨杀了族人。无论指控是真是假，还是只是方便他们这么说，我与氏族之间的誓约都被切断了。没有氏族的骑手，在草原上就是个死人，所以在他们把这句话变成事实之前，我向西骑走了。

Then a son of the Great Goblin lost a wager on his pet. They chained my arm to the post and sent in three blades against me. I killed all three and the pet, too. Someone had to pay for that, and it was not him.
后来，半兽人王的一个儿子押他最宠爱的家伙，赌输了。他们把我的一条胳膊锁在柱子上，派来三个刀手。我把三个全杀了，连他那个宝贝也没放过。这事总得有人受罚，当然不会是他。
Then be damned, and take what you can tear from me.
那你就见鬼去吧，能从我身上逼出多少算你本事。

Then grain ran short at Caras Gorthad, and the garrison went hungry while my men sat on stored sacks. A clerk worked out where it had gone. My company scattered at the first sound of the king's riders, and I, the leader, scattered fastest.
后来卡拉斯戈沙德缺粮，驻军饿着肚子，我的人却守着囤起来的粮袋。有个文书查清了粮食的去向。国王的骑兵刚有动静，我那队人就四散奔逃，而我这个头儿跑得最快。

Then grain ran short at Fornost, and the garrison went hungry while my men sat on stored sacks. A steward worked out where it had gone. My company scattered at the first sound of the king's riders, and I, the leader, scattered fastest.
后来佛诺斯特缺粮，驻军饿着肚子，我的人却守着囤起来的粮袋。有个总管查清了粮食的去向。国王的骑兵刚有动静，我那队人就四散奔逃，而我这个头儿跑得最快。

Then grain ran short in the tower, and the garrison went hungry while my men sat on stored sacks. A bookkeeper worked out where it had gone. My company scattered at the first sound of the king's riders, and I, the leader, scattered fastest.
后来塔里缺粮，驻军饿着肚子，我的人却守着囤起来的粮袋。有个账房查清了粮食的去向。国王的骑兵刚有动静，我那队人就四散奔逃，而我这个头儿跑得最快。
Then it is steel, and I am sorry for it. We have fought worse odds than yours and lost our honour long ago. There is little left to lose.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]
那就只能动刀了，对不住。我们打过比这更难赢的仗，荣誉也早就丢光了，没什么可再失去的。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]
Then let our realms stand together. This alliance is forged.
那就让我们的国度并肩而立。这个联盟成立了。
Then swear it: your blade at my side, my bread in your pack, until your term is served. Do you swear?
那就立誓吧：你用刀剑为我而战，我给你的行囊装上口粮，直到服役期满。你愿意发誓吗？
Then the Misty Mountain goblins, 'Shadow Lurkers.' Pathetic name. They hid like rats. I'd charge into elf-lines, rending limbs, yet they'd whine, 'Why break ranks?'
后来是迷雾山脉的半兽人，自称“暗影潜伏者”。可悲的名字。他们像老鼠一样躲着。我冲进精灵阵线，撕开他们的肢体，他们却只会哀嚎：“为什么要打乱队形？”
Then the Wood keeps you. Loose![ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
Then the crows will have you. The hills remember who stood against them.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
那你就等着喂乌鸦吧。敢跟我们山里人作对，我们可不会忘。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
Then the grass will drink your blood, and my kin will sing of it. Ready yourself.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
那草原就会喝下你的血，族人也会把这事唱成歌。准备接招吧。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
Then the vultures will feast before sunset. Raise the spears.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
那日落之前，秃鹫就能饱餐一顿。举起长矛。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
Then we board you the old way. Blades out, and take what the sea has not.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
那就用海盗的老办法，拔刀开抢！大海没收走的，都归我们！[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
Then we settle this the dwarven way. Axes up! Let the mountain hear it.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
那就用矮人的办法解决。举起斧头！让大山听见！[ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
Then you are an oathbreaker, and every man here knows it. Get out of my sight.
那你就是个背誓者，这里人人都知道了。滚，别再让我看见你。
Then you carry a grudge and call it thrift.
你只是心怀怨恨，却管它叫节俭。
Then you go in the ledger of grudges. Axes ready![ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
那就把你记到我们的仇账上！准备斧头！[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
Then your name is lost to the wind. Sound the horns and loose the arrows.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_insulted]
那你的名字就等着被风吹散吧。吹号，放箭。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_insulted]
There is a foul nest of them in the hills, traveller. They take our goods and our people, and the watch is too few to root them out.
旅人，山里有一处贼窝。他们抢走我们的货物，还抓走我们的人。守卫人手太少，没法把他们一网打尽。
There is a lord I would see humbled -- taken alive and brought low. Capture an enemy lord in battle and I will count it a great service.
有个领主，我很想看他被活捉，再狠狠受一番羞辱。只要你能在战斗中俘虏一名敌方领主，就算帮了我一个大忙。
There is a viper in the grass -- an agent of my enemies, moving with a band of cutthroats. Find them and end them before they strike.
暗处藏着一条毒蛇，是敌人派来的密探，身边还带着一群亡命徒。趁他们还没动手，找到他们，除掉他们。
There is bad blood between my house and another, old and deep, and now it has come to swords. Break their armed men and the feud may at last be settled.
我的家族和另一个家族结怨多年，仇恨很深，如今已经动了刀剑。打败他们的武装人员，这场恩怨或许就能了结。
There is fighting to be done. Ask again once the field is quiet.
眼下还有仗要打，等战场平静了再来问。
There is no creature in the world I understand better than a horse. People are harder.
这世上，我最懂的活物就是马。人可难懂多了。
There is no elite trade for this faction here.
此处无法招募该阵营的精锐兵种。
There is no emissary trade in this settlement.
这个聚落没有使者提供招募服务。
There is no freedom like the wind in your face atop a swift horse...
没有什么自由，比得上骑在快马上迎风前行……
There is no game to hunt on this ground.
这片地方没有猎物可打。
There is no room for another companion right now. {TROOP_NAME}'s promotion will be offered again later.
目前没有空余的同伴名额。之后还会再次询问是否晋升{TROOP_NAME}。
There is no route from that source to you right now.
目前没有从该补给地通往你所在位置的路线。
There is no water close enough to fish.
附近没有适合捕鱼的水域。
There is nobody left in that party to speak for it.
那支部队已无人能出面交谈。
There is nobody there to keep to.
那里没有可跟随的目标。
There is nobody there to take.
那里没有可接管的士兵。
There is something I would ask you.
There's a greedy lot who'd rob their own mothers. Lure them in and break them, and we'll split what they were carrying -- quiet-like.
有一伙贪得无厌的家伙，连自己亲娘都敢抢。把他们引过来干掉，我们再悄悄分掉他们带的东西。
These kingdoms are bound by an unbreakable alliance.
这些王国受不可打破的联盟约束。
These kingdoms can never be allied.
这些王国永远不可能结盟。
These kingdoms stand on the same side of the War of the Ring.
这些王国在魔戒大战中属于同一阵营。

They call me the Cairn because I mark where old craft meets new. Each weapon I've forged for this realm is a memorial stone, honoring what was while serving what is. My bow sings the same precision I demand from every edge I sharpen.
他们叫我石冢，是因为我标记着旧工艺与新工艺相遇之处。我为这个国度锻造的每一件武器，都是一块纪念石，既纪念过去，也服务现在。我的弓也唱着同样的精准，那是我要求每一道锋刃必须达到的标准。

They call me the Ostler's Dread because I tend to the community like a stable master tends horses - with patience, firmness, and care. Day and night, I stand ready. No query too small, no crisis too large. Saruman made me to serve, and serve I do - just not as he intended.
他们叫我马倌之惧，是因为我照看社群，就像马倌照看马匹一样，耐心、坚定，也细心。无论白天黑夜，我都随时待命。没有小到不值得回答的问题，也没有大到不能处理的危机。萨茹曼造我出来是为了服从，而我的确在服从，只是不是按他想要的方式。
They called it treachery. I call it the only argument the council ever listened to. Either way my command is gone, but I know my trade, and there is always work for a captain who wins.
他们说这叫叛变，我说，这是议事会唯一听得进去的道理。不管怎么叫，我的指挥权没了，可本事还在。会打胜仗的队长，总有活干。
They can take in only so many at once.
他们一次只能接收这么多人。
They cast me out through the Front Porch with a rope on my neck. I do not mind. Out here the ring is wherever I stand, and no fat son of a chief chooses who dies in it.
他们给我脖子套上绳子，从前门廊赶了出去。我不在乎。在外头，我站哪儿，哪儿就是斗场，再没有酋长的胖儿子来决定谁死。

They found my workshop during a routine inspection. The flame-throwing ballista scared them most, too reminiscent of dragon-fire, they said. The guild called an emergency meeting, declared my work blasphemous. They gave me three days to leave, my name stricken from the engineer rolls.
一次例行检查中，他们发现了我的工坊。最吓到他们的是那台喷火弩炮，他们说它太像龙焰了。公会召开紧急会议，宣布我的作品亵渎传统。他们给我三天离开，还把我的名字从工程师名册上划掉。
They know the country better than you do, and use it.
他们比你更熟悉这里的地形，并利用这一点甩掉了你。
They never formed up. It was over in the dark.
他们还没来得及列阵，战斗就在黑暗中结束了。

They say I'm one of the finest in the realm at this craft. Every texture, every shadow, every detail must be perfect - this is the Silvan way. My works stand as monuments to what dedication can achieve.
他们说，在这门手艺上，我是整个国度里最出色的人之一。每一道纹理、每一片阴影、每一个细节都必须完美，这就是西尔凡的方式。我的作品会成为献给专注与技艺的纪念碑。

They say Spartans never retreat - I never leave code unfinished. Where others see endless text, I see the architecture of reality itself. Through systematic organization and relentless optimization, I build foundations others can stand upon.
人们说斯巴达人从不撤退，而我从不留下未完成的代码。别人只看见无尽文本，我看见现实本身的架构。凭借系统化的整理和不懈优化，我建起别人可以立足的根基。
They scatter into broken country and the horses will not follow.
他们分散逃进崎岖地带，战马无法继续追赶。
They still tell tales of me at the gathering-grounds, or so I like to think. Here is the truth behind the tales.
他们在集会场上大概还会讲我的故事，至少我愿意这么想。现在听听那些故事背后的真相。
They stripped me of rank but couldn't take my skills. Now I wander, offering my spear to those who still believe in justice. The realm decays from within while we watch for enemies without.
他们剥夺了我的军衔，却夺不走我的本领。如今我四处漂泊，将手中长矛献给依然相信正义之人。当我们在外防范敌寇时，王国正从内部腐朽溃烂。
They stripped me of the bow-post and chained my hand to the oar-bench. I broke the chain on the third night. A bowman has no use for shame. Give me a target and a wind.
他们撤了我的弓哨，把我的手锁在划桨的长凳上。第三晚，我弄断了锁链。弓手留着羞耻也没用，给我个目标，再给我一阵风。
They surrendered, and you killed them. That is not war.
他们投降了，你还杀了他们。这不叫打仗。
They took my company and my banner, and told me mercy is what separates us from what we fight. I am not certain they are right. I walk the roads now with a spear and no one left to keep safe.
他们夺走我的队伍和旗帜，告诉我，我们与敌人的区别就在于仁慈。我不确定他们说得对。现在我提着长矛走在路上，已没有谁需要我保护。

They wanted me silenced, so I vanished. Now I use my skills independently, hunting threats that others refuse to see. Gondor's greatest enemies may not be orcs, but those who profit from our slow defeat.
他们想让我闭嘴，我便消失了。如今我独自运用技艺，追猎那些他人视而不见的威胁。刚铎最大的敌人或许并非奥克，而是那些从我们缓慢败亡中牟利之徒。

They would not pay for new stone, so I made them pay another way. When the goblins came that autumn I gave up the north gate without a fight and held the inner wall. Nobody died who need have, and the council voted the stone within the month. Then a sentry told them I had known the raid was coming.
他们不肯花钱买新石料，那我就让他们换个法子付账。那年秋天半兽人来时，我没打就放弃了北门，退守内墙。没有谁枉送性命，议事会一个月内就批了石料钱。后来一个哨兵告诉他们，我早知道这次袭击会来。
They'll do nicely. You have my thanks.

Thingol, in his five-and-fiftieth year, is the elder kinsman of the house and warden of its archives, and was first sword-bearer to Rondamir's father in the campaigns along the Poros. He is grave of speech, sparing of laughter, and the names of all the fallen of the house lie graven in his memory. In council he speaks last and seldom, yet his word turns the chamber. He counsels his lord that the oath to the Steward must endure while the King is not yet come.
辛葛已经五十五岁，是家族年长的亲族和档案守护者，早年曾在波罗斯河一带的战役中担任隆达米尔之父的首席持剑侍从。他言辞严肃，少有笑意，家族所有阵亡者的名字都刻在他的记忆里。议事时他总是最后开口，而且很少发言；但只要他说话，厅堂就会转向。他劝告自己的领主，只要国王尚未真正到来，对宰相的誓言就必须延续。
Think twice, stranger. The rest of the clan waits behind that hill, axes sharp and tempers shorter, waiting for our signal.
想清楚，外乡人。族里其余的人就在山后等着，斧头磨得锋利，脾气也火爆得很，只等我们的信号。
Thiqa is wife to the chieftain of the southern wastes and keeps the water tallies of his camps.
锡卡是南方荒地酋长的妻子，负责记录各营地的用水和储水情况。
Thirty dead and you stand there. What kind of captain?
三十个死了，你还站在这里，算哪门子队长？
Thirty lives, and you want another army to lose?
三十条命，你还想再葬送一支军队？
Thirty years of service, ended by one moment of conscience...
三十年的服务，因一瞬间的良知而结束……
Thirty-one left to die. What would you do to my flank?
丢下三十一个等死，你又会怎么处置我的侧翼？
This armoury cannot work {CLASS} pieces: it needs level {NEED}, and this one is level {LEVEL}.
这座军械库无法加工{CLASS}装备：需要{NEED}级，而这里只有{LEVEL}级。
This armoury works to level {LEVEL} of 3. Heavy pieces need level {HEAVY}, elite pieces level {ELITE}, and lord kit a master armourer at level {LORD}. The piece keeps its quality.
这座军械库的等级为{LEVEL}，最高3级。重型装备需要{HEAVY}级，精英装备需要{ELITE}级，领主装备需要{LORD}级军械库的铸甲大师。装备的品质会保留。
This battle has its own speed control.
本场战斗使用自己的速度控制。
This fief no longer belongs to your realm.
这处封地已不属于你的国家。
This many men need {N} tools, and the party holds too few.
这么多人需要{N}份工具，部队现有工具不足。
This mission uses {PERCENT} percent of the engine's skeleton buffer, and the game freezes for good when it is full. Lower the battle size.
本次任务已占用引擎骨架缓冲区的百分之{PERCENT}，缓冲区一旦耗尽，游戏就会彻底卡死。请降低战场规模。
This person cannot be reached by messenger at this time.
现在无法通过信使联系此人。
This town's armoury works to level {LEVEL} of 3.
这座城镇的军械库等级为{LEVEL}，最高3级。
This would not improve your relation.
这样不会改善你们的关系。
Thomund commands a company of Westfold riders.
索蒙德统领一支西伏尔德骑手队伍。
Thormund Grizzlyhew cleaves through enemy ranks with his great two-handed axe.
“灰熊斧”索尔蒙德用巨大的双手斧劈开敌阵。
Thornwall charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.
荆棘壁垒所需充能大幅减少，几乎随时都能发动。
Thornwall charge reduced, activating more frequently.
荆棘壁垒所需充能减少，可以更频繁地发动。
Thornwall duration extended, fortifying the defense.
荆棘壁垒持续时间延长，让防线更加稳固。
Thornwall grants +5% resistance and steadies the defenders.
荆棘壁垒提供+5%抗性，让守军更加坚定。
Thornwall grants additional defensive buffs while active.
荆棘壁垒生效期间，提供额外的防御增益。
Thornwall radius greatly expanded, devastating power.
荆棘壁垒的作用范围大幅扩大，威力更具毁伤性。
Thornwall radius increased, empowering more warriors.
荆棘壁垒的作用范围扩大，更多战士获得增益。
Thorwen, wife of Malrior, is a capable woman who manages her household with quiet determination.
索尔玟是马尔瑞奥尔的妻子，是一位能干女子，以安静决心管理家宅。
Thorzag, a fang master, commands spider assaults, echoing the battles in Mirkwood.
索尔扎格是牙刺大师，指挥蜘蛛进攻，呼应黑森林中的战斗。
Those names on your ledger are alive because you wrote them down.
你账上的那些人，因为你记下了他们，才活了下来。
Those who prepare for war are rarely thanked until it comes.
为战争做准备的人，通常要等战争来了才会被感谢。
Thought of crawling back to the pits. But lost my hoard in the chaos. If a warband needs scarred flesh, I'll reclaim it.
我想过爬回坑里，但我的财物在混乱中丢光了。如果有战团需要一身伤疤的肉，我会把它重新夺回来。
Thousands answer the prophet's call. +5 party size.
成千上万人回应先知的召唤。+5 部队规模。
Thraka serves the Black Maw as quartermaster and enforcer. Her iron discipline keeps the supply lines running even under siege.
斯拉卡在黑颚担任军需官兼执法者。她的铁一般纪律让补给线保持运转，也让士兵不敢违抗。
Thrakgul oversees the Black Maw's pit-gangs and counts a shift wasted if nothing is broken in it. Saruman's overseers leave him to his methods because the mail comes out on time.
斯拉克古尔监管黑颚的坑场劳工。如果一班下来什么都没弄坏，他就觉得这班白干了。只要锁子甲按时交货，萨茹曼的监工就不管他怎么做。

Thranduil's Woodland Realm in northern Mirkwood. Silvan archers and veteran militia hold the great forest against spider, orc, and shadow. Woodland Sustenance keeps the supplies light; Woodland Bonds keep morale high. Forest isolation slows growth.
这是瑟兰杜伊位于黑森林北部的林地王国。西尔凡弓手和老练民兵守住大森林，抵御蜘蛛、奥克与阴影。林地给养减轻补给压力，林地纽带维持高昂士气；森林孤立则会拖慢发展。

Thranduil, the Elvenking of the Woodland Realm, is a wise and stern ruler, embodying the grace and resilience of the Sindar elves from Tolkien's lore. As the son of Oropher, he guards Mirkwood against the encroaching shadows of Dol Guldur, leading with a keen strategic mind and unyielding defense of his forested domain, ever vigilant in the face of Sauron's growing threat.
瑟兰杜伊，林地王国的精灵王，是一位睿智而严厉的统治者，体现出托尔金传说中辛达精灵的优雅与坚韧。他是欧洛斐尔之子，守护黑森林不受多古尔都阴影侵蚀。他凭借敏锐的战略眼光和坚定的防守意志统领自己的森林领地，始终警惕索隆日益增长的威胁。

Thrangul, a twisted orc chieftain in the Shadow Tower Clan, serves Khamûl with brutal efficiency, leading raids that echo the orc assaults in Tolkien's tales, sowing fear among the Wood-elves of Mirkwood.
斯兰古尔是影塔氏族中一名心性扭曲的奥克酋长，以残暴而高效的手段为可哈穆尔效力。他率领的劫掠队如同托尔金故事中的奥克袭击者，让黑森林的森林精灵深感恐惧。
Thrargol, a grave robber, desecrates tombs for Khamûl, fueling the undead hordes as hinted in Sauron's dark arts.
斯拉戈尔是一名盗墓者，为可哈穆尔挖掘并亵渎墓穴，壮大亡灵大军，正如索隆的黑暗法术所暗示的那样。

Thrazak serves as a hardened orc lieutenant in Gundabad, drawing from the lore of orcish hordes that plagued the North. His skill in siege warfare and unyielding aggression make him indispensable in assaults on fortified positions, always striving to expand Gundabad's domain under the Warlord's command.
斯拉扎克是贡达巴德久经磨炼的奥克副官，带有曾祸害北方的奥克大军传统。他擅长攻城，进攻性毫不退让，因此在攻击坚固阵地时不可或缺，也始终试图在军阀命令下扩张贡达巴德的疆域。
Thrazgul, a tormentor orc, extracts information from captives, akin to the interrogators in Tolkien's dark realms. His methods yield valuable intelligence for the clan.
斯拉兹古尔是奥克拷问者，以类似托尔金黑暗国度审讯者的手段从俘虏口中榨取情报。他的方法能为氏族带来有价值的消息。

Three Stone Trolls had settled in the Tower Hills closer to the Ford than any before. You spotted their camp, mapped its position, estimated their range, and brought the report to the wardens before they had moved. The wardens handled the rest.
三只岩石食人妖在塔丘安了家，离渡口比以往任何一群都近。你发现营地，标出位置，估算它们的活动范围，并在它们出动前把情报送给了守望者。剩下的事就交给了守望者。

Three Stone Trolls had settled in the Trollshaws closer to the Ford than any before. You spotted their camp, mapped its position, estimated their range, and brought the report to the wardens before they had moved. The wardens handled the rest.
三只石巨魔在食人妖森林中扎营，位置比以往任何一次都更靠近渡口。你发现营地，标出位置，估算它们活动范围，并在它们移动前把报告带给守卫。剩下的由守卫处理。
Three generations of my line died fighting. Point me at your enemy and I will do the same, or better.
我家三代人都战死了。把你的敌人指给我，我也会这样死，或者干得更好。
Three generations of warriors flow in my veins, I fight because I must.
三代战士的血流在我体内，我战斗，因为我必须战斗。

Three months in Thranduil's halls under a false identity gave you access to conversations that no agent of Dol Guldur had ever overheard. You came back with names, plans, and relationships that the shadow-masters used to shape the next season's strategy. You found the experience unexpectedly informative about Elves.
你用假身份在瑟兰杜伊厅堂中待了三个月，接触到多古尔都任何代理人都从未听过的谈话。你带回名字、计划和关系，阴影大师据此塑造下一季战略。你意外地发现，精灵也很值得研究。
Three names, and two of them can already hold a spear.
你招到了三个人，其中两个已经会用长矛。
Throga of the Throgmaw orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯罗加是斯罗格莫氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Throgar of the Skarnâk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯罗加尔是斯卡尔纳克战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Throgash of the Uzgnâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯罗嘎什是乌兹格纳什战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Throgza of the Bûrzghâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯罗格扎是布尔兹加什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Throkdush, chieftain of the Uzgnâsh orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
斯罗克杜什是乌兹格纳什奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Throkka is a brute of the Tower-guard, kept for the work that wants no cunning, only weight and a heavy blade.
斯罗卡是塔卫中的一个莽汉，专门干那些不需要动脑子，只需要体重和大刀的活。
Throrgash, chieftain of the Fell Beast Tribe, breeds winged terrors, inspired by the fell beasts ridden by Nazgûl in books and films.
斯罗尔加什是凶恶巨兽部族的酋长，培育着令人恐惧的有翼巨兽。这一设定的灵感来自书中和电影里那兹古尔骑乘的凶恶巨兽。
在下一次程序更新时抛出异常
下次任务 AfterStart 时主动抛出异常
在下一次场景更新时抛出异常
Thrugash, a screech caller, unnerves enemies, her beasts' cries breaking morale as in battles.
斯鲁加什是尖啸召唤者，用巨兽的嚎叫扰乱敌人，像战场上的恐怖吼声一样击垮士气。
Thrugol, an orc smith, hammers armor echoing the dark forges of Isengard. In Gundabad, his works clad warriors in impenetrable plates for the coming wars.
斯鲁戈尔是奥克铁匠，锤打出的铠甲带有艾森加德黑暗熔炉的影子。在贡达巴德，他的作品为即将到来的战争给战士披上难以洞穿的甲片。
Thrulza, a venomous assassin, strikes from shadows, her methods evoking the stealthy orcs that captured Thorin's company in The Hobbit.
斯鲁尔扎是用毒的刺客，总是从阴影中出手。她的手段让人想起《霍比特人》中俘获梭林远征队的那些潜行奥克。
Thrulza, a vigilant orc sentinel, watches the passes like the guards of Cirith Ungol. Her alertness thwarts infiltrations into Gundabad's depths.
斯鲁尔扎是一名警觉的奥克哨卫，像奇立斯乌苟的守军一样盯守着各处山口。她的警戒让敌人很难潜入贡达巴德深处。
Thrulzia, a ghost whisperer, communes with spirits, summoning aid from beyond the grave.
斯鲁尔齐娅是幽魂低语者，能与灵体沟通，并从坟墓之外召来助力。

Thrumak is a forge-master orc, forging weapons in the style of those used by Azog's forces in the movies and books. His craftsmanship arms Gundabad's warriors, turning raw ore into instruments of war and destruction.
斯鲁马克是奥克锻造大师，打造的武器带有电影与书中阿佐格部队使用装备的风格。他的手艺武装贡达巴德战士，把粗矿变成战争与毁灭的工具。
Thrunak, an orc infiltrator, sneaks into enemy camps like the spies in Tolkien's wars. His sabotage undermines foes from within.
斯鲁纳克是奥克渗透者，像托尔金战争中的间谍一样潜入敌营。他的破坏能从内部削弱敌人。
Thrurg, head of the Dark Sorcerer's Guard, wields forbidden magics, guarding Khamûl with spells akin to Sauron's sorcery in lore.
斯鲁尔格是黑暗巫卫的首领。他施展禁忌魔法，用近似传说中索隆巫术的法术守护可哈穆尔。
Thunder forward with an unstoppable cavalry charge — boosts +25% charge damage, +20% mount speed, and +10% melee damage for 8s.
以势不可挡的骑兵冲锋碾过敌阵：+25% 冲锋伤害，+20% 坐骑速度，+10% 近战伤害，持续 8 秒。

Thurka is a cunning orc scout and assassin in Gundabad, embodying the stealthy prowlers that haunted the woods in the tales. Her role in espionage and sabotage weakens foes before the main assaults, contributing to Azgar's overarching strategy of domination.
瑟卡是贡达巴德狡猾的奥克斥候兼刺客，体现故事中徘徊林间的潜行猎手。她负责间谍活动和破坏，在主力进攻前削弱敌人，为阿兹加尔整体支配战略出力。
Thyra Bloodtusk earned her epithet through countless victories.
“血獠”蒂拉通过无数次胜利赢得了这一绰号。

Théoden King, once mighty, now sits pale and confused while Wormtongue whispers poison. I heard orders given that made no sense - troops withdrawn from threatened borders, supplies sent to uncertain destinations.
希奥顿国王曾经强大，如今却苍白而糊涂，任由佞舌在耳边灌下毒话。我听见过毫无道理的命令：从受威胁的边境撤军，把补给送往不明去处。
Théoden, King of Rohan, rules from Meduseld in Edoras. Once bewitched by Saruman's servant Gríma, he was freed by Gandalf and led his people to glory at Helm's Deep and the Pelennor Fields.
希奥顿是洛汗国王，在埃多拉斯的美杜塞尔德统治王国。他曾受萨茹曼的仆人格里马蛊惑，后来被甘道夫解救，并带领族人在海尔姆深谷和佩兰诺平野赢得荣耀。
Théodred was the only son of King Théoden, Prince of Rohan. He fell defending the Fords of Isen against Saruman's Uruk-hai.
希奥杰德是希奥顿国王唯一的儿子，也是洛汗王子。他在艾森河渡口抵御萨茹曼的乌鲁克时阵亡。
Théodwyn was sister to King Théoden and mother of Éomer and Éowyn. She died of grief after her husband Éomund was slain by Orcs.
希奥德温是希奥顿国王的妹妹，也是伊奥梅尔和伊奥温的母亲。丈夫伊奥蒙德被奥克杀害后，她悲痛成疾，不久便去世了。

Thûlnar serves as Maugrukh's lieutenant on the Cirith Ungol stair, and he has counted every coin in the captain's strongbox twice. Loot is his drive and the tower his hunting-ground, for caravans bound from Minas Morgul up to the pass are easily skimmed by the orcs who watch the road. He pays his uruks in trinkets stolen from the men of Gondor, and keeps the heavier plunder for a day when Maugrukh slips on the stair. He nurses an old grudge against Kûragh of the Akheth, who once stole his share of a Morgul-train.
图勒纳尔是莫格鲁赫在奇立斯乌苟阶梯上的副官。他把队长钱箱里的每枚硬币都数过两遍。驱使他的是财物，而高塔就是他的猎场：从米那斯魔古尔前往隘口的商队，很容易被守路的奥克克扣货物。他用从刚铎人那里偷来的小饰物给乌鲁克付酬，自己留下值钱的战利品，等着莫格鲁赫在阶梯上失足的那一天。他始终记恨阿克赫斯氏族的库拉格，因为对方曾偷走一支魔古尔运输队里本该属于他的那份。

Thûrak stands sentinel at the Morannon, the iron Black Gate where the legions of Lugburz pour out into the northern wastes. Fear of the Great Eye is the marrow of him, for he was once flogged on the gate-stones for letting a tark scout slip past in the dusk. Since that day he has not slept the whole night through, and his uruks know better than to be found drowsing on the wall. The Brughash of Dûrzan he watches with a particular dread, for they keep their own counsel in the south and do not answer the muster as swiftly as the Gate would like.
图拉克守卫着魔栏农，也就是铁铸的黑门。路格布尔兹的军团从这里涌向北方荒野。他对大魔眼的恐惧已经深入骨髓：他曾在黄昏放过一名塔克斥候，结果在城门的石板上挨了鞭打。从那以后，他再没睡过一个整觉，手下的乌鲁克也知道，绝不能让他发现自己在城墙上打瞌睡。他尤其提防杜尔赞的布鲁加什氏族，因为他们在南方自有盘算，响应集结的速度总让黑门不满。
Tick "Show only better items" each time the inventory opens.
每次打开物品栏时，自动勾选“只显示更好的物品”。
更新分析器显示条目数
Tilda is wife to Lord Regna.
瓦尔卡娃是伊斯万领主的妻子。
Time ran out, and the enemy holds more of the field.
时间结束，敌方控制了更多战场区域。
Time ran out, and you hold more of the field.
时间结束，你控制了更多战场区域。

Tint each settlement plate by your relation to its owner: green for your own faction, red for an enemy, blue for an allied kingdom, plain parchment for neutral. Off leaves every plate parchment. Applies immediately.
按你与领地所有者的关系给定居点名称牌着色：自己势力绿色，敌人红色，盟国蓝色，中立保持普通羊皮纸颜色。关闭后全部保持羊皮纸颜色。立即生效。
Tint inventory items that beat the selected character's gear: green for an upgrade, yellow for a sidegrade (more total armour, less in its own slot).
为物品栏中优于所选角色现有装备的物品着色：直接提升用绿色；各部位总护甲更高、但对应部位护甲较低的取舍型装备，用黄色。
Tints each kingdom's land in its colour between the borders, like a map in an atlas.
在国境内按王国颜色为土地着色，类似地图册。
Titles mean little against true evil. My bow sings for justice, not for crowns. If you fight for good, I would stand beside you.
在真正的邪恶面前，头衔没有多少意义。我的弓为正义而鸣，不为王冠而鸣。若你为善而战，我愿与你并肩。
To learn from the Lore-Grandmaster himself would be an honor.
能向学识大宗师本人学习，是一种荣幸。
To lose your beast is a hard thing.
失去自己的坐骑，确实不好受。
To wield weapons forged by such hands is an honor.
能使用这样一双手锻造出的武器，是一种荣幸。
Today you sell the road to caravans. Tomorrow it will be trolls.
今天你把道路的底细卖给商队，明天就该卖给食人妖了。
Toggle dropdown vs custom value above.
选择使用下拉预设，还是上方的自定义数值。
Too close to a town or castle - pitch a field camp farther from settlements.
离城镇或城堡太近，请到远离聚落的地方建立野战营地。
Too close to a town or castle - raise a refuge farther from settlements.
离城镇或城堡太近，请到远离聚落的地方修建避难所。
Too eager, they say. Overseers ban me from duels. Shame. Prefer quick kills over endless hunts. No arrows, no ambushes. Just fury, blood, feast.
他们说我太急着杀。监工不准我再参加决斗。可惜。我更喜欢利落的杀戮，不喜欢没完没了的追猎。不要箭，不要埋伏。只要狂怒、鲜血和一顿饱餐。
Toqto of House Zorian rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
佐里安家族的脱脱率领着家族的枪骑兵。他手段强硬，鲁恩平原上的人都畏惧他的旗帜。
Tormund the Hammer earned his name through devastating charges with his war hammer.
“铁锤”托蒙德靠着挥舞战锤发起的猛烈冲锋，赢得了自己的称号。
Torvald Oxhorn is the heir of Othric, already showing his father's wild spirit.
“牛角”托瓦尔德是奥瑟里克的继承人，已经显露出父亲的狂野精神。

Total war is the only war. Saruman wants to control and calculate everything, I just want to destroy our enemies completely. Someone out there understands that victory requires absolute brutality, not measured violence. I'll find them, and together we'll wage real war.
全面战争才是真正的战争。萨茹曼想控制一切、计算一切，而我只想彻底毁灭我们的敌人。外面总有人明白，胜利需要绝对的残酷，而不是经过丈量的暴力。我会找到他们，然后我们一起打真正的战争。
竞技大会：对立阵营倍率
竞技大会：每人的关系奖励
Tower-shield elite of the Broadbeam line, the King's own guard.
宽梁族的精锐塔盾兵，国王的亲卫。
身材高大、古老血脉绵延的领主。
Tracked and ambushed in the ruins of the North Kingdom.
在北方王国废墟中追踪和伏击。
Tracked game and Orcs in the forest east of Dale.
在河谷邦东部森林追踪猎物和奥克。
Tracked game and enemies through Eriador's wilds.
在埃利阿多荒野追踪猎物和敌人。
Tracked wolves and orcs along the Mirkwood edge.
沿黑森林边缘追踪狼群和奥克。
Trade Road Sprint boosts mount resilience while active.
贸易之路冲刺生效期间，会强化坐骑韧性。
Trade Road Sprint charge greatly reduced, ride without ceasing.
贸易之路冲刺充能消耗大幅降低，可以不停骑行。
Trade Road Sprint charge reduced, swifter activation.
贸易之路冲刺充能消耗降低，可以更快发动。
Trade Road Sprint duration extended, maintaining momentum.
贸易之路冲刺持续时间延长，让势头保持更久。
Trade Road Sprint grants +5% melee damage and your horse quickens.
贸易之路冲刺提供 +5% 近战伤害，并让你的坐骑加快步伐。
Trade Road Sprint radius expanded, sweeping wider formations.
贸易之路冲刺作用范围扩大，可以扫过更宽的阵型。
Trade Road Sprint radius greatly expanded, unstoppable impact.
贸易之路冲刺作用范围大幅扩大，冲击势不可挡。
Trade and war are two edges of the same blade, properly wielded...
贸易和战争，是同一把刀的两面，只要用得好……
Trade scouts of the Vales sell the roads they know to anyone who pays on time. We are not sentimental about it.
河谷的商队斥候，谁按时付钱，就替谁指路。我们不讲什么人情。
Trade scouts of the Woodmen sell the paths they know to anyone who pays on time. We are not sentimental about it.
林中居民的商队斥候，谁按时付钱，就替谁指路。我们不讲什么人情。
Trade with Erebor provides bonus income and arms-supply.
与孤山贸易会提供额外收入和武器供应。
Traded between the hill clans and the lowland markets.
在丘陵氏族和低地市场之间贸易。
Traded goods through the Riddermark markets.
在里德马克市场间贩运货物。
Traded horses at the fairs of Southwood.
Traders and toll-keepers along the Greenway live off the grain wagons bound for Bree. A few of us take a larger share than the king allows.
绿大道沿线的商人和收路费的人，靠往布理运粮的车过活。我们有些人拿得比国王准许的多了点。
Traders and toll-keepers at Last Bridge live off the grain wagons bound for Cameth Brin. A few of us take a larger share than the king allows.
最后大桥的商人和收路费的人，靠往卡梅斯布林运粮的车过活。我们有些人拿得比国王准许的多了点。
Traders and toll-keepers on the river road live off the grain wagons bound for Tharbad. A few of us take a larger share than the king allows.
河边大道的商人和收路费的人，靠往沙巴德运粮的车过活。我们有些人拿得比国王准许的多了点。
传统能存在，自然有它的道理。
与乌鲁克步兵一同训练。

Trained from birth in the Iron Hills fighting style, hammer and shield, grinding advance. Came to Erebor with Lord Dáin's reinforcements for the Battle of Five Armies. Stayed after, joined the mountain guard. Twenty years holding the gates, and I grew restless.
我从出生起就按铁丘陵的战法受训，锤与盾，稳步推进。我随戴因大人的援军来到孤山，参加五军之战。战后我留下，加入山中卫队。守了二十年大门，我开始坐不住了。
Trained in the art of Elven infantry.

在大厅里随国王的斧兄弟训练。

在格里姆贝奥恩的大厅里受训。

Trained in the royal hall of King Brand.
在布兰德国王王厅中训练。
Trained in the tunnel-halls of Goblin-town.
在半兽人镇的地下大厅中受训。
Trained in the war-halls of Moria.
在墨瑞亚的战厅中受训。
Trained in the war-halls of Mount Gundabad.
在贡达巴德山战厅中训练。
Trained in the war-yard of Orthanc.
在欧尔桑克战场院中训练。
接受加拉兹民骑兵训练。
Trained with the Guard of Cameth Brin.
在卡梅斯布林卫队受训。
Trained with the Guard of Imladris.
接受伊姆拉缀斯卫队训练。
Trained with the Guard of Mithlond.
Trained with the Guard of the Citadel.
Trained with the Riders of the Mark.
Trained with the wardens of Caras Galadhon.
随卡拉斯加拉松守卫训练。
Trained with the young warriors of the clan chief.
随氏族酋长的年轻战士训练。
Traveled with the camp followers of Rohan.
Traveled with the merchant caravans of the North.
Tristania serves in the dark forces.
特里斯塔妮娅效力于黑暗军队。

Troll and mumakil swings slice through a victim and carry 30% momentum into the next — one swing can hit multiple soldiers, including through shield blocks that take damage (a zero-damage block still stops the swing).
食人妖和猛犸的挥击会穿过受击者，并保留30%的动量继续攻击下一人，因此一次挥击可以命中多名士兵。受到伤害的盾牌格挡也会被穿过，只有完全挡住伤害的格挡才会截停挥击。
Troll hide turns aside most blades. +6% blunt resistance.
食人妖厚皮能挡开大多数刀剑。+6% 钝击抗性。
Troll, mumakil, war elephant and giant spider melee attacks can only be blocked with a SHIELD — a bare-weapon block is crushed through automatically.
食人妖、猛犸、战象和巨型蜘蛛的近战攻击只能用盾牌格挡，单靠武器格挡会被自动击穿。
半兽人镇食人妖驱策者
贡达巴德食人妖驱策者
Trolls Stay Off Siege Ladders, Towers and Walls
禁止食人妖使用云梯、攻城塔和城墙
Trolls and orcs on every border
各处边境都有食人妖和奥克
赠送士兵赢得领主好感

Troop counts on the map now blur with distance. A count such as {MASK_EXAMPLE} means you can read only its first digit. {HORIZON} marks a host at the very edge of sight, too far to count. Counts sharpen as you close in, and as your scout's Scouting grows. Hosts of your own realm are easier to count. AI lords always see the true numbers. The toggle is under Map UI in the mod options.
地图上的兵力数字现在会随距离变得模糊。像{MASK_EXAMPLE}这样的数字，表示你只能看清首位数。{HORIZON}表示有一支军队位于视野边缘，太远，无法清点。靠近目标，或让斥候提高侦察技能，都能让数字更清楚。本国军队的人数更容易看清，AI领主则始终能看到真实人数。可在MOD选项的地图界面中开关此功能。

Trouble is, I never could keep what I took. A good horse to a friend in need, silver to a hungry family, it all ran through my fingers. When I lifted mounts from a clan the Taskral favored and gave them away besides, the elders decided I was more trouble than I was worth.
麻烦在于，我从来留不住自己拿到的东西。好马送给需要它的朋友，银子给饥饿的家庭，一切都从我手指缝里流走了。后来我从塔斯克拉尔偏爱的一个氏族那里偷走坐骑，还把它们送了出去，长老们认定我带来的麻烦超过了价值。
真正的信徒会献出一切。+7 生命值。
Trust me with a message, a purse or a wounded man, and I will carry it anywhere you point.
不论是口信、钱袋还是伤员，交给我吧。你指哪儿，我就送到哪儿。
Trust me with your horses and your road, and neither will let you down.
把你的马和道路交给我信任，它们都不会让你失望。
Trust me with your supply and your trade, and your army will never want for the want of silver.
把补给和贸易交给我，你的军队就不会因为缺银子而短缺。
真相是外交的第一位牺牲品。
Truth is indeed a powerful weapon against darkness.
真相确实是对抗黑暗的强大武器。
Tselmeg of House Vazevian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
瓦泽维安家族的策勒麦格是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Tsetseg of House Cilzeron is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
西尔泽隆家族的其其格是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。

Tulrok Mithruntai, an innovative tactician of Rhûn, develops new warfare methods in the Third Age to serve Sauron. His inventions surprise and overwhelm enemies. Tulrok's ingenuity gives the Easterlings an edge in their campaigns.
图罗克·米斯伦泰是鲁恩富有创新精神的战术家，在第三纪元为侍奉索隆而研究新的作战方法。他的发明让敌人措手不及，难以招架。他的巧思让东夷在战役中占据优势。

Turn ON only to reproduce a combat or siege crash. Logs every damaging blow, every death, and every siege-engine shot to the TAOM debug log (Logs/taom_debug_*.log) with durable flushing, so the LAST line survives a hard native crash and names the fatal blow — victim race, blow flags, damage type, whether it was a fire pot. Costs a synchronous log write per hit while ON, so leave OFF for normal play. Default OFF.
只在复现战斗或围城崩溃时开启。将每次造成伤害的打击、每次死亡和每次攻城器械发射写入TAOM调试日志（Logs/taom_debug_*.log），并立即落盘，确保严重的原生崩溃后仍保留最后一行，指出致命打击的信息，包括受击者种族、打击标志、伤害类型和是否来自火罐。开启时，每次命中都需要同步写日志，正常游玩请关闭。默认关闭。
Turn aside, stranger. Two hundred riders wait beyond that ridge for my signal, and their horses are hungry for a charge.
绕道走，外乡人。山脊后有两百名骑兵等着我的信号，他们的马早就等不及要冲锋了。

Turns on the extra relation loss, on top of vanilla's own, that a village's owner and notables hold against you when you raid the village or force it to give goods or recruits. Villages your clan owns are never affected, and neither are raids you do not lead. Applies on the host in co-op. Default: on.
你劫掠村庄，或强迫村庄交出货物、提供新兵时，村庄所有者和要人会在原版惩罚之外，额外降低与你的关系。绝不影响你自己家族拥有的村庄，也不影响并非由你率领的劫掠。合作联机时在主机端生效。默认：开启。

Turns the three rewards on or off together: relation for releasing a captured lord, for donating a hero prisoner to a settlement and for winning a town's tournament. Each reward also has its own switch below. Applies on the host in co-op. Default: on.
同时开关三种关系奖励：释放被俘领主、向定居点移交英雄俘虏，以及赢得城镇竞技大会。下方还可分别开关各项奖励。合作联机时在主机端生效。默认：开启。
Tusk-Thunder of Mûmakan boosts beast resilience during the charge.
穆玛坎的雷霆巨牙会在冲锋期间强化巨兽韧性。
Tusk-Thunder of Mûmakan charge greatly reduced, unending dread.
穆玛坎的雷霆巨牙充能消耗大幅降低，恐惧持续不断。
Tusk-Thunder of Mûmakan charge reduced, terror always imminent.
穆玛坎的雷霆巨牙充能消耗降低，让恐怖随时逼近。
Tusk-Thunder of Mûmakan duration extended, fear lingers.
穆玛坎的雷霆巨牙持续时间延长，恐惧久久不散。
Tusk-Thunder of Mûmakan grants +10% horse charge damage and spreads fear.
穆玛坎的雷霆巨牙提供+10%坐骑冲锋伤害，并散播恐惧。
Tusk-Thunder of Mûmakan radius expanded, fear spreads further.
穆玛坎的雷霆巨牙作用范围扩大，恐惧传播得更远。
Tusk-Thunder of Mûmakan radius greatly expanded, the very earth shakes.
穆玛坎的雷霆巨牙作用范围大幅扩大，连大地都随之震颤。
Tuya of House Kalkian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
卡尔基安家族的图雅是一位骄傲的东夷女子。她掌管家务和粮仓，对骑马和射箭也不陌生。
Twenty years I held the White Tower's gates, until honor demanded I leave...
我在白塔的大门守卫了二十年，直到荣誉要求我离开……
Twenty-six dead. I would have hanged you.
死了二十六个？换我就把你吊死。
Twin Strike boosts precision window, maximum damage on first strike.
双刃连击强化精准出手窗口，让第一击造成最大杀伤。
Twin Strike charge greatly reduced, the blade is always ready.
双刃连击充能消耗大幅降低，刀锋随时准备出手。
Twin Strike charge reduced, relentless precision strikes.
双刃连击充能消耗降低，可以连续打出精准斩击。
Twin Strike duration extended, sustained dueling flurry.
双刃连击持续时间延长，让决斗中的连斩更持久。
Twin Strike grants +5% melee damage and heightens dueling precision.
双刃连击提供 +5% 近战伤害，并提高决斗时的精准度。
Twin Strike radius greatly expanded, death on all sides.

Vorgoth leads a sub-clan in Gundabad, a brutal orc chieftain inspired by the infighting orc captains in Tolkien's narratives. His ambition drives raids into Angmar's remnants, seeking artifacts of power to elevate his status within the greater horde.
沃尔戈斯统领贡达巴德的一个分支氏族，是一名残暴的奥克酋长，灵感来自托尔金叙事中互相倾轧的奥克队长。他的野心驱使他袭扰安格玛残余势力，寻找能提升自己在大军中地位的力量遗物。
Vorgria, a phantom stalker, pursues enemies unseen, evoking the relentless hunt of the Nine.
沃尔格莉娅是幻影追猎者，追逐敌人时不露形迹，让人想起九戒灵无休止的追猎。
Vorgrim acts as a supply master orc, hoarding resources much like the stockpiles in orc strongholds from the books. His management sustains prolonged campaigns against the North.
沃尔格里姆担任奥克补给官，像书中奥克要塞里的仓库一样囤积资源。他的管理支撑着对北方的长期战役。
Vorla, a divination seer, foresees threats, guiding the guard against Wood-elf ambushes.
沃尔拉是占卜先知，预见威胁，指引守卫应对木精灵伏击。

Vorondir, Lord of Garvirionath, holds the green vales of Anorien beneath the beacon of Amon Din, where his fathers have kept watch since the days of Steward Belecthor. Gallant in the saddle and grave in council, he bears Lossen, the silver sword forged at Pelargir for his grandsire who fell at the Crossings of Erui. In these dimming years he has set his oath unbroken with Lord Denethor, holding the old custodial bond above the rumour of a king out of the wild North. By day he rides the marches with Rohirric scouts; by night he watches the eastern stars and counts how long the shadow has grown.
沃隆迪尔是加尔维瑞昂纳斯家族之主，掌握阿诺瑞恩阿蒙丁烽火台下的绿色谷地；自宰相贝莱克索尔时代起，他的祖先便一直在那里守望。他骑术英勇，议事沉稳，佩剑洛森是一把在佩拉基尔锻造的银剑，曾属于他在埃茹伊河渡口阵亡的祖父。在这些日渐昏暗的岁月里，他与德内梭尔领主的誓言仍未破裂，认为古老的守护之约高于荒野北方传来的王者传闻。白日里，他与洛希尔斥候巡行边境；夜里，他望着东方星辰，计算阴影究竟已经增长了多久。
Vorthak, a cursed guardian, defends the tower with undead vigor, his role akin to the barrow-wights influenced by Sauron's power in Middle-earth lore.
沃尔萨克是受诅咒的守卫，以亡灵般的活力守护高塔。他的职责类似中洲传说中受索隆力量影响的古冢尸妖。
Vorzak commands his clan with the ambition of rising orc lords, aspiring to greater power under Sauron's shadow. His alliances forge stronger ties within Gundabad.
沃尔扎克统领自己的氏族，怀着奥克领主向上爬升的野心，希望在索隆阴影下获得更大权力。他的盟约加强了贡达巴德内部的联系。
Vorzha is an orc healer of sorts, using crude remedies drawn from the dark knowledge in Tolkien's world. Her role sustains the wounded, allowing Gundabad's forces to recover and strike again.
沃尔扎算是奥克中的治疗者，使用从托尔金世界黑暗知识中衍生出的粗糙疗法。她维持伤员性命，使贡达巴德的部队能够恢复并再次出击。
Vorzul, a nest guardian, protects spider lairs, ensuring the horde's multiplication in Dol Guldur's depths.
沃祖尔是巢穴守卫，负责保护蜘蛛巢，让多古尔都深处的兽群不断繁衍壮大。
Vorzul, a phantom reaper, harvests souls, feeding Khamûl's insatiable hunger.
沃祖尔是一名幽影收割者，收割灵魂来满足可哈穆尔永无止境的渴望。
Vrakash, chieftain of the Gashrim orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
弗拉卡什是嘎什林奥克的酋长，为黑暗势力守卫迷雾山脉深处的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Vrakdush of the Maughâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
弗拉克杜什是毛嘎什战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Vrakza of the Morgrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
弗拉克扎是莫格林氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Vrelga of the Hrakdûr orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
弗雷尔加是赫拉克杜尔氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Vughar of the Hrakdûr warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
武加尔是赫拉克杜尔战帮的一名奥克队长，脖颈粗壮。他经常在山路上劫掠，手里的砍刀已崩出许多缺口。
Vughza of the Gashrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
武格扎是嘎什林氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Vugra of the Maughâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
武格拉是毛嘎什氏族的一名女奥克，住在地底深处，凶狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族逊色。
Vurlak acts as a quartermaster orc, distributing gear like the logisticians in large orc armies. His efficiency keeps the clan battle-ready.
伏尔拉克担任奥克军需官，像大型奥克军队中的后勤者一样分发装备。他的工作让贡达巴德各战帮保持武装。
Vurzag is an orc saboteur, planting traps like those that ensnared Thorin's company. In Gundabad, his guerrilla tactics disrupt enemy movements, sowing chaos among the Free Peoples.
伏尔扎格是奥克破坏者，擅长布设陷阱，就像曾困住梭林远征队的那些机关。在贡达巴德，他用游击战术扰乱敌军行动，在自由人民中制造混乱。
Vûshka keeps the tally of the Nurn thralls, and culls the count herself when the books run long.
武什卡登记努尔恩的奴隶人数。账簿上的人太多时，她就亲手杀掉一些。
Wager your battle on my lance and I will not lose you the bet.
把你的战斗押在我的骑枪上，我不会让你输掉这场赌局。

作为夫人的学生走过魔镜之路。
Walls fall to whoever knows where they are weak. I know.
知道城墙弱点的人，就能把它打垮。我知道。
Wandered beyond the wood on private errands.
Wandered the wild roads beyond the valley.
在山谷之外的荒路上漫游。
Wandered with the nomadic tribes of the Sunlands.
随太阳地的游牧部族流浪。
Wanting to make it right is a fair beginning.
想弥补，就算个不错的开头。
War creates opportunities for those clever enough to exploit them...
战争会给足够聪明的人制造机会……
战争会逼人做出可怕的选择。
War is arithmetic. You did what was needed.
打仗就是算账，你做了该做的事。
War is cruel to horses, traveller. Mine have foundered on hard roads, and a rider without a mount is but a slow spearman.
旅人，战争可不会怜惜马匹。我的马在艰难的长途行军中接连累垮，骑手没了坐骑，也不过是个行动迟缓的矛兵。

War will intensify, and I know how to profit from it. Battlefields produce valuable salvage, desperate people buy at inflated prices, and chaos provides cover for enterprising individuals. I have connections on multiple sides and no particular loyalty to any. That's good business.
战争会愈演愈烈，而我知道怎么从中获利。战场会产出值钱的废弃物，绝望的人会用高价购买，混乱也会为有进取心的人提供掩护。我在多方都有关系，也不特别忠于任何一方。这就是好生意。
