You grew up among the chieftain's household in Beorn's Hall, swinging the great axe against posts and learning to sit a pony in full gear. Every bruise was a lesson, and the old bear-tales taught you what a Beorning owes his kin.
你从小与酋长的家臣一起生活在贝奥恩大厅，对着木桩练习挥舞巨斧，也学习全副武装骑小马。每块淤青都是教训，那些关于熊的古老故事，则教你明白贝奥恩一族的成员该为族人承担什么。
You grew up among the dockhands and petty thieves of Seagate, running errands for coin and selling what fell off the barges. The harbour taught you quick hands, a quicker tongue and when to vanish.
你在海门的码头工人和小偷之间长大，替人跑腿赚钱，卖些从驳船上掉下来的东西。港口教会你手脚要快、嘴要更快，还要知道什么时候该消失。

You grew up among the dockworkers and minor thieves of Esgaroth, learning to supplement honest wages with dishonest ones and to vanish before the watch arrived. The lake town's busy quays were a fine education in how the world actually worked.
你在埃斯加洛斯码头工人和小偷之间长大，学会用不诚实的收入补足诚实工钱，也学会在巡守赶到前消失。长湖镇繁忙码头很好地教会了你世界究竟如何运转。

You grew up among the king's household at Vineholm, learning to ride in full gear and to swing heavy weapons under the old guardsmen. Every bruise was a lesson, and the songs of the hall taught you what you owe your lord.
你从小与国王的家臣一起生活在葡萄洲，在老卫士指导下学习全副武装骑马、挥舞重兵器。每块淤青都是教训，大厅里的歌谣则教你明白，自己该为领主承担什么。

You grew up among the king's household in Woodmen-town, swinging the great axe against stumps and learning to move through the trees in full gear. Every bruise was a lesson, and the old forest songs taught you what the Woodmen owe each other.
你从小与国王的家臣一起生活在林中居民镇，对着树桩练习挥舞巨斧，学习全副武装在树木之间行动。每块淤青都是教训，古老的森林歌谣则教你明白，林中居民彼此该承担什么。
You grew up among the lean-tos outside the Forest Gate, running errands for travellers and selling what the road dropped. The road taught you quick hands, a quicker tongue and when to vanish.
你在森林之门外的简陋棚屋间长大，替旅人跑腿，卖些路上遗落的东西。道路教会你手脚要快、嘴要更快，还要知道什么时候该消失。
You grew up among the reed-huts and landings of the Gladden, running errands for coin and selling what the river brought. The water taught you quick hands, a quicker tongue and when to vanish.
你在金鸢尾河的芦苇屋和码头之间长大，替人跑腿赚钱，卖些河水带来的东西。河水教会你手脚要快、嘴要更快，还要知道什么时候该消失。
You grew up hauling baskets and driving carts on the vine terraces, building a strong back and sound legs. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你从小在葡萄梯田里搬筐、赶车，练出结实的腰背和双腿。征召开始时，别人递给你一杆长矛，教你守住阵线。

You grew up hauling nets on the Long Lake and tending the farmland around Esgaroth, building the stamina that lake life demands. When the militia was called you took up your spear alongside the other freemen and marched to keep your home safe.
你在长湖上拉网、在埃斯加洛斯周边农田劳作中长大，练出了湖上生活所需的耐力。民兵被召集时，你和其他自由民一同拿起长矛，行军保卫家园。
You grew up on the road between Bree and the Brandywine, running messages for coin and selling what travellers left behind. The road taught you quick hands, a quicker tongue and when to vanish.
你在布理与白兰地河之间的道路上长大，替人传话赚钱，也卖些旅人遗下的东西。道路教会你手脚要快、嘴要更快，还要知道什么时候该消失。
You grew up on the road between Tharbad and Sarn Ford, running messages for coin and selling what travellers left behind. The road taught you quick hands, a quicker tongue and when to vanish.
你在沙巴德与萨恩渡口之间的道路上长大，替人传话赚钱，也卖些旅人遗下的东西。道路教会你手脚要快、嘴要更快，还要知道什么时候该消失。

You grew up on the road between the Last Bridge and Weathertop, running messages for coin and selling what travellers left behind. The road taught you quick hands, a quicker tongue and when to vanish.
你在最后大桥与风云顶之间的道路上长大，替人传话赚钱，也卖些旅人遗下的东西。道路教会你手脚要快、嘴要更快，还要知道什么时候该消失。

You grew up picking through the shattered stones of Osgiliath, selling salvage to soldiers and running messages between outposts for coin. The ruined city taught you quickness and cunning — a thrown rock could drive off a man twice your size.
你在欧斯吉利亚斯破碎石堆中长大，把捡来的废料卖给士兵，也为钱在各前哨之间传信。这座废墟城市教会你敏捷和狡黠：一块扔准的石头足以赶走比你大一倍的人。

You grew up quick-tongued and quick-fingered in the busy dockyards of Umbar, learning to charm buyers, spot inflated bills, and move goods past customs without asking awkward questions. The harbor was a school in commerce and deception alike.
你在乌姆巴尔繁忙船坞中长大，嘴快手也快，学会讨好买主、看穿虚高账单，也学会不问尴尬问题就把货物绕过海关。港口既教商业，也教欺骗。

You grew up tending the clearings and cultivated patches at the edges of the Woodland Realm, harvesting what the shadowed forest would yield. It was hard and dangerous work, and you learned to move fast when the dark things came near.
你在林地王国边缘的空地和耕作小片土地上长大，收获阴影森林愿意给出的东西。这活艰苦又危险，黑暗之物靠近时，你也学会了跑得够快。

You grew up training alongside the children of Arthedain's noble families in the yards of Fornost. You learned sword and lance under knights sworn to the King, and the long lineages of the Dúnedain by heart.
你从小就在佛诺斯特的院场里，与阿塞丹贵族家的子女一起训练。效忠国王的骑士教你剑术和骑枪，你也把杜内丹人漫长的家谱背得滚瓜烂熟。

You grew up training alongside the children of Cardolan's noble families in the yards of Caras Gorthad. You learned sword and lance under knights sworn to the King, and the lineages of the barrow-kings by heart.
你从小就在卡拉斯戈沙德的院场里，与卡多蓝贵族家的子女一起训练。效忠国王的骑士教你剑术和骑枪，你也把长眠古冢的诸王家谱背得滚瓜烂熟。

You grew up training alongside the children of Gondor's noble families in the yards of Minas Tirith. You learned to fight with sword and lance under knights sworn to the Steward, and spent long hours practicing horsemanship on the Pelennor.
你在米那斯提力斯的训练场上，与刚铎贵族家族的孩子一同长大训练。你在宣誓效忠宰相的骑士指导下学习剑与骑枪，也在佩兰诺花了很长时间练习骑术。

You grew up training alongside the children of Rhudaur's Dúnedain houses in the yards of Cameth Brin. You learned sword and bow under lords sworn to the King, and the lineage of Eärendur's youngest son by heart.
你从小就在卡梅斯布林的院场里，与鲁道尔杜内丹家族的子女一起训练。效忠国王的领主教你剑术和射箭，你也把埃雅仁都尔幼子一系的家谱背得滚瓜烂熟。
You guided a Dunlending warband through Fangorn's edge without losing a man.
你带领一支黑蛮地战帮穿过范贡边缘，一个人也没丢。
You guided a Mumak caravan safely through the hostile desert interior.
你护送一支猛犸商队安全穿过敌对沙漠腹地。
You guided a Ranger company out of an ambush in the Ettenmoors.
你带领一队游民脱离了埃滕荒原的伏击。
You guided a Ranger company out of an ambush in the Trollshaws.
你带领一队游民脱离了食人妖森林中的伏击。
You guided a Ranger company through an Orc encirclement in Ithilien.
你带领一支游侠小队穿出伊希利恩的奥克包围。
You guided a warden patrol out of an ambush in the Old Forest.
你带领一支看守巡逻队脱离了老林子中的伏击。
You guided families out of the burning Eastmarch.
你带着几户人家逃离了烈火中的东境。
You guided families out of the shadow of Dol Guldur.
你带着几户人家逃出了多古尔都的阴影。
You guided refugees out of Mirkwood's southern edge during the shadow's expansion.
你在阴影扩张时引导难民离开黑森林南缘。

You had a natural gift for understanding others, often diffusing arguments and winning friends with ease. Your elders said you had the charisma of an elven lord, while your peers followed you with unwavering loyalty.
你天生懂得理解别人，常能平息争执，也很容易结交朋友。长辈说你有精灵领主般的魅力，同龄人也坚定地跟随你。

You hauled stone and worked bellows in the smoking forges that ringed Barad-dur, enduring heat and ash from before first light until long after dark. The work broke weaker youths, but you found a grim endurance that no taskmaster could extinguish.
你在环绕巴拉督尔的烟熏熔炉中搬石头、拉风箱，从天亮前一直忍受热浪和灰烬到深夜。这样的活会压垮软弱的年轻人，但你找到了连监工也无法熄灭的阴沉耐力。
You have a fast pony? I had forty. Do not laugh.
你有匹跑得快的小马？我以前有四十匹，别笑。
You have a good beast? I had one. Better.
你有头好坐骑？我以前也有，比你的还好。
You have arrived at {SETTLEMENT} to raid it. Some of the residents have gathered to resist you. Raiding this village will cause a war with {KINGDOM}.
你来到{SETTLEMENT}，准备劫掠这里。一些居民已经聚集起来反抗你。劫掠这个村庄会导致与{KINGDOM}开战。
You have arrived at {SETTLEMENT} to raid it. You do not meet any resistance. Raiding this village will cause a war with {KINGDOM}.
你来到{SETTLEMENT}，准备劫掠这里。你没有遇到任何抵抗。劫掠这个村庄会导致与{KINGDOM}开战。
You have drawn your due for your rank already. Earn the next stripe first.
你已经领过当前军阶应得的装备了。先争取晋升再来吧。
You have earned a plain answer. Mark these places well.
你值得我坦诚相告，记好这些地方。
You have earned the asking. The deep halls open to a friend. When this war lets us, you shall see the gold of Durin and the hammers of my people.
你已经赢得了我的信任。深处的厅堂会为朋友敞开。等这场战争让我们腾出时间，你就能看到都林的黄金，也能看到我的族人挥锤锻造。
You have earned your caution, and your bow.
你这份谨慎和弓术，都是吃过苦才换来的。
You have encountered {PARTY}. Fighting them will cause a war with {KINGDOM}.
你遇到了{PARTY}。与他们交战会导致与{KINGDOM}开战。
You have enough captives. Return to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} to hand them over.
你的俘虏数量已经足够，返回{QUEST_SETTLEMENT}交付即可。
You have enough to complete the task. Return to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} to hand it over.
你已备齐任务所需的物品，返回{QUEST_SETTLEMENT}交付即可。
You have lost the column. Await word of your commander.
你与队伍失散了，正在等待指挥官的消息。
You have marched well enough. Go, then — you are released.
你在军中的表现还算不错。去吧，你可以退役了。
You have no gold to add.
You have no soldiers to reward.
你没有可以犒赏的士兵。
You have not yet committed to a particular path. Your career will be determined by your actions in the world.
你还没有选定自己的道路。今后你在这世上的所作所为，将决定你走上什么职业。
You have pledged to defend {settlement}. Ride now!
你已承诺保卫{settlement}。赶快出发！
You have scouted this ground for years. River Navigator charge cost -20.
你已经侦察这片土地多年。河道巡守充能消耗 -20。
You have scouted this ground for years. Stand Fast charge cost -20.
你在这片土地上侦察多年。坚守不退充能消耗-20。
You have survived a hundred raids. +7 health.
你已经从上百次掠袭中活了下来。+7 生命值。
You have the look of someone with something worth taking. Relax, I only admire.
看你这模样，身上该有些值得拿的东西。别紧张，我只是欣赏。
You healed a severe Orc-wound that others said would not close.
你治好了一道别人认为无法愈合的严重奥克伤。
You held Sarn Ford against a host from Dunland.
你在萨恩渡口挡住了黑蛮地大军。
You held a mountain pass alone against an Orc patrol to buy the company time to retreat.
你独自守住一处山口，挡住奥克巡逻队，为同伴撤退争取时间。
You held the Carrock ford beside Grimbeorn.
你与格里姆贝奥恩并肩守住了卡尔岩渡口。
You held the Ettendale against a host from the mountains.
你在埃滕谷挡住了山中大军。
You held the Weather Hills against a host of Angmar.
你在风云丘陵挡住了安格玛大军。
You held the gate of Sunwall against a host from the east.
你在日墙城门前挡住了东来的大军。
You held the shieldwall at the Battle under the Mountain.
你在山下之战中守住盾墙。
You held the shieldwall at the gates of Belegost.
你在贝烈戈斯特城门前守住了盾墙。
You held when others would have run.

You helped tally the iron, grain and coin of Thorin's Halls from an early age, learning to keep ledgers and to supply a mountain hold through the long winters. The work made you methodical and gave you a strategist's eye for resources.
你从小就帮着清点梭林大厅的铁、粮食和钱币，学习记账，筹划山中要塞度过漫长冬季所需的补给。这份工作让你做事有条理，也学会从战略角度看待资源。
You helped the enemy's child. Your clan was right to be angry.
你救了敌人的孩子，族人生气也没错。
You hoarded like a dwarf. What did you expect?
你像矮人一样囤财宝，还指望有什么好结果？
You hold your draw longer for the perfect shot. Light Fletching duration +4s.
你能拉弓更久，只为等到最完美的一箭。轻羽箭持续时间 +4 秒。
You honed your skills in the dark arts of warfare, learning to fight with cunning and deception in the shadowed corridors of Dol Guldur.
你磨炼黑暗战法，学会在多古尔都阴影走廊中用狡诈和欺骗作战。
You hurl your axe with deadly precision. +5% ranged damage.
你能以致命精度掷出斧头。+5% 远程伤害。

You identified the spy through behavioral inconsistency, confronted him privately, and gave him a choice that made the decision simple. He fed false information back to Edoras for two seasons before anyone in Rohan suspected. You received nothing in writing for the achievement.
你通过行为不一致找出了那名间谍，私下与他摊牌，并给了他一个很容易做出的选择。他向埃多拉斯传回假情报整整两个季节，洛汗才开始怀疑。这个成就没有留下任何书面奖赏。
You infiltrated the Elvenking's court as a trader and reported what you heard.
你伪装成商人潜入精灵王庭，并汇报了听到的一切。
You joined Harad's swift outriders, scouting the vast desert on horseback and striking at the enemy's flanks before vanishing back into the heat-haze.
你加入哈拉德迅捷的前驱骑手，骑马侦察广阔沙漠，在敌人侧翼发动打击，再消失回热浪之中。
You joined the Black Scouts, riding swiftly through the wastelands to gather intelligence and harry the enemy's flanks.
你加入黑色斥候，在荒地中快速骑行，收集情报，并骚扰敌人侧翼。
You joined the Border Watch of Dunland, hurling javelins and fighting with sword to defend your clan's territory.
你加入黑蛮地边境守望，投掷标枪并持剑作战，保卫氏族领地。
You joined the Corsair Fleet of Umbar, learning to fight aboard ships and lead boarding parties against Gondor's coastal defenses.
你加入乌姆巴尔海盗舰队，学习船上作战，并率领登船队袭击刚铎沿海防线。
You joined the Iron Guard, Erebor's shock troops, learning to hurl throwing axes and fight in the tight corridors of the mountain halls.
你加入铁卫，也就是孤山的突击部队，学习投掷飞斧，并在山中厅堂狭窄走廊里作战。
You joined the King's guard in the citadel of Fornost, training in disciplined infantry warfare to protect the King and the hall of his fathers.
你加入了佛诺斯特王城的国王卫队，接受纪律严明的步兵训练，守护国王和他先祖留下的大厅。
You joined the Westfold skirmishers, learning to fight with thrown weapons and sword on the open plains.
你加入西伏尔德散兵，学习在开阔平原上用投掷武器和刀剑作战。
You joined the elite Tower Guard of Gondor, training in disciplined infantry warfare to protect the Citadel and the White Tree.
你加入刚铎精锐塔楼卫队，接受纪律严明的步兵战训练，守护圣白塔和白树。
You joined the elite cavalry of Lothlorien, riding swift horses through the Golden Wood and learning to fight with the grace of the Galadhrim.
你加入洛丝罗瑞恩精锐骑兵，骑着骏马穿过金色森林，学习以加拉兹民的优雅方式作战。
You joined the few mounted companies of Rhudaur, learning to ride sure-footed ponies over the fells and to strike fast and be gone before the enemy could form.
你加入了鲁道尔为数不多的骑兵队，学会骑着脚步稳健的小马翻越高地，迅速出击，并在敌人来得及列阵之前离开。
You joined the guard of Cameth Brin, training with greatsword and poleaxe to defend the King and the hall of his fathers on its rock above the hills.
你加入了卡梅斯布林卫队，用大剑和长柄战斧训练，守护国王，以及山丘上那块巨岩上的祖传大厅。
You joined the hewers of the Firebeards, the shock troops of Nogrod, learning to hurl throwing axes and fight in the narrow corridors of the mountain halls.
你加入了火须族劈砍手，他们是诺格罗德的突击部队。你学会投掷飞斧，在山中厅堂狭窄的走廊里作战。
You joined the mounted companies of Caras Gorthad, the best horsemen of the three northern kingdoms, learning to ride and fight with the lance across the open plains.
你加入了卡拉斯戈沙德的骑兵队。他们是北方三国最出色的骑手，你跟着他们在开阔平原上学习骑术和骑枪作战。
You joined the mounted companies of Fornost, learning to ride and fight with the lance under knights who still carry the old banners of the North-kingdom.
你加入了佛诺斯特的骑兵队，跟随那些仍打着北方王国旧旗的骑士，学习骑术和骑枪作战。
You joined the mounted wardens who patrol the vineyards and the Redwater banks, learning to ride and fight with the spear along the narrow terraces.
你加入了巡逻葡萄园与红水河岸的骑乘守卫，学习在狭窄梯田间骑马、用矛作战。
You joined the ranks of the Swan Knights of Dol Amroth, learning the art of mounted combat and chivalric warfare under the banners of Gondor's finest.
你加入多阿姆洛斯天鹅骑士行列，在刚铎最优秀的旗帜下学习骑战与骑士战法。
You joined the skirmishers of Westmark, learning to throw javelins and to fight with the sword on foot beside the riders.
你加入了西境散兵，学习投掷标枪，徒步持剑与骑兵并肩作战。
You joined the spear companies of the King's guard, training in disciplined infantry warfare to hold a line of Cardolan spears against horse and foot alike.
你加入了国王卫队的矛兵队，接受纪律严明的步兵训练，用卡多蓝的长矛阵线同时抵挡骑兵与步兵。

You joined the wardens who patrolled far beyond Lindon's borders into the wild Tower Hills and the upper Anduin vales, learning to track enemies and read the signs of dark movement through ancient forest.
你加入了守望者的巡逻队，远离林顿边境，深入塔丘的荒野和安都因上游河谷。你学会追踪敌人，辨认古老森林中黑暗势力留下的活动痕迹。

You joined the wardens who patrolled far beyond Rivendell's borders into the wild Trollshaws and the upper Anduin vales, learning to track enemies and read the signs of dark movement through ancient forest.
你加入守卫队，远远越过幽谷边境，巡行荒野中的食人妖森林和安都因上游谷地，学习追踪敌人，并辨认古老森林中黑暗活动留下的迹象。
You joined the wardens who patrolled the glades of Mirkwood, keeping watch against spiders, Orcs, and the creeping shadow of Dol Guldur.
你加入巡守黑森林林间空地的守卫，警惕蜘蛛、奥克和多古尔都不断逼近的阴影。
You keep a good horse? Mine is dead, and I am still angry about it.
你有匹好马？我的坐骑死了，我到现在还窝火。
You kept an injured party alive through a Misty Mountain winter.
你让一支受伤队伍活过了迷雾山脉的冬天。

You kept irregular company with the patrols that roamed outside Thranduil's formal borders, learning to set traps and ambushes for the spider-kin and Orc scouts that tested the Woodland Realm's edges. Cunning kept you alive where courage alone would not.
你常与巡行瑟兰杜伊正式边界之外的巡逻队同行，学习为蜘蛛族和奥克斥候布设陷阱与伏击；它们总在试探林地王国边缘。只有勇气不够，狡猾才让你活了下来。

You kept the hidden network of Dunedain informants alive, passing between settlements under assumed names and gathering word of Orc movements, dark strangers, and threats to the people. The Rangers relied on those who could pass for ordinary, and you had the gift.
你维系杜内丹情报人的隐秘网络，用假名往来各聚落，收集奥克动向、黑暗陌生人和威胁人民的消息。游侠需要能看起来平凡的人，而你正有这份天赋。

You kept vigil over the crumbling watchtowers and old road-crossings of the North Kingdom, learning to read the land and spot the signs of Orc movement before trouble arrived. The Rangers held no formal posts, only duty.
你守望北方王国残破的瞭望塔和旧路口，学会读懂土地，在麻烦到来前发现奥克活动的迹象。游侠没有正式岗位，只有职责。
You kept your oath when it cost you everything. That is rare.
哪怕因此失去一切，你也守了誓。这很少见。
You killed a fisherman. Your eyes are bad.
连渔夫都杀，你眼神不行。
You killed the pet and lost your place. Poor judgment.
你杀了他的心头宝，丢了自己的位置。这可不明智。
You killed your own side's men. Do not expect me to praise that.
你杀了自己这边的人，别指望我夸你。
You killed your own tithe-man. You will do worse.
你连自己的收税人都杀，以后还会做得更过分。
You know every crossing. River Navigator radius +3.
你熟悉每一处渡口。河道巡守作用范围 +3。
You know every crossing. Stand Fast radius +3.
你熟悉每一处渡口。坚守不退作用范围+3。
You know every valley and ridge of the Mark. +8% party spotting range.
你熟悉马克的每一道山谷和每一条山脊。+8% 部队侦察范围。
You know every valley and ridge of the plain. +8% party spotting range.
你熟悉平原上的每一道山谷和山脊。+8%部队侦察范围。
You know what I like. Thank you.
你知道我喜欢什么。谢谢。
You know, we orcs suffer when the weak are spared...
你知道吗，我们奥克最受罪的时候，就是弱者被放过的时候……

You labored in the irrigated fields around the desert oases, learning to coax growth from arid earth and to endure the physical demands of farm work under a merciless sun. When the war-levy came you were lean, strong, and ready.
你在沙漠绿洲周围的灌溉田地中劳作，学会从干旱土地中催发生长，也学会在无情烈日下承受农活对身体的要求。征召到来时，你精瘦、强健，也准备好了。

You labored in the underground excavations of Dol Guldur, dragging blocks and shoring tunnels in the permanent darkness beneath the corrupted hill. The work was relentless, and endurance was the only currency that bought any relief.
你在多古尔都地下开掘处劳作，在腐化山丘下永久黑暗中拖拽石块、支撑隧道。这活无休无止，耐力是唯一能换来片刻喘息的货币。
You lead the charge and none can match your speed. +10% horse charge damage.
你率先发起冲锋，无人能追上你的速度。+10% 坐骑冲锋伤害。

You learned the textile and craft arts of Lothlórien, working with the famous Elven weavers who produced cloth of silver and gold. The work required uncommon precision, and you found that beauty and persuasion were inseparable in the Golden Wood.
你跟随著名的精灵织工学习洛丝罗瑞恩的纺织和手工技艺，与他们一起织出银色和金色的布料。这份工作要求格外细致，你也渐渐发现，在金色森林，美本身就有打动人心的力量。

You learned the wooded ridges bordering the Misty Mountains as a young hunter, tracking deer and picking up the bow before most children could properly grip it. The forest kept its secrets, and you learned most of them.
年轻时，你以猎手身份熟悉了毗邻迷雾山脉的林间山脊，追踪鹿群，也在多数孩子还握不稳弓时就拿起了弓。森林守着它的秘密，而你学到了其中大部分。

You learned to forge crude but effective arms in the noisy smithing halls of the mountain, learning to trade them for supplies and favors. The work was ugly but the skills were real, and you left the forge knowing both iron and dealing.
你在山中嘈杂铁匠厅里学习打造粗糙但管用的武器，也学会用它们换取补给和人情。这活难看，但本事真实；离开熔炉时，你既懂铁，也懂交易。

You learned to keep accounts and charm buyers in the merchant halls of Dale, where goods from the East and South met goods from Erebor and the North. The city's famous trade made it the ideal classroom for anyone wanting to understand wealth.
你在河谷邦商馆中学习记账和讨好买主；东方、南方的货物在这里与孤山、北方的货物相遇。这座城市著名的贸易，让它成为任何想理解财富之人的理想课堂。
You learned to keep tallies and charm buyers in the cellars of Redwater, where every cask is sampled and every price argued, and to tell a fair bargain from a quick tongue.
你在红水酒窖里学习记账、招揽买家。每桶酒都要品尝，每个价格都要争论，你也学会分清公道买卖与花言巧语。

You learned to read the signs of passage left by men and beasts in the old forests and moorlands of Eriador, hunting game for the table and Orc scouts for the safety of the settlements. The bow was your first language and the wilderness your second home.
你学会读懂人和野兽在埃利阿多古林与荒原中留下的通行迹象，为餐桌狩猎野物，也为聚落安全追踪奥克斥候。弓是你的第一语言，荒野是你的第二个家。

You learned to set ambushes in the old ruins and thickets of ruined Arnor, reading trails and using the broken landscape to your advantage. A well-placed arrow from cover was worth a dozen men in the open, and you made every shot count.
你学会在阿尔诺废墟和灌木中设下伏击，读懂踪迹，并利用破碎地形取得优势。掩护中射出的一支好箭，胜过空地上的十几个人，而你让每一箭都算数。
You learned to shape bits, spurs and blades in the forge-houses of Horsemead, under a master who judged a sword by how it sat in the hand of a rider.
你在牧马草甸的锻炉间学习打造马衔、马刺和刀剑。师父评判一把剑，要看它握在骑手手里是否顺手。

You learned to shape metal and wood in the practical crafts of the Dunlending settlements, making tools, weapons, and fittings for the clans. The work gave you clever hands and an eye for how things were put together and how they could be taken apart.
你学习黑蛮地聚落中的实用工艺，塑造金属和木料，为氏族制作工具、武器和配件。这份工作给了你灵巧双手，也让你懂得东西是如何组装、又该如何拆开。

You learned to shape the bright steel of Rohan in the forge-houses of Aldburg, making blades and fittings for the Rohirrim. You went home each night with arms aching and a pride in craft that no battlefield could diminish.
你在奥德堡铁匠铺中学习锻造洛汗亮钢，为洛希尔人制作刀剑和配件。每晚回家时你双臂酸痛，但对手艺的骄傲不会被任何战场磨灭。

You learned to shape timber and caulk planking in the great ship-sheds of Umbar, studying the engineering of vessels that carried war across the sea. When you were not building ships you were thinking about how they might be broken.
你在乌姆巴尔巨大的船棚中学习修整木料、填塞船板，研究那些把战争载过海面的船只结构。不造船的时候，你就在想它们该怎样被拆毁。

You learned to work metal and manage materials in the smoky workshops that fed Saruman's war machine, picking up the arts of crafting and supply under pressure. The work was constant and inventive, and Saruman rewarded ingenuity.
你在供养萨茹曼战争机器的烟熏工坊中学习金属加工和物料管理，在压力下掌握制造与补给之道。工作从不停歇，也总有新花样，而萨茹曼会奖赏巧思。

You learned your craft from the Elven bowyers of Mirkwood, shaping staves and stringing the famous Woodland bows. The work required equal measures of patience and precision, and you left with hands that could shape a weapon as readily as use one.
你向黑森林精灵制弓师学习手艺，削制弓身，为著名的林地弓上弦。这项工作同样需要耐心和精准，而你离开时，双手既能造武器，也能用武器。

You learned your craft in the forges of Cameth Brin, working mountain iron under a master who still kept the Númenórean ways of tempering steel. By the time you were grown your hands knew the work better than your head.
你在卡梅斯布林的锻炉旁学艺，跟随师父锻打山中的铁料。他仍保留着努门诺尔人的钢铁淬火手艺。等你成年，许多活儿不用多想，双手就知道怎么做。

You learned your craft in the forges of Caras Gorthad, working the bellows under a master who still kept the Númenórean ways of tempering steel. By the time you were grown your hands knew the work better than your head.
你在卡拉斯戈沙德的锻炉旁学艺，替师父拉风箱。他仍保留着努门诺尔人的钢铁淬火手艺。等你成年，许多活儿不用多想，双手就知道怎么做。

You learned your craft in the forges of Fornost Erain, working the bellows under a master who still kept the Númenórean ways of tempering steel. By the time you were grown your hands knew the work better than your head.
你在佛诺斯特·埃莱因的锻炉旁学艺，替师父拉风箱。他仍保留着努门诺尔人的钢铁淬火手艺。等你成年，许多活儿不用多想，双手就知道怎么做。

You learned your craft in the smithing quarter of Minas Tirith, blowing bellows and grinding edges under a master armorer's stern eye. By the time you were grown your hands were calloused from hammer work and you could judge a blade's temper by its ring.
你在米那斯提力斯铁匠区学习手艺，在军械大师严厉目光下拉风箱、磨刃口。等你长大时，双手已因锤打而结满老茧，也能凭刀身响声判断淬火好坏。

You learned your trade at Ironwood Hall, splitting the dark heartwood and hafting axes under a master who tested every handle with a blow. By the time you were grown your hands knew the work better than your head.
你在铁木厅跟师父学艺，劈开深色心材，给斧头装柄。每根斧柄，他都要用力敲上一下检验。等你成年，许多活儿不用多想，双手就知道怎么做。

You learned your trade in the cooperages of Vineholm, bending staves and hooping barrels under a master who judged every join by its sound. By the time you were grown your hands knew the work better than your head.
你在葡萄洲的制桶作坊学艺，跟随师父弯桶板、上桶箍。他听听声音，就能判断每个接缝是否合格。等你成年，许多活儿不用多想，双手就知道怎么做。

You learned your trade in the timber yards of Beorn's Hall, shaping beams and hafting axes under a master who judged every cut by eye. By the time you were grown your hands knew the work better than your head.
你在贝奥恩大厅的木料场学艺，跟着师父削梁、给斧头装柄。他只靠眼睛就能评判每一刀做得好不好。等你成年，许多活儿不用多想，双手就知道怎么做。
You led the assault column at Helm's Deep and breached the outer wall.
你在海尔姆深谷率领突击纵队，炸开外墙。
You led the boarding party that took the Gondorian warship off Belfalas.
你率领登船队在贝尔法拉斯外海夺下一艘刚铎战船。

You led the charge onto enemy docks, hurling javelins and cutting your way through defenders before retreating to the Black ships with what you had taken. Raids were fast and brutal, and you learned that hesitation cost lives.
你冲上敌方码头，投出标枪，在守军中杀开道路，再带着抢来的东西撤回黑船。袭击迅速而残酷，你也明白了犹豫会要人命。
You led the clan migration to new grazing lands without losing the herd.
你带领氏族迁往新牧场，没有损失畜群。
You led the flanking charge that broke the Gondorian infantry square.
你率领侧翼冲锋，击破刚铎步兵方阵。
You led the raid that broke the Dwarven outpost on the Grey Mountains.
你率领劫掠打垮了灰色山脉的矮人前哨。
You left a friend to die and now you want wages?
你丢下朋友送死，现在还想领工钱？
You left honest drivers to the raiders.
你把老实车夫丢给了劫掠者。
You left honest drivers to the spiders.
你把老实车夫丢给了蜘蛛。
You left your comrades to die and call it arithmetic.
丢下同伴等死，还说只是算账。
You left your comrades to die. I do not trust that kind of nerve.
你丢下战友送死。你这份胆量，我信不过。
You left your friend to die and now you want wages?
你丢下朋友送死，现在还想领工钱？
You left your own to die. Do not expect trust.
你丢下自己人去死，别指望别人信任你。
You let goblins through your own gate to win an argument.
为了争赢一口气，你把半兽人放进了自家城门。
You let your own crew drown. I will not turn my back.
你眼看着自己的船员淹死，我可不会背对你。
You lied to the king and are shocked he found out.
你欺骗国王，被他查出来了倒还大吃一惊。
You lied to the king and are surprised it caught up with you.
你欺骗国王，事情败露了倒还觉得意外。

You lived by your wits on the roads of the North, trading small work for food and board, and occasionally lifting what was not offered. The Dunedain passed through the same settlements but spoke to no one, which taught you that invisibility was its own kind of power.
你在北方道路上靠机灵生活，用小活换食宿，偶尔也拿走别人没给你的东西。杜内丹会穿过同样的聚落却不与任何人交谈，这教会你：不被看见本身也是一种力量。

You lived outside formal Easterling clan structure, moving with the Karash bands who followed the armies and profited from their passage. Cunning and thrown weapons kept you fed on the margins of the great eastern host.
你不属于东夷正式的氏族组织，而是跟随卡拉什战帮行动。这些人尾随军队，从军队经过的地方捞取好处。你靠机灵和投掷武器的本领，在东方大军周围讨生活。

You lived outside the structure of the mountain clans, moving with the quick-fingered opportunists who followed warbands and picked over the aftermath of every skirmish. Throwing weapons and a fast pair of legs kept you alive when nothing else would.
你生活在山地氏族结构之外，混迹于手脚飞快的投机者之间；他们跟随战帮，在每场小规模冲突后搜刮残局。投掷武器和一双快腿在别无依靠时保住了你的命。
You look at my face. Good. Look at my hands as well.
你在看我的脸。好，也看看我的手。
You look like someone who pays for good information. Do you?
你看起来愿意为好消息付钱，是吗？
You lose the light before you lose the ground, and come back with little.
天色暗了，你还没来得及摸清地形，回来时所获不多。
You lost a beast and your nerve. The holds were right.
坐骑丢了，胆子也丢了。堡里那么对你没错。

You made blades and repaired equipment in the small hidden settlements where the Dunedain wintered, learning to craft with economy — materials were scarce and every piece had to be made to last. You developed a craftsman's precision and a warrior's instinct for what a weapon needed to do.
你在杜内丹过冬的小型隐秘聚落里打造刀剑、修理装备，学会节省材料来制作东西；资源稀缺，每件物品都必须耐用。你练出了工匠的精准，也有战士对武器用途的直觉。
You made the best horse-fair prices Southwood had seen in five years.
你谈成了南林马市五年来最好的成交价。

You made your first raids on the coasts of Gondor as little more than a youth, fighting at the front of a boarding party with sword and throwing knife. The raids were brutal and swift, and they taught you exactly what violence was worth.
你还只是少年时，就第一次参加了对刚铎海岸的袭击，持剑和飞刀站在登船队前列作战。袭击残酷而迅速，也教会你暴力究竟值什么价。
You mapped the Elven patrol routes in southern Mirkwood over six months.
你用六个月绘出黑森林南部精灵巡逻路线。
You mapped the Rohirrim patrol patterns and handed Saruman a strategic advantage.
你绘出洛希尔巡逻规律，给了萨茹曼战略优势。
You mapped the web-tunnel network in the southern forest.
你绘出了南方森林蛛网隧道网络。
You march with the Elf-friends. My own people would have my head for taking your coin, and yours would sooner see me hanged than armed. No.
你和精灵之友并肩作战。我收了你的钱，自己人会要我的命；而你们的人宁愿把我吊死，也不愿让我拿起武器。不干。
You march with the {CURRENT_SECTION} at present. Where would you rather stand?
你目前编在{CURRENT_SECTION}，想调到哪里？
You march with {COMMANDER}'s company, at your commander's pace.
你跟随{COMMANDER}的部队，按指挥官的步调行军。
You marched with the trading caravans along the Dwarf-road through the Shire to Bree, learning the ways of commerce and the art of defending valuable cargo.
你随贸易商队沿矮人路穿过夏尔，前往布理，学会经商的门道，也学会如何保护贵重货物。
You mended what the chiefs break. That counts for more than the stores you spent.
酋长把人打坏，你把人治好。这比你花掉的物资值钱多了。
You move swiftly through terrain that bogs others down. +6% party movement speed.
你能迅速穿过会拖慢他人的地形。+6% 部队移动速度。
You move unseen between salvos. +10% stealth bonus.
你能在齐射间隙悄悄移动。+10% 潜行加成。
You move without sound through the Dunlending hills. +10% stealth bonus.
你能悄无声息地穿过黑蛮地的丘陵。+10% 潜行加成。

You moved goods along the shadowed roads of Mordor, learning to barter and bluff your way past toll-keepers and corrupt overseers. The danger sharpened your wits, and you discovered that information was worth more than iron in the Dark Land.
你沿魔多阴影笼罩的道路搬运货物，学会靠讨价还价和虚张声势通过收费者与腐败监工。危险磨快了你的脑子，你也发现，在黑暗之地，情报比铁更值钱。

You moved through the old kingdom's overgrown ruins and moorlands as a ranger scout, learning to live off the wild land and track both beast and enemy across terrain that held memory in its stones. Speed and silence were your only tools.
你作为游侠斥候穿过旧王国被杂草覆盖的废墟和荒原，学会靠荒野生活，也学会在每块石头都记着往事的土地上追踪野兽与敌人。速度和安静是你唯一的工具。
You navigated the deep desert alone and found a lost oasis mentioned in old texts.
你独自穿越深沙漠，找到古籍提到的失落绿洲。
You need a companion - or a soldier you can promote - to lead a refuge.
你需要一名同伴或一名可提拔的士兵来担任避难所的守备官。
You need at least 2 healthy men to review the host.
至少需要2名健康士兵才能检阅部队。
You need less charge to unleash destruction. Bloodrage charge cost -20.
你只需更少充能就能释放毁灭。嗜血狂怒充能消耗 -20。
You need no great cause to rampage. Hammer Down charge cost -20.
你不需要什么伟大理由也会暴走。重锤压顶充能消耗 -20。
You need {COUNT} healthy men to labour.
需要{COUNT}名健康士兵参与劳动。
You need {GOLD} gold to switch careers.
You negotiated a peace between two feuding desert tribes.
你调停了两个沙漠部族之间的仇怨。
You negotiated a vital grain supply contract for Minas Tirith.
你为米那斯提力斯谈下一份关键粮食供应契约。
You negotiated the best horse-fair prices Edoras had seen in five years.
你谈成了埃多拉斯五年来最好的马市价格。
You no longer carry the materials.
你已经没有携带所需材料。
You no longer have the gold for it.
You no longer have the metals for it.
你的金属材料已经不足。
You nock and draw in a single fluid motion. +5% ranged damage.
你能以一个流畅动作完成搭箭和拉弓。+5% 远程伤害。

You noticed the signs of careful observation — broken grass pressed back upright, stones replaced — and realized someone had been reading the approaches to the Deep for weeks. You tracked back along their routes, identified the camp, and reported it to the garrison captain. Helm's Deep prepared accordingly.
你注意到谨慎观察留下的痕迹：被压倒又扶起的草、挪动后复位的石头，于是意识到有人已经研究通往深谷的道路数周。你沿他们路线反追，找出营地，并报告给守军队长。海尔姆深谷因此做好了准备。
You noticed the signs of careful watching: grass pressed back upright, stones turned, a fire dug over. You followed the trail south and brought the report back in time for the riders to act.
你注意到有人暗中侦察的痕迹：被重新扶直的草、翻动过的石头，还有掩埋过的火堆。你循着踪迹向南，及时带回报告，让骑兵能够采取行动。
You now lead {CLAN}. Kingdom votes and clan decisions recognise you again.
你现在是{CLAN}的领袖，王国投票和家族决策会再次承认你的身份。
You obtained Rohirrim military plans through a contact in Edoras.
你通过埃多拉斯的一名线人取得洛希尔军事计划。

You often slipped beyond the veiled borders of Lothlórien alone, exploring the Anduin's banks and the brown lands beyond out of restless curiosity. You learned to pass unseen and to use misdirection when straightforward paths were barred to you.
你常独自溜出洛丝罗瑞恩朦胧边界，出于不安分的好奇心探索安都因河岸和更远处的褐地。你学会无声通过，也学会在正路被堵住时用误导开路。
You opened a free market at the Old Ford.
你在老渡口开办了自由集市。
You opened a new seam of iron beneath the Blue Mountains.
你在蓝色山脉下开出了一条新铁矿脉。
You opened a timber market with the Beornings.
你与贝奥恩一族建立了木材集市。
You opened a trading relationship with Isengard that kept your clan fed through winter.
你打开了与艾森加德的贸易关系，让氏族撑过冬天。
You opened the first free market on the Sea of Rhûn.
你在鲁恩内海开办了第一处自由集市。
You opened the first permanent trading house between Dale and the Easterling border settlements.
你开设了河谷邦与东夷边境聚落之间第一家常设商行。
You opened trade with western merchants that gave the clans access to steel tools.
你与西方商人开启贸易，让氏族获得钢制工具。
You organized the Pelennor harvest under threat of Orc raids.
你在奥克袭击威胁下组织佩兰诺收成。
You outpace any pursuit. +5% movement speed.
任何追兵都追不上你。+5% 移动速度。
You paid for that loss in good iron.
这笔损失，你用好铁还了回去。
You paid your soldiers {GOLD} gold. Morale rises by {COUNT}.
你向士兵发放了{GOLD}金，士气提高{COUNT}点。
You passed through the Shire twice without any Hobbit knowing you had been there.
你两次穿过夏尔，却没有任何霍比特人知道你来过。
You patrol without pause or rest. River Navigator duration +2s.
你不眠不休地巡逻。河道巡守持续时间 +2 秒。
You patrol without pause or rest. Stand Fast duration +2s.
你日夜巡逻，从不停歇。坚守不退持续时间+2秒。

You patrolled the rocky wilderness surrounding the mountain fortress, tracking intruders and reading signs of enemy movement. The cold northern wilds gave you patience and a bowman's stillness that outlasted any target.
你巡逻山中要塞周围的岩石荒野，追踪入侵者，辨认敌人活动迹象。北方寒冷荒地给了你耐心，也给了你弓手般的静止，足以熬过任何目标。
You patrolled the walls of Rhun's settlements, learning archery and the art of defense against raiders from the wild eastern steppes.
你巡守鲁恩聚落的城墙，学习弓术，以及抵御东方荒野草原劫掠者的防御之道。
You patrolled the wilds of Ithilien, striking at the enemy from the shadows and honing your skills as a ranger in the tradition of Faramir's company.
你巡守伊希利恩荒野，从阴影中打击敌人，并沿着法拉米尔队伍的传统磨炼游侠技艺。
You pay {PRICE} denars. {HOST} will pass your clan's villages by.
你支付了{PRICE}第纳尔，{HOST}将绕过你家族的村庄。
You pledged your loyalty to King Farin, serving in the guard of Thorin's Halls and learning to wield axe and long-hafted mattock in defence of the mountain halls.
你向法林王宣誓效忠，在梭林大厅的卫队服役，学习用战斧和长柄镐守护山中厅堂。
You pledged your loyalty to the King Under the Mountain, serving in the elite Royal Guard and learning to wield axe and hammer in defense of the realm.
你向山下之王宣誓效忠，在精锐王家卫队中服役，学习挥舞斧锤保卫王国。
You pledged your loyalty to the King of Dale, serving in the Royal Guard and learning the martial traditions of the Men of the North.
你向河谷邦国王宣誓效忠，在王家卫队中服役，学习北方人的武艺传统。

You practiced combat alongside the young warriors of Dain's household, learning to swing the two-handed axe in the echoing training halls deep beneath the Lonely Mountain. Every scar was a lesson; every lesson was a point of pride.
你和戴因家中的年轻战士一同练武，在孤山深处回声震荡的训练大厅里学习挥舞双手斧。每道伤疤都是一堂课，每堂课都值得骄傲。

You practiced the mounted arts in the quiet training grounds of Lindon, learning to ride and fight with the fluid grace that Elven tradition demanded. The great library was never far, and your education in blade and lore went hand in hand.
你在林顿安静的训练场上练习骑术和马上作战，学会了精灵传统中流畅而优雅的战斗动作。大图书馆就在不远处，你在磨炼剑术的同时，也不断积累学识。

You practiced the mounted arts in the quiet training grounds of Rivendell, learning to ride and fight with the fluid grace that Elven tradition demanded. The great library was never far, and your education in blade and lore went hand in hand.
你在幽谷安静的训练场学习马背技艺，按精灵传统要求，以流畅优雅的姿态骑乘和作战。大图书馆就在不远处，你的刀剑和学识教育也始终并行。

You practiced the warrior arts in the silver courts of Caras Galadhon, learning the sweeping sword-style of the Galadhrim under the light of the Lady's power. Every morning began with drills and every evening with starlight and long memory.
你在卡拉斯加拉松银色庭院中练习战士技艺，在夫人的力量之光下学习加拉兹民大开大合的剑法。每天清晨从操练开始，每个夜晚则属于星光和悠久记忆。

You practised combat alongside the young warriors of King Farin's household, learning to swing the two-handed axe in the echoing training halls deep in the Blue Mountains. Every scar was a lesson; every lesson was a point of pride.
你与法林王家中的年轻战士一起练习战斗，在蓝色山脉深处回声阵阵的训练厅里学习挥舞双手斧。每道伤疤都是教训，每次学会新东西都值得自豪。
You priced a village's lives and found them too dear.
你给全村人的命标了价，还嫌不划算。
You produced a set of works that Dale's craft guild displayed in its hall.
你制作的一组作品被河谷邦工匠行会陈列在大厅中。
You proved your skill as a rider among the Rohirrim, learning to charge with lance and fight from horseback in the traditions of Eorl the Young.
你在洛希尔人中证明了自己的骑术，按照年少的埃奥尔的传统学习持枪冲锋和马背作战。
You proved your skill in the saddle among the king's household riders, learning to charge with the lance and to fight with spear and sword from horseback.
你在国王的亲随骑兵中证明了自己的骑术，学会用骑枪冲锋，也学会从马背上挥矛、用剑作战。
You proved your worth as a rider among the Khelek Warriors, learning mounted combat on the wide steppes of Rhun in the tradition of the eastern war-riders.
你在凯勒克战士中证明了自己的价值，按照东方战骑手的传统，在鲁恩广阔草原上学习骑战。

You proved yourself in the brutal warbands of Isengard, picking up every weapon style that kept you alive and leaving behind anything that did not. Saruman cared only for results and the warbands enforced that philosophy without mercy.
你在艾森加德残酷的战帮中证明自己，学会一切能让你活下去的武器用法，也抛掉一切无用之物。萨茹曼只在乎结果，战帮也毫不留情地执行这套道理。
You quelled a work-gang revolt without losing the day's output.
你平息了工队叛乱，还没有损失当天产出。
You raid from dusk to dawn without tiring. +5 health.
你能从黄昏一直掠袭到黎明，不知疲惫。+5 生命值。
You raised the gates of Gladden Hold.
你建起了金鸢尾堡的大门。
You raised the new gate-beams of Ironwood Hall.
你架起了铁木厅的新门梁。

You ran drills alongside the bred warriors of Isengard, learning to brace and hold with spear and to cut with sword in tight formation. Being neither Uruk nor pure Man you had to be twice as relentless to be accepted.
你与艾森加德培育出的战士一同操练，学习用长矛稳住阵线，并在紧密阵形中挥剑砍杀。你既不是乌鲁克，也不是纯粹的人类，所以必须加倍狠厉，才能被接受。
You ran from a friend and now you want coin?
你丢下朋友逃命，现在还想拿钱？

You ran in the shadow economy of the harbor city, carrying goods that could not be declared and messages that could not be written down. The work paid in secrets and small coins, and you learned every fence, bribe, and bolt-hole in Umbar.
你混迹港城地下买卖，搬运不能报关的货物，也传递不能写下的消息。这活用秘密和小钱付款，而你学会了乌姆巴尔每个销赃人、贿赂价和藏身洞。

You ran patrols through the ruins of Arnor with the Dunedain, learning to fight with sword and spear against the Orc warbands that tested the northern marches. The Rangers kept no fortresses, only vigilance, and you learned what that cost.
你与杜内丹一同巡逻阿尔诺废墟，学习用剑和矛对抗试探北方边境的奥克战帮。游侠没有堡垒，只有警惕，而你学会了这要付出什么代价。
You ran the most successful black market in Umbar's lower harbor for two years.
你经营了乌姆巴尔下港最成功的黑市，两年无人能破。

You ran with the dark patrols that pushed the corruption of Dol Guldur further into southern Mirkwood, cutting down resistance with axe and spear. Each foray took you deeper into the twisted forest and left less of your former self behind.
你跟随黑暗巡逻队，把多古尔都的腐化更深地推进黑森林南部，用斧和矛砍倒抵抗者。每次出击都让你更深入扭曲森林，也让过去的自己少留下一点。

You ran with the raiding bands that struck into the Grey Mountains, learning to fight with axe and spear in the brutal hit-and-run style of the northern clans. You came back meaner each time and a little more certain of your own survival.
你跟随袭入灰色山脉的劫掠战帮，学习北方氏族残酷的打了就跑战法，用斧和矛厮杀。每次回来你都更凶一点，也更确信自己能活下去。
You ranged far across the grass with the scouts, watching for Wainrider smoke and wolf-packs and learning to shoot from the saddle.
你随斥候骑马远行，观察草原上战车民升起的烟和狼群的踪迹，也学会从马背上放箭。

You ranged the Wold and the approaches to Helm's Deep as a scout for Isengard, learning to travel fast and unseen across open country. Reading the land and avoiding the Rohirrim patrols sharpened your instincts to a fine edge.
你作为艾森加德斥候巡行北高原和通往海尔姆深谷的道路，学会在开阔乡野中快速而隐蔽地移动。读懂土地并避开洛希尔巡逻队，把你的本能磨得锋利无比。

You ranged the dark forest edge south of the Long Lake, learning to track game and avoid the attention of worse things. Your bow was your most reliable companion and your knowledge of the forest trails kept you alive more than once.
你巡行长湖南方的黑暗森林边缘，学习追踪猎物，也避开更糟糕之物的注意。弓是你最可靠的伙伴，而你对森林小路的了解也不止一次保住你的命。
You ranged the dark trees beneath the Emyn Duir, tracking wolf-packs and burning spider-nests, and learned to shoot at a running shadow between the trunks.
你在埃敏杜伊尔山下阴暗的树林中巡行，追踪狼群，烧毁蜘蛛巢，学会向树干之间奔过的黑影放箭。

You ranged the dark woodlands east of the Long Lake, hunting game for the market and keeping a watchful eye on the Orc paths coming down from the mountains. The forest taught you to read the land and keep your bow strung at all times.
你巡行长湖东侧的阴暗林地，为市场狩猎野物，也警惕从山中下来的奥克道路。森林教会你读懂土地，并让弓弦始终上紧。

You ranged the eastern foothills of the Blue Mountains with the outer watch, learning to track orc raiders and shoot from cover among the pines along the Dwarf-road. The mountain air sharpened your senses and distance became your ally.
你跟随外围哨兵行走在蓝色山脉东麓，学习追踪奥克劫掠者，在矮人路沿线的松林中借助掩护射击。山里的空气让你的感官更敏锐，拉开距离也成了你的优势。
You ranged the edge of Mirkwood and the stony slopes of the Carrock with the hunters, learning to move without sound and to loose a bow at a shadow. Your first goblin fell to it soon after.
你随猎人行走在黑森林边缘和卡尔岩多石的坡地，学会悄无声息地移动，朝黑影放箭。很快，你就用弓射倒了第一个半兽人。
You ranged the marshes and river-woods with the fowlers, learning to move without sound and to loose a bow at a shadow among the reeds.
你随捕鸟人行走在沼泽与河边树林，学会悄无声息地移动，向芦苇之间的黑影放箭。
You ranged the northern slopes of the Blue Mountains, where the goblins of Blue Craig hold their caves, tracking raiders and wolves and keeping watch on the passes.
你行走在蓝色山脉北部的山坡上，蓝岩半兽人占据着这里的洞穴。你追踪劫掠者和狼，监视各处隘口。

You ranged the slopes around Erebor as part of the outer watch, learning to track Orc raiding parties and shoot from concealment in the pine forest. The mountain air sharpened your senses and distance became your ally.
你作为外围守望者巡行孤山周边山坡，学习追踪奥克劫掠队，也学会在松林中隐蔽射击。山中空气磨利了你的感官，距离成了你的盟友。

You ranged widely across the Eastfold with your bow, hunting game and keeping a sharp eye on the eastern horizon for signs of Orc movement. The wide plains taught you to see far and move quietly, and both skills served you well.
你带着弓走遍东伏尔德，狩猎野物，也警惕东方地平线上是否有奥克活动迹象。广阔平原教会你看得更远、动得更轻，这两样本事都很有用。
You ranged widely along the forest edge with your bow, hunting game and keeping a sharp eye on both the trees and the open grass.
你带着弓沿森林边缘四处行走，猎取野兽，也时刻留意树林和开阔草地上的动静。
You reach them. The news reached them first.
你赶到了，可消息比你先到。
You read the land like a book. +5% party spotting range.
你像读书一样读懂大地。+5% 部队侦察范围。
You read the plains of Rhovanion as a book. +5% party spotting range.
你能像读书一样看懂罗瓦尼安平原。+5%部队侦察范围。
You read the plains of Rohan as a book. +5% party spotting range.
你像读书一样读懂洛汗平原。+5% 部队侦察范围。
You rebuilt the Long Lake fish-weirs after the Easterling war damaged them.
你修复了长湖的捕鱼堰，这些设施曾在与东夷的战争中遭到破坏。
You rebuilt the farms of Eastbank after a goblin raid.
半兽人袭击后，你重建了东岸的农场。
You receive {GOLD} denars for signing on again.
你续签服役，获得了{GOLD}第纳尔。
You recovered stolen cargo from a corrupt dock official and kept his accounts.
你从腐败码头官员手中追回被盗货物，并留下了他的账目。
You regenerate wounds that would cripple men. +8 health.
足以让人残废的伤势，你也能恢复过来。+8 生命值。
You reopened the Forest Road trade route after years of closure.
你在多年封闭后重开密林路贸易线。
You retrieved a stolen document from a Ranger camp without being seen.
你从游侠营地取回一份被盗文件，全程无人发现。
You ride as one with your mount. +10% horse charge damage.
你与坐骑合为一体。+10% 坐骑冲锋伤害。
You ride for days without dismounting. +5 health.
你能连续骑行数日而不下马。+5 生命值。
You ride the line and come back with the ground mapped.
你沿线骑行侦察，回来时已经绘出了当地的地形。
You ride the road twice and still miss whatever was on it.
你在路上巡查了两遍，还是没找到可疑的目标。
You roamed the highlands and forests as a scout, learning to read the land and shoot from horseback.
你作为斥候游荡在高地和森林中，学会读懂土地，也学会骑射。
You roamed the treacherous mountain paths around Blue Craig, tracking enemies and ensuring safe passage for your kin.
你穿行在蓝岩周围险恶的山路上，追踪敌人，确保族人能安全通过。
You roamed the treacherous mountain paths around Goblin-town, tracking enemies and ensuring safe passage for your kin.
你穿行在半兽人镇周围险恶的山路上，追踪敌人，确保族人能安全通过。
You roamed the treacherous mountain paths around Gundabad, tracking enemies and ensuring safe passage for your kin.
你游荡在贡达巴德周围险恶山道上，追踪敌人，并确保族人通行安全。
You roamed the treacherous mountain paths around the Misty Mountains, tracking enemies and ensuring safe passage for your kin.
你穿行在迷雾山脉周围险恶的山路上，追踪敌人，确保族人能安全通过。
You robbed a rival tribe's treasury caravan and redistributed it to your own.
你抢下敌对部族的财宝商队，并分给自己的部族。
You robbed the dead and your chief. Brave.
你既抢死人，又抢酋长，真有胆量。

You rode as a forward scout for the Easterling cavalry columns, ranging days ahead of the main force and reporting back what you found. The work demanded you stay unseen, shoot straight from horseback, and judge when to run rather than fight.
你曾担任东夷骑兵纵队的前哨，骑马赶到主力前方几天路程的地方侦察，再带回情报。你必须善于隐蔽，能在马背上准确射击，还要懂得什么时候应该撤走，不能恋战。
You rode as a runner for the chieftain, carrying his word between Beorn's Hall, the Old Ford and the Carrock, and learned to read the Vales from the back of a pony.
你曾骑马为酋长传令，往来于贝奥恩大厅、老渡口和卡尔岩之间，骑着小马，逐渐学会看懂安都因河谷的地形。

You rode far ahead of the eastern columns along the shores of the inland sea, reading the land for threats and opportunity. The steppe gave you a horseman's eye for distance and a bowman's patience for the right moment.
你沿着内海岸边，远远走在东方队列前方，观察土地，寻找威胁和机会。草原让你有了骑手丈量距离的眼光，也让你有了弓手等待时机的耐心。
You rode in the charge at the Fords of Isen and held the line.
你参加艾森河渡口冲锋，并坚守阵线。
You rode in the charge that broke a Wainrider host before Wainwatch.
你参加了一次冲锋，在战车哨站前击溃战车民大军。
You rode in the service of Dol Guldur, commanding dark steeds and spreading terror across the southern reaches of Mirkwood.
你在多古尔都麾下骑行，驾驭黑暗坐骑，把恐惧散播到黑森林南部。
You rode in the vanguard of the Black Serpent's march north.
你骑在黑蛇北上大军的先锋中。
You rode out alone to escort a wounded messenger back to Imladris.
你独自出骑，把一名受伤信使护送回伊姆拉缀斯。
You rode out alone to escort a wounded messenger back to Mithlond.
你独自骑马出发，护送一名受伤的信使回到米斯泷德。
You rode the dry country of the Eastmarch, east of the vines, tracking raiders and wolves from the saddle and learning to loose a bow at a gallop.
你骑马行走在葡萄园东侧、东境干燥的土地上，从马背追踪劫掠者与狼，也学会在飞驰中放箭。
You rode the forest margin east of the Anduin, tracking wolves and orc-bands to their dens and learning to shoot from the saddle between the trees.
你骑马沿安都因河东岸的森林边缘巡行，追踪狼群和奥克队伍，找到它们的巢穴，也学会在树木之间从马背上放箭。
You rode through the dark woods on swift Elven steeds, learning to fight from horseback among the ancient trees of Thranduil's realm.
你骑着迅捷的精灵坐骑穿行黑暗林间，在瑟兰杜伊王国的古树之间学习马背作战。
You rode with the scouts of the Wold, ranging far across the plains to watch for threats from the East.
你随北高原斥候骑行，远远穿过平原，监视来自东方的威胁。
You run them down before they reach the treeline.
他们还没逃到林边，就被你追上了。

You sat with the shamans and healers of the Easterling clans, learning the ritual knowledge and practical medicine that kept the nomadic people alive on the open plains. Words and understanding were your tools long before any weapon.
你跟随东夷各氏族的萨满和医者，学习仪式知识和实用医术。这些本领帮助游牧民在开阔的平原上生存。早在拿起武器之前，你就已经学会靠沟通和理解来解决问题。
You saved the best of your force. That is sense.
保住最有用的兵力，这很明智。
You saved the life of a traveller that Cirdan's healers had given up on.
你救活了一名连奇尔丹的医者都已放弃救治的旅人。
You saved the life of a traveller that Elrond's healers had given up on.
你救下一名埃尔隆德医者已经放弃的旅人。
You saved the vintage of Redwater from an early frost.
你保住了红水遭早霜威胁的葡萄收成。
You saved twelve lives with a choice no one else would make.
你作了一个别人都不肯作的选择，救了十二条命。
You saved your bags and drowned your herd. Greed.
保住袋子，淹死马群，全是贪心。
You saw the danger when others hoped it away.
别人还指望危险自己消失时，你已经看清了。
You scouted the Gondorian fortress at Cair Andros and mapped its weaknesses.
你侦察刚铎凯尔安德洛斯要塞，并绘出它的弱点。

You scraped by among the broken towns of fallen Cardolan, where barrow-robbers and outlaws made their living. You learned the value of a quick hand, a well-thrown stone and a story nobody could check.
你曾在衰落的卡多蓝那些破败城镇中勉强度日，盗墓贼和法外之徒也在这里讨生活。你学会了手脚要快、石头要扔得准，还要会编没人查得出真假的故事。
You scraped by in the Trollshaws, where outlaws and troll-hoard robbers made their living. You learned the value of a quick hand, a well-thrown stone and a story nobody could check.
你曾在食人妖森林勉强度日，法外之徒和偷盗食人妖宝藏的人也在这里讨生活。你学会了手脚要快、石头要扔得准，还要会编没人查得出真假的故事。

You scraped by in the contested ruins of Osgiliath, learning the lethal economy of street-fighting and the value of a well-thrown stone. Survival in that half-drowned maze of broken stone shaped you into someone who could improvise anything from nothing.
你在反复争夺的欧斯吉利亚斯废墟中艰难求生，学会了街头搏杀的残酷规矩，也明白一块投得准的石头有多大价值。在那片半淹没的碎石迷宫中求生，把你磨成了能无中生有的人。
You scraped by on the wharves of Tharbad, where smugglers and cutpurses made their living among the barges. You learned the value of a quick hand, a well-thrown stone and a story nobody could check.
你曾在沙巴德码头勉强度日，走私贩和扒手也在驳船之间讨生活。你学会了手脚要快、石头要扔得准，还要会编没人查得出真假的故事。
You seek the finest warriors our people can offer? Name them, and they are yours — for the right price.
你想要我们最精锐的战士？选出你要的人，只要出得起价，他们就归你指挥。
You seize the envoy. {HOST} will not forget it: the next host of its side rides against your kingdom first.
你扣押了使者，{HOST}不会忘记这件事：对方下一支大军会优先进攻你的国家。
You sell anyone. Why would I think I am safe?
谁你都肯卖，我凭什么觉得自己安全？
You sent your own kin to a wizard. Spare me the excuses.
你把同族送给巫师，别找借口了。
You serve in your commander's line. Take your place in the fight.
你在指挥官麾下服役，去战斗吧。

You served as a sentinel on the sun-baked battlements of Harad's fortified cities, learning to scan the shimmering horizon for enemy movement and to direct arrow fire against raiders from the desert fringe.
你在哈拉德设防城市被太阳晒烫的城垛上担任哨兵，学会扫视闪动热浪中的地平线，寻找敌人动向，并指挥箭雨打击沙漠边缘的劫掠者。
You served as a sentry at the halls of Cirdan, learning to read the land and anticipate threats before they could reach the Grey Havens.
你在奇尔丹的殿堂担任哨兵，学会观察地形，在威胁抵达灰港之前就察觉它们。
You served as a sentry at the halls of Elrond, learning to read the land and anticipate threats before they could reach the hidden valley.
你在埃尔隆德厅堂担任哨兵，学会观察土地，在威胁抵达隐秘山谷前预先察觉。

You served as lookout and scout-sailor, learning to read the sea and chart a course through the dangerous waters of the Bay of Belfalas. What you spotted from the masthead determined whether a raid succeeded or became a catastrophe.
你担任瞭望手和侦察水手，学习读懂海面，并在贝尔法拉斯湾危险水域中规划航路。你从桅顶看见什么，决定一场袭击是成功还是变成灾难。
You served in the garrison of Cameth Brin, keeping the night watch on its tower and learning the craft of siege defence from captains who had held it against the orcs of the mountains.
你曾在卡梅斯布林的驻军服役，夜里守卫高塔，并向那些抵挡过山中奥克进攻的队长学习守城本领。
You served in the garrison of Caras Gorthad, keeping the night watch on its walls and learning the craft of siege defence from captains who had held them against the wild men of the south.
你曾在卡拉斯戈沙德的驻军服役，夜里守卫城墙，并向那些抵挡过南方野人进攻的队长学习守城本领。
You served in the garrison of Fornost Erain, keeping the night watch on its walls and learning the craft of siege defence from captains who had held them against Angmar.
你曾在佛诺斯特·埃莱因的驻军服役，夜里守卫城墙，并向那些抵挡过安格玛进攻的队长学习守城本领。
You served in the garrison of Gundabad, defending the forges and tunnels from intruders with bow and spear.
你在贡达巴德守军中服役，用弓和矛保卫熔炉与隧道不受入侵者侵犯。
You served in the garrison of Minas Tirith, defending the White City's walls and learning the art of siege defense from its veteran commanders.
你曾在米那斯提力斯守军中服役，保卫白城城墙，并向老练指挥官学习围城防御之道。
You served in the garrison of Moria, defending the forges and tunnels from intruders with bow and spear.
你在墨瑞亚的守军中服役，用弓和长矛守卫锻炉与隧道，抵御入侵者。
You served in the garrison of Seagate, shooting from the wall at raiders on the Sea of Rhûn and learning how a few bowmen can hold a harbour.
你曾在海门的驻军服役，从城墙上向鲁恩内海的劫掠者放箭，学会几个弓手该如何守住一座港口。
You served in the garrison of Wainwatch, shooting from its wall and learning tactics and discipline from the captains who watch the eastern plain.
你曾在战车哨站的驻军服役，从城墙上放箭，向那些监视东方平原的队长学习战术与纪律。
You served in the garrison that watches the High Pass, shooting from the rocks at goblin raiders and learning how a few bowmen can hold a narrow way.
你曾在看守高隘口的驻军中服役，从岩石间向半兽人劫掠者放箭，学会几个弓手该如何守住一条狭道。
You served in the harbor garrisons of Umbar, defending the docks and learning the art of coastal defense.
你在乌姆巴尔港口守军中服役，保卫码头，并学习海岸防御之道。

You served in the healing rooms of Lindon, learning herb-lore and the arts of mending under the guidance of Cirdan's healers. Tending to weary travellers and wounded Elves gave you both knowledge and the empathy that comes with it.
你在林顿的医馆中帮忙，在奇尔丹的医者指导下学习药草知识和治疗方法。照料疲惫的旅人和受伤的精灵，让你学会医术，也更懂得体谅别人。

You served in the healing rooms of Rivendell, learning herb-lore and the arts of mending under the guidance of Elrond's healers. Tending to weary travellers and wounded Elves gave you both knowledge and the empathy that comes with it.
你在幽谷疗愈室中服侍，在埃尔隆德医者指导下学习草药知识和治伤技艺。照料疲惫旅人和受伤精灵，让你既获得知识，也拥有由此而来的同理心。

You served in the masthead and scout-boats of the Corsair fleet, reading tides and spotting prey across open water while learning to loose a bow from a pitching deck. What you saw decided whether a raid went ahead or was abandoned.
你在海盗舰队的桅顶和侦察小船上服役，读懂潮汐，在开阔水面上发现猎物，也学会在摇晃甲板上放箭。你的观察决定一场袭击是开始还是放弃。
You served in the warrens of Blue Craig, defending the forges and tunnels from intruders with bow and spear.
你在蓝岩的巢窟中服役，用弓和长矛守卫锻炉与隧道，抵御入侵者。
You served in the warrens of Goblin-town, defending the forges and tunnels from intruders with bow and spear.
你在半兽人镇的巢窟中服役，用弓和长矛守卫锻炉与隧道，抵御入侵者。
You served on the wall of the Forest Gate, shooting from the platforms at wolves and goblins on the road below and learning how few bowmen can hold a narrow way.
你曾在森林之门的围墙上服役，从平台上向下方道路的狼和半兽人放箭，学会几个弓手该如何守住一条狭道。
You served under the banners of Lindon, training in mounted combat and the graceful Elven martial arts to defend the Grey Havens.
你在林顿的旗帜下效力，学习骑战和优雅的精灵武艺，为保卫灰港做好准备。
You served under the banners of Rivendell, training in mounted combat and the graceful Elven martial arts to defend the Last Homely House.
你在幽谷旗帜下服役，学习骑战和优雅的精灵武艺，以守护最后家园。

You shadowed the Rangers of Ithilien as a youngster, learning to move without sound through the overgrown gardens east of the Anduin. You strung your first bow before you were tall enough to draw it properly and learned to read boot-prints in the mud.
你年少时跟随伊希利恩游侠，在安都因河东岸荒废花园中学习无声移动。你还没高到能稳稳拉弓时就给第一张弓上了弦，也学会在泥地里读出靴印。
You shamed your elders before the hall and call it ambition.
你当众羞辱长辈，倒管这叫雄心。
You shored up the lower mine galleries after a partial collapse.
你在局部塌方后加固了下层矿廊。
You shot three Orcs from a flet at night during a border incursion.
边境遭袭的夜里，你从树台上射杀三个奥克。
You shot your commander. What will you do to me?
你连指挥官都射，又会怎么对我？
You showed mercy when mercy was all you had. That is not treason.
你手里只剩怜悯，却仍给了别人。这不是叛变。
You shrug off wounds that would fell lesser beings. +6 health.
足以击倒弱者的伤势，你也能硬扛过去。+6 生命值。
You shut out hill families and called it arithmetic.
把山里的百姓关在门外，也叫算账？
You shut out your own people and call it arithmetic.
把自己的百姓关在门外，也叫算账？
You shut your own crew in with a monster. Brave, or cruel?
你把自己人和怪物关在一起，是勇敢，还是残忍？

You slipped beyond Lindon's borders as often as you could, exploring the Tower Hills and the shores of the Gulf of Lune. You developed a taste for risk and discovered that you could survive on cunning where a sword would only bring trouble.
你一有机会就偷偷越过林顿边界，探索塔丘和路恩湾沿岸。你逐渐喜欢上冒险，也发现有些地方动剑只会惹来麻烦，靠头脑反而能活下去。

You slipped beyond Rivendell's borders as often as you could, exploring the Trollshaws and the valleys of the Misty Mountains. You developed a taste for risk and discovered that you could survive on cunning where a sword would only bring trouble.
你常常溜出幽谷边境，探索食人妖森林和迷雾山脉谷地。你渐渐喜欢上风险，也发现有时靠狡猾就能活下去，而拔剑只会惹来麻烦。
You slipped through Dol Guldur's outer pickets and returned with a prisoner count.
你穿过多古尔都外围哨线，带回了囚犯数量。
You smash through fortified lines. +6 health.
你能冲破坚固的防线。+6 生命值。
You smash through gates and men alike. +10% armour penetration.
你能砸穿城门，也能砸碎敌人。+10% 破甲。
You sold men. I will not forget it, however polite you are.
你贩卖过人口。再怎么彬彬有礼，我也不会忘。
You sold out your own people. I should check my purse.
你把自己人都卖了，我该看看钱袋还在不在。
You sold the Elves slag and shamed your whole people.
你拿矿渣冒铁卖给精灵，丢了全族的脸。
You sold the road to smugglers. Next it will be orcs.
你把道路的底细卖给走私贩，下回就该卖给奥克了。
You sold to the elves. You will sell to me.
你肯卖给精灵，也就肯卖给我。
You sold your own coast and want me to trust you with mine?
你卖了自己的海岸，还想让我把我的交给你？
You sold your own hold. Why should I be spared the same?
你出卖了自己的堡垒，凭什么不会同样出卖我？
You sold your own kin for dwarf silver.
为了一点矮人白银，你就出卖同族。
You sold your own kin's wagons to thieves.
你把自家族人的货车出卖给了贼。
You sold your own tunnels. Why would you not sell me?
你连自己的地道都卖，怎么会不出卖我？

You spent your adolescence running errands and learning accounts in the tiered market halls of the White City. You quickly learned the art of the deal, flattering merchants and counting coin in the shadow of the White Tower.
少年时，你在白城层层市场大厅里跑腿、学账目。你很快学会了交易手腕，会奉承商人，也会在白塔阴影下清点钱币。

You spent your formative years learning the craft-arts and histories preserved in Lindon, working alongside master artisans and loremasters. Long evenings of talk sharpened your tongue and your understanding of the world's deep past.
你在成长时期学习林顿保存的工艺和历史，与工匠大师及博学者一起钻研。漫长的夜谈锻炼了你的口才，也加深了你对这个世界久远历史的理解。

You spent your formative years learning the craft-arts and histories preserved in Rivendell, working alongside master artisans and loremasters. Long evenings of talk sharpened your tongue and your understanding of the world's deep past.
你在幽谷度过成长岁月，学习这里保存的工艺技艺和历史，与大师级工匠、学识大师一同工作。漫长夜谈磨利了你的舌头，也加深了你对世界远古过去的理解。

You spent your youth at the smith's bench in Nogrod, learning to work the iron of the Blue Mountains in forges older than any kingdom of Men. When the work was done you carried finished blades to the Elves of Lindon, who paid in silver and in patience.
年轻时，你在诺格罗德的铁匠台前学艺，在比任何人类王国都古老的锻炉中，学习锻打蓝色山脉的铁。活做完后，你把成品刀剑送给林顿精灵，他们用银子付账，也耐心与你打交道。

You spent your youth at the smith's bench, learning to work metal in the blazing heart of the Lonely Mountain. You mastered the values of craft and trade, carrying finished blades to the markets of Dale when the light faded on the forge.
你少年时在铁匠台边度过，在孤山炽热核心学习金属加工。你掌握了工艺和贸易的价值，熔炉光芒暗下时还会把成品刀剑送往河谷邦市场。

You spent your youth carrying ledgers and running errands in the market of Bree, where every road in Eriador seems to meet. You learned to bargain with Dwarves, flatter Hobbits and never trust a Southerner's scales.
年轻时，你在布理集市抱着账簿跑腿，埃利阿多的每条路似乎都会在这里交汇。你学会了和矮人讲价、哄霍比特人高兴，还知道绝不能轻信南方人的秤。

You spent your youth carrying ledgers and running errands in the market of Tharbad, where the roads and the river meet. You learned to bargain with bargemen, flatter Dwarves and never trust a Dunlending's scales.
年轻时，你在沙巴德集市抱着账簿跑腿，道路与河流就在这里交汇。你学会了和船夫讲价、哄矮人高兴，还知道绝不能轻信黑蛮地人的秤。

You spent your youth carrying tallies and running errands at the trading post of the Last Bridge, where the East Road meets the hill country. You learned to bargain with Dwarves, flatter hill-chiefs and never trust a stranger's weights.
年轻时，你在最后大桥的商站拿着账目跑腿，东大道就在这里通向山地。你学会了和矮人讲价、哄山民酋长高兴，还知道绝不能轻信陌生人的砝码。
You spent your youth counting carts and bales at the Old Ford market, learning to bargain with Woodmen, Elves and the occasional Dwarf, and to know a fair price from a quick tongue.
年轻时，你在老渡口集市清点货车和一捆捆货物，学会与林中居民、精灵，以及偶尔来访的矮人讲价，也听得出哪些是公道价，哪些只是花言巧语。

You spent your youth learning the art of mounted war among the king's household at Vidugard, where the old riders taught you to keep your seat, your spear and your temper through a long day in the saddle.
年轻时，你在维杜加德的王家亲随中学习骑战。老骑兵教你在马背上熬过漫长的一天，坐得稳、拿稳矛，也稳住自己的脾气。

You spent your youth learning the art of mounted war in service to one of the marshals of the Riddermark, drilling with lance and sword in the wide grasslands of Rohan. Horsemanship was not taught in the Riddermark — it was breathed.
你少年时侍奉里德马克一位元帅，学习马背战争，在洛汗广阔草地上用骑枪和刀剑操练。在里德马克，骑术不是教出来的，而是像呼吸一样自然。

You spent your youth minding the flocks across the wind-scoured hillsides of Dunland, and when the call came you were handed a spear and shoved into the levy. The hills made you tough and the levy made you dangerous.
你少年时在黑蛮地风吹山坡上照看羊群；号召来临时，一支长矛被塞到你手里，你也被推入征召队伍。丘陵让你变得坚韧，征召则让你变得危险。
You spent your youth tallying logs and planks in the timber yards of Woodmen-town, learning to bargain with Beornings and caravan-masters and to tell sound wood from rot.
年轻时，你在林中居民镇的木料场清点原木和木板，学会与贝奥恩一族和商队领队讲价，也能分清好木料与朽木。
You spotted a Gondorian naval trap before your fleet sailed into it.
你在舰队驶入陷阱前发现了刚铎海军埋伏。
You stand a round of {DRINK} for the whole house. Word of it will spread.
你请在场所有人喝了一轮{DRINK}，这件事很快就会传开。
You stand a round of {DRINK} for your company. Good cheer goes round (recent events morale +{MORALE}).
你请部队喝了一轮{DRINK}，大家兴致高涨（近期事件士气 +{MORALE}）。
You stand far from the Sea of Rhûn, stranger, and far from any friend. Our bows are drawn and our patience is short. Leave your silver on the ground and keep walking.
你离鲁恩内海很远，外乡人，附近也没有朋友能帮你。我们的弓已经拉开，耐心可不多。把银子放在地上，接着往前走。
You starved a fortress to fatten your purse.
你为了鼓起自己的钱袋，让一座要塞的人挨饿。
You starved a garrison to fatten your purse.
你为了鼓起自己的钱袋，让驻军挨饿。
You starved the tower to line your pockets.
你为了往自己兜里塞钱，让塔里的人挨饿。
You stayed back while the column fought, and your share of the battle's due was cut.
队伍作战时，你没有参战，因此被扣掉了一部分应得的战斗报酬。
You stood guard over the gates and walls of Edoras, learning tactics and discipline in service of the Golden Hall.
你守卫埃多拉斯的城门和城墙，学习战术和纪律，侍奉金殿。

You stood shoulder to shoulder with your kinsmen in the disciplined Easterling spear line, learning to brace against cavalry and advance in ordered ranks under the red dawn banners that had marched west before.
你与族人肩并肩站在纪律严明的东夷长矛阵中，学习抵住骑兵冲锋，并在曾向西进军的红色黎明旗帜下整列推进。

You stood the long quiet vigils on the high platforms among the mallorn branches, learning to read the forest below and loose silver-tipped arrows with deadly calm. The endless patience of those watches shaped your eye and stilled your hand.
你在瑁珑枝间高台上度过漫长安静的守望，学习读懂下方森林，并以致命的冷静射出银尖箭。无尽的耐心塑造了你的眼睛，也让你的手稳下来。

You stood the long, still watches on the high platforms among the mallorn branches, your silver bow drawn across the threshold of the veiled borders. Nothing passed the Galadhrim wardens unseen — and you intended to keep it that way.
你在瑁珑树枝间的高台上度过漫长而寂静的守望，银弓横在隐秘边界之前。没有任何东西能在加拉兹民守卫眼下通过，而你决心让它一直如此。
You stood the watch at Dimrill Dale alone when your partner fell ill.
搭档病倒时，你独自守住黯溪谷哨位。
You stood with King Brand at the Battle of Dale.
你在河谷之战中与布兰德国王并肩而立。
You stood with the ranks of Lindon's warriors, mastering the spear and sword in the precise, deadly style of the High Elves.
你与林顿的战士并肩作战，掌握了高等精灵精准而致命的矛术和剑术。
You stood with the ranks of Rivendell's warriors, mastering the spear and sword in the precise, deadly style of the High Elves.
你曾与幽谷战士列阵，掌握高等精灵精准而致命的枪剑技艺。
You strike before the enemy knows you're there. Sneak-Creeping charge cost -20.
在敌人发现你之前抢先出手。潜行突进充能消耗 -20。
You strike first, always. Sneak-Creeping charge cost -30.
你永远先发制人。潜行突进充能消耗 -30。
You struck the best trade agreement with Dale in a generation.
你与河谷邦达成了一代人以来最好的贸易协议。
You struck the best trade agreement with Lindon in a generation.
你与林顿谈成了一代人以来最有利的贸易协议。

You studied the deeper arts of the Golden Wood under those closest to Galadriel's counsel, learning the songs of power and the quiet persuasion that could shift the will of lords without raising a blade. You left with gifts not easily named.
你跟随加拉德瑞尔最信任的顾问，学习金色森林更深奥的技艺。你学会了蕴含力量的歌谣，也学会了不动刀剑、只凭温和劝说就改变领主心意的本事。离开时，你已经有所收获，只是这些收获很难用言语说清。

You survived on the margins of the Dark Lord's realm, running with the quick-fingered bands who slipped past patrols and lived by theft and misdirection. You learned every shadow and every bribe-price in the shadow of the Morannon.
你在黑暗魔君领地边缘求生，跟着手脚飞快的小团伙躲过巡逻，靠偷窃和误导活下去。你学会了魔栏农阴影下的每一处黑暗角落，也知道每一笔贿赂该出什么价。

You survived on the rough margins of the harbor city, moving goods that could not be declared and acquiring skills that could not be taught in any school. The Corsair world had a place for those clever enough to see opportunities no one else had noticed.
你在港城粗暴的边缘地带活下来，搬运不能报关的货物，学会那些任何学校都不会教的本事。海盗世界总会给足够机灵、能看见别人忽略机会的人留位置。
You survived the trial of the Black Pits and were named to the Eye's legion.
你活过黑坑试炼，被编入魔眼军团。
You swing and thrust 10 percent slower.
你的挥砍与突刺速度降低10%。
You swore to guard them and left anyway. Your word was thin.
你发誓保护他们，还是走了。你的承诺也太轻了。
You swore to guard them, and you left. Words are cheap.
你发誓保护他们，却还是走了。空口承诺谁都会。
You swore to guard them, then walked away. Oaths come cheap.
你发誓保护他们，却转身走了。空口起誓谁都会。
You swore to serve, and {DAYS} days of that oath are still owed. I hold you to it.
你发誓要服役，现在还欠{DAYS}天。你必须履行誓言。

You swung a pick in the deep galleries under Mount Dolmed before your beard had grown, learning the hidden passages of the mountain and the engineering of tunnels and supports. The deep stone became as familiar to you as open sky.

You wandered the open grass without clan or hold to call your own, learning to live by wit and trade, and to read a stranger before he reached your fire.

你想让我赢下竞技大赛？

你想让他们见识真正的战斗？

You went with the caravans that moved between Dale, Erebor, and the southern kingdoms, learning the arts of commerce, survival on the road, and the opportunism that made some traders very successful and others very sorry.

你获准进入瑟兰杜伊的王庭，跟随那些从群星初升时就开始歌唱的精灵，学习外交技巧和森林精灵的歌谣。在精灵王的殿堂里，口才和剑术同样重要。
You were among the berserkers of Blue Craig, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
你曾是蓝岩狂战士中的一员，学会用不顾生死的狂怒和压倒性的蛮力作战。

你曾是贡达巴德狂战士之一，学习以不顾一切的怒火和压倒性力量作战。
You were among the berserkers of the Misty Mountains, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
你曾是迷雾山脉狂战士中的一员，学会用不顾生死的狂怒和压倒性的蛮力作战。

You were among the hunters tasked with keeping the great spiders from the Woodland Realm's heart, learning to lay snares and ambushes in the dark undergrowth and to strike with knife and hurled blade before the creatures could close with you.
你曾是负责阻止巨蛛接近林地王国核心的猎手之一，学会在黑暗灌木中设置绳套和伏击，也学会在那些怪物逼近前用短刀和飞刃先发制人。

You were apprenticed to one of the Dunedain healers who kept the knowledge of Westernesse alive in the north, learning to identify plants and treat wounds with the resources the wild lands offered. Wisdom and practical knowledge were equally revered.
你拜一位杜内丹医者为师；他们在北方保存着西方之地的知识。你学习辨认植物，也学习用荒野能提供的资源治疗伤口。智慧和实用知识同样受尊重。

You were blooded in the torch-lit training halls of the mountain stronghold, learning to ride hard and swing heavy weapons in the tradition of the northern Orc clans. Status came to those who could prove themselves in the pit before their elders.
你在山中堡垒火把照亮的训练厅里见了血，按照北方奥克氏族传统学习猛骑和挥舞重型武器。能在长辈面前先于斗坑中证明自己的人，才配得到地位。
You were born to this saddle. +9 health.
你是天生的骑手。+9 生命值。

You were cast out or wandered off, spending your formative years on the margins of Dunlending society, picking up work and trouble in equal measure. You learned that a well-aimed throw or a convincing lie could open doors that no clan-badge would.
你被驱逐，或自己离开，在黑蛮地社会边缘度过成长岁月，工作和麻烦都捡了不少。你学会一记准准的投掷或一个可信的谎言，能打开氏族徽记打不开的门。
You were chosen to train with the elite Warg Riders of Mordor, learning to control the fearsome beasts and strike terror into the hearts of the enemy.
你被选中与魔多精锐座狼骑手一同训练，学会控制这些可怕野兽，把恐惧打进敌人心里。

You were given a club and a corner of the yard and told to keep the work gangs in line. You learned fast how to read a crowd and where to hit to get compliance without killing. Strategy and brutality became second nature.
你被塞了一根棍子和院子一角，命令你把工队管住。你很快学会如何看懂人群，也学会打哪里既能让人服从，又不至于把人打死。谋略和残暴成了你的本能。

You were neither soldier nor slave, moving on the shadowed margins of Mordor's great army — stealing what you could, trading information, and learning which officers were bribeable and which were better avoided. Cunning was the only currency you trusted.
你既不是士兵，也不是奴隶，而是在魔多大军阴影边缘活动。你偷能偷的东西，交易情报，也学会分辨哪些军官可以收买，哪些最好绕着走。你唯一信得过的货币就是狡猾。

You were put to work in the pits as soon as you were strong enough, breaking rock and hauling spoil to feed Saruman's endless construction. The work built your endurance past what most men's bodies could bear.
你刚有力气就被送进深坑干活，破石、搬渣，供养萨茹曼无休止的建设。这样的工作把你的耐力推到多数人身体承受不了的程度。

You were quick-fingered and clever enough to be used as a courier and informant in the grey world of Saruman's spy networks. You learned how much a secret was worth and how much pain it cost to keep one.
你手快又聪明，因此被萨茹曼的间谍网络当作信使和线人使用。你学会一个秘密值多少钱，也学会保守秘密要付出多少痛苦。
You were right to hold the maker responsible.
造剑的人也该负责，你没做错。
You were right, and they should have listened.
你说得对，他们该听你的。

You were run through brutal drills in the packed-earth yards of Isengard, learning to wield halberd and two-hander under the eyes of Uruk-hai sergeants. Saruman's forces trained without mercy, and softness was driven out of you fast.
你在艾森加德踩实的泥土操场上经历残酷操练，在乌鲁克军士眼下学习使用戟和双手武器。萨茹曼的军队训练毫不留情，软弱很快就被你身上剥离。

You were schooled in the martial arts of Dale, learning to ride and wield heavy weapons under the instruction of Brand's household guard. The rebuilt city was prosperous and proud, and its soldiers were expected to match its reputation.
你在布兰德家中卫队指导下学习河谷邦武艺，练习骑乘和使用重型武器。重建后的城市繁荣而自豪，它的士兵也被要求配得上这份名声。
You were sent as a scout and spy, ranging across the lands to gather intelligence for Saruman's war machine.
你作为斥候和间谍被派往各地，为萨茹曼的战争机器收集情报。

You were sent into the twisted undergrowth of southern Mirkwood to track and eliminate those who strayed near the Necromancer's domain, learning to stalk quarry through corrupted forest without making a sound or leaving a print.
你被派进黑森林南部扭曲的灌木深处，追踪并清除靠近死灵法师领地的人，学会在腐化森林中无声追猎，不留下脚印。
You were spotted by {ENEMY} before you could strike - attack anyway?
你还没动手就被{ENEMY}发现了，仍要进攻吗？
You were stationed at Orthanc, manning the crossbows and defending the breeding pits from any who would oppose Saruman's will.
你驻守欧尔桑克，操作弩弓，守卫育兵深坑，抵挡任何反对萨茹曼意志的人。

You were stationed on the watchtowers and walls of Mordor's black fortresses, scanning the horizon for movement and directing fire on any who approached. The post suited those who could think as well as shoot.
你驻守在魔多黑色要塞的瞭望塔和城墙上，盯着地平线寻找动静，并指挥火力打击任何接近者。这个岗位适合既会思考也会射击的人。

You were taken in hand by the Rangers of the North while still young, learning to move through the wild lands of Eriador in silence and track enemies across ruined Arnor. The Rangers asked little and demanded everything, and you learned to give it.
你年纪还小时，就被北方游民带在身边，学习在埃利阿多荒野中悄无声息地行进，在阿尔诺的废墟间追踪敌人。游民们不向你索取太多东西，要求的却是你全心全意的付出。你也学会了这么做。

You were taken into the company of the Dunedain Rangers, learning to ride hard through the ruins of Arnor and fight with the disciplined ferocity of the Heirs of Isildur. The Rangers rode far and told little to any they met on the road.
你被纳入杜内丹游侠队伍，学会在阿尔诺废墟中疾驰，并以伊熙尔杜后裔的严明和凶猛作战。游侠骑得很远，却很少对路上遇见的人多说什么。

You were taken to sea young, learning to hand a sail and fight with the cutlass and boarding axe of the Corsair tradition. The deck of a warship was your training ground, and the Anduin Delta was your proving ground.
你年纪很小时就被带上海，学习掌帆，也学习海盗传统中的弯刀和登船斧。战船甲板是你的训练场，安都因三角洲则是你的试炼地。

You were thrown into the pit-fighting yards of the Dark Tower as soon as you could hold a weapon. The older warriors showed no mercy, and you learned quickly that hesitation meant pain. Pain taught you to strike first and strike hard.
你刚能握住武器，就被丢进邪黑塔的斗坑训练场。年长战士毫不留情，你很快学会犹豫就意味着疼痛。疼痛教会你先出手，而且要下狠手。

You were used as a courier and agent in the Necromancer's network, carrying messages through the dark wood and delivering them to contacts who never showed their faces. You learned that shadows were your armor and silence your best weapon.
你被死灵法师的网络当作信使和代理人使用，穿过黑暗森林传递消息，交给从不露面的联系人。你学会阴影就是甲胄，沉默就是最好的武器。
You were wounded and stayed back while the column fought.
你因受伤没有参加队伍的战斗。
You won the Dwarves of the Blue Mountains as partners in trade.
你促成了与蓝色山脉矮人的贸易合作。
You won the Dwarves of the Iron Hills as partners in trade.
你促成了与铁丘陵矮人的贸易合作。
You won the Great Mountain Tournament and were named a warchief's retainer.
你赢下大山比武，被任命为战酋随从。
You worked from dawn to dusk among the hives and herds below the Carrock, hauling water and mending fences. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在卡尔岩下的蜂箱和牛群间从早忙到晚，挑水、修篱笆。征召开始时，别人递给你一杆长矛，教你守住阵线。

You worked from dawn to dusk in the clearings around Thornhold, hauling stumps and driving cattle out of the shadow of the trees. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在荆棘堡周围的林间空地从早干到晚，搬走树桩，把牛群赶出树荫。征召开始时，别人递给你一杆长矛，教你守住阵线。
You worked from dawn to dusk on the cold farms below Fornost, hauling stone and driving sheep across the downs. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在佛诺斯特下方寒冷的农场，从早到晚搬石头、赶羊群走过丘岗。征召开始时，别人递给你一杆长矛，教你守住阵线。
You worked from dawn to dusk on the farms between the rivers, hauling grain and driving cattle to the fords. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在两河之间的农场从早干到晚，搬运粮食，赶着牛群去渡口。征召开始时，别人递给你一杆长矛，教你守住阵线。

You worked from dawn to dusk on the high fells, driving flocks between the summer and winter pastures and keeping the wolves off them. When the levy was called you were handed an axe and taught to hold a line.
你曾在高地从早干到晚，赶着羊群往返于夏牧场和冬牧场，提防狼来捕食。征召开始时，别人递给你一把斧头，教你守住阵线。

You worked the black-iron forges of Dol Guldur, learning to shape weapons under conditions that would break a lesser youth. The materials were dark and the methods darker, and you left with knowledge that few would admit to having.
你在多古尔都黑铁熔炉中工作，在足以压垮普通年轻人的条件下学习塑造武器。材料黑暗，手段更黑暗，而你带着很少有人愿意承认拥有的知识离开。

You worked the terraced gardens of Imladris, learning patience and diligence from Elves who had tended those same beds for an age. Between rows you practiced swordplay, finding that tending living things gave you an instinct for measured force.
你在伊姆拉缀斯的梯田花园中劳作，向照料这些苗床已有一个纪元之久的精灵学习耐心和勤勉。你也在田垄之间练剑，并发现照看生命会让人懂得何时用力、用多大力。

You worked the terraced gardens of Mithlond, learning patience and diligence from Elves who had tended those same beds for an age. Between rows you practiced swordplay, finding that tending living things gave you an instinct for measured force.
你在米斯泷德层层铺开的花园中劳作，向那些照料同一片园地多年的精灵学习耐心和勤勉。你也会在花畦间练习剑术，照料花草的经验让你逐渐学会恰到好处地运用力道。

You worked your family's pastures in the Westfold, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk, and were pressed into levy service as soon as you were tall enough for the spear. The rolling plains of western Rohan were your school.
你在西伏尔德自家牧场劳作，几乎刚会走路就开始接触马匹，等长到能握住长矛时便被征召服役。洛汗西部起伏平原就是你的学校。
You worked your family's pastures on the Northmark, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk. When the levy was called you took a spear and a place in the line.
你在北境的家族牧场干活，几乎还没学会走路，就开始学习照料马匹。征召开始时，你拿起长矛，站进队伍。
You would have me fight in the lists?
你想让我替你出战比武场？
You would leave a lord in rags, before his own people's eyes? Think what it will cost you.
你要让一位领主穿着破衣烂衫，出现在自己的人民面前？想想你要付出什么代价。
You wove a ceremonial cloak that the Lady of the Wood presented as a gift.
你织出一件森林夫人用作赠礼的仪式斗篷。

You'd be surprised how battles turn on knowing the land. Every scene I craft teaches me terrain, sightlines, and strategic advantage. The Wold bred warriors who read the earth itself. Shall I ride with you?
你会惊讶于战局多么依赖对地形的理解。我塑造的每个场景，都教会我地势、视线与战略优势。北高原养出了能读懂大地的战士。我可以与你并骑吗？

You'd be surprised. My eye for structure reveals weak points in any wall, and my knowledge of spaces gives tactical advantage. Besides, this hammer serves in battle as well as creation. Will you have me?
你会惊讶的。我对结构的眼光能看出任何墙体的弱点，对空间的理解也能带来战术优势。况且，这把锤子能用于创造，也同样能用于战斗。你愿意让我加入吗？
You're right - Gondor retreats too easily.
你说得对，刚铎人不该这么轻易就撤走的。
You, your clan and your vassals must hold more than half of its lands.
你本人、你的家族与封臣必须持有其半数以上土地。
Young Uruk from Isengard, driven from the Black Guard by jealous rivals. Seeks glory untainted by politics.
来自艾森加德的年轻乌鲁克，被嫉妒他的对手赶出黑卫队。他追求不受权谋玷污的荣耀。
Young blood seeks glory, but finds only shadow...
年轻人追寻荣耀，找到的却只有阴影……
年轻，却已经证明过自己，这是危险的组合。
Young dwarf seeking glory outside Erebor's safe walls. The world will be my testing ground.
年轻矮人，离开孤山安全的城墙寻找荣耀。世界会成为我的试炼场。
Young dwarves dream of glory their fathers already won...
年轻矮人梦想着父辈早已赢得的荣耀……
Young eyes can mistake shadows for substance.
年轻人的眼睛，也会把影子当成实物。
Young riders of Vidugard are raised on tales of great charges. Some of us learn early that the real enemy leaves no banner.
维杜加德的年轻骑手，都是听着壮烈冲锋的故事长大的。我们有些人早早就懂得，真正的敌人并不打旗号。
Young spearmen of Dale grow up on the story of the dragon's fall. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
河谷城的年轻矛手，都是听着屠龙的故事长大的。我们有些人，总想找一场同样轰轰烈烈的仗。
Young spearmen of Dorwinion grow up on the tale of Ostmar the Warden. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
多温尼安的年轻矛手，都是听着守望者奥斯特马尔的故事长大的。我们有些人，总想找一场同样轰轰烈烈的仗。
Young spearmen of the Vales grow up on the tales of Beorn. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
河谷的年轻矛手，都是听着贝奥恩的故事长大的。我们有些人，总想找一场同样轰轰烈烈的仗。
Young spearmen of the Woodmen grow up on the tales of the spiders of Emyn Duir. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
林中居民的年轻矛手，都是听着埃敏杜伊尔蜘蛛的故事长大的。我们有些人，总想找一场同样轰轰烈烈的仗。
Young, eager, and well-trained, I'll prove my worth through deeds, not lineage.
我年轻、急切，也受过良好训练。我会用行动证明价值，而不是靠血统。
Younger sons of the Dúnedain lords of the Angle grow up with a sword and no land. Some of us write our own legends to make up for it.
河角地杜内丹领主的幼子们，从小有剑却没土地。我们有些人只好自己编点英雄事迹，弥补一下。
Younger sons of the old Dúnedain houses grow up with a sword and no land. Some of us write our own legends to make up for it.
杜内丹古老家族的幼子们，从小有剑却没土地。我们有些人只好自己编点英雄事迹，弥补一下。

Youngest of seven brothers, I was always the smallest, the quickest. While they swung hammers, I learned the crossbow and the art of silence. Became lead scout for the eastern patrols, tracking orc movements through the Grey Mountains. My reports saved many lives.
我是七兄弟里最小的，一直也是最矮、最快的那个。他们挥锤时，我学会了弩和沉默的本事。后来我成了东部巡逻队的首席斥候，在灰色山脉追踪奥克动向。我的报告救过许多命。

你已针对{ENEMY}布下埋伏，现在动手吗？

你的弓兵准度提高20%，开弓速度提高10%。

你的弓手会掩护每一次推进。+4% 部队伤害。

你的弓手射出的箭矢遮天蔽日。+6% 部队伤害。
Your archers draw 20 percent faster and reload 15 percent faster.
你的弓兵开弓速度提高20%，装填速度提高15%。

你的弓手放箭精准得像机械一样。+4% 部队伤害。
你的弓兵装填速度降低10%。

你的弓兵受到的伤害增加10%。

你的护甲像河流一样坚韧不息。+10% 远程抗性。
Your arms and armour are mine now.
你的武器和盔甲现在归我了。
Your arrival steadies the warhost. +3% troop morale.
你的到来能稳住战团。+3% 部队士气。
Your arrows carry vile toxins. Voice of the One radius +3.
你的箭矢带有恶毒毒素。至尊魔戒之声作用范围 +3。
Your arrows fly without deviation. +6% ranged damage.
你的箭矢飞行毫无偏差。+6% 远程伤害。
Your beast keeps its legs in the hardest fights. +10% horse health.
你的坐骑在最艰苦的战斗中也不会轻易倒下。+10% 坐骑生命值。
Your blade will find plenty of work out here.
你的刀在外面会有很多活儿可干。
Your blow lands with the force of a battering ram. +10% melee damage.
你的重击有攻城锤般的力量。+10% 近战伤害。
Your blows carry the fury of the Dark Lord. +12% melee damage.
你的攻击带着黑暗魔君的怒火。+12% 近战伤害。
Your blows shatter guard formations. +5% swing speed.
你的重击能砸碎敌人的防御阵型。+5% 挥砍速度。
Your blows shatter shields and men alike. +6% melee damage.
你的重击会砸碎盾牌和敌人。+6% 近战伤害。
Your body endures the harshest rides. +5 health.
你的身体经得住最艰苦的奔袭。+5 生命值。
Your body shrugs off wounds that would kill smaller folk. +10% resistance to ranged.
足以杀死矮小种族的伤口，你的身体也能硬扛过去。+10% 远程抗性。
Your campaign begins without a camp: {REASON}
己方占领进度正在回退：{PERCENT}%

你的职业经过重新设计，已退还职业选项。
Your caution was bought dearly, and so was your bow.
你这份谨慎和弓术，都是付过大代价才换来的。
你的骑兵造成的伤害提高8%。
Your cavalry gain 15 experience each day.
你的骑兵每天获得15点经验。
你的骑兵受到的伤害降低12%。

你的咏唱会动摇敌人。+10% 部队抗性。

你的冲锋会冲散敌军阵型。+13% 坐骑冲锋伤害。

你的冲锋无法阻挡。+15% 坐骑冲锋伤害。

你的冲锋会摧毁沿途的一切。+15% 坐骑冲锋伤害。

你的冲锋会冲散敌军阵型。+13% 坐骑冲锋伤害。
